articleTitle: First-order all-optical spectral phase transition from coupled optical parametric oscillators
abstract: We demonstrate first-order phase transition in coupled optical parametric oscillators corresponding to an abrupt transition from degenerate to non-degenerate oscillation at a critical cavity detuning which can be utilized for enhanced sensing, and information processing.

articleTitle: Integrated 2-µm electro-optic modulator based on grapheme-silicon slot-waveguide microring resonator
abstract: We demonstrated a hybrid integrated 2-µm electro-optic (E/O) modulator based on graphene-silicon slot-waveguide microring resonator, with 4 dB modulation depth and >20 GHz modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Dual Comb Ranging and Rotation Sensing with Orbital Angular Momentum
abstract: We demonstrate a dual comb ranging system capable of simultaneously measuring the distance to a target and the transverse rotation rate of the target by preparing the probe comb with orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Needle probe for accurate prostate cancer diagnosis - Results on fresh biopsy cores
abstract: A Raman Spectroscopy probe is used to discriminate between healthy and cancerous prostate tissue. Results from ex vivo human biopsy tissue are presented. Results show excellent classification performance between the different types of tissue

articleTitle: Experimental Probing of Atmospheric Turbulence Along the Propagation Direction Using a Single Transmitter Aperture and Multiple Pairs of Longitudinally Structured Beams
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the probing of turbulence along the propagation direction by transmitting multiple complementary pairs of longitudinally structured beams between a single transmitter/receiver aperture pair. The results show probing errors could be reduced by >~25% when using pairs of beams compared to using only one type of beam.

articleTitle: Generation of Structured 3D Linear Space-time Light Bullets Using Nonlocal Nanophotonics
abstract: We propose the generation of 3D linear light bullets propagating in free space using a single passive optical surface. Our approach provides simultaneous control of various properties including group velocity, spin, and orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Chiral State Transfer in the Vicinity of a Non-Hermitian Singularity
abstract: The parametric steering of a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian on closed loops excluding the exceptional point is studied. It is shown that a combination of topology and shape of the Riemann surfaces governs the topological state transfer.

articleTitle: SiN-based waveguides with ultra-low thermo-optic effect
abstract: We demonstrate SiN-based passive waveguides with ultra-low thermo-optic effect, based on a novel waveguiding mechanism that confines light in the lower index of refraction. We demonstrate broadband operation over at least 200nm, with less than 0.01% change in the index over 200 degrees.

articleTitle: Dissipative soliton generation and interaction in Chimera laser cavities
abstract: We theoretically unveil the mode-locking principle in microresonator-filtered laser cavities and predict chirped bright soliton with normal-dispersion microresonators. With ultrahigh-speed time magnifier, we experimentally observe real-time soliton rain harmonics and the first soliton Newton's cradle.

articleTitle: Tailor-made 3D Vectorial Optical Fields in Simple Media
abstract: A general framework for designing vectorial optical fields based on Maxwell’s equations is proposed. This approach is then verified experimentally by generating various beams; for example, a beam that propagates in free space and splits into two branches having orthogonal polarization states.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Engineered Low Power Thermo-Optic Silicon Phase Shifter
abstract: We present a fast response, energy-efficient thermo-optic silicon phase shifter based on Non-Hermitian engineering. A 500 kHz bandwidth and a 1.72 mW π-phase-shift (Pπ) power consumption are demonstrated at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Active Tuning of Dispersive-Wave Emission from Kerr Solitons
abstract: We demonstrate an approach using coupled-ring microresonators with integrated heaters to actively tune the spectral location of a dispersive wave associated with a Kerr soliton by more than 110 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of single-photon detectors with low-loss reconfigurable LNOI optical circuits
abstract: We integrate electro-optic modulators and superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors on a single low-loss Lithium-Niobate-On-Insulator device. We show single photon detection at modulation frequency up to 1 GHz and static reconfigurability with an optimal bias-drift-free operation.

articleTitle: Studying the interaction of J-aggregates with plasmonic nanoparticles using hyperspectral microscopy
abstract: Utilizing a combination of hyperspectral measurements and sorting K-means algorithms, we study coupled J-aggregate–plasmonic nanostructures system. The effect of proximity and cover ratio of the J- aggregates on the plasmonic resonance is shown and modeled.

articleTitle: Resonant Acousto-optic Modulator using Thin-film Lithium Niobate on Sapphire
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated acousto-optic phase modulator using thin-film lithium niobate on sapphire. The phase modulation is strongly enhanced by a high-Q acoustic resonance at 700 MHz and leading to several higher-order optical sidebands.

articleTitle: Branched Flow of Light in Curved Space
abstract: We present the theoretical and experimental study of branched flow of light in curved space.

articleTitle: Self-Compression in Single-Domain KTP at 1 micron in a Normal Dispersion Regime
abstract: We demonstrate self-compression of 173 fs pulses centered at 1030 nm down to 19.5 fs through electro-optic phase modulation by the phonon-polariton waves generated in a phase-matched intra-pulse difference-frequency mixing.

articleTitle: Breaking the Q-S limitation between the fundamental and high order modes on multimode silicon photonic crystal nanobeam cavity
abstract: We theoretically demonstrated breaking the quality factor-sensitivity (Q-S) limitation between the fundamental and higher order modes on a multimode silicon photonic crystal nanobeam cavity. Ultra-strong side-surface localizations benefited high-Q and high-overlap-integration resonances were achieved, simultaneously.

articleTitle: Modeling of Nonlinear Propagation of Femtosecond Laser Pulse in Air for Laser Ablation
abstract: We have developed a model to simulate the nonlinear propagation of ultrashort laser pulse in air, incorporating the effects of self-focusing and air ionization, and have succeeded in quantitatively predicting the ablation radius of copper.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Detection of Quantum Many-Body Localization Phase Transition
abstract: We propose a scheme for detection of quantum many-body phase transitions using unsupervised machine learning. We validate it on simulated 1D Bose-Hubbard model, and then use it on an experimental 2D system undergoing many-body localization.

articleTitle: FPGA Investigation of Enumerative Sphere Shaping for Probabilistically Shaped 64QAM
abstract: We investigate the implementation of enumerative sphere shaping (ESS) algorithm in real-time PS-64QAM system for the first time. Experiments achieved 0.08dB/0.02dB SNR gain under strong/weak shaping situation with much larger power consumption compared with HiDM.

articleTitle: Coherent Shaping of an Octave Spanning Supercontinuum
abstract: We optimize the intensity of six wavelengths in a supercontinuum by tuning the dispersion of a chirped fiber Bragg grating. The phase stability between wavelengths exceeds that of most optical clocks.

articleTitle: Optical Microcavities Stabilized using Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate telecom-wavelength microcavities stabilized by dielectric metasurfaces. The approach achieves microcavities with quality factors exceeding 3300 using prevalent semiconductor manufacturing processes and opens the near-arbitrary field control of metasurfaces to cavity electrodynamics.

articleTitle: Nanosensitive Optical Coherence Tomography for Tracking of Mesenchymal Stem Cells Labelled With Gold Nanostars
abstract: We demonstrate the capability of nsOCT technique to discern MSC pellets labelled with different concentrations of nanostars. Useful to track stem cell differentiation and interpret the mechanism by which stem cells deliver their therapeutic effect.

articleTitle: Novel illumination for imaging using self-modulated coherent random fiber laser
abstract: A self-modulated coherent random fiber laser is proposed for both memory-effect-based imaging and ghost imaging, filling the gap that the two imaging scenarios haven’t been realized using a same light source.

articleTitle: Integrated optical gyroscope with inverse weak value amplification
abstract: We apply inverse weak value amplification to an integrated Sagnac interferometer gyroscope. We demonstrate rotation measurement with the weak value gyroscope.

articleTitle: Lensed MMF and SMF coupling of tri-mode VCSEL for 62-Gbps OOK and 164-Gbps OFDM transmission
abstract: The non-tilting lensed-MMF/SMF coupling of tri-mode VCSEL with D factor of 14 GHz/mA<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sup> is demonstrated to provide root-mean-square linewidth of 0.66/0.54 nm and mode-partition-noise of -145/-140 dBc/Hz for error-free 62-/58-Gbit/s NRZ-OOK and 164-/140-Gbit/ s 16-QAM-OFDM transmission.

articleTitle: Multimode Diamond Cavity Optomechanics
abstract: We perform multimode optomechanical spectroscopy of diamond microdisk cavity optomechanical devices, and observe mechanical modes with frequencies between 1 and 5 GHz with mechanical Q up to 14,000.

articleTitle: RF-Injection Controlled Quantum Cascade Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate the manipulation of the quantum cascade laser output state using microwave-injection. In the spectral domain, the optical bandwidth can be doubled, whereas in the time-domain, we observe narrow, approximately 1 ps wide features.

articleTitle: Surface Acoustic Wave Microwave Photonic Filters in Silicon-on-Insulator with 16 and 32 Taps
abstract: Integrated, discrete time microwave filters are realized in surface acoustic wave photonic devices in standard silicon on insulator. The devices are scaled to 16 and 32 taps. A single 7 MHz-wide passband is demonstrated.

Author Keywords: (060.5625) Fiber optics and optical communications, radio frequency photonics

articleTitle: Helicity- and Azimuthal-Dependent Topological Photocurrents in Bi2Se3 using THz Spectroscopy
abstract: Enhancement of helicity-dependent topological photocurrents in epitaxially-grown Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> with reduced twinning is investigated with polarization-sensitive time-domain THz spectroscopy. Strong dependence of the circular and linear photogalvanic effects are observed to correlate with the azimuthal angle.

articleTitle: 56 dB Parametric Gain in AlGaAs-on-insulator Nanowaveguides
abstract: We demonstrate broadband optical parametric amplification in an 11-mm-long AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguide with pulsed pumping at 1550 nm. We achieve a net on-chip gain of 56 dB, the highest demonstrated parametric gain in integrated platforms.

articleTitle: Telecom-Wavelength Bright Single Photon Sources with Post-Selected Indistinguishability
abstract: We demonstrate a bright telecom-wavelength single photon source based on a tapered nanobeam containing InAs/InP quantum dots. We obtain a first-lens brightness of 21.0% and a post-selected Hong-Ou-Mandel visibility of 0.91 in the telecom O-band.

articleTitle: Complete Coupling of Light into Surface Polaritons
abstract: We show that a small scatterer placed at a suitable distance from a given surface can couple light completely into the surface modes supported by the surface, under illumination by an adequately modulated field.

articleTitle: Towards CMOS compatible high power mode-locked lasers and frequency combs
abstract: We show our progress towards integrated modelocked lasers producing short pulses with high peak power and low timing jitter for applications in frequency combs and optical frequency synthesizer.

articleTitle: Dual asynchronous undersampling of fast spectral variations with triple optical frequency combs
abstract: A dynamic demodulation scheme for high-frequency spectral modulations based on triple optical frequency combs is proposed here. This scheme could further extend the capability of dual-comb measurement techniques, and it also illustrates the potential of simple multi-comb laser source for novel yet practical applications.

articleTitle: Reduction of Temperature Drift in Refractive-index-sensing Optical Frequency Comb by Mechanical-sharing Dual-fiber-cavity Configuration
abstract: We suppress the temperature drift in the refractive-index-sensing optical frequency comb (RI-sensing OFC) by taking the difference of repetition frequency between an active RI-sensing OFC and a dummy one in the mechanical-sharing dual-fiber-cavity configuration.

articleTitle: Spatial distributions of amplitude and phase of electromagnetic wave in 1-dimensional photonic crystal
abstract: In order to construct photonic crystal with necessary optical properties to define relation of wave and material structures is necessary without using average value of wave vector. Presented work is aimed to get this relation.

articleTitle: Electrothermal 1D Varifocal Metalens
abstract: We report a MEMS-based spatial light modulator which consists of an electrothermally actuated varifocal metasurface. The focal length can be tuned over a range of 40 µm with less than 10 V. The lens exhibits a high compactness and simplicity of fabrication.

articleTitle: Efficient second-harmonic generation in silicon carbide nanowaveguides
abstract: We achieve an ultra-uniform 4-inch SiC-on-insulator wafer for high-yield waveguides. For the first time, we demonstrate second-harmonic generation in a 4H-SiCOI waveguide with conversion efficiency as high as 5.4% W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: On-chip electro-optic frequency comb generation using a heterogeneously integrated laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first on-chip resonant electro-optic frequency comb source on thin-film lithium niobate with an electrically-pumped heterogeneously integrated laser.

articleTitle: Shape Engineered Ultrafast Carrier Dynamics in Lead Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
abstract: We demonstrate dynamical photo-physics of shape-engineered cube (6 facets), rhombicdodecahedron (12 facets), and rhombicuboctahedron (26 facets) CsPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanocrystals using ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. Results show remarkably contrasting carrier dynamics and Burstein-Moss effect for tuning optoelectronic properties.

articleTitle: Integrated All-Optical Controlled Amplitude Modulator Using Laser Delivered Signals
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate integrated all-optical controlled amplitude modulation. Range of 0.25 mW control power is used to tune 15 dB of the output optical intensity. The design is fabricated in a commercial silicon photonics process.

articleTitle: Self-pulsing and Four-wave mixing of a Raman-Brillouin distributed feedback fiber laser
abstract: We report on the regular self-pulsing of a 1119 nm Raman DFB laser at the Brillouin Stokes shift of the Raman laser. We also detail four-wave mixing between the pump and Raman.

articleTitle: Radiation-induced Negative Nonlinear Absorption in Glass and Sapphire
abstract: We report the observation of negative nonlinear absorption in gamma and neutron-irradiated quartz glass, BK7 glass, and sapphire. Thermal annealing is effective in restoring the pre-irradiation optical properties.

articleTitle: Delayed luminescence from mesoscopic scattering media
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and numerically that many-body interactions between nanosized colloidal particles lead to subradiant regimes where the lifetime of emission long after the excitation ceases depends on the average particle-particle distance.

articleTitle: One-way clock synchronization with single photons
abstract: Quantum communication systems can be synchronized using data patterns, precise oscillators, or pulsed lasers. We demonstrate an alternative approach that uses time-bin quanta as a reference for synchronizing low-cost oscillators down to timing uncertainties < 16 ps.

articleTitle: Influence of defects on the femtosecond laser damage resistance of multi-layer dielectric grating
abstract: The influence of various defects on the femtosecond laser damage resistance of a HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>-based 48-layer grating designed for 800 nm is studied using the finite-difference time-domain method incorporated with the Keldysh photoionization theory.

articleTitle: A Compact, Large Field-of-View, and High-Resolution 2D Imaging Device Based on Metalens Array
abstract: We demonstrate a large field-of-view, high-resolution 2D imager by using a metalens array with bounded angular field of view. The metalens array is compactly integrated with a camera sensor with a total thickness of ~5mm.

articleTitle: Coil-Based Waveguide Layout Architecture for Micro-Photonic Devices
abstract: A novel design methodology for building micro-photonic devices using a coil-based architecture is proposed. The effectiveness of the methodology has been demonstrated by realizing an ultra-compact 4-λ LAN multiplexer with state-of-the-art optical performance.

articleTitle: Evidence for Collective Vibrational Quantum Coherence in Spontaneous Raman Scattering
abstract: We measure Stokes–anti-Stokes coincidence under two-pulse excitation of a molecular liquid in the regime of spontaneous Raman scattering. We observe quantum beats that are signatures of vibrational quantum coherence across billions of molecules.

articleTitle: Topological Edge States at Singular Points in Non-Hermitian Plasmonic Waveguide-Cavity Systems
abstract: We show that non-Hermitian plasmonic waveguide-cavity systems can simultaneously exhibit both topological edge states and singular points. We also show that the sensitivity of the reflected light intensity is greatly enhanced at such singular points.

articleTitle: Intensity Noise Suppression of Brillouin Random Fiber Laser based on 2nd Stokes Injection
abstract: We demonstrated a stabilized Brillouin random fiber laser based on external injection of the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order Stokes for the first time, benefiting a dynamic gain-loss balance for relative intensity noise suppression under optimized injection power.

articleTitle: A long-lived spin qubit in an optically active semiconductor quantum dot
abstract: We report on the first s pin-control e xperiments i n o ptically active GaAs/AlGaAs quantum dots. Using dynamic decoupling, we retain a quantum superposition for up to 105 µs, a hundred-fold improvement over the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical Nonreciprocity without 3D Chirality: Archimedean Spirals on InSb
abstract: We achieve tunable nonreciprocal directional dichroism at terahertz frequencies without breaking the spatial inversion symmetry by combining an Archimedean spiral metasurface and the magneto-optical effect in indium antimonide (InSb) in one hybrid metamaterial.

articleTitle: Deep learning of polarization transfer in liquid crystals with application to quantum state preparation
abstract: We present deep learning of light polarization in liquid crystals. Our model maps the transfer function at the unprecedented fidelity level of 0.999. The approach is used for accurate remote preparation of polarization quantum bits.

articleTitle: Creation of high-aspect-ratio microchannels inside silicon with three-dimensional laser lithography
abstract: Here, we demonstrate for the first-time, high-aspect-ratio microchannels inside silicon wafers, exploiting modulated lasers beams. The optical quality of the top wafer surface is preserved for further on-chip, in-chip integration.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic chirality transfer to dielectric Mie resonators
abstract: We propose that chirality transfer from chiral molecules to dielectric nanoresonators enhances enantiomer detection. Our approach offers circular dichroism enhancements orders of magnitude stronger than optical chirality-based methods.

articleTitle: Nonlocal Time-Resolved Terahertz Spectroscopy in the Near Field
abstract: We demonstrate the first "nonlocal" pump-probe measurement using a scattering scanning near-field microscopy technique by laterally displacing the pump and probe spots. We observe nonlocal effects associated with carrier drift into the probe region.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy and Mid-Infrared Laser Operation of “Mixed” Sesquioxide Ceramics Er:(Y,Sc)2O3
abstract: Transparent ceramics based on “mixed” sesquioxides, Er:(Y,Sc)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, are fabricated by vacuum sintering at 1750 °C from laser-ablated nanoparticles. They exhibit inhomogeneously broadened spectral bands. A continuous-wave Er:(Y,Sc)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ceramic laser generates 312 mW at 2716 nm.

articleTitle: Interplay of Quantum and Classical Dynamics in a Generalized Dicke Model
abstract: We investigate signatures of classical nonlinear behavior in the vicinity of a superradiant quantum phase transition in a generalized Dicke model. Classical multistable behavior is signalled by spontaneous tunneling between macroscopic quantum states.

articleTitle: 28.224-Tbit/s Capacity over 8191.898-km in Full C-band Using Single-mode Fibers with Adaptive Chromatic Dispersion and Nonlinearity Compensation
abstract: Transmission capacity of 28.224-Tbit/s over 8191.898-km single-mode fibers based on probabilistically-shaped 16QAM has been experimentally demonstrated. The BER results after adaptive chromatic dispersion and nonlinearity compensation are lower than 25%FEC threshold for all C-band channels.

articleTitle: Interaction Lengths in Tilted-pulse-front Terahertz Setups
abstract: We map out the impact of the interaction lengths on the efficiency and terahertz spatial profile in tilted-pulse-front setups via systematically scanning the 5D-parameter space spanned by fluence, pulse-front tilt, crystal-position, and beam size.

articleTitle: Fluorescence enhancement of Er3+-ions using reverse hybrid plasmonic nano-focusing
abstract: We report the broadband fluorescence enhancement of erbium ions embedded in a single non-resonant reverse nano-focusing waveguide. We measure a large radiative Purcell enhancement of a total emission rate enhancement of > 250 across the entire measured spectrum including the prominent telecoms C-band. Further, we observe the enhancement of single electric dipole transitions from Stark-split levels at room temperature.

articleTitle: Inference of Process Variations in Silicon Photonics from Characterization Measurements
abstract: A Bayesian-based method is developed to infer the distribution of systematic geometric variations in silicon photonics. Width, thickness, and partial etch depth variation distributional maps are reported for silicon nitride ring resonator characterization measurements.

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Frequency Combs for Low-Phase Noise mm-waves Generation
abstract: We experimentally implement a low-phase noise mm-waves generator based on integrated optical frequency comb, which provides -80 dBc/Hz for 1 kHz offset at 28 GHz and spectral purity equivalent to commercially available RF generator.

articleTitle: Bright, narrow-linewidth color centers in Silicon Carbide-on-Insulator microresonators
abstract: An outstanding challenge for color center-based quantum information processing is the integration of optically-coherent, stable emitters into a scalable thin-film photonics platform. Here, we show bright, narrow optical emission from silicon vacancy defects in 4H-silicon carbide-on-insulator microdisk resonators.

articleTitle: Optical synchronization of a 2 µm Ho:fiber oscillator and phase-noise analysis
abstract: A 2 µm Holmium oscillator, frequency-converted to 1025 nm, and a 1030 nm oscillator locked to an RF reference are synchronized optically. The timing jitter measured on the 2 µm oscillator is reduced to 19 fs.

articleTitle: Topological Photonics in Low Loss Tantalum Pentoxide
abstract: Topologically designed arrays of ring resonators are fabricated in tantalum pentoxide, a low-loss waveguide material. Testing reveals edge modes and successful topological behavior, and establishes tantalum pentoxide as a suitable material for topological photonics.

articleTitle: Learning-based quantum state reconstruction using biased quantum state distributions
abstract: We derive the Dirichlet concentration parameters for mixtures of Haar-random pure states that recover mean purities equal to standard measures, demonstrating how tailored distributions attain appreciable performance advantages in machine-learning-based and Bayesian quantum state reconstruction.

articleTitle: Spatially Asymmetric Hot-Carrier Transport for Ultrafast Generation of Electromagnetic Waves
abstract: We demonstrate the ultrafast conversion of statically passive dielectrics (e.g., amorphous TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) to transient second-order nonlinear media following the femtosecond transfer of hot electrons, enabling active control of nonlinear interactions, envisioned for terahertz functionalities.

articleTitle: In-situ photonic circuit field characterization in electronics-photonics CMOS platform via backside flip-chip near-field scanning optical microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate device field characterization using NSOM collection and interaction measurement modes via the backside buried-oxide of large scale photonic circuits fabricated in monolithic electronics-photonics CMOS platforms (here a microdisk resonator) post-processed using flip-chip substrate-removal.

articleTitle: Electron Pulse Compression with Optical Beat Note
abstract: We propose to use optical beat notes to compress electron pulses, which is applicable to electron pulses with a wide range of initial duration.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm High Speed Heterogeneous Quantum-Dot Lasers on Si
abstract: We report record-setting quantum-dot lasers integrated on Si for multifunctional integrated systems. Efficient coupling of laser output to Si waveguides was achieved with 13 GHz 3-dB bandwidth, 60 dB side-mode-suppression-ratio, and 26 kHz fundamental linewidth.

articleTitle: Photonics-enabled Continuous and Gapless Time-frequency Analysis of Fast Transient Events
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the gapless operation of lens-based energy conserving time-frequency analysis by real-time spectrum acquisition of events as short as ~160 ps, without any loss of information and regardless of the time of arrival.

articleTitle: Single-shot characterization of two-photon distinguishability with dielectric metasurfaces
abstract: We propose and fabricate a static dielectric metasurface grating that enables single-shot characterization of the distinguishability between two photons in multiple degrees of freedom including time, spectrum, and polarization.

articleTitle: ‘All’ Bright Toroidal Metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate bright-bright coupling mediated by mode-hybridization in multi split-ring resonator based metasurface leading to antiparallel toroidal moments in the metasurface cavity.

articleTitle: Subwavelength Color Router
abstract: We introduce a subwavelength color router for solid state image sensors. Our design achieves perfect red-green-blue color routing without loss of photons in a subwavelength footprint and has broadband, polarization-independent, and angular robust response.

articleTitle: All-fiber scan-free precision detection with large depth of field
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber detecting system based on a single multimode fiber. The system showcases the capability to detect precision natural scenes by its inverse transmission matrix. Integrated reflective illumination mode makes it more accessible.

articleTitle: Linear Response of Optical Systems With Exceptional Points
abstract: We develop a linear theory for non-Hermitian optical systems having exceptional points. In contrast to previous studies, our analysis results in an exact expression for the resolvent operator without the need to use perturbation expansions.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modulation of Photonic Quantum States using Nonlinear Optical Metasurface
abstract: We report a dynamic modulation of the photonic quantum states in an all-optical manner using the nonlinear metasurface. The entanglement state was efficiently controlled and a quantum state distillation has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Femtosecond Sources with Continuously Tailorable Bandwidth Enabled by Self-Phase Modulation
abstract: By varying the initial pulse conditions and investigating the spectro-temporal behavior of self-phase-modulation-dominated spectral broadening, we experimentally demonstrated a femtosecond source featuring tailorable spectral peak and bandwidth, paving a way for bandwidth-tunable nonlinear spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Creation Distribution and Sorting of Multimode Correlated Photons in a Multimode Fiber
abstract: We use spontaneous four wave mixing to generate multimode photon pairs in a few-mode fiber. We show the photons are correlated in the fiber mode basis using a 1km long all-fiber mode sorter.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable O-band Lithium Niobite/III-V Hybrid Laser
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically pumped widely tunable lithium Niobite/III-V hybrid laser offering over 40 nm tuning range in the O-band, and a maximum output power of 5.2 mW.

articleTitle: Towards Lower Repetition Rate and Visible Wavelength Microresonator Frequency Combs for Optical Atomic Clocks
abstract: Microresonator frequency combs that service optical atomic clocks must exhibit octave bandwidth, detectable repetition rate, and wavelengths compatible with advanced atomic references. We present recent progress towards realizing such microcombs for Sr lattice optical cocks.

articleTitle: Use of neural networks fro designing robust flat-optics on flexible substrates
abstract: We present an inverse design platform that enables the fast design of flexible flat-optics that maintain high performance under deformations. The platform is based on evolutionary large-scale optimizers, and neural network predictors.

articleTitle: Probing Ultrafast Element- and Depth-resolved Magnetization Dynamics with Transvers Magneto-optical Kerr Effect Spectroscopy in the Soft X-ray Range
abstract: We analyse time- and angle-resolved transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect spectroscopy measurements at soft x-ray energies via polarization-dependent magnetic scattering simulations to determine the spatio-temporal and element-specific evolution of femtosecond laser-induced spin dynamics in magnetic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Low-threshold Plasmonic Nanolasers at Optical Communication Wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate a room-temperature plasmonic nanolaser at optical communication wavelengths showing robust performance to fabrication imperfections. The threshold of 49.96 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is lower than the reported near-infrared plasmonic nanolasers of any configuration.

articleTitle: A Demonstration of Frequency-Shift Keying in Underwater Optical Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper experimentally demonstrates the resilience of frequency-shift keying (FSK) signalling to turbulence effect in underwater optical wireless communications. The findings offer valuable insight into the design trade-off between spectral efficiency and resistance to turbulence.

articleTitle: Low Temperature Heterogeneous Integration of Structured III-V Semiconductors for Quantum Optics Applications
abstract: Heterogeneous integration of 250 nm thick and 1 mm long InGaP waveguides on SiO2 via native oxide molecular bonding for counter-directional spontaneous photonpair generation at 1550 nm and 1300 nm with 50 nm tunability is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Solid-State Multimode Long-Lived Optical Quantum Memory for Quantum Repeaters
abstract: In this work, we fabricate a multimode quantum memory out of a thulium-doped crystal and demonstrate storage of laser pulses of up to 100 µsec. A significant step forward for creating quantum memories with long optical storage times.

articleTitle: Intrinsically chiral modes near exceptional points in modified H1 photonic crystal cavity modes
abstract: We propose a scheme to generate intrinsically chiral modes via non-Hermitian backscattering caused by the loss-induced imaginary coupling between the two orthogonal linearly polarized dipole modes in the H1 photonic crystal cavity.

articleTitle: Measuring n-photon Indistinguishability
abstract: We propose a scalable measurement of the indistinguishability of a n-photon state harnessing a multi-port interferometer. We demonstrate this method using four photons from a quantum dot single-photon source with an integrated cyclic interferometer.

articleTitle: Calibration of Electronic Distance Meters using Autocorrelation of Femtosecond Pulses
abstract: Calibration of Electronic Distance Meters is crucial since they are used in surveying and construction. A method is proposed here to calibrate EDMs using the autocorrelation of femtosecond pulses generated from an Optical Frequency Comb.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based image reconstruction in optical coherence tomography using undersampled spectral data
abstract: We present a deep learning-based image reconstruction method in swept-source optical coherent tomography (OCT) using undersampled spectral data. This method can improve the imaging speed without the need for any hardware modifications.

articleTitle: Laser Cooling of Sapphire
abstract: Laser cooling of titanium-doped sapphire via electric-dipole-allowed transitions is reported at discrete resonances of the dopant in the spectral range of its near-infrared emission band.

articleTitle: Reference frames in astronomical interferometry
abstract: We connect the reference frame problem in astronomical interferometry to the concept of decoherence-free subspaces in quantum information. Inspired by this connection, a new scheme that does not rely on reference frame is proposed.

articleTitle: Entangling Distant Atoms using Telecom Wavelengths
abstract: We report on the distribution of entanglement between two single-atom quantum memories generated over telecom fibers with lengths up to 33 km and propose realistic improvements for the performance-limiting atomic state coherence time.

articleTitle: Ultra-High-Q Multi-Resonant Metasurface using Plasmonic Lattice in Inhomogeneous Medium
abstract: We demonstrate excitation of guided lattice resonances inside a semiconductor thin-film in a inhomogeneous metasurface enabled by a lossy plasmonic lattice reso-nanances with a record Q-factor value over 10,000.

articleTitle: In-Situ Tuning of Optomechanical Crystals with Nano-Oxidation
abstract: We present a method that employs nano-oxidation by an atomic-force microscope (AFM) to achieve in-situ, selective and simultaneous tuning of the optical and acoustic resonance frequencies of silicon optomechanical crystal cavities.

articleTitle: Topology in Photonic Space-Time Crystals
abstract: We introduce topological phases in photonic space-time crystals, which have gaps in both momentum and frequency. We show that edge states waves refracted and reflected from spatial and temporal interfaces are governed by topological invariants.

articleTitle: Twin-Neural-Network Differential Autoencoder and Dynamic-Contrast Optical Coherence Tomography for Cancer Diagnostics
abstract: Dynamic-contrast optical coherence tomography (OCT) using en face digital holography senses intracellular dynamics in living tumor tissue. Intracellular motions produce ultra-low-frequency Doppler shifts for speeds down to nanometers per second (10 mHz) and up to microns per second (10 Hz). Cancer drugs applied to human tumor biopsies induce changes in these dynamics and produce specific Doppler signatures of therapeutic efficacy. We have developed a new type of deep neural network that performs as a differential autoencoder with high common-mode rejection that isolates Doppler signatures associated with drug response and patient outcomes. The differential autoencoder is applied to Doppler signals from a clinical trial of esophageal cancer patients.

articleTitle: Ultrafast energy exchange between two single Rydberg atoms on the nanosecond timescale
abstract: We observed a nanosecond-scale dynamics between two single atoms trapped in optical tweezers separated by ∼ 1 µm and excited to Rydberg state with picosecond laser pulses. This opens the path for ultrafast quantum computation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Non-Collinear Pump-Probe Spectroscopy of Intersubband Polariton-Polariton Scattering
abstract: Non-collinear multi-THz pump-probe spectroscopy reveals the intersubband polariton dynamics in a dispersive microcavity. Selective pumping of the lower polariton at finite in-plane momentum leads to coherent polariton-polariton scattering towards the ground state.

articleTitle: Toward quantum electronic-photonic systems-on-chip: a monolithic source of quantum-correlated photons with integrated frequency locking electronics and pump rejection
abstract: We demonstrate a CMOS electronic-photonic photon-pair source with integrated feedback-controlled frequency locking, >80 dB on-chip pump rejection, and signal/idler demultiplexing, achieving a CAR of ≃5 at ≃40 ccps pair rate.

articleTitle: Broadband Spectroscopic Imaging Using Dual Frequency Comb Spectroscopy and Compressive Sensing
abstract: We merge the broadband, high resolution capabilities of dual frequency comb spectroscopy with a spatially resolving single pixel camera experimental architecture to demonstrate broadband spectroscopic imaging via compressive sensing.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Non-Injecting Mirror Concept for Feedback-Resistant High-Power Laser Diodes with a Multiphysics Model
abstract: A multiphysics model of a high-power external cavity laser diode is used to evaluate the impact of an electrically unpumped section near the front facet on its COD threshold when operated with misaligned optical feedback.

articleTitle: Four-Dimensional (4D) Light Manipulation
abstract: Temporal and spatiotemporal variation of material parameters provides extra degrees of freedom in manipulating and controlling waves, exhibiting additional functionality. In this presentation, we give an overview of our recent findings in such 4D platforms.

articleTitle: Microresonator Brillouin Backaction Thermometry
abstract: Long-term frequency stable operation of Brillouin lasers relies on strict temperature control of the optical mode volume. We report measurement of optical mode temperature and its stabilization using Brillouin-induced back-action in a cascaded Brillouin laser.

articleTitle: Probing strongly coupled light-matter interactions using quantum free electrons
abstract: We propose to use free-electrons as quantum probes of strongly coupled light-matter systems. Interactions with such systems are distinctly imprinted on the electron energy spectrum, allowing for quantum detection and new photon blockade mechanisms.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated lithium niobate photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid L iNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic integrated platform with propagation loss of 8.5 dB/m at wafer scale. The platform exhibits low insertion loss (4 dB) and precise lithographic control. We also demonstrate a number of applications of the platform.

articleTitle: Galaxy waves: 3D inhomogeneous auto-accelerating beams
abstract: We propose and generate a new class of structured light whose wavepackets have 3D inhomogeneous angular velocity evolution with auto-accelerating upon both its longitudinal propagation and transverse multilayer rotation akin to galactic kinematics.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Photoexcited Molecular Dynamics of Metalated Porphyrin – Napthalimide Based Donor-Acceptor Systems
abstract: Ultrafast excited state molecular relaxation dynamics of two porphyrin-napthalimide molecular systems in donor–acceptor configuration, have been studied using femtosecond transient absorption measurements upon pumping the Soret bands of the porphyrins with 400 nm excitation.

articleTitle: Eigenvalue Topology of Non-Hermitian Band Structures in Two and Three Dimensions
abstract: In one dimension, eigenvalue topology of non-Hermitian photonic systems is classified by the braid group. Here, we give a complete description of the much richer eigenvalue topology in two and three dimensions.

articleTitle: Band-edge-induced mid-infrared radiation in a gas-filled antiresonant hollow-core fiber
abstract: We demonstrate band-edge-induced strong radiation at 3.5 μm wavelength from a gas-filled antiresonant hollow-core fiber that is pumped by femtosecond pulses at 2 μm. The high conversion efficiency allows the generation of sub-μJ level mid-infrared pulses.

articleTitle: Modulation Instability Suppression for Fiber Optic DAS Assisted with Dual Wavelength Lasers
abstract: A dual-wavelength-lasers DAS for suppressing modulation instability (MI) effects is proposed. Through respectively setting the wavelength of one laser at the MI gain spectrum peak of another laser, a 9.225dB power improvement is realized.

articleTitle: Laser-Driven Photon Sources and Exemplary Applications at ELI Beamlines
abstract: E(xtreme)L(ight)I(nfrastructure) Beamlines within the EU’s ELI project provides laser-driven secondary sources of EUV/XUV, X-ray and relativistic charged particles offering unique pump/probe/harvest experimental schemes carried out by various end stations.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Interferometry with Fiber-Based Comb Synthesizers
abstract: Self-referenced frequency-comb generators based on ultrafast fiber lasers enable new approaches to interferometry, owning to their ultralow noise and extreme stability. Benefits for precision spectroscopy over broad spectral bandwidths and for digital holography are presented.

articleTitle: THz-wave generation and modulation for wireless communication using micro soliton comb
abstract: The THz-wave generation using O/E conversion of micro soliton comb modes has advantages in having compact laser source and the generation of THz-wave with low phase noise. We investigated the THz wireless communication systems using the two DFG lasers and micro soliton comb as a laser source.

articleTitle: Magnetic free optical isolator based on light shift in atomic vapor
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a magnetic field free isolator based on the light shift effect in miniaturized hot vapor cell. This work paves the way into nonmagnetic optical isolator for optical information processing applications.

articleTitle: Fast chirped ultral-low noise hybrid integrated FMCW laser source
abstract: A hybrid integrated FMCW laser source is proposed which has a fast chirped speed of up to 100 kHz with intrinsic linewidth of 22 Hz and tuning range more than 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Exploring the Topological Phase with Quench Dynamics in a Frequency Synthetic Dimension
abstract: We theoretically study the dynamical classification of topological phase in a frequency synthetic dimension constructed by modulated rings, where the holographic quench dynamics is proposed to explore the band evolution in only the time dimension.

articleTitle: A Novel Optical Path Matching Method for Balanced Detection
abstract: A novel optical path matching method is provided to eliminate the optical path difference of the balanced detection fiber link. The noise floor is reduced by 8dB compared with that of the single photodetector output.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Mode Selection in Metallo-Dielectric Nanolasers Coupled via a Bridge
abstract: Bridge-coupled metallo-dielectric nanolasers that can operate in the in-phase or out-of-phase modes are experimentally demonstrated. The lasing action is confirmed by conventional lasing characterizations, whereas the operating modes are identified by near-field and far-field imaging.

articleTitle: Electron phase-space control in photonic chip-based particle acceleration
abstract: We demonstrate complex electron phase-space control in a 77.7 micrometer long silicon-based nanostructure. This low-loss electron transport scheme is a prerequisite to the future mega-electron-volt electron accelerator on a photonic chip.

articleTitle: Saturated absorption spectroscopy using azimuthally structured mode in hollow-core fiber
abstract: We report on saturated-absorption-spectroscopy in acetylene-filled hollow-core fiber using azimuthally-structured fiber modes. The results show rotational-frequency-shift of 11 MHz and 2-fold contrast enhancement of the saturated signal when using with LP11 mode over LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> mode.

articleTitle: Enhanced Viewing Angle Tabletop Integral Imaging Without Flipping Effect Based on Space-multiplexed Voxel Screen and Compound Lens-array
abstract: A flipping-free integral imaging with 96°×96° viewing angle is performed based on space-multiplexed voxel screen and compound lens-array. A 3-times larger viewing angle with less than 9% of image distortion is displayed.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Source of Entangled Frequency bins
abstract: We present a highly-efficient integrated reconfigurable source of entangled frequency bins. Leveraging the flexibility offered by the silicon photonics platform, we demonstrate the on-chip generation of all the main two-qubit quantum states.

articleTitle: Towards Ultrafast, Near-Unity Light Modulation at the Few-Electron Limit Using Exciton-Trion-Polaritons
abstract: Exciton-trion-polaritons, quasiparticles with tunable, strong electron-photon coupling, are described. Devices using these quasiparticles are electrostatically controlled, and shown to be promising in realizing small-scale, ultrafast, near-unity light modulators which are otherwise difficult to realize.

articleTitle: Modeling Cross-channel Interference Caused by Arbitrary Spectral Shaped Signals
abstract: A closed-form, highly accurate model estimates the cross-channel interference for arbitrary spectrum signals in long-haul fiber-optic transmission. It eliminates estimation errors of up to 37% resulting from assuming a rectangular spectrum for RRC signals.

articleTitle: Event-Driven SPAD Array for Quantum-Enhanced Imaging
abstract: We present a novel Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) imager optimized to detect and map temporally coincident photons in quantum-enhanced imaging with a modular TDC-free event-driven architecture, seamlessly scalable to large format arrays.

articleTitle: Vertical cavity using a heterostructure dual-period high-contrast grating
abstract: A vertical cavity using a heterostructure dual-period high-contrast grating with a feature size of about 15 nm is demonstrated for the vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser application. The reflectivity spectra of the vertical cavity are measured.

articleTitle: Atomic Floquet Physics Revealed by Free Electrons
abstract: We theoretically investigate the ability of free electrons to probe the nonlinear Floquet dynamics of atoms under intense illumination. We observe multiple features in the electron energy-loss spectra associated with electron-photon exchanges and Floquet resonances.

articleTitle: Crust Deformation Detection System based on Coherent Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
abstract: We demonstrate fiber crust deformation detection system based on coherent phase detection. With sensitivity enhancement design and compensation scheme, the system can reach a strain resolution of 151pε@ 0.01Hz, which could record the crust deformation.

articleTitle: Realization of nontrivial higher-order topological corner states in photonic graphene
abstract: We demonstrate nontrivial higher-order topology in photonic honeycomb lattices with different corner/edge geometries established by cw-laser-writing technique, unveiling two distinct corner states that are expected to represent features of higher-order topological Dirac semimetal.

articleTitle: Biopsy-free Virtual Histology of Skin Using Reflectance Confocal Microscopy and Deep Learning
abstract: We report in vivo virtual histology of skin without a biopsy, where deep learning is used to virtually stain tissue and generate hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-like microscopic images of skin using a reflectance confocal microscope.

articleTitle: Phase-Based Multi-Tone CW Lidar: A Technique for Ranging Beyond the Coherence Length of the CW Laser
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ranging and velocimetry at >500× beyond the coherence length of a CW laser in a technique called phase-based multi-tone continuous-wave lidar that eliminates the need for any form of phase or frequency sweeping.

articleTitle: Quantum Entanglement in a Double-Resonant Optical Parametric Oscillator (OPO) based on Hot Rubidium Vapour
abstract: We demonstrate the first measurement of entanglement between the twin beams generated by an OPO based on four-wave mixing in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">85</sup>Rb above the threshold. We reconstruct the covariance matrix by using the method of resonator detection.

articleTitle: MW-level Pulses from an All-Fiber and Self-Starting Femtosecond Oscillator
abstract: We present an all-fiber Mamyshev oscillator that generates 40 fs and 80 nJ pulses. The resulting 1.5-MW peak power is 20 times higher than that of prior all-fiber and self-starting lasers.

articleTitle: Self-Dispersion-Managed Octave-Spanning Adiabatic Frequency Converter
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an octave-spanning mid-IR adiabatic frequency converter that uses monolithic, intrinsic pulse shaping to impart near-zero group delay dispersion. 13.5-fs 743-nm pulses become 16-fs 2.66-µm pulses with high efficiency and slight residual chirp.

articleTitle: A study of stochastic phase noise in white light generation
abstract: White-light spectral interferometry quantifies the stochastic phase noise acquired during white light generation in bulk crystals. Spectrally-resolved energy-to-phase transfer coefficients are extracted and jitter-free operating points are identified.

articleTitle: Optically generated graphene plasmons for optoelectronic logic operations
abstract: Leveraging the counter-propagating and temporally-synchronized laser comb pulses, we demonstrate all-optical generation and electrical control of multiple plasmon polarizations in 0 ~ 50 THz, enabling AND/OR/NOR optoelectronic logic operations in one single device.

articleTitle: Enhanced THz metasensors with bound state in a continuum
abstract: An ultra-sensitive THz metasensor is presented based on high-quality quasi-BIC Fano resonance, which can distinguish extremely dilute concentrations (nM) of solutions. It provides a non-destructive sensing approach for disease prevention and diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Accurate Methane Line List in the 7.2–8.0 μm Range from Comb-Based Fourier Transform Spectroscopy
abstract: We use comb-based Fourier transform spectroscopy to record high-resolution spectra of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> from 1250 to 1380 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. We obtain line positions and intensities of 4 bands with uncertainties of ~450 kHz and ~3%, respectively, which we use to improve a global fit of the effective Hamiltonian.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Metalenses based on Antimony Trisulfide (Sb2S3) Phase Change Material
abstract: We design and fabricate reconfigurable antimony trisulfide (Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) cylindrical metalenses. Simulation results show focusing efficiencies of 72.85% and 79.7% for focal lengths of 3.5cm and 5cm at a wavelength of 750nm. Experimental verification is underway.

articleTitle: Higher-order-mode soliton dynamics in gas-filled hollow capillary fibres
abstract: We explore the mode-dependent scaling of soliton dynamics in hollow-core waveguides and experimentally demonstrate ultraviolet dispersive-wave emission in a higher-order mode of a hollow capillary fibre.

articleTitle: Heralding Single Photons using Photon-number-resolving Superconducting Nanowires
abstract: We improve a single photon source based on spontaneous parametric down-conversion by heralding one of the output modes using a photon number resolving superconducting nanowire detector. We measure a reduced magnitude of the second order cross correlation of one of the output modes conditioned on detection of a single photon in the other mode.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic metamaterial nanocavity enhanced photodetector based on 2D TMDC material
abstract: We design and demonstrate experimentally nanoscale hyperbolic metamaterial cavities for enhancing the optical absorption in photodetector structures made from 2D TMDC materials. This demonstration paves the way for integrating such materials in optoelectronic applications.

articleTitle: Multiple concentric rainbows induced by microscale concave interfaces for reflective displays
abstract: We unambiguously define the physics behind structural coloration induced by microscale concave interfaces using both white light, and single wavelength illumination.

articleTitle: 129 MW, Sub-ps, 206 nm All-solid-state Deep-ultraviolet Pulse Generation Driving by 1μm Yb:YAG Laser
abstract: We demonstrate an all-solid-state deep-ultraviolet (DUV) laser delivering 0.8 W, 80 µJ, ~582 fs, 206 nm pulses with peak power of 129 MW from a 1030 nm Yb:YAG laser at a 10 kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Experimental Observations of Thermal Fluctuations of Metamaterial Optical Properties
abstract: We demonstrate that fluctuations in the optical properties of nanomechanical photonic metamaterials can reach 1% at room temperature. Such fluctuations arise from ‘Brownian’ motion and peak at the frequencies of the nanostructures’ natural mechanical modes.

articleTitle: High speed mid-infrared Stark modulator for optical data transmission up to 10 Gbit.s-1
abstract: Using the Stark effect in coupled InGas/AlInAs quantum wells, we demonstrate a mid-infrared broadband optoelectronic external modulator enabling 10 Gbit/s free space optical data-transmission in the second atmospheric window (9 µm) at room temperature.

articleTitle: On-Chip Quantum Devices Enabled by Shallow-Implanted Vacancy Centers in Laser-Written Waveguides in Diamond
abstract: We present a quantum device platform enabled by shallow implanted vacancy centers in the front facet of laser-written waveguides in diamond. Two proof-of-principle experiments highlight the potential for quantum sensing and single photon light-field engineering.

articleTitle: Wavelength-resolved all-Silicon microring avalanche photodiode for telecom wavelength detection
abstract: We report a p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>pn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> junction silicon microring avalanche photodiode based on linear defect state absorption. The large avalanche photocurrent gives rise to giant thermo-optic nonlinearity in the microring, resulting in a unique linear photocurrent-wavelength response.

articleTitle: Subwavelength optical waveguiding via inverse designed deformation of reflective surface
abstract: We demonstrate subwavelength waveguiding device based on the artificial material with ultra-high refractive index. Material is engineered through the deformation of reflective substrate via transformation optics approach which allows to achieve arbitrary refractive index distribution.

articleTitle: Attachable 1D Photonic Crystal Laser Thin-Film for Strain Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic crystal laser embedded in a polymeric thin film, which can attach to the object’s surface and show significant wavelength responses in bending, pressing, and gas pressure sensing via nanoclamps with strain-shaping.

articleTitle: Experimental Generation of Cluster-state Entanglement by Phase Modulation of the Quantum Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: We report on the progress of experimental cluster-state generation in the optical frequency comb of a single, phase-modulated optical parametric oscillator.

articleTitle: Inverse-Designed Optical Image Compression Metamaterials
abstract: For the first time, we present image redundancy reduction, that is image compression, through inversely-designed metamaterials. The optimized metamaterial performs passive image compression at the speed of light without the need of transistor-based computations.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared Time-stretch Optical Coherence Tomography
abstract: We demonstrate mid-infrared swept-source optical coherence tomography at a record high axial scan rate of 80 MHz by exploiting time-stretch infrared spectroscopy (TSIR) operating at 3.5 µm.

articleTitle: Isotopologue trace gas detection using multipass cavity Raman scattering
abstract: Feedback-assisted multipass-cavity spontaneous Raman scattering is demonstrated as an effective method of isotopologue analysis. Deuterium concentration precision near one part-per-million in water was obtained by direct vapor and indirect dihydrogen measurements.

articleTitle: Coherent Combining of Broadband Radiation Using Multicore Fibers with Square Array of Coupled Cores
abstract: We demonstrate stable propagation of the out-of-phase supermode in a multicore fiber and efficient coherent combination the output radiation in a setup without lenslet array scalable to high power levels applicable to fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: High-performance III-V/Si3N4 O-band External Cavity Tunable Laser
abstract: We present a III-V/Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> O-band hybrid laser, which shows a high output power of 42 mW, wide tuning range of 62 nm with side-mode suppression ratio >50 dB, and narrow intrinsic linewidth of ~600 Hz.

articleTitle: Electrically driven reprogrammable phase-change metaoptics
abstract: Electrically reconfigurable metaoptics through the integration of a robust microheater decoupled from an optically smart phase-change metasurface is experimentally demonstrated for optical switching with record 80% contrast ratio and beam steering into different diffraction orders.

articleTitle: Electro-Optic Spectral Switching and Q-switching in a Dual-Wavelength Nd:YVO4 Laser Based on Aperiodically Poled Lithium Niobate
abstract: We demonstrate a novel dual-wavelength Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser where either or both of its emission lines can be selected and Q-switched electro-optically using a domain-engineered LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. Electro-optic switching among five wavelengths from the system is observed.

articleTitle: Hollow-Core-Fiber-Delivered Mid-Infrared Heterodyne Spectroscopy
abstract: We report mid-infrared heterodyne spectroscopy of a sample located at the distal end of a hollow-core fiber, providing excellent sensitivity, eliminating distal-end electronics and enabling common-mode rejection of parasitic absorptions in the delivery path.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser femtosecond pulses for supercontinuum generation
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate the generation of 630 fs, 4.5 W pulses from a mid-infrared quantum cascade laser by gain modulation induced spectral broadening and external pulse compression. Such sources open new pathways for broadband supercontinuum generation in the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Diffraction-free Space-Time Wave Packets Localized in All Dimensions
abstract: We present the first demonstration of propagation-invariant space-time (ST) wave packets localized in all dimensions. By introducing orbital-angular-momentum into the wave packets, we produce propagation-invariant ST-OAM wave packets traveling at arbitrary group velocities.

articleTitle: Glyphosate Assessment by Raman Spectroscopy and Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy
abstract: We applied Raman and SERS spectroscopy to obtain the fingerprint of glyphosate, a worldwide used dangerous pesticide. We corroborate the utility of gold nanoparticles to improve the Raman scattering, obtaining an enhancement factor of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Cross-Thin-Slab Amplifier for High Peak and Average Power Ti:Sa Laser Systems
abstract: A room temperature Ti:Sa amplifier based on a cross pump-seed geometry was demonstrated to generate 25mJ at 1 kHz, pumped when pumped by 100 mJ from an Yb:YAG laser. The amplifier geometry maintains the crystal temperature at~ 30<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> C.

articleTitle: 1 GHz Erbium-Doped Mode-Locked Laser Dual-Frequency Comb Spectrometer
abstract: In dual-comb spectroscopy, the maximal spectral coverage and the minimal measurement time depend quadratically on the lasers’ pulse repetition rate. Here, we demonstrate a high-repetition rate 1 GHz dual-comb spectrometer based on low-noise Erbium-doped mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: A Boson Sampling Chip for Graph Perfect Matching
abstract: We map the perfect matching problem in graph theory to a reconfigurable GBS model with the connection of the Hafnian of a matrix. We configure the linear optical circuit and squeeze parameter of the GBS model according to the decomposed unitary matrix and diagonal matrix of the graph’s adjacency matrix. The perfect matching numbers can be directly acquired from the 4-photon coincidence counts with a distribution similarity of 0.9304.

articleTitle: Nyquist cavity solitons in fiber resonators
abstract: Temporal solitons can arise in spectrally confined cavities with no chromatic dispersion. When the filter order tends to infinity, the soliton tends to a Nyquist pulse with a fully confined ultra-flat spectrum and a transform-limited waveform.

articleTitle: Multimode Quantum Correlations of Soliton Microcombs in Silicon Carbide Microrings
abstract: We generate soliton microcombs in silicon-carbide-on-insulator microrings with a minimum operation power of 2.3 mW in the input waveguide. Using a single-photon optical spectrum analyzer, we study the multimode quantum correlations of soliton micro-combs.

articleTitle: Frequency-domain fluorescence lifetime imaging as method to analyze wood structures
abstract: The analysis of wood structures using FD-FLIM seems promising for the identification of wood at 488 nm, as lignin has a high impact on the fluorescence lifetime.

articleTitle: Powerful Sub-100-fs Diode-Pumped Solid-State Laser Oscillator Operating at Gigahertz Repetition Rate
abstract: Our Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:CALGO laser oscillator generates 93-fs pulses in 6.9-W and 48-fs pulses in 4.1-W at 1-GHz repetition rate. These are the shortest pulse duration and highest average power of any GHz-class Yb-based oscillator.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Virtual Immunohistochemical HER2 staining of Label-Free Breast Tissue
abstract: We present deep learning-based virtual immunohistochemical (IHC) HER2 staining of label-free breast tissue sections, matching the standard IHC HER2 staining performed by histotechnologists.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, Low Loss 3dB Splitter in Silicon Photonics Waveguides
abstract: The design of a silicon photonic broadband Y-splitter by particle-swarm optimization algorithm is presented. Across the broad wavelength range 1.25-1.55μm, the splitter shows simulated losses <0.17dB, and experimental losses of 0.18dB (1.31μm) and 0.26dB (1.55μm).

articleTitle: Sub 150-fs mJ-level Yb:CALYO Diode Pumped Regenerative Amplifier
abstract: We report Yb:CaYAlO4 (Yb:CYA) regenerative amplifier providing 135 fs output pulses with 1 mJ energy and 1 kHz repetition rate at 1040 nm. Single Yb:crystal in TEM00 resonator was pumped by a diode laser.

articleTitle: Towards reciprocal links for frequency distribution using low backscattering hollow core fibers
abstract: We demonstrate that optical frequency distribution using hollow core fiber links allows for the same backward and forward propagating signal carrier wavelength (due to low backscattering), potentially reducing non-reciprocal link noise.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short Pulse Non-Classical Light Emitters Utilizing Multiple Wide Quantum Wells
abstract: We report a novel ultra-short pulse emitter utilizing transient charge carrier behavior and cooperative emission in multiple wide-quantum-well heterostructures. Its optical cavity reassembles a tandem-cavity laser diode with electroabsorber section surrounded by two gain sections. With selection of the electrical pump pulse and the absorber voltage, due to quantum-confined Stark effect in wide quantum well, it is possible to spatially pull the electrons and holes apart from each other. When the pump bias is removed, an ultra-short pulse due to cooperative recombination of electrons and holes emerges. We demonstrate that such cooperative superradiance produces non-classical high-order correlations in the emitted light while Wigner function of the state reveals quantum oscillations.

articleTitle: All-optical Scalable Spatial Coherent Ising Machine
abstract: We propose an all-optical spatial coherent Ising machine with a parametric cavity and spatial light modulator (SLM). We discuss how different SLM configurations realize different couplings, and then study the performance of the proposed machine.

articleTitle: Polarization independence in superconducting microwire single-photon detectors
abstract: Micrometer-scale superconducting wires can detect single photons at nearinfrared wavelengths. We employ a novel meander geometry to fabricate high-fill factor microwire devices with low polarization sensitivity (1.02±0.008) and high efficiency 93%) across a 40 nm bandwidth centered at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithic InP extended cavity mode-locked laser with a record low 670 MHz repetition rate
abstract: A record low repetition rate monolithic InP mode-locked laser is experimentally reported. Under passive mode-locking, an electrical beat tone at 670 MHz with an electrical linewidth of sub-kHz and a signal-to-noise ratio > 40 dB is measured.

articleTitle: Injection locking of two CW lasers via a Kerr microresonator soliton comb for low noise THz generation
abstract: We demonstrate the amplification and phase noise transfer of the comb modes of a microresonator soliton comb by optical injection locking, showing > 40 dB amplification gain and < -100 dBc/Hz residual noise.

articleTitle: Coherent Backscattering of Entangled Photon Pairs
abstract: We report on the first observation and study of coherent backscattering of entangled photon pairs. We show that after the photons backscatter from a dynamic random medium, they remain correlated, exhibiting a new mesoscopic phenomenon.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser-induced confined nanocrystallization in dielectric multilayers
abstract: TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanoparticles are used in countless optical applications, from photovoltaics to detectors. Here, we demonstrate the use of ultrafast laser to form TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanocrystalline particles locally confined within a multi-layer stack, while preserving the surface.

articleTitle: Correlated optical-spin coherence spectroscopy on telecom-wavelength epitaxial rare-earth qubits
abstract: We perform correlated optical-spin coherence spectroscopy on epitaxial rare-earth qubits in an oxide thin film. Single Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions are optically addressed and used to probe coupling to two-level-systems as a simultaneous optical-spin decoherence mechanism.

articleTitle: Caries Detection using Terahertz Birefringence
abstract: Terahertz birefringence phenomenon in enamel is, for the first time, observed via terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, which is weakened or even disappeared when caries is formed, expecting to be applied in early diagnosis of dental caries.

articleTitle: Power-efficient optical bottle-beam traps
abstract: We introduced a figure of merit for optical bottle-beam traps, and identified optical bottle-beam traps based on metasurfaces illuminated by a Gaussian beam that are superior in terms of power efficiency compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Multipoint FBG sensing using incoherent OFDR and two-photon absorption process in Si-APD
abstract: We propose multipoint sensing using fiber Bragg gratings having almost the same Bragg wavelength and incoherent optical frequency domain reflectometry along with two-photon absorption process in Si-APD. The principle is confirmed by using multicore FBG.

articleTitle: Observation of the spinful higher-order topology in multilayer Td-WTe2
abstract: We propose evidence that the multilayer T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf>-WTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is a higher-order topological insulator. By measuring the Kerr effect using the graphene/WTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure, we revealed the existence of spinful topological hinge states protected by the time-reversal symmetry.

articleTitle: A Robust and Non-Interleaved Full-Color Metasurface Hologram with Suppressed Color Crosstalk
abstract: We developed and experimentally demonstrated a full-color metasurface hologram based on phase optimization, with neither pixel interleaving nor Fourier space multiplexing of three primary color channels.

articleTitle: Achieving Stable Ultraviolet Photoelectrochemical Photodetection via TiO2-assisted GaN Nanowires
abstract: The stability of GaN nanowires-based photoelectrochemical photodetector was significantly improved by coating the nanowires with an ultrathin TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> protective layer. Thereby, the device stably operated for over 2000 s with little photocurrent decay.

articleTitle: Single-photon frequency shifting using coupled microring resonators on thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We frequency shift single photons by 18.2 GHz using coupled thin-film lithium niobate microring resonators controlled by a single-tone microwave signal, and characterize the indistinguishability of the shifted and unshifted photons using Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. A visibility of 74 ± 0.9% is achieved.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Filament Coupled with Structured Light for Free Space Optical Communication
abstract: We created a 4-bit communication channel for free-space optical communication (FSO) through a segmented space division multiplexing method using structured light coupled with a femtosecond-laser induced filament.

articleTitle: Low-Threshold Thulium-Silicon Microdisk Lasers
abstract: We present low-threshold lasing around 1.9 µm in compact thulium-silicon hybrid microdisk resonators with a pulley-coupled design. We observe total on-chip output powers of > 2 mW and threshold pump powers of < 1 mW.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed optical phased array with a wide steering angle
abstract: A slow-light photonic crystal waveguide is demonstrated for a group index of 25 using photonic inverse design. We construct optical phased arrays with a 7-fold increase in steering angle at a given spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Nonlinear Spectral Broadening in a Multi-Pass Cell at 2.05 μm
abstract: We present nonlinear spectral broadening of pulses with input pulse energy of 1.74mJ at 2.05μm inside a gas-filled Herriott-type multi-pass cell with efficiency of 95%. The transformlimited pulse duration is reduced from 1.43ps to 0.27ps.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed multi-wavelength, multi-mode optical interconnects using soliton microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate 130 Gbps transmission in each of 4 spatial modes using Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> soliton microcombs and inverse-designed silicon mode multiplexers. Out of 52 carriers, 42 data channels show natively error-free data transmission.

articleTitle: Fast full-field 3D surface profilometry by heterodyne interferometry of a femtosecond laser
abstract: We present an interferometer of a femtosecond laser for fast full-field 3D surface profilometry. The heterodyne interference is introduced to reduce the requirement of camera’s frame rate, thus achieving an enhancement on the measured speed. This method has experimentally demonstrated to increase the measurement speed several fold without significant loss of precision.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Laser Waveform Measurement in the Short-wave Infrared using Fluorescence Emission in a Solid
abstract: Multiphoton and tunneling excitation have been exploited as temporal gates to characterize few-cycle waveforms, including recently in single-shot measurements. We demonstrate that band fluorescence following multiphoton absorption allows single-shot waveform measurement in the short-wave infrared.

articleTitle: Energy Conversion Efficiency of High-Order Raman Solitons
abstract: We experimentally and numerically evaluate the energy distribution of fundamental solitons following a high-order soliton fission process. Under certain conditions, this evaluation significantly diverges from the prediction led by the inverse scattering method.

articleTitle: Development of sub-Gfps ultrafast snapshot imaging system based on recirculation filtering of ultrashort optical pulses
abstract: We demonstrated ultrafast snapshot imaging with a sub-GHz framerate on the basis of our newly proposed recirculation-filtering method, which enables us to generate a wavelength-division multiplexed pulse train with a time interval in nanosecond regime.

articleTitle: Quantum-Optimal Discrimination of Multiple Objects in Sub-Diffraction Incoherent Imaging
abstract: We derive the quantum limit for discriminating between M ≥ 2 incoherent, diffraction-limited objects and identify a quantum-optimal measurement that can distinguish two orders of magnitude more objects than direct imaging with no additional error.

articleTitle: High-gain photoreceiver module integrated with QD-SOA for high-baud-rate optical communication
abstract: We present a compact hybrid photoreceiver module integrated with a high-bandwidth photodetector and a temperature-stable 1.5-m quantum dot high-gain semiconductor optical amplifier instead of a transimpedance amplifier at 80 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Hollow-Core Fiber Based Inline Polarizer
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first compact antiresonant hollow-core fiber based inline polarizer. The device offers >25 dB polarization extinction ratio and <1.5 dB insertion loss when fusion spliced to mode-matched solid and hollow-core fibers.

articleTitle: Sub-ps Thermionic Charge Injection Effect on Exciton Formation Dynamics at Tungsten disulfide (WS2)/Metal Schottky Junction
abstract: We employ an optical pump-push-probe scheme to study how charge injection affects the dynamics of exciton formation in WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The transient response depends on the ratio of excited and injected electrons, revealing their effective interaction.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable (993-1110 nm) and ultra-short pulse (sub-40-fs) Yb:YLF lasers
abstract: We present a diode-pumped Yb:YLF oscillator with record cw (993-1110 nm) and fs (1019-1047 nm) tuning ranges, with up to 4 W power and 78% slope efficiency, generating pulses as short as 39-fs when mode-locked.

articleTitle: A Bayesian approach to nanoparticle characterization
abstract: We introduce and numerically validate a Bayesian method for plasmonic nanometrology. Applicable to any system described by a scattering cross section, our approach quantifies uncertainty automatically and enables model comparison through Bayes factors.

articleTitle: Thermalization of orbital angular momentum beams in optical fibers
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically study the thermalization of orbital angular momentum beams in nonlinear multimode graded-index optical fibers. Our results shed new light on the physical mechanism of the beam self-cleaning effect.
