articleTitle: Ultra-high-Q torsional nanomechanics for quantum experiments and precision measurement
abstract: We show that torsion modes of strained nanoribbons can have ultrahigh Q-factors, are naturally soft-clamped, and can be mass-loaded without changing their Q. We leverage these insights to realize sub-SQL optical lever measurements and chip-scale torsion pendula with µHz damping rates.

articleTitle: Enhanced Chiroptical Sensing through Coherent Perfect Absorption in a Parity-Time Symmetric System
abstract: We report how a coherent perfect absorber (CPA) enabled by an achiral optical system obeying parity-time (PT) symmetry has an enhanced ability to effectively sense molecular chirality of monolayered substances with unprecedented sensitivities.

articleTitle: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy of methane in hypersonic Laval expansions
abstract: We report the study of the hot bands of methane in a vibrationally hot and rotationally cool environment. The near infrared transitions were measured usingcavity ring down spectroscopy in a molecular hypersonic expansion.

articleTitle: DCT-Cam for Single-shot Action Recognition
abstract: We propose a DCT-Cam to capture the video spectrum directly from the scene in a single shot, which can reduce 75% data requirement and achieve the same accuracy for the action recognition.

articleTitle: Higher-Order Photonic Topological States in Split-Ring Resonators-Based Kagome Lattice
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the emergence of higher-order topological states induced by bianisotropy in a photonic metasurface formed by split-ring resonators (SRR) arranged into a kagome lattice.

articleTitle: Nearly-Resonant Crystalline-Phononic Coupling in Quantum Spin Liquid Candidate CsYbSe2
abstract: We study crystal field-phonon interactions in quantum spin liquid candidates CsYbSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with variable temperature, polarization, and magnetic-field dependent Raman microscopy. Complex interplay between phonon modes and CEF modes is observed in real space.

articleTitle: Multiparameter Monitoring of PAM4 Signals Using Deep Learning
abstract: PAM4 signal performance monitoring is demonstrated using CNN-based deep learning. A 98.51% prediction accuracy is achieved for jointly monitoring multiple parameters including baud rate, probabilistic shaping, roll-off factor, optical signal-to-noise ratio, and chromatic dispersion. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation of Squeezed Light from Non-Degenerate Backwards Four-Wave Mixing in Warm Rubidium
abstract: We report the generation of squeezed light from phase conjugation using backwards four-wave mixing in warm rubidium vapor. We observe a squeezing bandwidth of ~3MHz and achieve 1dB of intensity difference squeezing at 1MHz.

articleTitle: Cascaded Second Order Optical Nonlinearities in a Dielectric Metasurface
abstract: In this work, we prove the existence of cascaded second-order nonlinearities in a dielectric metasurface by analyzing the second and third wave mixing signal in conjunction with crystal symmetry and polarization selection rules.

articleTitle: First Real-Time 2.46Tb/s Ultra-Dense WSDM PON Demonstration with Optical Injection Locking Enabled Self-Homodyne Coherent Detection
abstract: Using optical injection locking enabled self-homodyne coherent detection, we demonstrated the first 2.46Tb/s real-time cost-efficient ultra-dense WSDM PON with filterless ONU, which can tolerate up to ~10MHz transmitter laser linewidth and 1024MHz frequency offset.

articleTitle: All-optical dynamic pulsed beam steering
abstract: We propose an all-optical scheme for dynamic pulsed beam steering using a spatial array of optical frequency combs with a uniform gradient in their carrier-envelope offset frequencies.

articleTitle: Kerr soliton dual-microcomb generation in a synchronously driven microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate a Kerr soliton dual-microcomb generation by synchronously driving two orthogonal polarization modes of a single microresonator. We also apply the generated dual-microcomb to perform a proof-of-concept spectroscopic measurement.

articleTitle: Manipulating optical field of a microcavity by tailoring phase space
abstract: We propose to manipulate the optical mode of a microcavity by tailoring its phase space, through which the photon transport can be precisely controlled, resulting in on-demand engineering of far-field emission patterns with experimental verifications.

articleTitle: Terahertz Generation and Acceleration
abstract: Laser based multi-cycle THz generation by difference frequency mixing has been pushed to optical to THz conversion efficiencies close to 1%. This opens up the possibility to implement THz driven electron and X-ray sources.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Flexible Chalcogenide Fibers with Capability of Transmitting 100-Watt-Level 2-5μm Laser
abstract: We report transmitting 2-μm laser power of 63 W through a 200-μm-core As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> fiber, under 120 W incident power. For the first time, a flexible chalcogenide fiber show the capability of delivering 100W-level 2-5μm laser.

articleTitle: Observation of intersubband polaritonic coupling in a quantum-cascade metasurface
abstract: An amplifying quantum-cascade (QC) metasurface – the key component of the QC vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting-laser (VECSEL) – is studied as a function of current density using reflection-mode terahertz time domain spectroscopy. Nearly perfect absorption and an anomalous reflection phase characteristic is measured at zero bias, which disappears as the device is biased to provide gain. This is attributed to critical coupling between a lossy intersubband transition within the active material and the metasurface resonance. These results provide insight into the interaction between the intersubband QC-gain material and the metasurface and modify the design rules for QC-VECSELs for both biased and unbiased regions.

articleTitle: Laser writing of single photon emitters in hexagonal boron nitride
abstract: We create single photon emitters in hexagonal boron nitride using a femtosecond laser and subsequent thermal annealing. Photoluminescence and photon anti-bunching measurements of generated bright spots clearly show that these are the single photon emitters.

articleTitle: Suppression of Timing-Jitter in a Collinear LiNbO3 Optical-to-Terahertz Converter
abstract: We report passive compensation of terahertz timing-jitter via collinear combination of the two-sided Cherenkov radiation emitted in a LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> slab. The timing drift per beam displacement is reduced 70-fold compared to non-collinear geometries.

articleTitle: Time-Correlated Photons from a Triply Resonant Photonic Crystal Cavity
abstract: Correlated Photon pair generation via triply resonant spontaneous Four-Wave-Mixing is demonstrated in Photonic Crystal Cavities. Consistently with scaling rules, gen-eration efficiency is larger than in ring resonator made of the same technology.

articleTitle: Spectral gain measurement of extended L-band EDFAs using a saturating tone
abstract: We compare the spectral gain measurement of an extended L-band EDFA performed using a saturation tone combined with a tunable signal, to the measurement done with an L-band comb source. The optimum tone wavelength is investigated.

articleTitle: Scalable Optical Control for Atomic Qubits in a Silicon Nitride Platform
abstract: Here we present a new integrated photonics platform for optical quantum control that allows the generation of multiple high fidelity optical pulses to implement quantum gates on individual atomic qubits at speeds exceeding several hundred MHz.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning Kerr solitons with repetition rates of 1, 2, and 3 THz in a Si3N4 microresonator
abstract: Octave-spanning single-soliton and soliton crystals with repetition rates of 1, 2, and 3 THz are demonstrated in a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator. A single-soliton step with ~0.09 nm (~11 GHz) is achieved using slow pump tuning.

articleTitle: Generation and all-optical measurement of few-cycle vacuum squeezing in lithium niobate nanophotonics
abstract: We demonstrate 4.2 dB (~11 dB inferred) of few-cycle vacuum squeezing over more than 25 THz of bandwidth in lithium niobate nanophotonics enabling practical paths towards scalable photonic quantum information systems with THz clock rates.

articleTitle: Metasurface blue-detuned atom trap arrays using singularity engineering
abstract: An array of ten identical, blue-detuned atom traps with 3D confinement generated by inverse-designed metasurface is presented, a proof-of-concept for metasurfaces as a compact and versatile means for multi-atom optical traps in quantum optics.

articleTitle: Single-Ended Coherent Channel Estimation
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method for finding the coherent transfer matrix (CTM) of a multi-channel transmission medium utilizing backscattering and coherent optical time-domain reflectometry (COTDR). We measured the CTM for two polarizations of a single-mode fiber with ±0.3dB and ±8.5° amplitude and phase precisions.

articleTitle: 1000-Element Silicon Optical Phased Array for Aliasing-Free 2D Optical Beam Steering
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 1000-element silicon optical phased array based on a slab grating and half-wavelength-spacing waveguide array. A large beam steering range of >140° and a small beam divergence of 0.16° were achieved.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Orbital Angular Momentum Carrying Fibers
abstract: We show that orbital angular momentum, and especially its coupling with spin angular momentum (polarization), yields distinctive selection rules for the modal content of Stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical fibers.

articleTitle: High Pulse Energy, Erbium-doped, Very-Large Mode Area Fiber Amplifier
abstract: We report pulse energy ~3.85mJ from 1480nm core-pumped, 6m long Er-doped VLMA fiber amplifier with 50μm core diameter and 50dB/m absorption, and diffraction-limited output, by amplifying broad-linewidth microsecond pulses at 10-kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Vanadium Dioxide Metasurfaces for Continuous Optical Wavefront Tuning
abstract: We design and fabricate vanadium dioxide metasurfaces for dynamic optical amplitude, phase, and beam angle modulation. Temperature-dependent ellipsometry yields a refractive index modulation of ~1.8. Metasurface optical modulation of ~17 dB is projected with near π phase tuning.

articleTitle: Quantum metrology of two-photon absorption
abstract: We consider the measurement of two-photon absorption (TPA) cross sections as a quantum metrology problem. We establish the scaling behaviour of nonclassical light sources for precision measurements of TPA cross sections and assess different measurement strategies. Finally, the impact of single-photon losses is discussed.

articleTitle: Pulse energy scaling of multi-pass cells for nonlinear spectral broadening applications
abstract: We discuss basic pulse energy scaling principles for multi-pass cells (MPCs) and introduce a novel multi-pass cell type which we employ to numerically predictpost-compression of 125 mJ pulses using a 2 m setup.

articleTitle: Highly efficient high-harmonic generation from artificially stacked 2D materials
abstract: We report high-harmonic generation from the artificially stacked monolayer tungsten disulfide. The harmonic yield scales quadratically with the number of layers, limited by reabsorption by subsequent layers for above bandgap energies.

articleTitle: Time-Stamping of Ultrafast Electron Probes Using Terahertz Radiation
abstract: We show a method for detection and correction of the time-of-arrival jitter of electron bunches generated from an rf photoeinjector through Terahertz time-stamping, subsequently improving the temporal resolution of pump-probe UED measurements.

articleTitle: Tapered multi-core fiber for biomedical lens-less endoscopes
abstract: We present a novel fiber-optic component, a “tapered multi-core fiber”, designed for integration into ultra-miniaturized endoscopes for minimally invasive imaging. We develop a numerical model and use it to identify optimal designs which we then fabricate and experimentally validate.

articleTitle: An Investigation on High-Resolution Color Conversion Layer Based on Colloidal Quantum Dots
abstract: Fine pixel (5-micron) array patterning of colloidal quantum dots is achieved via inkjet dispense and semiconductor processes. The vacuum storage lifetime can be as long as 12830 hours when a dielectric protective layer is on.

articleTitle: New type of frequency standard transitions realized by comb laser
abstract: The clock transitions recommended by BIPM are never realized by a femtosecond comb laser. In this report, we recommend two comb-laser-based stepwise transitions resolved simultaneously from rubidium and cesium atom.

articleTitle: Nonlinear chirped Doppler interferometry for ultrafast χ(3) spectroscopy
abstract: We report a novel jitter-free ultrafast spectroscopy method to investigate third-order nonlinearity. The method is applied to assess the nonlinear refractive indices of orientated, nematic liquid crystals in the femtosecond regime.

articleTitle: High-dimensional Stokes-space spatial beam analyzer
abstract: We demonstrate a device for measuring the generalized Stokes parameters of a six spatial mode beam. The device is a single-shot wavefront sensor measuring spatial complex amplitude and coherence without an external phase reference.

articleTitle: Imaging through Disordered Optical Fiber System Using Unsupervised Learning
abstract: Because of the excellent light guidance provided by transverse Anderson localization, unsupervised learning is sufficient for high-fidelity cell imaging through disordered fibers. A multi-step image recovery process, including standardization and generative adversarial networks, is presented.

articleTitle: Experimental Single-Copy Entanglement Distillation
abstract: We experimentally realize an entanglement distillation protocol which, against conventional wisdom, operates on a single photon pair entangled in two properties. This enables practical entanglement distillation which is orders of magnitude more efficient over long distances.

articleTitle: ZPAN: A New Organic Nonlinear Optical Crystal for THz Generation
abstract: We discover and characterize the new organic nonlinear optical crystal ZPAN for THz generation.

articleTitle: Generation of arbitrarily oriented spatiotemporal optical vortices with nonlocal metasurfaces
abstract: We investigated a family of spatiotemporal optical vortices with arbitrarily oriented orbital angular momentum, and introduce a compact metasurface device for its generation. This is achieved by engineering the transmission nodal line of the device.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient Nonlinear Subcarriers for Nonlinear Frequency Division Multiplexing
abstract: We propose the use of spectrally efficient Hermite-Gaussian carriers, for NFT-based optical communication systems and demonstrate a record high SE for NFDM schemes in excess of 4.4 bits/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Sub-100 femtosecond resolution of clock-offset measurement over a 100 km fiber link with dual-comb sampling
abstract: We demonstrate a sub-100 femtosecond level resolution clock-offset measurement via a 100 km near-zero dispersion fiber by transferring high coherence optical frequency combs, each phase-locked to the ultra-narrow linewidth lasers.

articleTitle: Real-space nanophotonic field manipulation using Landau polaritons
abstract: We develop the theory of multimode hybridization in polariton platforms. In the specific case of Landau polaritons we demonstrate the possibility of tuning the near-field electromagnetic spatial mode profile by hybridising multiple metamaterial modes.

articleTitle: Optical limiters relying on VO2 phase transition in thin multilayer films
abstract: We propose a self-activating optical limiter device based on phase transition of vanadium dioxide in thin multilayer films. The optimal geometry reduces the transmitted power by ~ 70% and shows a recovery time of 10 ns.

articleTitle: Towards efficient nanostructuring of silica glass by elliptically polarized ultrafast laser pulses
abstract: Efficient creation of anisotropic nanopores and associated birefringence in silica glass by elliptically polarized femtosecond laser pulses is observed, contrary to common belief. Application to multiplexed optical data storage is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Accidental BIC in All-Dielectric Nano-Sized Tri-Air holes Silicon Disk Resonator
abstract: We report a high-quality factor (~ 1800 and 348) in a compact all-dielectric three hollow-channeled Si disk resonator that exhibits multiple accidental bound states in the continuum for normally incident x polarized light.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared SEIRA Sensors Employing Liquid-Metal-Based Nanophotonic Structures
abstract: We demonstrate mid-infrared SEIRA sensors employing an unconventional liquid-metal-based nanophotonic structure, which allows for convenient delivery of thin film analyte into the sensing hot spots. State-of-the-art SEIRA sensing performance was demonstrated for sensing monolayer 1-octadecanethiol.

articleTitle: Experimental Entanglement-Enhanced Covert Sensing
abstract: We report the theory and experiment for entanglement-enhanced covert sensing, a paradigm that simultaneously offers high measurement precision and data integrity by concealing the execution of the protocol.

articleTitle: Multiple-access channel with a single photon
abstract: We present and experimentally demonstrate a quantum-enhanced multipleaccess channel consisting of multiple senders, a single receiver and a single particle as the medium. A Bell-type inequality violation and greater capacity rate sum are observed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Impact of CaCO3 Concentrations on the Fluorescence Lifetime of Polypropylene
abstract: The impact of fillers on the fluorescence lifetime of polymers is still unknown. Investigating polypropylene containing different CaCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> concentrations using FD-FLIM show an exponential increase in fluorescence lifetime proportional to the CaCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> density in polypropylene.

articleTitle: 160 Gbps IM/DD amplifier-free transmission using a 10GHz-class DML with low-power DNLE and MLSE
abstract: The 160Gbps (2km SSMF) and 150Gbps (10km SSMF) amplifier-free IM/DD transmissions are demonstrated based on a commercial 10G-class DML by utilizing advanced low power and complexity digital signal processing (DSP).

articleTitle: Metasurfaces on Silicon Photonics for Simultaneous Emission Amplitude and Phase Control
abstract: We numerically and experimentally demonstrate simultaneous control of emission amplitude and phase control with amorphous silicon metasurfaces monolithically integrated on silicon waveguides. We generate emission patterns, including a focused Gaussian beam and a Hermite-Gaussian mode.

articleTitle: Hidden Four-Mode Entanglement in a Single-pass Stimulated FWM
abstract: We present a hidden entanglement between four-modes generated by stimu-lated FWM. Theoretically, we show the violation of DGCZ inequality for different sideband bipartitions. Experimentally we present previous results of the auto-homodyne detection and the asymmetry in the sidebands.

articleTitle: Seeing through unknown, random diffusers using diffractive optical networks
abstract: Diffractive deep neural networks composed of spatially-engineered transmissive layers were designed and experimental demonstrated to see through unknown, random phase diffusers, instantaneously reconstructing images of unknown objects without the need for a digital computer.

articleTitle: Self-injection Locked Photonic Time Crystals in a Dually-pumped Kerr Microcavity
abstract: We demonstrate the simultaneous self-injection locking of two independent lasers to same-family Kerr cavity modes. The pumps realize dissipative discrete time crystals through sub-harmonic generation and can completely dominate mode anti-crossings in the pumping region.

articleTitle: Waveguide integrated nonreciprocal optical routers for silicon photonics
abstract: We report a silicon integrated 5×5 nonreciprocal optical router based on the magnetooptical nonreciprocal phase shift effect. The device shows an asymmetric scattering matrix, with 16 dB isolation ratio and -22 dB crosstalk measured at 1551 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Theory of Ground State Cooling of a Macroscopic Anelastic Mechanical Oscillator
abstract: Conventional laser cooling techniques have proved inefficient on mechanical oscillators heavier than a few nanograms. Here, we present a new approach to realize motional ground state cooling of such oscillators, paving the way to currently inaccessible experiments such as tests of gravity’s effect on massive quantum systems.

articleTitle: Excitation of photon localization state with giant atom coupled in a waveguide-QED system
abstract: We study a theoretical model where light transports along a dynamically-modulated coupled-resonator waveguide interacting with a giant atom, and find a bound state where photon is localized and excited atom exhibits a subradiant decay.

articleTitle: Wavelength tunable mid-infrared generation in non-critically cut CdSiP2 crystals by cascaded optical parametric generation with a nanosecond 1.064 μm Nd:YAG laser
abstract: We demonstrate a method to generate wavelength tunable mid-infrared radiation from 3.7–4.3 μm using a nanosecond 1.064 μm Nd:YAG pump at 10 Hz, employing cascaded optical parametric generation in non-critically cut CdSiP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystals.

articleTitle: Spectral compression of biphotons using time-varying cavities for quantum networking
abstract: We propose and analyze the use of linear, time-variant cavities for spectral compression of broadband frequency correlated photon pairs, with potential applications in quantum networking. Our time-varying cavity relies on rapid electro-optic switching of input coupling to the cavity.

articleTitle: Broadband, high polarization extinction ratio, and mirror-integrated superluminescent diode for light source of Si photonics
abstract: Broadband and high polarization-extinction ratio (PER) superluminescent diode integrated with Si photonics platform has been demonstrated. The light was transferred into grating coupler by reflection mirror, leading to >1mW, >25nm bandwidth, and >20dB PER.

articleTitle: Optical Clocks with Trapped Ions: Atomic and Nuclear Clocks
abstract: Progress on optical clocks with laser cooled trapped ions is presented with a focus on two systems that both possess small systematic uncertainties and a high sensitivity in fundamental tests: The <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion with an E3 transition and the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">229</sup>Th<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ion with a low-energy nuclear transition.

articleTitle: Slotted Silicon Microring Resonator Gated by Transparent Conducting Oxide Capacitor
abstract: We demonstrated a slotted silicon microring resonator with the waveguide gap filled by high mobility titanium-doped indium oxide (ITiO) MOS capacitor. It experimentally achieved an extremely large electro-optic wavelength tunability of 540 pm/V.

articleTitle: Multimode optical field reconstruction from higher-order nonclassicality parameters
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a multimode field reconstruction technique combining the N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order correlation functions (g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(N)</sup>’s) and the recently proposed θ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(N)</sup> parameters, resilient to Poissonian noise. Our technique is best-suited for characterizing single-photon emitters with background noise.

articleTitle: 7-octave high-brightness CEP-stable light source
abstract: We present a carrier-envelope-phase stable light source, seeded by a mid-IR frequency comb, with simultaneous spectral coverage across 7 optical octaves, from the UV (340 nm) into the THz (40,000 nm).

articleTitle: Photonic Spiking Neural Network with Resonant Tunnelling Diode Optoelectronic Neurons
abstract: We report high-speed, energy-efficient artificial optoelectronic spiking neurons based upon resonant tunnelling diodes (RTD). Using these, we demonstrate a photonic spiking neural network (perceptron) numerical model for classification of spatiotemporal pulse patterns with 94% accuracy.

articleTitle: Highly integrated reconfigurable radiofrequency filter based on microcomb and a silicon photonic processor
abstract: We demonstrate a novel chip-scale reconfigurable radiofrequency filter by using AlGaAs-on-insulator microcomb and silicon photonics in combination, simultaneously bypassing the employment of bulky pulse shaper and long-haul dispersive fiber.

articleTitle: Sympathetic Cooling of Nanoparticles Levitated in a Paul Trap
abstract: We demonstrate three-dimensional sympathetic cooling of the center-of-mass motion of a silica nanoparticle. The nanoparticle is coupled to a feedback-cooled particle in an ion trap. We investigate limits of the process and discuss optimum strategies.

articleTitle: Modeling the frequency response of vertical and lateral Ge-on-Si waveguide photodetectors: Is 3D simulation unavoidable?
abstract: Using a 3D multiphysics model as a reference, we investigate the achievements and limitations of a simpler 2D drift-diffusion model to reproduce and optimize the electrooptical frequency response of vertical and lateral Ge-on-Si waveguide photodetectors.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based transformation of H&E stained tissue into special stains
abstract: We present a deep learning-based technique to computationally transform H&E-stained tissue sections into different special stains. We also demonstrate that this stain-to-stain transformation framework improves diagnostic accuracy over the use of H&E only.

articleTitle: Inverse Spectral Design of Microcombs: Meta-Dispersion in Photonic-Crystal Ring Resonators
abstract: Inverse design is used to spectrally shape Kerr microcombs via dispersion optimization. We experimentally demonstrate flexible ‘meta’ dispersion control using selective multimode hybridization in photonic crystal ring resonators and present initial comb results.

articleTitle: Landau Polaritons in a Full-Dielectric Three-Dimensional Photonic-Crystal Cavity
abstract: We fabricated a full-dielectric three-dimensional photonic-crystal cavity containing an ultrahigh-mobility two-dimensional electron gas. By applying a strong perpendicular magnetic field, we created Landau polaritons originating from the ultrastrong coupling of electrons with cavity modes.

articleTitle: Frequency-bin Bell state generation via successive single and dual spectral-line pumping
abstract: We demonstrate a simple and versatile scheme to generate all four two-dimensional frequency-bin Bell states using single and dual spectral-line pumps and passive filtering. Experimentally, we measure ≥97% fidelity for all states.

articleTitle: Line-scan Confocal Endomicroscopy for Rapid Digital Histology of Early Breast Cancer
abstract: We present a high-speed line-scan confocal laser endomicroscope, which enables digital histopathology of freshly excised un-fixed breast tissue specimens in real-time.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband quadrature squeezing with thin-film lithium niobate nanophotonics
abstract: We demonstrate squeezed light generation with parametric down-conversion single-pass configuration on thin-film lithium niobate nanophotonics. We measure 0.56 dB quadrature squeezing (~2.6 dB inferred on-chip) with 7 THz bandwidth.

articleTitle: 3D scanning quantum LIDAR
abstract: Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) is a powerful imaging technique. By utilising a superconducting nanowire single photon detector (SNSPD) we construct a 3D scanning LIDAR system operating with eye-safe infrared laser pulses and millimeter pre-cision.

articleTitle: High-Power, All-Fiber, Yb-Doped Multi-Core Fiber Amplifier
abstract: We have demonstrated a 173 W, all-fiber multicore amplifier using a six-core single-mode Yb-doped fiber and an all-fiber multi-core pump-signal combiner. Each of Yb-doped cores has 17-µm mode-field diameter and is capable of kW-class operation.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous integration of AlGaAs/GaAs photodiodes on tantala waveguides for visible-light applications
abstract: For the first time we demonstrate heterogeneously integrated photodiodes on tantalum pentoxide (Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>, or tantala) for visible light detection. The photodiodes have 20 pA dark current, 0.115 A/W responsivity at 635 nm wavelength, and a projected >12 GHz RC-limited bandwidth.

articleTitle: AutoML Hyperparameter Tuning of Generative DNN Architecture for Nanophotonic Device Design
abstract: We introduce an automated machine learning (AutoML) framework to construct a deep neural network model relevant for inverse design of nanophotonic devices without relying on manual trial-and-error hyperparameter tuning.

articleTitle: Floquet topological quadrupole in photonic crystals protected by space-time symmetry
abstract: We present that a space-time screw symmetry can be preserved in periodically driven optical nonlinear materials. Such symmetry can protect a high-order topological phase, which is demonstrated with a photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Dark Plasmonic Mode Assisted Broadband Adiabatic Light Transfer and Polarizing Beam Splitting
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a broadband light transfer and polarizing beam splitting assisted by a dark plasmonic mode [1] using stimulated Raman adiabatic passage. The plasmonic loss is mitigated by the unique mode evolution mechanism.

articleTitle: High operating temperature plasmonic detectors
abstract: We demonstrate high operating temperature plasmonic infrared detectors, with sub-diffractive absorber thicknesses. Our detectors operate at 230 K with substantially better performance than commercial detectors at the same operating temperature.

articleTitle: Electro-plasmonic Nanoantennas for In Vivo Neural Sensing
abstract: Electro-plasmonic nanoantennas (NeuroSWARM<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) translate local electric fields to changes in scattering intensity to wirelessly sense neural activity with high resolution, throughput, and SSNR while operating in the NIR spectrum for deep tissue penetration.

articleTitle: Real-Time Explosion Dynamics in a Thulium-doped Linear Fiber Laser
abstract: Real-time explosion dynamics in a transition chaotic state and a dual-wavelength vector soliton state in a thulium-doped linear fiber laser are analyzed with real-time pulse measurements.

articleTitle: Coherent Doppler Lidar for Improved Object Velocomitry using Dual Measurement Fusion
abstract: The fusing of Time-of-Flight measurements with Doppler shifts in Pulsed Coherent Doppler Lidar (Pulsed CDL) through a Kalman Filter. Live tests for noise characterization and simulations show that object range and velocity estimates are improved over traditional Pulsed CDL by 3.9% and 16%, respectively.

articleTitle: Terahertz Electric Field Microscopy of Ultrafast Near-fields
abstract: We present a new ultrafast field microscope based on the visible luminescence of semiconductor quantum dots. The quantum-confined Stark-effect enables the resolution of Terahertz near-fields beyond the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Planar Terahertz Toroidal Meta-Device for Efficient Polarization Conversion
abstract: An ultra-wideband polarization conversion of linearly polarized light via a toroidal metamaterial has been demonstrated experimentally. The cross-polarization conversion of more than 40% is achieved which is highest to the best of our knowledge.

articleTitle: Improving model accuracy of National Ignition Facility fusion class laser using black-box optimization techniques
abstract: Experiments conducted at NIF require delivery of precisely shaped laser pulse to the target. To accurately deliver such shaped pulses, a high-fidelity laser model is crucial. We describe improvement in NIF laser model accuracy using black-box optimization technique.

articleTitle: Topological Lasers with Epitaxially Grown InGaAs Nanowires on a SOI Substrate
abstract: We report a semiconductor laser based on optical cavities formed by topologically distinct honeycomb lattice photonic crystals. Topological lasers, fabricated on SOI wafers by using a selective area epitaxy method, can have edge modes and bulk modes under optical pumping.

articleTitle: Fiber Grating sensor based in curvature sensing for monitoring bidirectional displacements
abstract: A Bragg grating sensor prototype for Structural Monitoring is presented for the measurement of bidirectional displacements (±50 mm) with a single grating, based on curvature sensing with a sensitivity up to 40 pm/mm.

articleTitle: Defect-engineered localized exciton in monolayer WSe2
abstract: Here, we demonstrate controlled defect engineering in monolayer WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> via UV-ozone treatment. The creation of Tungsten oxyselenide (TOS) shows broad red-shifted PL emission centered at ~770 nm at room temperature.

articleTitle: Active hyperspectral imager based on a supercontinuum laser and a MEMS Fabry–Pérot interferometer
abstract: We present the design and characterization of tunable SWIR supercontinuum laser based active hyperspectral imager. A MEMS Fabry–Perot interferometer is used for nondispersive wavelength selection, enabling the use of monochromatic camera for hyperspectral imaging.

articleTitle: A Space-efficient Optical Computing Chip Based on Diffractive Neural Network
abstract: A the integrated diffractive optical network for implementing parallel Fourier transforms, convolution operations and application-specific optical computing is demonstrated and achieved ~10-fold reduction in both footprint and energy consumption. It has high potential in optical-artificial-intelligence.

articleTitle: Periodic Localization in Homogeneous Photonic Lattices with Temporal Coupling Gradients
abstract: We theoretically describe and experimentally realize periodic spatial wave packet recurrence in homogeneous lattices under the action of a temporal coupling gradient. We observe these dynamics in photonic mesh lattices.

articleTitle: Hybrid Metal-Silicon Metasurface for Reconfigurable THz Wave Modulation
abstract: We propose reconfigurable THz wave modulation using high-definition photoinduced patterns on hybrid metal-silicon metasurface. The method suppresses lateral diffusion of photogenerated carriers and enables continuous photoconductive patterns. A tunable bandpass filter is investigated.

articleTitle: Compact Silicon Photonics Meandered Mach-Zehnder Modulator
abstract: We report a C-band compact (100 × 420 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and power efficient (0.9 pJ/bit) SiP meandered Mach-Zehnder modulator with low optical loss (2.09 dB) and demonstrate DAC-less and DSP-free 32 Gbps OOK transmission with Q=6.64 dB.

articleTitle: Optical Nonlinearity of Colloidal Quantum Wells Coupled to a Low Mode-Volume Cavity
abstract: CdSe colloidal quantum wells (CQWs) are coupled to low mode-volume silicon nitride nanobeam cavities with selective material placement, and CdSe CQW cavity-coupled photoluminescence indicates optical nonlinearity at room temperature.

articleTitle: Multi-channel approach for secure optical image encryption
abstract: We propose a generalized encryption scheme suited for transmission of image data on multiple wavelength channels. Our key space size grows double-exponentially with number of channels, ensuring security against both brute-force and more sophisticated attacks.

articleTitle: Spectrally Tunable High-Power Low-Noise Yb:fiber-based Chirped Pulse Amplifier
abstract: We report on 100-W 132 MHz Yb:fiber amplifier seeded by a low noise oscillator. We tune the laser spectrum to match it to different applications while keeping noise properties and power performance of the system.

articleTitle: Bypassing dynamic reciprocity via a chiral cross-Kerr nonlinearity
abstract: The optical Kerr nonlinearity can't be used to achieve on-chip optical nonreciprocity because of dynamic reciprocity. Here, we propose a chiral cross-Kerr nonlinearity to bypass dynamic reciprocity and to achieve all-optical nonreciprocity on a chip.

articleTitle: Liquid-crystal optical electrodes for neural interfacing
abstract: Traditional systems for neural interfacing rely on electrons for signal transmission from the biological tissue. We discuss herein an alternative approach using light to both sense and transmit the neural signals. Central to this approach is novel passive, fluorophore-free optical electrode.

articleTitle: Optical Parametric Amplification of Intense Few-Cycle, Passively Phase-Locked 2 μm Pulses at 100 kHz repetition rate
abstract: We develop a few-cycle femtosecond optical parametric amplifier with a passively stabilized carrier-envelope phase in the 1.8-2.5μm region, and tunable repetition rates up to 100 kHz with a fixed pulse energy of approximately 30 µJ.

articleTitle: Modeling the Image Formation Process in Fourier Domain Optical Coherence Microscopy for a Bessel-like LP02 Mode from a Higher Order Mode Fiber
abstract: We model the full image formation process in FD-OCM for a Bessel-like LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf> illumination beam as well as Gaussian beams. The LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf> beam generated in a HOM fiber enables design flexibility and an extended DOF.

articleTitle: Beam Forming in Integrated Optical Phased Array Enabled with Deep Neural Network
abstract: The application of DNN to adaptively control phase in integrated optical-phased-array to form desired beams is proposed. Beam scanning with 0.1° step and accuracy of 0.02°, and beam forming with two independent peaks are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Restoration of Gas Dynamics on Laser Filamentation at High Repetition Rates
abstract: We demonstrate that thermal effects limiting femtosecond laser filamentation in gases can be addressed using a simple gas replenishment method. This enables high average power filamentation applications like THz sources.

articleTitle: Long-lived THz-induced birefringent state in quantum paraelectric KTaO3
abstract: We report the observation of a long-lived birefringent state in quantum para-electric KTaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> induced by THz pump pulses in a two-THz-photon process. We relate this long-lived state to the proximity of the ferroelectric phase transition.

articleTitle: High power burst mode laser for compact enhancement cavities
abstract: We report on an ultrafast laser delivering 10mJ burst energy at a repetition rate of 10kHz, with a GHz intraburst repetition rate. The low phase noise is compatible with coupling into high-finesse enhancement cavities.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric High-Speed Spatial Light Modulator Based on Guided-Mode Resonances
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed spatial light modulator technology based on a silicon nitride platform fabricated in a CMOS process. Using piezoelectrically modulated guided-mode resonances, we can reach bandwidths over 10 MHz for a single pixel.

articleTitle: Simulation of large-area metasurfaces with a distributed transition matrix method
abstract: We present a method to accurately compute simulations and gradients of large-area metasurfaces. Our distribution strategy gives a linear simulation time reduction proportional to number of compute nodes, opening the door to accurate large-scale inverse-design.

articleTitle: Nano-Opto-Electro-Mechanical Relaxor Ferroelectrics
abstract: We harness the giant electro-mechanical force of relaxor ferroelectrics to fabricate flexible BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanobeams, adjacent to plasmonic metasurfaces. We record reflection modulation of near-infrared light up to 2.936 ±0.008% across the kHz to MHz range.

articleTitle: Tunable terahertz-wave confinement in a nonlinear topological photonic chip
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear generation and topologically tuned confinement of THz waves in a wedge-shaped Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice laser-written in a lithium-niobate chip, examining THz defect modes from band structure and analyzing their robustness to chiral perturbation.

articleTitle: Scalable quantum information processing architecture using a programmable array of spin-photon interfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable quantum information processing architecture consisting of a planar array of tin-vacancy (SnV) centers, tunable across a thousand diamond cavities integrated on a control chip based on a commercial foundry process.

articleTitle: An Er/Yb:glass laser-based optical frequency comb for precision metrology
abstract: We characterize an Er/Yb:glass laser frequency comb for precision metrology of atomic clocks and demonstrate a fractional frequency instability < 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> at 1-s averaging and a 10 GHz phase noise < -110 dBc/Hz at a 1 Hz offset.

articleTitle: Thermal-tuning of Amorphous Silicon Carbide Nanophotonic Devices
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate thermally tunable nanophotonic devices in amorphous-silicon carbide-on-insulator integrated platforms. The resonant wavelength of the microring resonators and the bandgap of the two-dimensional photonic crystal waveguides are tuned, based on the thermo-optic effect.

articleTitle: Phase Recovery and Holographic Imaging using Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)
abstract: We demonstrate a recurrent neural network (RNN) enabled holographic imaging method that simultaneously performs autofocusing and phase recovery, achieving faster reconstruction speed and extended depth-of-field.

articleTitle: Supersensitive Optical Phase Measurement Using a Novel Deterministic Multi-Photon Noon State
abstract: On demand generated Noon state is used for optical phase measurement with precision which is better than the standard noise limit, depending only on the detectors’ efficiency.

articleTitle: Online inverse design chip for matrix computation and tunable wavelength selection switch
abstract: We demonstrate an online inverse design chip realizing incoherent arbitrary positive matrix computation with high accuracy and tunable wavelength selection switch whose extinction ratio of each output port is beyond 10dB.

articleTitle: Temporal Binding of a Coherent Spectrally Translated Pulse from a Dissipative Kerr Soliton in a Synthetic Frequency Lattice
abstract: We present a dissipative Kerr soliton in a synthetic frequency lattice mediated by four-wave mixing Bragg scattering. The dual pumping creates a potential that temporally binds a coherent spectrally translated pulse to the original soliton.

articleTitle: Spontaneous photon pair generation at the nanoscale
abstract: Subwavelength resonators have recently emerged as promising sources of spontaneous parametric down-conversion. By modeling them with quasi-normal mode expansion, we reveal a nonlinear multimode interaction and assist the design of efficient metasurfaces for quantum technologies.

articleTitle: Single-pulse Laser Induced Buried Defects in Silicon Written by Ultrashort-pulse Laser at 2.1 um
abstract: We report sub-wavelength micrometer-sized buried defects induced in silicon by single ultrashort laser pulses at 2.09 μm. We also report laser-induced depressed cladding waveguide and other 3D-structures, and demonstrate waveguiding.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning Based Focal Stack Camera Depth Estimation
abstract: We propose an unsupervised deep learning based method to estimate depth from focal stack camera images. On the NYU-v2 dataset, our method achieves much better depth estimation accuracy compared to single-image based methods.

articleTitle: Validation of a multi-frequency differential absorption LIDAR (DIAL) system from aerosol and cloud retrievals
abstract: A ten wavelength DIAL system based on a 100 Hz optical parametric oscillator (OPO) is used to simultaneously acquire range-resolved and integrated path dry-air CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentrations from soft cloud targets in Boulder, Colorado.

articleTitle: Object Identification Using Time-of-Flight Depth Camera and Data Fusion
abstract: We demonstrate an approach of object identification using a ToF depth camera. Six objects with different materials are recognized with data fusion and machine learning methods. A 98.01% accuracy is achieved by using KNN algorithm.

articleTitle: Theoretical Proposal of Optical Neural Network Architecture with Temporal Synthetic Dimension
abstract: We theoretically propose the construction of the optical neural network architecture for deep learning in a single ring resonator, with the concept of temporal synthetic dimension formed by arrival times of optical pulses.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency-like effect with topological protection
abstract: By introducing a kagome lattice with higher-order corner states into a photonic crystal waveguide system, we realize EIT-like effect with topological protection.

articleTitle: Ultrafast wavefront control of femtosecond pulses using optical phased array based on optical frequency comb
abstract: An optical phased array with a frequency-controlled optical frequency comb has been proposed for controlling the synthesized wavefront of broadband ultrashort pulses by changing only the ratio of two frequency parameters of the comb.

articleTitle: FEC-free optical data transmission with a chip-integrated microresonator frequency comb source
abstract: We investigated the feasibility of IM-DD communication in a microcomb. Turing pattern and soliton combs are ideal, though MI comb can transmit signals when the pump-detuning is well controlled and excessive noise is suppressed.

articleTitle: Graphene-Oxide Based Humidity Sensor Employing Few Micron Diameter Optical Fiber
abstract: Novel relative-humidity (RH) sensor employing GO as sensing medium onto few micron diameter optical fiber is reported. Very high sensitivity with linear response over dynamic range 5%RH- 87%RH is observed.

articleTitle: Optical Two-Dimensional Coherent Spectroscopy of Cold Atoms
abstract: We report the first implementation of optical two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy of cold atoms. The experiment opens a new avenue to study many-body interactions and correlations in cold atoms/molecules.

articleTitle: Broadband Optical Circulator for Mid-IR Quantum Cascade Frequency-comb Remote Sensors
abstract: We present an optical circulator that maximizes usable light while attenuating optical feedback to mid-IR quantum cascade laser combs. The circulator preserves over 87% of light and maintains optical feedback below 1%.

articleTitle: Photonic Vector Modulator Based on MRR Weight Banks
abstract: A microwave photonic phase shifter is presented based on a complex Cartesian weighting approach using microring resonators. The proposed architecture realizes simultaneous phase shifting and combining of RF signals using wavelength-division-multiplexed optical signals.

articleTitle: GHz Harmonic Mode Locked Fiber Laser by Using an Over-coupled Long Period Fiber Grating Based Saturable Absorber
abstract: We demonstrated a harmonic mode-locked fiber laser by using saturable absorber based on interaction of over-coupled long period fiber grating and carbon nanotubes. Maximum repetition rate of 2.416 GHz was obtained with 15 mW output.

articleTitle: Random number generation using spontaneous symmetry breaking in a Kerr resonator
abstract: We present an all-optical random number generator based on polarization symmetry breaking in a passive, nonlinear Kerr cavity. The system generates numbers with statistically confirmed randomness at MHz rates with no post-processing.

articleTitle: Repeated thermally deposited and annealed gold thin films as SERS-active substrate
abstract: Size of gold nano-islands and gap between them is engineered using repeated gold film deposition and then annealing in the presence of argon gas. Increase in the density of nano-islands resulted in better SERS performance.

articleTitle: A model-based approach to achieve a multi-100kHz repetition rate, self-seeded Q-switched oscillator with stable pulse-to-pulse energies
abstract: We provide a model-based approach to high-repetition-rate Q-switched oscillators. We show that the quantum-stochastic nature of the seed can be identified as cause for pulse-to-pulse instabilities at multi-100kHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: High Contrast Variable-Emissivity Coating using Vanadium Dioxide
abstract: We demonstrated a variable-emissivity coating incorporating vanadium dioxide with an integrated hemispherical emissivity that is switchable between values of 0.79 (maximum) and 0.17 (minimum) 0.17 that can be used for passive thermal control of spacecraft.

articleTitle: Silicon Optical Phased Array with 180-degree Field of View for Solid-State 2D Beam Steering
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a silicon optical phased array based on a slab grating and waveguide array with a half-wavelength pitch. 2D beam steering with 180° field of view and low side lobe level (<-19 dB within ±40°) has been achieved.

articleTitle: Detection of Starch Content variations in Grasses using Raman Microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate the use of Raman microscopy to monitor spatial and temporal variations in starch content in leaves. High throughput, non-invasive, measurements of starch accumulations can improve biomass production predictions and assist breeding programs.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Spectroscopy for Astronomical Spectrograph Calibration
abstract: Precise and accurate calibration of astronomical spectrograph is key in exo-planet searches and cosmological studies. Dual-comb spectroscopy of a Fabry-Pérot cavity represents a new approach to absolute calibration avoiding the need for high-repetition rate lasers.

articleTitle: Integrated Metasurfaces for Free-Space Wavefront Generation with Amplitude, Phase and Polarization Control
abstract: We demonstrate integrated metasurfaces that are excited by a slab waveguide mode and can produce free-space optical radiation with designer amplitude, phase and polarization distributions.

articleTitle: qp-SLM: An open-source holography suite for spatial light modulators
abstract: We present qp-SLM, a python software package for high-performance control of phase-only spatial light modulators. We demonstrate qp-SLM for automated trimming of a 64-pixel photonic crystal SLM by picometer-precision thermal oxidation.

articleTitle: Optical Up-Conversion-Based Cross-Correlation of Terahertz-Wave Pulses
abstract: We characterized a temporal profile of sub-nanosecond terahertz (THz)-wave pulses from an injection-seeded THz-wave parametric generator by using an optical up-conversion-based cross-correlation in a MgO-doped lithium niobate crystal.

articleTitle: Quasi-real-time dual-comb spectroscopy based on 750-MHz Yb:fiber combs unfolding aliasing down-sampled spectra
abstract: Quasi-real-time computational coherent averaging is proposed and applied in the 750-MHz Yb:fiber laser dual comb spectroscopy system. More than three aliasing down-sampled spectra can be distinguished and unfolded due to the well-corrected phase noise.

articleTitle: Einstein-Laub and Lorentz Optical Force Densities with a Planar Interface
abstract: Realizing optomechanical devices from nanostructured media requires a spatially-dependent force density model in the material. The general Einstein-Laub force density is shown to be consistent with a boundary description, thereby completing a needed analytic description.

articleTitle: 1-fs-level passive pump-seed-pulse synchronization in white light seeded OPCPA
abstract: We present measurements on the timing stability of a white light seeded, two stage OPCPA intended as seed for laser plasma acceleration drive lasers. A 1 fs rms timing jitter was observed over 66 hours.

articleTitle: Universality of thermalization in multimoded nonlinear optics
abstract: We demonstrate the universality of Rayleigh-Jeans distribution in nonlinear multimoded optical systems, regardless of the type of nonlinearity or the existence of wave mixing.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet Orbital Angular Momentum Generation Through a Second-Harmonic Process
abstract: This paper introduces a Higher Order Bessel Gaussian beam system for the generation of light in the ultraviolet band (258.5 nm) using a second-harmonic nonlinear process. Thus, providing a dynamically controlled high-dimensional OAM UV source.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable beam manipulation based on intersubband polaritonic metasurfaces
abstract: We report electrically tunable beam manipulations using intersubband polaritonic metasurfaces. Experimentally, 45° of reflection phase tuning, 15% of beam diffraction tuning, and 11% of beam steering were achieved near wavelength of 6.55 μm.

articleTitle: High-Speed Automatic Target Recognition using the Hybrid Opto-electronic Correlator with Multi-channel Detection
abstract: We report on the demonstration of high-speed modality of the hybrid opto-electronic correlator for rotation, scale, and shift-invariant automatic target recognition via use of simultaneous detection of the relevant digital-holographic signals using six focal-plane arrays.

articleTitle: Vortex Beam Generation Directly from a Fiber Laser Incorporating Plasmon Metasurface
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the high-quality orbital-angular-momentum beam generation directly from a compact metasurface-assisted vortex fiber laser around the wavelength of 1030 nm.

articleTitle: Generation of Photon Pairs in Linearly Uncoupled Resonators Employing a Reconfigurable Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
abstract: We demonstrate spontaneous four-wave mixing in two linearly uncoupled resonators employing a Mach-Zehnder interferometer capable of wide band (>150 nm) operation and a fourfold improvement in the generation rate with respect to previous configurations.

articleTitle: Theory and Applications of Temporal Reflection in a Dispersive Medium
abstract: An optical pulse can be reflected at a moving boundary of refractive index change formed by a strong pump pulse. We discuss the theory and possible applications of this effect.

articleTitle: On-chip Reconfigurable Entangled Photon-pair Sources for Quantum Parallel Processing
abstract: We performed the generation and manipulation of the optical high-dimensional hyper-entanglement based on the on-chip reconfigurable Sagnac configuration. Our work provides the critical step for the efficient parallel processing of quantum information with integrated photonics.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Deep-Brain Imaging through an Intact Skull Using a Label-Free Reflection Matrix Microscopy
abstract: We implemented a label-free reflection matrix microscopy system using a 1.3-μm wavelength pulsed laser and conducted in vivo imaging of a 3- to 10-week-old mouse brain with an intact skull. The myelination processes at the early developmental stages were observed up to the cortical layer IV with the ideal diffraction-limited resolution of 650 nm.

articleTitle: A Spatial Light Modulator Based on an Electro Optical Polymer
abstract: We design and fabricate an electro optical spatial light modulator based on a Fabry Perot resonator utilizing a fast switchable integrated organic polymer layer, where the phase response can be tuned on a subwavelength scale.

articleTitle: Superluminal k-gap solitons in photonic time-crystals with Kerr nonlinearity
abstract: We find superluminal solitons residing in the momentum gap of nonlinear photonic time-crystals and explore their faster-than-light pulse propagation in view of Einstein’s causality, the instantaneous response of time-varying permittivity, and signal velocity forerunners.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy of 5s5p3P0-5s4d3D1 with cold Sr atoms
abstract: We perform spectroscopy of 5s5p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>-5s4d<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> in magneto-optically trapped Sr atoms for various power of 2.6 μm laser. We develop a compact distributed feedback (DFB) laser at 2.6 μm as the light source for probing spectroscopy. The absolute frequency of the 5s5p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>-5s4d<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> transition is expected to be measured by the accurate spectroscopy with the frequency comb or high-resolution wavemeter.

articleTitle: Switchable unidirectional Tm3+-doped soliton fiber laser
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a stable unidirectional Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped mode-locked fiber laser in a bidirectional oscillation setup, and the mode-locking operation between the clockwise and counterclockwise direction can be switched by adjusting the waveplates in the cavity.

articleTitle: Lightweight Long-Wave Infrared Camera via a Single 5-Centimeter-Aperture Metalens
abstract: We present a lightweight long-wave infrared camera via a single 5cm-aperture, 0.5mm-thick, and 3.7g-weight metalens fabricated by standard semiconductor technology. Imaging experiments with an uncooled FPA are conducted to evaluate the performances of the metalens.

articleTitle: Imaging the field profile inside dielectric laser acceleration nanostructures
abstract: We present deep sub-wavelength measurement of the field distribution inside nanophotonic dielectric laser accelerator structures, using photon-induced nearfield electron microscopy. Comparing the measured field with theory provides new insight into accelerators’ performance and structural sensitivity.

articleTitle: Multimode Interferometer in Lithium Niobate-on-Insulator centered at 780 nm
abstract: We present the modelling and fabrication of a 1x2 multimode interferometer in lithium niobate-on-insulator operating close to visible around 780 nm. We measure low excess loss of 0.16 ± 0.21 dB and extinction ratios up to 30 dB.

articleTitle: Tailoring interlayer exciton-phonon hybridization in van der Waals heterostructures
abstract: We introduce proximity-controlled strong-coupling between Coulomb correlations and lattice dynamics in neighboring van der Waals materials, creating new electrically neutral hybrid eigenmodes. We directly trace their spectral fingerprints using phase-locked few-cycle mid-infrared pulses.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide phase-change material-based, ultrathin, all-dielectric tunable mid-infrared metamaterial perfect absorber
abstract: Ultrathin, all-dielectric, metamaterial design based on an asymmetrical optical micro-/nanocavity, enclosing a 10 nm thick Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> photoabsorber film, is inversely optimized for perfect tunable absorption in the mid-infrared. The absorption can be actively/geometrically pre-/post-fabrication spectrally tuned.

articleTitle: High-throughput ultrafast laser micromachining with multiple parallel spots
abstract: The parallel use of a large number of ultrashort pulsed laser beams with individual power modulation creates a completely new digital controllable tool in surface processing. High performance ultrashort pulsed lasers allow the material independent processing in nanometer accuracy, even for large components.

articleTitle: Universally printable single-mode laser on low-index platforms
abstract: Heterogeneous laser integration usually entails a platform-dependent process flow and design. We experimentally show a single-mode laser that can be printed on all platforms with n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">plat form</inf> = 1.7 − 2.3 without changing the design or process flow.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband Optical Frequency Doubler at Telecom Wavelength
abstract: We present dispersion-engineered PPLN nanowaveguides with a geometry designed for broadband frequency doubling at telecom wavelengths with low pump energy. We realize a 45-nm-broad transfer function in a 5-mm-long crystal pumped by fs-pulses.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Integrated Coupler Based on Compact Antennas for OAM Fiber Modes
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated device in SOI platform for the coupling of OAM modes into multimode fibers. The coupler is tunable for different OAM modes with low intermodal crosstalk.

articleTitle: Lasers based on time-dependent gain media
abstract: We present a new gain concept based on time-modulated quantum systems. We show "Floquet lasers" incorporating this gain enable phenomena such as single-threshold coherent multimode lasing and even lasing without traditional population inversion.

articleTitle: Engineering the Frequency Response of Petahertz-Electronic Nanoantenna Field-Sampling Devices
abstract: Unlike atomic and bulk solid-state systems, nanoantenna-based petahertz-electronic devices offer unprecedented control over electron emission response. We show how device symmetry, nonlinearity, and driving waveform control the frequency response of petahertz-electronic optical field samplers.

articleTitle: Spectral Peaking in Ultrashort Pulse Fiber Lasers with Molecular Gas Cell
abstract: We demonstrated spectral peaking phenomenon in fiber laser cavity for the first time. Ultrashort soliton pulse with multiple sharp spectral peaks were successfully generated in Erdoped SWNT fiber laser with HCN gas cell.

articleTitle: Lasing Micro-Robots: Manipulation of Active Laser Sources in Biological Fluids
abstract: The concept of lasing micro-robots was introduced and demonstrated in biological fluids through liquid crystal microdroplets. Precise manipulation of optofluidic microlasers with various motions and velocity were achieved, opening new possibilities for micro-manipulation in photomedicine.

articleTitle: Resolution of Gauge Ambiguities in Cavity Quantum Electrodynamics
abstract: We present the fundamental theoretical framework for cavity Quantum Electrodynamics in truncated Hilbert spaces by resolving the gauge ambiguities between the Coulomb gauge and the dipole gauge Hamiltonians under both photonic mode and matter truncation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Multidimensional Spectroscopy with Phase Sensitivity at Multi-THz Frequencies
abstract: Noncollinear two-dimensional terahertz spectroscopy enables phase-sensitive investigation of coherent low-energy dynamics in semiconductors and strongly correlated materials in a perturbative excitation regime. A strong nonlinear response in indium antimonide reveals the ultrafast dynamic bandgap renormalization.

articleTitle: Controlling quantum fluctuations of macroscopic light with sharply nonlinear gain
abstract: Here, we introduce a mechanism of "sharp nonlinear gain" that strongly suppresses quantum fluctuations of lasers. This effect can lead to orders-of-magnitude suppression of intensity fluctuations in real lasers, as well as macroscopic sub-Poissonian light.

articleTitle: Accelerating two-plasmon spontaneous emission via nonlocal epsilon-near-zero modes
abstract: We apply the epsilon-near-zero effect to greatly accelerate the typically forbidden two-plasmon spontaneous emission of a doped InSb film, resulting in entangled mid-infrared light emission with an emission rate comparable to the one-photon emission process.

articleTitle: Dynamic monitoring of strain distribution in optical fiber coils
abstract: We present a high frequency (500 Hz) and high resolution (sub-50 cm) strain distribution measurement in a 1-km fiber coil excited by a shaker, using a phase-sensitive optical frequency domain reflectometer.

articleTitle: High performance micrometer scale magnetometer based on dielectric metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a miniaturized, high sensitivity magnetometer by combining micrometer vapor cells and polarization selective dielectric metasurfaces. With Bell-Bloom scheme [1] we obtained magnetic field sensitivity of $\sim 3pT\sqrt {Hz}$, paving the way towards miniaturized magnetic sensing.

articleTitle: Dispersion-compensated microring photon pair source design with configurable purity–pair rate–heralding efficiency tradeoff
abstract: We present a Si microring-based photon pair source design with tailored pump/signal/idler escape rates allowing configurable purity-rate-heralding tradeoffs, while maintaining efficiency through tunable dispersion compensation. We validate the subcomponents using stimulated FWM experiments.

articleTitle: Spatial Heterodyne Offset Raman Spectroscopy for materials’ interfaces with high sensitivity
abstract: Spatial Heterodyne Offset Raman Spectroscopy (SHORS) integrating Spatially Offset Raman Spectroscopy (SORS) with a fiber-coupled spatial heterodyne spectrometer (SHS) to enable a high sensitivity, ‘on-the-fly’ and movement-free deeper detection method for biomaterial models.

articleTitle: Coherent contributions to population dynamics in a semiconductor microcavity
abstract: Ultrafast exciton-polariton dynamics are investigated using optical multidimensional coherent spectroscopy. A Bloch equations simulation including Pauli blocking and the Coulomb interaction between excitons is found to give good agreement with measured spectra.

articleTitle: Highly Selective Optical Filtering Technology on 300 mm Glass Wafer for Advanced Spectroscopy Applications
abstract: This paper presents the fabrication and measurements of optical rejection filters, made of dielectric nanogratings developed on 300 mm glass wafer using CMOS process. Their suitability for integrated VIS-NIR spectroscopy applications is assessed.

articleTitle: Nanoscale Isolation with Circularly Polarized Stimulated Raman Scattering in a Doubly-resonant Silicon Metasurface for Subwavelength Nonreciprocity
abstract: Nonreciprocal devices allow light to pass in one-direction only, which is critical for the stable operation of photonic systems, but conventional isolators remain prohibitively large. We fabricate and demonstrate metasurfaces for sub-micron nonreciprocal Raman amplification.

articleTitle: Velocity Measurements in a Ground-test Ramjet using Dual Frequency Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrate velocity measurements using dual frequency comb spectroscopy in a supersonic test engine at various flow conditions with a 1% calculated measurement uncertainty.

articleTitle: Final Program Draft Cleo 2022
abstract: Presents the conference program.

articleTitle: Copyright Page
abstract: Presents the copyright information for the conference. May include reprint permission information.

articleTitle: Title Page
abstract: Presents the front cover, title page, or splash screen of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Spin-Polarized Photocarrier Dynamics in WSe2/hBN/Bi2Se3 van der Waals Tunnel Device
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient optoelectronic platform using WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/hBN/Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> van der Waals heterostructures to manipulate the photocarrier polarization and dynamics. Our observations are corroborated by the comprehensive polarization, external electric field, and two-pulse delay dependence behaviors.

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillation from soft-glass fiber cavity
abstract: We report two fiber optical parametric oscillators (FOPO) built entirely out of chalcogenide and fluoride fibers. The FOPOs show Raman assisted and pure parametric oscillation with tunable Stokes emission within 2.023-2.048 µm and 2.088-2.139 µm.

articleTitle: Direct Laser Lithography: Single-Tool Patterning for Nonlinear Integrated Quantum Optics
abstract: We present direct laser lithographic patterning of low-loss waveguides, periodic poling structures for single photon generation, electro-optical modulators and superconducting detectors based on WSi, for integrated quantum circuits in titanium in-diffused lithium niobate.

articleTitle: An ANN-based QoT Estimation Model with Asymmetric Loss Function for Networks Capacity Improvement
abstract: An ANN-based QoT estimator with asymmetric loss function is proposed. It enables efficient assignment of modulation format, which increases network capacity compared to the model trained based on the symmetric loss function in test networks.

Author Keywords: (060.4250) Fiber optics and optical communications, Networks

articleTitle: On-Chip Transferrable Microdisk Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate a precisely on-chip transferrable low-threshold single microdisk laser on Si-post, using micro-structured polymer-assisted transfer-printing technique.

articleTitle: Rapid motion-free generation of interpulse delays for time-domain pump-probe spectroscopies with amplified fs pulses
abstract: We present a dual-channel ultrafast amplifier delivering millijoule energy with electronically tunable delay of the output pulses from femtoseconds to milliseconds with femtosecond precision. Millijoule energies allow frequency-conversion enabling numerous applications in linear and nonlinear spectroscopy.

articleTitle: High Average Power Ti:Sa Amplifier for High Energy High Repetition Rate Laser Plasma Accelerator
abstract: Modern laser plasma accelerators require combination of high peak power and high average power from the laser. Ti:Sa CPA remaining the best technology for such purpose a high average power Ti:Sa amplifier has been developed

articleTitle: Higher-Order Anapole in Slanted Nanodisk Resonator
abstract: We propose slanted silicon nanoresonator which gives rise to higher-order anapole due to the interference of electric quadrupole and toroidal quadrupole modes. Numerical simulation is conducted to get the overview by varying suitable parameters.

articleTitle: Design of dual-mode photonic crystal nanobeam cavity via artificial neural network
abstract: Here we present the design of a dual-mode nanobeam cavity with elliptical holes and a slot assisted by an artificial neural network with desired transmission spectrum.

articleTitle: Reversible Magnetoelectric Control of THz Polarization Rotation in Magnetostrictive Spintronic Emitters on PMN-PT
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient voltage control of the polarization in Spin-tronic Terahertz Emitters, by combining a spin pumping multilayer with strong magnetic anisotropy and magnetoelastic properties, and a piezoelectric substrate to obtain a reversible 70° THz polarization rotation by sweeping the applied voltage on the substrate over 400V.

articleTitle: Remotely Establishing Polarization Entanglement by Entanglement Transfer
abstract: We experimentally establish polarization entanglement between photon pairs distributed over noisy polarization channels. We exploit energy-time entanglement for transmission, and then transfer the entangled state at the receivers to the polarization do-main.

articleTitle: 1 Pb/s Transmission in a 125μm diameter 4-core MCF
abstract: We achieve petabit/s transmission with 801 x 24.5 GBd PDM-256QAM carriers over 20 THz bandwidth in 4 cores of standard cladding diameter multi-core fiber using doped-fiber and Raman amplification with a novel freespace multi-core pump module.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Constellation Shaped via Deep Learning and Robust to Residual-Phase-Noise
abstract: We propose a deep-learning-based geometric constellation shaping algorithm for resisting the residual laser phase noise. In experiment, the proposed scheme outperforms 16QAM by 5.3 dB and non-deep-learning constellation shaping by 1.8 dB in OSNR.

articleTitle: Optical dispersion properties of topological photonic crystals using infrared photonic band diagram microscope
abstract: We developed a photonic band diagram microscope using hyperspectral Fourier image spectroscopy to investigate optical properties of topological photonic crystals. The band inversion near the Γ point was observed in the high-speed measurement.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable nonlinear polaritonic metasurfaces for third-harmonic generation
abstract: We propose an electrically tunable nonlinear intersubband polaritonic metasurface for third-harmonic generation (THG). Numerically, 7300% of THG modulation depth, over 300° of local phase tuning, and dynamic THG diffraction signal modulation were achieved in mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Atomic imaging of complex and chiral molecular structure with laser-induced electron diffraction and machine learning
abstract: We show how laser-induced electron diffraction (LIED) combined with a convolutional neural network (CNN) allows to image the complex chiral molecule Fenchone (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</inf>O).

articleTitle: A Tunable VUV Frequency Comb for 229mTh Nuclear Spectroscopy
abstract: We developed a tunable vacuum-ultraviolet frequency comb via cavity-enhanced 7th-harmonic generation. Its tunable spectrum covers a large fraction of the current <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">229m</sup>Th nuclear clock transition uncertainty range.

articleTitle: Two-photon Absorption of Squeezed Light in the Continuous-Wave Limit
abstract: We calculate the two-photon absorption for squeezed light pumped by a continuous-wave source, near or far from resonance, beyond the low intensity limit. For typical two-photon absorption parameters, we find no squeezed light enhancement.

articleTitle: Q-switched mode-locking by NPR in As2S3 tapers
abstract: We demonstrate a Thulium-doped fiber laser that is Q-switched mode-locked via nonlinear polarization rotation in an As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> taper. The laser allows single and multiwavelength pulses, tunable central wavelength and tunable multiwavelength separation.

articleTitle: Simultaneously Tracking Tens of Reaction Pathways Initiated by Tunnel Ionization of Organic Molecules
abstract: We present experimental results where tens of products resulting from strong-field ionization of organic molecules are tracked simultaneously via disruptive probing. A theoretical model is used fit to the results and extract dynamic constants.

articleTitle: Random Lasers, Complex Systems and the Nobel Prize in Physics 2021
abstract: Random lasers are recognized as open cavity complex systems emitting coherent radiation with interesting properties. I shall describe its applications to studies of spin-glass, turbulence and its relation to the Nobel Prize in Physics 2021

articleTitle: Network analysis of Weyl semimetal photogalvanic systems
abstract: We develop a general methodology capable of analyzing the response of Weyl semimetal photogalvanic networks. To illustrate our approach, we carry out transport simulations in arbitrarily shaped configurations involving pertinent Weyl semimetals.

articleTitle: Generation of OAM beam with arbitrary trajectory using a single phase-only element
abstract: By controlling the radial phase distribution of OAM beams, we successfully generate OAM beams with desired transmission trajectories, which can suppress the intrinsic divergence of conventional OAM beam at different transmission distance.

articleTitle: Remote comb-to-comb stabilization over a 1.3-km free-space atmospheric optical link
abstract: We perform comb-to-comb stabilization through a 1.3-km free-space optical link. The achieved frequency stability is 1.22×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–15</sup> at 1.0 s integration over the entire comb spectrum.

articleTitle: Quantum Recoil in Free Electron-Driven Spontaneous Emission from Van Der Waals Crystals
abstract: We experimentally measure quantum recoil in Smith-Purcell radiation, achieved by scattering free electrons off the periodic lattice of van der Waals crystals to generate multimode coherent X-rays.

articleTitle: Exciton-Enhanced Light Scattering in Atomically-Thin Metasurfaces
