abstract: We demonstrate temperature-dependent and dynamic control over light scattering by exciton resonances in atomically-thin optical elements by carving them directly out of monolayer WS2. Using electrostatic ion-liquid gating we dynamically manipulate the material’s exciton resonance.

articleTitle: Numerical study of laser excitation in Silicon using Three-Temperature model
abstract: Laser excitation in Silicon is studied using a new Three-Temperature model. The thresholds for partial melting and electron emission show good agreement with experimental results. Comparison with two-temperature model is also done.

articleTitle: 225 GHz Mode-Hop-Free Tuning with a Narrow Linewidth Integrated InP/Si Laser
abstract: We demonstrated mode-hop-free tuning over 225 GHz (1.8 nm) in an integrated external-cavity diode laser operating around 1550 nm and with an intrinsic linewidth of 4.7 kHz.

articleTitle: A nanophotonic interface for tin-vacancy centers in diamond
abstract: We present the coupling of tin-vacancy centers in diamond to a photonic crystal cavity resulting in a more than 10-fold enhancement of the spontaneous radiative recombination rate.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Fabry-Perot Bragg Grating Nanoresonator with Ultrahigh Intrinsic Q
abstract: An ultra-high intrinsic quality factor (Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">int</inf>) of 13 million for a Fabry-Perot Bragg grating resonator is demonstrated. The loss of the Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide platform is evaluated to be 0.018 dB/ cm.

articleTitle: Effects of high-β on the stability of phase-locking in coupled semiconductor lasers
abstract: We observe from the bifurcation analysis that high spontaneous emission factor β contributes towards stable phase locking of two laterally coupled semiconductor lasers, with varying pump rate and non-zero frequency detuning being considered.

articleTitle: Neural network-based multiplexed and micro-structured virtual staining of unlabeled tissue
abstract: We present a method to generate multiple virtual stains on an image of label-free tissue using a single deep neural network, which is fed with the autofluorescence images of the unlabeled tissue alongside a user-defined digital-staining matrix. Users can indicate which stain to apply on each pixel by editing the digital-staining matrix and blend multiple virtual stains, creating entirely new stain combinations.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nanoscopy of an excitonic insulator-metal transition in twisted bilayer WSe2
abstract: Many-body interactions between excitons in a transition-metal dichalcogenide bilayer drive a transition into an electron-hole liquid at high densities. Using ultrafast polarization nanoscopy, we unveil spatiotemporal dynamics of this continuous Mott transition on the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Reference Frame Independent Time Bin Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We present the experimental results of the first reference frame independent time bin quantum key distribution. Despite a lack of active phase stabilization of the interferometers, 0.078 asymptotic secret key bits per second were generated.

articleTitle: High-Spectral-Resolution Stimulated Raman Spectroscopy with Amplified fs Pulse Bursts
abstract: We propose a new approach to a species-selective SRS gas sensing combining the advantages of strong signal levels and the ease of optical frequency conversion, obtainable with broadband fs pulses, with the high frequency resolution characteristic of narrowband sub-ns pulses. Spectra are mapped by electronic phase control of the amplified burst.

articleTitle: Electric-Field Programmable Spin Arrays for Scalable Quantum Repeaters
abstract: We introduce an electric-field programmable spin array (FPSA) for scalable quantum repeaters. We analyze the FPSA scheme for arrays of nitrogen vacancy color centers in a slow-light diamond waveguide.

articleTitle: Nonlinear compression towards high-energy single-cycle pulses by cascaded focusing and compressing
abstract: By cascaded focusing and compressing, we demonstrated 50-fold postcompression of carrier-envelope-phase-stabilized, 157 fs and 1.34 mJ pulses at 1030 nm down to 3.1 fs (single-cycle) with a pulse energy of 0.98 mJ.

articleTitle: Add-drop silicon ring resonator with low-power MEMS tuning of phase and coupling
abstract: Applications of silicon photonics range from sensing to microwave processing. However, low-power active filters with long FSRs are lacking. We demonstrate an add-drop ring filter with 4 nm FSR and nW-level MEMS tuning of phase and coupling.

articleTitle: Fiber-Optic Sensors for Strain Measurement in a Spallation Neutron Target
abstract: A fiber-optic strain sensor has been developed based on a low-coherence interferometer and an all-fiber phase-shifted demodulator. The sensor has been applied to the measurement of megahertz dynamic strains in a high-radiation spallation neutron target.

articleTitle: Single-shot spatiospectral characterization of ultrafast pulsebeams
abstract: Single-shot spatiospectral characterization of ultrafast pulse-beams is critical for their optimal application. Here we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first reference-free spatiospectral characterization of a single pulse-beam, performed using broadband single-shot ptychography (BBSSP).

articleTitle: High quality factor universal phase gradient metasurfaces for narrowband wavefront engineering
abstract: We introduce a universal high quality factor meta-reflect-array platform capable of producing arbitrary wavefronts. As proof-of-principle, we experimentally realize strong narrowband beam-steering by perturbing guided-mode resonant elements with maximum structural differences of just 14nm (6%).

articleTitle: Quantitative photoacoustic velocimetry technique using multi-angle observations
abstract: By changing the ultrasonic receiving angle in post-processing, we can obtain flow vectors from a photoacoustic experiment on a blood vessel phantom by solving the photoacoustic Doppler equation using a least-squares optimisation approach.

articleTitle: High-Density 100 GHz-Class Mach-Zehnder Modulators integrated in a InP Generic Foundry Platform
abstract: High-density modulators with 17µm width reduce the electrical losses in the cross-section of the modulator to just 5dB/mm at 67GHz and enable a bandwidth enhancement of 67GHz electro-optic bandwidth at -1.4dBo to be demonstrated on a generic foundry platform.

articleTitle: Turbulence-Resilient 2.25-Gbit/s DPSK Self-Coherent Free-Space Optical Communication Link Using Automatic Optoelectronic Mixing of Many Spatial Modes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 2.25-Gbit/s DPSK free-space optical link that exhibits resilience to turbulence-induced modal coupling loss. The measured average mixing loss is ~14.6-dB less than a single-mode-fiber-coupled system based on 200 random turbulence realizations.

articleTitle: Self-injection-locked Brillouin laser with high-Q fiber ring cavity
abstract: A simple Brillouin fiber laser pumped from a self-injection locked distributed feedback (DFB) laser diode delivers radiation with the Lorentzian linewidth of ~75 Hz and phase noise power density less than –100dBc/Hz (>30 kHz).

articleTitle: Forward Brillouin Laser in a Polarization Maintaining Fiber
abstract: A first fiber laser based on forward Brillouin scattering is proposed and demonstrated. The laser is based on inter-modal scattering in a standard panda type polarization maintaining fiber. Single-mode and multi-mode regimes are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Novel fold-back 1×20 100 GHz mux/demux planar Echelle grating for low loss photonic switches
abstract: We design and investigate a novel photonic integrated four-use fold-back 20 channels 100GHz spacing Echelle grating multiplexer/demultiplexer. Results show <2.5dB insertion loss, <-45dB cross-talk, and fabrication tolerance of 0.3μm rounding corner radius.

articleTitle: Selective Plane Illumination Optical Endomicroscopy with Polymer Imaging Fibres
abstract: We present an ultrafast laser fabricated end-cap for use with polymer imaging fibres. The end-cap enables optical sectioning of the imaged sample and reduces background fluorescence from both the sample and the fibre itself.

articleTitle: On-chip Training Silicon Photonic Circuits to Perform Digital and Analog Computing
abstract: We review our recent results on on-chip training silicon photonic circuits to perform digital (single and combinational Boolean logics) and analog (classification tasks in machine learning) computing.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-Insulator Couplers for SDM Transmission
abstract: We present two CMOS-compatible couplers with record-high efficiency for bridging chips and fibers exploiting spatial division multiplexing. The maximum coupling efficiencies to a few-mode and a 7-core fibers were −3.0 dB and −4.3 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Threshold Single Mode Surface-Grating DFB Lasers for Chip-Scale Atomic Clocks
abstract: We present an ultra-low threshold-current single-mode surface-grating DFB laser for chip-scale atomic-clocks. The index-coupled surface-grating yields the coupling-coefficient ~300cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. The fabricated laser exhibits stable single-mode operation with threshold-current and SMSR of 3mA and 40dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Holographically fabricated blazed gratings for out-of-plane coupling in integrated optics
abstract: We report the development of 45° blazed gratings in integrated waveguides using a holographic UV laser inscription technique for out-of-plane free-space coupling of beams.

articleTitle: Scalable Preparation and Measurement of 2N-dimensional Time-bin States in (2N+1) Mutually Unbiased Bases
abstract: We propose (2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup> +1) mutually unbiased basis measurement for 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup>-dimensional time-bin states, where the number of devices scales logarithmically with the dimension. We observed average error of only 3.8% for four-dimensional phase bases.

articleTitle: Engineered Multi-Output Supercontinuum Generation in Tantala Waveguides for Optical-Lattice-Clock Stabilization
abstract: We create a tantala nanophotonic waveguide circuit to generate supercontinuum spectrum that covers all the wavelength bands required for a strontium optical-lattice clock. The phase-locked supercontinuum is a versatile tool for compact and manufacturable optical clocks.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Annual Modeling of Low-Emissivity Films for Energy-Saving Buildings
abstract: We present large-scale building simulations with a low-emissivity film. This film annually reduces heat gain and loss by 257.6 MJ per installation wall area. It is estimated to reduce 1.14 billion metric tons of global CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission.

articleTitle: Soliton microcombs in ytterbium-doped lithium-niobate microrings
abstract: Soliton microcombs were first demonstrated on a Z-cut ytterbium-doped lithium niobate microring. The comb has a spectrum ranging from 1480 nm to 1660 nm and a repetition rate of 197.79 GHz.

articleTitle: Ultra-high system detection efficiency superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors for quantum photonics and life sciences
abstract: Ultra-high system detection efficiency ( SDE) s uperconducting nanowire single-photon detectors are demonstrated for a broad range of wavelengths, from UV to mid-infrared, opening novel possibilities in the fields of quantum photonics, neuroimaging and astronomy.

articleTitle: Correlative Cathodoluminescence Microscopy of Strain-Enhanced hBN Spin Defects
abstract: We utilize correlative cathodoluminescence, photoluminescence, and scanning electron microscopies to map the strain enhancement of boron vacancy spin-defect emission across creases in hBN flakes with nanoscale spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Photo-induced frequency engineering for nonlinear photonics in chalcogenide microresonators
abstract: We present a novel approach to modify the specific mode frequency in chalcogenide microring resonators and demonstrate an efficient and widely tunable optical parametric oscillation, which is independent of geometry dispersion engineering.

articleTitle: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution of Frequency-Nondegenerate Photons
abstract: Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) of frequency-nondegenerate photons was proposed and demonstrated based on a frequency-domain beam splitter, which simplified the implementation of MDI-QKD and provided network functions on the relay node.

articleTitle: Multipass In-Well Pumped Semiconductor Disk Laser for Sodium Guide Stars
abstract: We describe a novel membrane-external-cavity surface-emitting laser geometry employing multi-pass in-well pumping. Narrow linewidth output power of 6.2 W at 589 nm is achieved targeting sodium guide star applications.

articleTitle: Broadband Optoelectronic Mixer for Optical Frequency Division and Synthesis
abstract: We report broadband optoelectronic mixers based on high-speed modified uni-travelling carrier photodiodes. Up to 500 GHz frequency mixing has been demonstrated without any other high-frequency components.

articleTitle: Label-free three photon micro-endoscope
abstract: We report the first three photon micro-endoscope enabling imaging of unlabeled biological tissues. It is based on a double clad antiresonant hollow-core fiber which is designed to make the endoscope highly multimodal (2PEF, 3PEF, SHG, THG, CARS).

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Optical Beamforming on a Dispersion-Engineered Heterogeneous Multicore Fiber
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of tunable optical beamforming for phased-array antennas on a dispersion-engineered heterogeneous multicore fiber. We developed in-house both the fiber and the antenna and successfully demonstrated radio beam-steering at 26 GHz.

articleTitle: Joint Spectral Characterization of Cryogenic Spontaneous Parametric Down-Conversion
abstract: We demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, the first functional cryogenic SPDC source. This proof-of-principle experiment represents a starting point for interfacing SPDC with integrated components requiring cryogenic operation conditions, such as superconducting detectors.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of over-intensities caused by compression grating phase modulations of the PETAL facility
abstract: Optics laser damage in high intensity short pulse laser facilities is a major limitation to performance upgrade. We report on the impact of gratings phase modulation on laser-induced damage using high-resolution measurements and Miró modeling.

articleTitle: Non-Line-of-Sight Imaging Using a Fractal Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector
abstract: We demonstrate non-line-of-sight imaging at the wavelength of 1560 nm using a high-efficiency, high-timing-resolution fractal superconducting nanowire single-photon detector. Light-cone-transform algorithm is used to reconstruct the shape of the hidden objects.

articleTitle: Violating Kirchhoff’s Law of Thermal Radiation in Semitransparent Structures
abstract: We design a nonreciprocal thermal emitter that features absorptivity-emissivity contrast in semitransparent setting, by using magneto-optical effect. Our emitter can overcome the restriction that Kirchhoff’s law of thermal radiation imposes on solar energy harvesting.

articleTitle: Control of Pulse Front Tilt and Curvature for Ultrafast Ponderomotive Electron Acceleration
abstract: We explore an electron acceleration scheme which uses the ponderomotive force of a tilted ultrafast laser as the drive mechanism for acceleration. The effect of pulse front curvature on the acceleration process is also discussed.

articleTitle: Lens-Free Optical Physical Unclonable Function with Native Fibrous Media
abstract: We propose a novel optical PUFs by adopting native silk with its intrinsic properties of randomly disordered structures. The demonstrated silk PUFs present high reproducibility and randomness in bit extractions.

articleTitle: Highly linear integrated lithium niobate modulator based on ring-assisted Mach–Zehnder interferometer
abstract: We report an ultra-high-linearity modulator on thin-film lithium niobate platform based on the ring-assisted Mach–Zehnder interferometer (RAMZI) structure, with measured spurious free dynamic range (SFDR) up to 120.04 dB•Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4/5</sup> at 1GHz.

articleTitle: Laser Induced Persistent Holographic Gratings in Europium Doped Tellurite Glasses Using a Continuous Wave Visible Laser
abstract: Strong persistent gratings were formed in europium doped tellurite glasses using the four-wave mixing technique. The gratings were written by a CW laser operating at 532 nm. The maximum change in the index of refraction was 0.00023.

articleTitle: Efficient Quantum State Tomography Using Collective Measurements of Two-Photon Polarization States
abstract: We implement a theoretical proposal by Massar and Popescu to demonstrate more efficient quantum state tomography using collective measurements. To do so, we project onto non-maximally entangled polarization states of two photons from the ensemble.

articleTitle: Crack control of femtosecond laser processing lithium niobate by tailoring temporal dispersion
abstract: A low-cost efficient method is proposed to control the formation of various cracks when processing lithium niobate by temporally shaped femtosecond laser, which shows broad prospects for laser processing technology and micro/nano photonics.

articleTitle: Sub-GHz Resolution Dynamic Line-by-Line Pulse Shaper at 1 µm
abstract: We present a sub-GHz resolution programmable pulse shaper at 1064 nm capable of fine phase control of ~30 mrad steps and >30 dB amplitude control range. Line-by-line shaping of a 3 GHz comb is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Interactions of polar quantum systems with light
abstract: We discuss how spatial asymmetry of quantum systems quantified in terms of permanent dipole moments influences their emission properties in different light-matter interaction regimes. Applications for spontaneous emission suppression and coherent emission are explored.

articleTitle: Field Demonstration of Systems Towards CubeSat Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Satellite QKD enables quantum-secure communications at global scale. However, practical systems require high-rate, low size, weight and power photon sources and ground stations. We present systems enabling CubeSat QKD missions and demonstrate their interoperation.

articleTitle: Electric Fingertips: An Electric Tactile Sensor Based on Gallium Nitride Nanopillars
abstract: A tactile sensor based on electrically pumped gallium nitride (GaN) light-emitting diodes (LEDs) with ultrathin p-contacts is proposed, fabricated, and demonstrated. The proposed sensor has the ability to decern the direction of an applied force.

articleTitle: Direct Distributed Analysis of Nonlinear Inter-Modal Forward Scattering in Polarization Maintaining Fibers
abstract: Direct, distributed analysis of forward scattering is demonstrated for the first time in any optical medium, using inter-modal nonlinear coupling in polarization maintaining fibers. Local spectra of forward Brillouin scattering and Kerr effect are resolved.

articleTitle: Tailoring spontaneous emission rates from atomic systems with shaped free-electron wavepackets
abstract: We show that electron-photon and atom-photon interactions can be engineered to interfere with each other, allowing us to tailor the total spontaneous emission rate through the shape of quantum electron wavepackets.

articleTitle: Achieving Near-Intrinsic Exciton Linewidth at Room Temperature in Monolayer WS2 Coupled with a Mie Resonator
abstract: Strong multiparticle interactions at room temperature (RT) lead to broadened homogeneous exciton linewidths in 2D semiconductors, degrading the quality of excitonic mode and emission. By coupling a Mie resonator with monolayer WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, we achieve narrowed linewidths at RT, approaching the theoretical limit at 0 Kelvin.

articleTitle: Optimization of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering Gain in a Double-Stripe Si3N4 Waveguide
abstract: We employ a genetic algorithm to optimize the stimulated Brillouin scattering gain coefficient in a symmetric double-stripe (SDS) S i<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide. We achieve 15× enhancement compared to previous results. Further, we verify the numerical findings with measurements for a selected set of SDS waveguides.

articleTitle: AlGaAsOI Photonics and Low-Loss Links for High-Speed Entanglement-Based Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We report a record-high detected entangled-photon pair coincidence rate from an AlGaAs-on-insulator microring resonator with raw coincidence rates >19 kHz that is capable of time-bin entanglement-based QKD with an estimated secure key rate of 1.4 kbits/second.

articleTitle: Nanometer-precision long-distance LiDAR using soliton microcombs
abstract: A time-of-flight L iDAR i s d emonstrated u sing a s ingle s oliton frequency comb generated in an ultrahigh-Q silica microresonator. Utilizing an electro-optic sampling Sagnac interferometer, distance measurement with 8-nm precision at 1-km range is achieved.

articleTitle: Over 1 Watt THz QCLs with high doping concentration and variable Al composition in active structure
abstract: A 1.31 W peak power and 52 mW average power THz QCL is presented by variable Al composition active structure with high doping concentration based on NEGF method design. Device has thick growth active layers and large mesa size with the consideration of heat dissipation.

articleTitle: Label-free multiplexed microtomography of endogenous subcellular dynamics using generalizable deep learning
abstract: We report a deep-learning-based imaging technique to predict 3D multiplexed fluorescence signals based on label-free refractive index measurements. We demonstrate the retrieval of specific subcellular information without exogenous labeling or staining, enabling multiplexed molecular imaging across various spatiotemporal scales.

articleTitle: Coherent Single Photon Source in an Integrated Diamond Nanophotonic System
abstract: We demonstrate an on-demand source of individual, temporally modulated photons with high purity (g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(0) = 0.017) and detection efficiency (14.9%) using a silicon-vacancy center in diamond coupled to an asymmetric nanophotonic cavity.

articleTitle: Smart and agile 84 W fs Yb-fiber laser for spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrate an all-PM high power ultrafast Yb-fiber laser utilizing digital controls for frequency comb stabilization and femtosecond pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Terahertz Photonics with Quantum Materials
abstract: It has recently become evident that quantum materials with massless Dirac fermions have extremely strong terahertz nonlinearities. This talk will show how these can be enhanced even further, with interesting prospects for applications.

articleTitle: Engineering Long-Range Coupling in Metasurfaces
abstract: The far-field diffraction pattern of subwavelength ridge-like plasmonic metasurfaces is measured. Secondary diffractions peaks arise due to propagating surface modes, providing an additional degree of freedom for tailoring metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Ultrafast renormalization of the onsite Coulomb repulsion in a cuprate superconductor
abstract: Time-resolved x-ray absorption spectroscopy is used to monitor the transient modification of the on-site Coulomb repulsion in the high-temperature superconductor La<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.905</inf>Ba<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.095</inf>CuO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> following an excitation with an ultrashort optical femtosecond pulse.

articleTitle: Experimental Realization of Non-Adiabatic Holonomic Quantum Gates
abstract: We present the experimental realization of non-adiabatic holonomic quantum gates, paving the way towards noise-resilient quantum computing in integrated quantum optics. Their topologically protected functionalities are realized solely by means of non-Abelian geometric phases.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Far-field Pattern in an Apodized Optical Phased Array by Refractive Index Liquids
abstract: We investigate the far-field pattern broadening of an apodized optical phased array when changing the waveguide cladding indices. Results indicate the beam broadening can be optimized and circumvented by tuning liquid claddings.

articleTitle: Photonic Topological Baths for Quantum Simulation
abstract: Using coupled arrays of upto 16 high Q nanocavities we experimentally realized quantum photonic baths based on the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model and investigated the effect of fabrication induced disorder on these baths by probing individual super-modes.

articleTitle: A Telecommunication-Compatible, Bias-Free Photoconductive Terahertz Emitter on a Silicon Substrate
abstract: We present a telecommunication-compatible, bias-free photoconductive terahertz emitter fabricated on an InAs layer grown on silicon, which provides significant enhancement in the radiated power above 0.5 THz compared to the state-of-the-art bias-free terahertz emitters.

articleTitle: Thermally Reconfigurable Nonlocal Metalenses
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a thermally-controlled wavefront-shaping nonlocal metasurface on a simple device platform.

articleTitle: Cascaded Forward Brillouin Scattering in a Chalcogenide Microsphere
abstract: We report cascaded forward Brillouin scattering in the near-infrared region at 70 nW threshold on an As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> chalcogenide microsphere.

articleTitle: Towards Polariton Condensation in a Red Fluorescent Protein at Room Temperature
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear increase in polariton density and thermalization at room temperature using a red emitting fluoroscent protein, mscarlett. Such fluoroscent proteins are an attractive platform to study polariton condensation and even realize condensate lattices.

articleTitle: Focusing Integrated Optical Phased Arrays for Chip-Based Optical Trapping
abstract: Optical trapping using integrated optical phased arrays is demonstrated, enabling chipbased trapping at distances compatible with standard biological experimentation and opening the door to broader implementation of optical-trapping technology.

articleTitle: Short Pulse Mid-IR Fiber Lasers for Advanced Applications in Industry and Science
abstract: We report our latest development on short pulse mid-infrared fiber lasers both at the laser and application level. We will provide an overview of promising applications enabled by mid-IR short pulses in industry and science.

articleTitle: Degenerate multi-frequency radiation of two-color pulse compounds
abstract: We discuss emission of multi-frequency radiation by oscillating two-frequency soliton molecules in nonlinear waveguides. We demonstrate that subpulse dynamics can cause unexpected degenerate spectral bands with complex structure that can be precisely predicted theoretically.

articleTitle: An Invariance Property of Dynamic Media in Diffusive Cavities
abstract: We expand Cauchy’s theorem and demonstrate an invariance property for dynamic media. We demonstrate that details of scattering processes do not affect the relationship between measured correlation times and the intrinsic time-scale of medium’s dynamics.

articleTitle: Large-area SNSPDs for up to 7.4 μm wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate large-area superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) for operation in the mid-IR band, up to 7.4 μm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast double-pulse ablation of monolayer MoS2
abstract: Two pulse ablation experiments were conducted on monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with various substrates. The hole size variation is explained via bandgap renormalization and carrier relaxation for different pulse separations.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Experimental study on feedback sensitivity in a semiconductor ring laser
abstract: We experimentally investigate sensitivity to external optical feedback in a modified semiconductor ring laser with filtered optical feedback. Feedback insensitive, single-mode lasing with SMSR below -40dB over a 76mA range is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improvement in fs pre-pulse and ps pedestal in the J-KAREN-P laser facility
abstract: We have realized the removal of most pre-pulses with wedged optics and orders of magnitude enhancement of the pedestal with higher optical quality optics. We have successfully installed the plasma mirror system for further improvement.

articleTitle: Self-Pulsing Nanobeam Photonic Crystal Laser
abstract: Self pulsing in the GHz range is achieved in a Semiconductor Nanolaser integrated on a Silicon Photonic Circuit whereby saturable absorption is obtained by selective optical puming.

articleTitle: Impact of Link Limitations in 50 Gbps PAM-2 VCSEL MMF Links: Alignment, Equalization and Fiber Type
abstract: The impact of connector offset countered with limited equalization is quantified for 50GBaud high-speed VCSEL MMF links comprised of 850nm and 1060nm VCSELs and OM4 and OM5 fiber.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Lossless Electron Beam Monochromator in an Ultrafast TEM Using Near-field THz Radiation
abstract: We realize a lossless electron beam monochromator in an ultrafast transmission electron microscope. The monochromator uses a single-cycle in-situ THz emitter, reducing the electron energy spread by a factor of 2.8 without losing electrons.

articleTitle: Low-noise near-ultraviolet photonic integrated lasers
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a hybrid integrated low-noise laser composed of a gallium nitride (GaN) based laser diode and a silicon nitride photonic chip based microresonator operating at record low wavelengths as low as 410 nm in the near ultraviolet wavelength region.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Graphene Organic Hybrid Phase Modulators
abstract: Ultra-short, low-loss graphene-organic hybrid phase modulators are introduced. 20 Gbit/s PAM-2 and PAM-4 data modulation are demonstrated with devices of 25 μm length and on-chip losses of 0.86 dB.

articleTitle: Quantum Control of the Tin-Vacancy Spin Qubit in Diamond
abstract: Group-IV colour centres in diamond are a promising light-matter interface for quantum networking devices. We demonstrate multiaxis coherent control of the SnV spin-qubit via an alloptical stimulated Raman drive between the ground and excited states.

articleTitle: Analysis of Key Post-Processing for Physical Layer Key Generation in Optical Communication
abstract: This paper analyzes the post-processing security through information entropy and compares three privacy amplification methods for physical layer key generation. Simulation reveals key generation rate and security should be jointly considered when applying privacy amplification.

articleTitle: Large scale programmable photonic circuits using silicon photonic MEMS
abstract: We demonstrate low-power and non-volatile MEMS actuators on an industrially established silicon photonics platform. The compact electrostatically actuated phase shifters and tunable couplers enable large-scale programmable photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: In-Situ Single-Photon Detection of Er Sites in Si
abstract: Using sample-on-SSPD and photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy, we demonstrate Er sites in Si with inhomogeneous broadening below 100 MHz, a 350 kHz upper bound on the homogeneous linewidth, and electron T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> lower bound of 1 second.

articleTitle: Emission from Arrays of Tm3+ Ions in Solid-State Microphotonics
abstract: Using an ion implantation technique, we demonstrate that precisely implanted arrays of thulium ions can be engineered to study collective and coherent light-atom interactions on solid-state lithium niobate ring resonators.

articleTitle: Using Heralded Spectrometry to Measure the Biexciton Binding Energy of an Individual Quantum Dot
abstract: Spectrometry of a quantum state of light is a fundamental challenge with practical implications. Here, we demonstrate how such a technique can super-resolve the exciton and biexciton energies in a single quantum dot at room temperature.

articleTitle: Diffractive networks form cascadable all-optical NAND gates
abstract: A cascadable, all-optical NAND gate based on diffractive networks is presented. The resulting NAND design was cascaded by projecting the output field of one diffractive gate onto another, all-optically performing logical operations, e.g., a half-adder.

articleTitle: Orientation-patterned semiconductors for efficient mid-infrared frequency conversion
abstract: Compound III-V semiconductors based on GaAs, InP, and their analogs are widely used as LEDs, lasers, and photodetectors. Here we describe novel periodically-inverted GaAs and GaP structures for highly engineerable frequency conversion to the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Label-free detection of a novel ovarian cancer biomarker from complex biofluids using microtoroid resonators
abstract: We combine mass spectrometry with microtoroid resonators to discover and detect a new biomarker for ovarian cancer. Our results show that the biomarker levels increase with time, revealing the progression of tumors implanted in mice.

articleTitle: Compact Piezoelectric Photonic Crystal Modulator in a Visible-NIR 200 mm CMOS Architecture
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon nitride photonic crystal cavity modulated via piezo-mechanical actuators fabricated in a broadband CMOS platform. We measure >25 dB extinction with Fano resonances in a small footprint Mach-Zehnder interferometer configuration.

articleTitle: Absolute Angular Position Sensing by Dual-Comb Autocollimator
abstract: We propose a dynamic absolute angular position measurement method based on dual-comb spectroscopy combined with laser auto-collimation technique. The method exhibits a dynamic angle precision of 0.12 arcsec in the range of ~6660 arcsec.

articleTitle: Virtually Noiseless Phase Sensitive Amplifier using χ2 in AlGaAs with 30 dB Gain
abstract: The first χ <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-based AlGaAs pulsed PSA with substantial confinement. This PSA achieves on chip in-phase gain of 30 dB, a sensitivity of 0.005 photons per pulse, and approaches the genuine quantum noise figure (NF) of 0 dB in near single mode operation for all degrees of freedom.

articleTitle: Avoided Mode Crossing Suppressed Microresonators with a Mode Filter Integrated Bus Waveguide
abstract: We introduce a tapered concentric bus waveguide to suppress avoided mode crossing induced by polarization mode coupling in microresonators. We experimentally validate the method using AlGaAs-on-insulator-based microresonators.

articleTitle: 3D Dynamic Lensing via Enhanced Light-Sound Interactions
abstract: Most acousto-optic lenses produce energy dissipating annular fringes. Here, we report a 3D dynamic focusing with fully-localized focus and 477-fold beam confinement with an extended depth of field (DoF) of more than 28 cm.

articleTitle: Electrically Pumped Silicon Waveguide Optical Amplifier at Communication Wavelengths by Deep Cooling
abstract: An electrically pumped optical amplifier is fabricated on deep cooling processed Er/O doped SOI wafer. 18dB signal enhancement and stimulated emission at a wavelength of 1534nm were observed under pump current of 2.5mA at room temperature.

articleTitle: Light-induced tunable optical properties of 1T-TaS2 at different temperatures
abstract: The c-axis permittivity of 1T-TaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> – a quasi-2D charge-density-wave material – changes upon illumination due to light-induced reorganization of CDW stacking. Here we probe the mechanism of this reorganization and find a nucleation mechanism at work.

articleTitle: THz Generation with Photoconductive Emitters with a Low-noise GHz Repetition Rate Laser
abstract: We demonstrate THz generation with a low noise GHz repetition rate laser with stateof-the-art photoconductive emitters. We measure a maximum dynamic range of 73 dB and a bandwidth of more than 3 THz.

articleTitle: Electrically-driven 2D multi-beam steering with large field of view by using VCSEL scanner array
abstract: We demonstrate electrically driven 2D beam scanner for solid-state LiDARs by fabricating VCSEL scanner array and using simply stacked optics. A large field of view of 70° × 45° and record resolution of 33,000 were realized.

articleTitle: Electro-optic frequency-comb generation in monolithically integrated, low-loss barium titanate waveguides
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated, low-loss photonic platform based on all-barium-titanate ridge waveguides. The platform is used to demonstrate the first on-chip generation of electro-optic frequency combs in barium titanate.

articleTitle: Vertical 2D Grating Coupler for Efficient Multiplexing of Six Modes Between the Few Mode Fiber and SOI Chip
abstract: We have successfully designed a vertical 2D grating coupler that can multiplex/de-multiplex three spatial fiber modes in both polarizations between a few mode fiber and six SOI waveguides with reasonably equalized high efficiencies.

articleTitle: Superchiral Surface Lattice Resonance on 3D Bipartite Metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate record-breaking 44 times enhancement in optical chirality from surface lattice resonance supported on 3D bipartite nanostructure. The superchiral metasurface is expected to be useful in chiral sensing, fluorescence, and nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Tunable Threshold in VO2-based Photonic Devices Enabled by Defect Engineering
abstract: Using ion implantation, we engineered tunable thresholds of optical switches that incorporated frequency-selective surfaces (FSSs) with thin-film VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. We also used a focused ion beam to selectively control any passband of an FSS-VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> optical switch.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin Scattering Microwave Photonic Notch Filter in Silicon Nitride
abstract: We show the first all silicon nitride microwave photonic notch filter using stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS). The filter has a rejection of more than 60 dB, a linewidth of 1 GHz, and a tunable center frequency over 1 GHz.

articleTitle: High-Power Terahertz Generation from Optically-Pumped Graded Composition InGaAs Structures
abstract: We present a record-high-power photoconductive terahertz emitter operating at 1550 nm wavelength, which utilizes graded composition InGaAs structures integrated with plasmonic nanoantennas. We demonstrate 860 µW pulsed terahertz generation at 900 mW optical pump power.

articleTitle: Frozen-mode Enabled Photonic Sensing for Label-free Biosensors
abstract: We propose a novel SOI waveguide-based label-free photonic biosensors utilizing coupled Si ridge waveguide stemmed frozen-mode which improves light-matter interaction by slowing the light over 600 times compared to free space for integrated photonic sensing.

articleTitle: Low-concentration detection of CO2 using suspended silicon waveguides in the mid-IR
abstract: We show detection of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentrations as low as 500 ppm using a suspended silicon photonic mid-IR waveguide. The performance is enabled by the low propagation loss (2.35 ± 0.25) dB/cm permitting sensing with waveguides up to 7 cm in length.

articleTitle: Investigation of Localized lasing modes of a One Dimensional strongly scattering gain medium
abstract: We shows, how real time spatial shaping of pump profile imposed on a strongly scattering gain medium can be used to achieve single mode lasing at pre-selected target wavelength. Simultaneously, near field imaging of the sample surface from the top allow us to record field distribution of the localized modes. We show that slope efficiency of Ander-son localized lasing mode enhanced by one order magnitude under selective pumping.

articleTitle: Comparison of Linear and Circular Polarization Ultrafast Laser Pulses Ionization in Bulk Dielectrics
abstract: We experimentally confirm the polarization dependent of multiphoton ionization and the polarization independent of avalanche ionization in the intensity regime of 10 TWcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. By modeling the ultrafast laser interaction with bulk fused silica, we obtain the multiphoton ionization cross section for linear and circular polarization. Then we verify, both with experiments and numerical simulations, that circularly polarized picosecond pulses can be employed to improve the micromachining precision while keeping the machining efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamically tunable microwave-rate soliton microcombs on a monolithic LiNbO3 platform
abstract: We report microwave-rate soliton microcombs on a chip-scale lithium niobate platform, where the repetition rate can be tuned by electro-optic means.

articleTitle: Ultra-Large Cross-Phase Modulation for Room-Temperature Photon-Number-Resolving Detection
abstract: We propose and analyze a room-temperature photon-number-resolving detection scheme based on cascaded sum-frequency generation. We measure an effective |n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>| of 6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/W in lithium niobate, which is 600x larger than the intrinsic value.

articleTitle: Screening for effective COVID-19 drugs using microtoroid optical resonators
abstract: We virtually screen for effective COVID-19 drugs and test their ability to prevent binding of SARS-CoV-2 and two variants to hACE2 receptors using microtoroids. Three drugs were found to have picomolar inhibitory constants.

articleTitle: A Thin Film Barium Titanate-on-Insulator Optoelectronics Platform with Various Photonic Devices
abstract: We present a thin-film barium titanate-on-insulator platform and its optical and electro-optic properties, some of which are superior to lithium niobate-on-insulator, and discuss our progress in device fabrication, performance, and some unique device architecture designs.

articleTitle: Dynamic stray light and background correction to allow truly simultaneous optical stimulation and multiphoton imaging
abstract: We introduce a new approach to reduce uncorrelated background signals from fluorescence imaging data, using real-time subtraction of background light. Our method allows removing image artifacts that cause signal clipping in a conventional imaging setup.

articleTitle: Stimulated Forward Brillouin Scattering from a Fundamental Acoustic Mode in a Fiber Taper
abstract: Strong stimulated optomechanical coupling to the fundamental flexural acoustic mode of a tapered fiber is demonstrated, broadening access to frequencies, and increasing interaction-times for applications. A theoretical model featuring unique propagation dependent behavior is introduced.

articleTitle: Quantum processors for high performance analog RF signals processing
abstract: Quantum properties of Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions in a YAG matrix enable high dynamic signal processing for RF sensing. Here we program a spectro-spatial grating selectively diffracting optical frequencies, leading to a high performance photonic RF filter.

articleTitle: Widely separated optical parametric oscillation in Chalcogenide microrings
abstract: We provide a novel approach to experimentally achieve widely-separated χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> OPO ranging from 1250nm to 2100nm in chalcogenide microrings pumped at anomalous dispersion. Our approach realized robust and widely-separated OPO generation on-chip.

articleTitle: Geometric Four-Wave Mixing Phase-Matching in Photonic Nanoresonators
abstract: We present nanoresonators in which a shared photonic defect provides two distinct guiding mechanisms. Their drastically different dispersion profiles enable unconventional, near-arbitrary phase-matching for four-wave mixing, advantageous for wideband wavelength access.

articleTitle: Efficiency of pulse pumped microcavity solitons
abstract: Pulsed pumping of a silica microcavity is used to generate single-soliton microcombs with conversion efficiency of 54%. Analytical expressions are developed by the Lagrangian approach and applied to model the results.

articleTitle: Microwave-optical transduction using high overtone bulk acoustic resonances
abstract: We demonstrate efficient microwave-optical frequency conversion using a released HBAR-on-photonic damascene platform. Thermal tuning of coupled optical ring cavities with integrated heaters allows to operate in the triply resonant transduction scheme.

articleTitle: Scalable Multi-Channel Optical Waveform Generation with Lithium Niobate
abstract: We demonstrate fast and accurate individual control over sixteen optical modes using integrated lithium niobate modulators. This result marks a first step towards realizing scalable optical hardware necessary for general quantum computation on atomic systems.

articleTitle: Strolling through a NISQ processor
abstract: We demonstrate high fidelity multi-particle quantum walks on an 8x8 two-dimensional square superconducting qubit NISQ processor with 62 functional qubits. Further we implement a Mach-Zehnder interferometer where quantum walkers can coherently traverse the circuit.

articleTitle: Optical signal generation and amplification in the spectral region from 1600 to 1800 nm based on bismuth-doped fiber
abstract: We present a tunable, continuous-wave fiber laser with a tuning range of 187 nm (1617-1804 nm) and an fiber amplifier with an output power of more than 200 mW, both based on bismuth-doped germanosilicate fiber.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Modulators with Electro-Optic Polymer Embedded Ladder-Slot Waveguide
abstract: We have developed silicon-photonic modulators with electro-optic polymer embedded silicon ladder-slot waveguide. 3-dB bandwidth calculated from RC product is estimated to be over 400 GHz. Fabricated modulators exhibited a half-voltage-length product (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L) of 3.3 Vmm.

articleTitle: Lithium-niobate-based narrow-linewidth integrated lasers with petahertz frequency tuning rate
abstract: We demonstrate an electro-optically tunable hybrid integrated laser self-injection locked to a mode of a heterogeneously integrated lithium-niobate-on-Damascene-silicon-nitride microresonator. An intrinsic linewidth of 3 kHz and a frequency tuning rate of 12 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> Hz/s were observed. Proof-of-principle coherent LiDAR experiments were performed.

articleTitle: Multimode Mamyshev Oscillator
abstract: Spatiotemporal mode-locking (STML) is demonstrated in a Mamyshev Oscillator. We observe a variety of STML states with different degrees of spatiotemporal coupling. The design allows some control over the multimode output beam profile.

articleTitle: High-Harmonic Generation from Subwavelength Resonators
abstract: We generate up to the 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> optical harmonic from a single AlGaAs resonator. The resonator hosts engineered modes associated with bound states in the continuum. We investigate both direct and cascade mechanisms of high harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Deterministic and Scalable Patterning of Plasmonic Nanoparticles
abstract: We report deterministic and scalable patterning of colloidal plasmonic nanoparticles using a two-step capillary assembly and dry transfer printing process. This process achieves consistent optical response on diverse surfaces, demonstrated using a nanoparticle-on-mirror platform.

articleTitle: Compressive Hyperspectral Imaging Based on an End-to-end Learned Metalens
abstract: We design a compressive hyperspectral imaging system by end-to-end optimization of a metalens and image-reconstruction neural network. Our system shows superior spectral-spatial image quality to systems using a standard metalens and neural network.

articleTitle: Scalable Control of Spin Quantum Memories in a Photonic Integrated Circuit
abstract: Using magnetic field gradients and optimally shaped microwave pulses, we demonstrate selective control of color center spin qubits in a diamond micro-chiplet coupled to a photonic integrated circuit, yielding a platform for scalable qubit control.

articleTitle: 40 GHz and 1.1-V Vπ InP-Based n-i-n EO Modulator
abstract: An InP-based electro-optic modulator with an n-i-n heterostructure is demonstrated. An ultra-low half-wave voltage-length product of 0.22 V•cm is recorded, together with 40 GHz bandwidth for a 2-mm modulation length.

articleTitle: Large mode area waveguide for silicon photonics and modelocked lasers
abstract: We show experimental results on large mode area waveguides in silicon photonics. Mode area up to 30 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is demonstrated in a 10 cm long serpentine waveguide with 0.75 dB/cm propagation loss limited only by the aluminum oxide film loss.

articleTitle: MOS Capacitor Driven Silicon Microring Resonator with Large Wavelength Tunability
abstract: We demonstrated a silicon microring resonator driven by high mobility titanium-doped indium oxide MOS capacitor. It achieved an unprecedented wavelength tunability of 480 pm/V with field-effect mobility of 70 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in the gate.

articleTitle: High-Q Silicon-Germanium On-Chip Ring Resonator in the Mid-Infrared
abstract: We report a high-Q ring resonator in the mid-infrared in a silicon-germanium on silicon chip-based platform. The side-coupled ring exhibits a loaded Q-factor of 90,000 at the operating wavelength around 4.18 µm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser-Induced Damage Threshold of Nematic Liquid Crystals at 1030 nm
abstract: The femtosecond laser-induced damage threshold of freely-suspended thin films of liquid crystals is investigated. The breakdown is found dominated by ionization at low repetition rate and by linear absorption at high repetition rate.

articleTitle: Parity-time Symmetric Optical Neural Networks
abstract: An optical neural network architecture is proposed that utilizes parity-time symmetric couplers as its building blocks. Gain–loss contrasts across the array are adjusted as a means to train the network.

articleTitle: Proton Beam Enhancement from Ultrafast Laser Interactions with Compound Parabolic Concentrators
abstract: We describe results of an experiment conducted on the Texas Petawatt Laser using compound parabolic concentrators affixed to Cu targets. We demonstrate enhancements in the peak proton energy and measured dose compared to flat targets.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable meta-pixels using low-loss optical phase-change materials
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate high-resolution, high-saturation, wide-gamut, dynamic, and electrically switchable color meta-pixels by leveraging a newly emerged class of low-loss optical phase-change materials enabling multiplexed image encryption in the state of polarization and material phase.

articleTitle: Near-Ultraviolet Dual-Comb Spectroscopy with Photon-Counting
abstract: A dual-comb interferometer using electro-optic modulators and nonlinear frequency conversion enables linear absorption spectroscopy in the 390-nm region at the single-photon level. Photon-counting instrumentation alleviates the use of high-power lasers.

articleTitle: A laser diagnostic for HCN detection in mid-infrared
abstract: A difference-frequency generation (DFG) laser is used to develop a diagnostic for HCN sensing near 14 μm. Pressure- and temperature-dependent absorption cross-sections are reported. The sensor is showcased in shock tube chemical kinetic experiments.

articleTitle: Recent Progress on Single-frequency EYDFAs for Gravitational Wave Detection
abstract: We present a monolithic, single-frequency EYDFA at 1556 nm with polarizationmaintaining fibers and advanced cooling concept. The amplifier was long-term tested at 50 W output power with low amplified spontaneous emission levels and no stimulated Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: 100W Dual-Output Thin Disk Laser for Picosecond OPCPA Pumping
abstract: Thin disk regenerative amplifiers have suitable characteristics to pump picosecond OPCPA. By optimizing the trigger pulse to the MZM, a dual-output laser operating at 100 W, 1 kHz repetition rate, compressed to the transform limit is reported.

articleTitle: Intelligent Meta-lens Array for Autonomous Sensing
abstract: The design, fabrication, and applications of the intelligent meta-lens array are reported in this talk. We developed the meta-lens array based light field imaging system for full-color imaging, depth, edge detection and intelligent sensing.

articleTitle: Investigation of Resonant Excitation and Stark Tuning of Negatively Charged Tin-Vacancy Centers in Diamond
abstract: We present a study on the resonant excitation and electrical Stark tuning of negatively charged tin-vacancy (SnV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>) defect centers in diamond.

articleTitle: THz Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Combs based on Planarized Waveguides
abstract: We present a planarized double metal waveguide platform for THz quantum cascade laser frequency combs with a wide top metallization, extending above the surrounding low-loss BCB polymer. Compared to a standard double metal waveguide, improvements in waveguide losses, RF and thermal properties are observed. Tapered waveguide devices display a field-enhancing effect, improving comb performance due to the enhanced four wave mixing process. These devices feature strong free-running beatnotes up to nearly -30 dBm and comb operation at high temperatures up to 115 K in continuous wave.

articleTitle: Bioinspired, multi-scale photonic-crystal films for hybrid polarimetric imaging and sensing
abstract: We demonstrate polarization-switching in conducting, electrochromic photonic-crystal films. These ordered, multi-scale structures offer numerous opportunities for inexpensive, large-area, active metasurfaces and fabrication over flexible and non-flat substrates.

articleTitle: Time-reflection beyond the critical angle
abstract: We study the time reflection of evanescent fields beyond the critical angle of total internal reflection, caused by a sudden temporal change in permittivity. We find high sensitivity of the time- reflection near the critical angle.

articleTitle: On-chip χ(3) microring optical parametric oscillator with ultra-high conversion efficiency and >15 mW of output power
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated microresonator χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> optical parametric oscillator with ≈30 % conversion efficiency and >15 mW of output power into a parametric sideband, by reducing parasitic non-linear gain saturation and engineering resonator-waveguide coupling.

articleTitle: Frequency-Agility Probes Enable High Spatial Resolution for Digital Optical Frequency Comb-Based Fast BOTDA
abstract: Utilizing frequency-agility probes in digital optical frequency comb-based fast BOTDA, a record 5 m spatial resolution over 5 km fiber with 4 MHz frequency resolution and 1 GHz bandwidth is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: LightHash: Experimental Evaluation of a Photonic Cryptocurrency
abstract: We propose LightHash, the first feasible photonic cryptographic hash function for blockchain technology using programmable photonic networks. We experimentally evaluate LightHash and assess whether photonic circuits can outperform digital competitors in latency and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: 4-channel DWDM System using Optical Frequency Combs and Active Demultiplexer for Data Center Interconnects
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an OFC and active demultiplexer based 12.5 GHz DWDM system for DCIs. Successful transmission of directly modulated 17.5 Gb/s/λ 16-QAM DMT data is accomplished by using DD-LMS equalizer to overcome cross-channel interference.

articleTitle: High aspect ratio and high-speed glass drilling with femtosecond GHz-bursts
abstract: We report on high aspect ratio and high-speed glass drilling with femtosecond GHz-bursts. The drilling process dynamics of deep and high-quality holes in different glasses and sapphire is monitored by in-situ microscopy and thermal imaging.

articleTitle: Generation of Sub-20 fs Pulses at 2 µm via Degenerate Optical Parametric Amplification
abstract: We present a compact two-stage optical parametric amplifier that implements ultrabroad phase-matching at degeneracy driven by a ytterbium-based laser, enabling the generation of sub-20 fs pulses at 2 µm with µJ pulse energy.

articleTitle: Experimental test of quantum causal influences within an instrumental process
abstract: We implement a binary-variable instrumental scenario on a photonic setup. Despite no Bell-like inequality exists for this model, we detect non-classical correlations by quantifying causal influences, which allows demonstrating discrepancies between quantum and classical predictions.

articleTitle: Functional Drug Sensitivity Screening of Bioprinted Tumor Organoids using High-Speed Live Cell Interferometry
abstract: We develop a method to apply a high-throughput quantitative phase imaging-based assay to functional biomass accumulation measurements of 3D tumor organoids with single-organoid resolution, and demonstrate its utility for drug screening and therapy selection.

articleTitle: Fiber-based Wavelength-tunable Passively Q-switched Laser at 2.7 μm
abstract: We present a 2.7-µm passively Q-switched Er-ZBLAN fiber laser. By introducing an intracavity Lyot birefringence fiber filter utilizing both polarization-maintaining and non-polarization-maintaining silica fiber, the laser achieved the central wavelength tunability of 2702-2772 nm.

articleTitle: Linear Optical Sampling Enabled Soliton Distillation Based on Nonlinear Fourier Transform
abstract: Nonlinear Fourier transform enabled soliton distillation is experimentally verified for the first time, where the full-field information of 1.71 ps ultrashort pulse delivered from a fiber laser can be accessed by linear optical sampling technique.

articleTitle: Directional Broadband Emissivity with Angled Microstructures Produced via Femtosecond Laser Surface Processing
abstract: We demonstrate directional broadband emissivity in the mid-IR range of 7.5 to 14 µm, achieved with angled micro-scale structures on stainless steel produced using femtosecond laser surface processing.

articleTitle: Global Phase Correction Improves Metalens Efficiency
abstract: We introduce a fast joint optimization of unit cells across the whole metasurface, exploiting interactions between nearby cells to produce a desired near-field profile and improving whole-lens focusing efficiency.

articleTitle: Electrooptic Intermodal Interference in Silicate Fibers with Internal Electrodes
abstract: The electrooptic effect is used in a few-mode fiber to control intermodal interference. The fiber has internal electrodes and is poled to increase its electrooptic coefficient. The response time is in the nanosecond range.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptive Radiative Cooler for Maximizing Year-Round Energy Saving of households
abstract: We present an approach to household thermal regulation and energy saving from an all-season perspective by developing a mechanically flexible and energy-free coating that automatically adapts its thermal emittance to different ambient temperatures.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s NRZ OOK signal regeneration on a silicon chip
abstract: All-optical regeneration of 100 Gb/s NRZ OOK signal with 3.6 dB extinction ratio and 0.5 dB quality factor improvements is experimentally demonstrated using a silicon waveguide with reverse-biased p-i-n junction for the first time.

articleTitle: Symmetry-Protected Higher-Order Exceptional Points in Staggered Photonic Rhombic Lattices
abstract: We propose a scheme to realize parity-time-symmetric flatband systems by introducing on-site gain/loss to rhombic lattices with staggered couplings. Such non-Hermitian lattices possess chiral-symmetry-protected third-order exceptional points, exhibiting an ~є<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</sup> eigenvalue separation.

articleTitle: Super resolution imaging through opacity based on auto-modulated speckle illumination
abstract: Imaging through opacity is proposed based on auto-modulated multimode fiber speckle illumination. The imaging resolution is improved by making use of the intrinsic characteristics of the speckle illumination and a localization strategy.

articleTitle: A magnetic field tunable Zero-Index-Metamaterial
abstract: We report a magnetic tunable structure consists of YIG nanorods. Applied magnetic field leading to a tunable band gap from 0 to 0.67 GHz, effective refractive index from 0 to 0+0.09i at 9 GHz frequency.

articleTitle: Transmission-Reflection Terahertz Spatial Light Modulator Using Electrically Tunable Dual-Mode Metamaterial
abstract: Transmission-reflection terahertz spatial light modulator is introduced using electrically tunable dual-mode metamaterial. Simultaneous transmissive and reflective imaging technique for differential respective objects was demonstrated using single SLM with high accuracy compared to real object.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Source Spanning from 5 to 30 μm in Bulk Te pumped at 10 μm
abstract: We report supercontinuum generation in a Te crystal pumped by picosecond CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser pulses at intensities up to 20 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The effective nonlinear refractive index of Te is estimated to be 30x that of GaAs.

articleTitle: Polarimetric Imaging Using One Fractal SNSPD
abstract: We demonstrate a polarimetric imaging system with one fractal superconducting nanowire single-photon detector and time-multiplexed photon-counting scheme, which allows us to obtain images with multiple types of contrast.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Room Temperature Heterodyne Detection with Stabilized Qc Lasers
abstract: A heterodyne detection system, made with unipolar devices operating @4.5µm, reaches a record noise equivalent power of 200 fW at room temperature. Key elements of this setup are frequency stabilized QC lasers and high-speed detectors.

articleTitle: Sub-decibel Efficiency, Bi-Layer, O-band Fiber-to-Chip Grating Coupler Demonstrated in a 45 nm CMOS Foundry Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a grating coupler with 0.85 dB fiber-to-chip coupling loss in the O-band (1,300 nm), implemented in a 45 nm CMOS foundry platform.

articleTitle: Bright zero-phonon transition from point defect-stacking fault complexes in silicon carbide nanowires
abstract: We investigate a new type of quantum emitters, point defect-stacking fault complexes in silicon carbide nanowires. It exhibits record-high bright single-photon emission in silicon carbide and strong zero-phonon transition at even room temperature.

articleTitle: Low-noise Narrow-linewidth Brillouin Random Fiber Laser with Dynamic fiber grating
abstract: A low-noise Brillouin random fiber laser with narrow linewidth is realized by incorporating an unpumped Erbium-doped fiber loop which acts as a dynamic fiber grating capable of center-frequency auto-tracking, mode filtering, and lasing stabilization.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Full-Color Holograms for Visible Light Based on Meta-Waveguides
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photonic integrated visible full-color meta-holograms based on guided wave-driven metasurfaces with complete phase-and-amplitude control capability. Our lightweight and compact meta-holograms can be potentially used for virtual/augmented/mixed reality near-eye displays.

articleTitle: Quantum Hologram Distillation
abstract: A recent holography technique based on induced coherence has been introduced. The technique uses photon pairs wherein one of them illuminates the object, and its partner is detected. The photon illuminating the object is never detected. Here we present a novel technique to distill a hologram with undetected photons.

articleTitle: Fine-structure absorption spectroscopy of singly-ionized 77Se deep-donors in silicon for chip-scale spin-photon interfaces
abstract: We examine and identify mid-infrared transitions of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">77</sup>Se<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> deep-donors in silicon via absorption spectroscopy. The optically-accessible Se nuclear spins, with potentially long coherence, can serve as on-chip spin-photon interfaces for quantum communications and repeater architectures.

articleTitle: Deterministic Creation of Single Nitrogen-Vacancy Center in Diamond Using Femtosecond Laser Writing
abstract: We report a deterministic creation of color centers in diamond by employing single-shot laser writing. After thermal annealing treatment, we have confirmed that the optical emission and spin coherence consist with the conventional single NV.

articleTitle: Plasmon-enhanced Quantum Emission from Spin Defects in Two-dimensional Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: We demonstrate 120-fold photoluminescence enhancement of $\text{V}_{\text{B}}^{-}$ spin defects in hBN by coupling them to nanopatch antennas. Since the laser spot is 6.25 times larger than the antenna area, the actual enhancement is 750-fold.

articleTitle: Evolution of optical vortices from deterministic to random fields
abstract: Upon interaction with inhomogeneous media, high-order optical vortices divide into canonical ones which diffuse away from the optical axis. We demonstrate how this dynamic process depends on both the topological charge and the interaction strength.

articleTitle: Ultrashort laser sintering of printed Ag and Au nanoparticle thin tracks on heat sensitive substrates
abstract: We propose an efficient sintering method for metal nanoparticles films on flexible heat sensitive substrate using femtosecond laser. Sheet resistance measurements and SEM micrographs reveal significant improvements in conductivity and grain size after laser sintering.

articleTitle: Pyroelectric gating of graphene transistor for plasmon-enhanced optical sensing
abstract: A plasmon-enhanced pyroelectric membrane was applied to control the current flow in a graphene transistor for light detection. The graphene transistor was built on a free-standing, 15-μm-thick PVDF membrane, which was doped using gold nanorods to facilitate its optical absorption. Under the resonant condition, the device exhibited a responsivity of 0.79 μA/mW.

articleTitle: A Simple Way to Incorporate Loss When Modelling Multimode Entangled State Generation
abstract: We prove that the light generated via spontaneous four-wave mixing in a set of M coupled, lossy cavities is an M-mode squeezed thermal state. The state generation and evolution is simply obtained by solving a set of 3M first-order differential equations, independent of the number of photons generated.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Reduction in Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers using Low-Index Quantum Barrier Structures
abstract: The phase noise caused by current fluctuations in single-pass semiconductor optical amplifiers is experimentally investigated. Using low-index quantum barrier designs in prototype devices is found to reduce phase noise by 18% compared to reference designs.

articleTitle: Custom-tailored THz radiation generated by on-chip optical rectification in thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We demonstrate the arbitrary synthesis of THz waveforms based on integrated optical rectification in thin-film lithium niobate. The arrangement of THz antennas in logic circuits enables spectral and temporal control of the generated electric farfield.

articleTitle: Concurrent Error-Free Modulation of Adjacent Kerr Comb Lines on a Silicon Chip
abstract: We demonstrate the first error-free simultaneous modulation of multiple Kerr comb lines with cascaded SiP microdisk modulators. Data rates up to 20 Gb/s/λ are shown, supporting the feasibility of Kerr comb-driven SiP DWDM transmitters.

articleTitle: Full Stabilization of a Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Comb via Radiofrequency Injection and Frequency Locking to a Crystalline Microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate a novel scheme for full stabilization of a Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Comb via radio-frequency injection and frequency stabilization on a crystalline microresonator. A final linewidth of 30 kHz over 2 ms is achieved.

articleTitle: Optical Convolutional Neural Network with Atomic Nonlinearity
abstract: An optical convolutional neural network is demonstrated in which linear operations are implemented by lenses and spatial light modulators, while an optical nonlinearity is realized by a cesium vapor cell as a saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Scrambled Time-Bin Encoding for Efficient High-Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We propose analyze and demonstrate a novel high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocol. We implement the protocol using a software update in a standard two-dimensional system and observe a twofold enhancement in the secure key rate.

articleTitle: Sensitive Control of Broad-area Semiconductor Lasers by Cavity Geometry
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that a slight modification of the Fabry-Perot cavity geometry has a profound impact on lasing performance. The near-planar cavity laser supports hundreds of transverse lasing modes with directional and stable output. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multiplexed broadband ptychography characterization of complex spatial and spectral EUV beams from high harmonic generation
abstract: Using multiplexed broadband ptychography, we investigate high-order harmonic vector beams. The method retrieves highly structured beam profiles and wavefronts in addition to spectral resolution without grating dispersion.

articleTitle: Nonlocal Soft Plasmonics: Investigating the ionic plasmon effects of planar electrolyte systems
abstract: We discuss the nonclassical interactions between electrolytes and active planar solid interfaces caused by optical excitation, using a multi-fluid model. The nonlocal plasmonic properties are investigated under tunable ionic system parameters and different illumination conditions.

articleTitle: Wavelength Conversion Based on Four-Wave Mixing and Coherency Broken Bragg Gratings
abstract: We carry out wavelength conversion using four-wave mixing and suppress the pump with a coherency broken Bragg grating with >50 dB rejection ratio and 44 dB/nm roll-off in a single c-Si photonic circuit.

articleTitle: Two-color high-purity entanglement
abstract: We report continuous variable entanglement between light modes of different colors (852nm and 1064nm). Entanglement is demonstrated from radio-frequency down to the acoustic frequency range. The high-purity state violates the separability limit by -7.5 dB.

articleTitle: Operational entanglement-based quantum key distribution in real-field
abstract: We present a fully operational, real field quantum key distribution link based on entanglement over 3 sites in the city of Nice for a total distance of deployed optical fiber of 50.0km.

articleTitle: Distributed Fiber Sensing in Transmission Using Few-mode Operation
abstract: Distributed optical fiber sensors often rely on backscattering phenomena to retrieve the position information, limiting their employment in long-haul amplified links. We introduce and experimentally demonstrate a method for transmission-based distributed sensing through few-mode operation.

articleTitle: Bound states in the continuum in plasmonic metasurfaces
abstract: Being inspired by the structure of butterfly wings, we design and demonstrate experimentally novel types of plasmonic metasurfaces supporting high-Q collective lattice resonances (Q~89) in the mid-IR region revealed by focused light beams with large apertures.

articleTitle: Coherent Combining for High-Power Kerr Combs
abstract: We demonstrate coherent combining of two Kerr combs operating in the normal group-velocity dispersion regime via on-chip synchronization. We achieve a nearly 2´ increase in the combined comb power while maintaining 26% conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-millijoule broadband pulse generation at 3 µm through a 2-µm pumped OPCPA
abstract: A ZnGeP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier pumped by a 2 µm Ho:YLF generated a 3 mJ pulse at 3 µm. The bandwidth supports a 50 fs transform-limited duration.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Rectangular Core Few-mode Fiber with Ultra-low Differential Group Delay
abstract: We design and experimentally demonatrate a rectangular core few-mode fiber that can support the transmission of TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</inf>/TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>/TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>/TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> modes with ultra-low differential group delays.

articleTitle: Spectral Self-Compression in Gas-Filled Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate spectral self-compression in a hollow-core gas-filled photonic crystal fiber for the generation of high energy ps pulses with limited bandwidths.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Efficient OPA via Simultaneous SHG
abstract: We demonstrate dramatic parametric amplifier conversion efficiency enhancement simply by arranging for simultaneously phase-matched idler second-harmonic generation, with 44% pump-to-signal energy conversion (68% pump depletion) in a 48-dB-gain bulk-crystal mid-IR amplifier stage with Gaussian beams.

articleTitle: Stability and deterministic generation of single solitons and soliton crystals in microresonators with avoided crossings
abstract: We determine the stable regions in the parameter space of single soliton and soliton crystal frequency combs in microresonators with avoided crossings. We show that solitons are obtained deterministically when the stable region is enlarged.

articleTitle: Engineering Joint Spectral Densities with Orbital Angular Momentum States in Optical Fibers
abstract: We exploit the large modal space available in ring-core fibers supporting orbital angular momentum modes to demonstrate a versatile means to control the shape of photon-pair jointspectral densities generated by spontaneous four-wave mixing.

articleTitle: Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging of Protein Aggregation to Understand the Etiology of Neurodegenerative Diseases
abstract: Time-domain fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy is presented for the detection of alpha-synuclein aggregation in neurons and for determining spread, thereby facilitating understanding of the development and progression of Parkinson's disease.

articleTitle: THz Detectors with Photoconductive Metasurfaces Operating at Microwatt Gate Power Levels
abstract: We demonstrate terahertz (THz) detectors enabling high signal-to-noise ratio photoconductive detection at gate powers as low as 5μW. This is achieved by integrating a photoconductive metasurface, which enhances the detector efficiency and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Fast neural-network-enhanced quantum imaging
abstract: Quantum ghost imaging is a promising technique limited by time-efficiency. We implemented novel deep neural networks to enhance and denoise the reconstructed image, and to establish early image recognition leading to 5× faster imaging speeds.

articleTitle: A Deconvolution Enhanced Multimode Michelson Objective Based Full Field Optical Coherence Tomography Imaging System
abstract: A Michelson Objective based Full Field Optical Coherence Tomography system is combined with fluorescence imaging and deconvolved with the point spread function to enhance the image resolution of biological tissue, exceeding classical resolution limits.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing Chip with Error-Correction Encoding
abstract: We design and fabricate a quantum photonic circuit to implement a quantum error correction code.
