A single logical qubit is encoded with 4 physical qubits to demonstrate its capability of detecting and correcting a single-bit error with an average state fidelity of 86%. We further extend the scheme to demonstrate a fault-tolerant teleportation process.

articleTitle: Transverse-Mode-Entangled Photon-Pair Generation in Optical Fiber
abstract: We present our experimental results on generating photon pairs entangled in a transverse-mode Bell state in few-mode optical fiber by controlling the transverse mode of the pump to selectively excite spontaneous four-wave mixing processes.

articleTitle: Amplitude regeneration and phase noise suppression of an 8-PSK signal by an attenuation-imbalanced NOLM
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear phase noise suppression for a 50%-duty-cycle RZ 8-PSK signal by a nonlinear-optical loop mirror (NOLM). Using NOLM prior to a 25-km-long nonlinear transmission link improves Q-factor by 2.3dB and EVM by 5.2%.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Bandpass Filters with Polarization Diversity
abstract: We demonstrate polarization diverse silicon photonic bandpass filters at telecommunication wavelengths, with high out-of-band rejection (>40 dB), low insertion loss, and lower architecture complexity. Such filters are critical for on-chip wavelength (de)multiplexing in classical/quantum photonics.

articleTitle: Measurement and Assignment of Hot-Band Methane Transitions with Sub-MHz Accuracy
abstract: We use double-resonance spectroscopy with cavity-enhanced comb probe to measure sub-Doppler transitions in the 3ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>←ν<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> band of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. We assign the final states using different pump/probe combinations reaching the same state, and the dependence of line intensities on relative pump/probe polarization.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide soliton access window in an AlN microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate an octave spanning Kerr soliton, with widest soliton access window of 126 pm (~16 GHz) in an AlN microresonator using slow pump tuning at temperature of 16 °C and 320 mW pump power.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal light-driven vortex isolator
abstract: We report a nonreciprocal reconfigurable light-driven isolator for vortex modes based on topology-selective Brillouin scattering in chiral PCF. The isolation rates are higher than 22 dB and 23 dB for 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup>- and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order optical vortices.

articleTitle: Mid-IR hollow fiber gas sensor applications in environmental sensing and isotope analysis
abstract: Gas sensors based on tunable laser absorption spectroscopy with a hollow fiber waveguide as its central gas cell are discussed. Compact sensors enable trace gas and isotope analysis of greenhouse gases in the field.

articleTitle: Continuous atmospheric methane concentration monitoring using wavelength modulation spectroscopy and anti-resonant hollow core fiber
abstract: High-sensitivity atmospheric methane detector utilizing wavelength modulation spectroscopy is presented. DFB interband cascade laser operating near 3.27 µm and 7.5-m-long negative curvature hollow-core fiber are used and single-ppb detection limit is obtained.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics mean wavelength monitor for fiber optics gyroscope applications
abstract: We utilize the optical power ratio between two output ports of a silicon Mach-Zehnder interferometer to detect the mean wavelength of incident light for fiber optics gyroscope applications. A 70-nm wavelength detection range is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Microfluidic Pumps with Laser Streaming from Tips of Optical Fibers and Sewing Needles
abstract: We demonstrate a versatile microfluidic pump using laser streaming from optical fiber facet and sewing needle tip. The high-speed directional jet flow successfully drives fluid inside a capillary tube, paving the way for biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Measurements at up to 130-kHz Sampling Rates Using Ti:sapphire Dual-Comb Distance Metrology
abstract: By using band-limited detection we demonstrate Ti:sapphire dual-comb distance metrology at >100 kHz, providing few-nm precision in 100 ms with a non-ambiguity range of 29 cm. Exemplar dynamic measurements of audio waveforms are presented.

articleTitle: Anisotropic Dirac cone and slow edge states in a photonic Floquet lattice
abstract: We have proposed a photonic Floquet lattice that supports anisotropic Dirac cones and topological edge states. Under the anisotropic condition, these slow edge states exhibit robustness against disorder, which enable new applications in slow-light systems.

articleTitle: Versatile quantum enabled telecom receiver
abstract: We demonstrate a time-resolving quantum receiver at a telecom wavelength. We show state discrimination errors below the shot noise limit for legacy, novel telecommunication protocols with long alphabets.

articleTitle: Integration of single GaN micro-lenses with high index semiconductors by transfer printing
abstract: Suspended GaN micro-lenses are micro-transfer printed onto diamond to increase light-coupling efficiency. We demonstrate micro-lenses with 4 – 13 µm diameter, up to 3 µm height and r.m.s. surface roughness below 2 nm.

articleTitle: Towards high purity heralded single photon generation in thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We design and fabricate dispersion-engineered thin-film lithium niobate waveguides for high-purity heralded single-photon generation in the telecommunications band, characterize the phase-matching function via sum-frequency generation, and estimate the joint spectral intensity separability.

articleTitle: Modal Content and Confinement Loss Evolution with Surface Roughness Profile in Hollow-Core Inhibited Coupling Tube Lattice Fibers
abstract: We investigate with a numerical model the confinement loss of the higher-order modes of hollow-core inhibited coupling tube lattice fibers as influenced by the power spectral distribution of transverse surface roughness in the glass tubes forming the fiber cladding.

articleTitle: Wavelength shifting concept for high-power femtosecond lasers
abstract: We introduce a new concept to frequency shift a high-power laser using a waveshaper and a multi pass cell. We demonstrate this concept by experimentally frequency shifting a 200fs laser from 1030nm to 1000nm.

articleTitle: The Transition from Linear to Quadratic Flux Scaling in Nonlinear Optical Processes with Variable Brightness Broadband Squeezed Vacuum
abstract: We characterize broadband parametric down conversion at low and high gain regimes. Two-photon absorption is measured at high gain, and sum-frequency generation is used to investigate the transition to high gain, and spectrally resolve two-photon interactions.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, tunable mid-IR source based on enhanced-efficiency intrapulse difference-frequency generation
abstract: We report on an ultra-broadband mid-infrared source based on intrapulse difference-frequency-generation delivering 135 nJ, 50 fs-long pulses at 250 kHz repetition-rate. A bichromatic waveplate is used, enhancing the number of photons for the mid-infrared generation.

articleTitle: Imprinted Barium Titanate Metalenses with broadband Focus
abstract: We present a metalens from barium titanate, a widely transparent and optically nonlinear material. We demonstrate broadband visible to near-infrared focusing using a simple soft nano-imprint fabrication to reach aspect-ratios of up to 8.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Laser Fabrication of Efficient Volume Bragg Gratings at Depth in Silica
abstract: By using a spatial light modulator to correct for depth-dependent aberrations, we demonstrate the ultrafast laser fabrication of volume gratings at depths up to 850 μm that exhibit 45% efficiency for 633 nm light.

articleTitle: Ultra-low energy programmable non-volatile silicon photonics based on graphene heaters
abstract: We demonstrate a nonvolatile electrically programmable phase-change silicon photonic switch and phase shifter leveraging a monolayer graphene heater with record-high programming energy efficiency (8.7±1.4 aJ/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) and endurance (> 1,000 cycles).

articleTitle: TaAs Weyl Semimetal Full-Stokes Integrated Polarimeter
abstract: We demonstrate a full-Stokes integrated polarimeter based on the circular photogalvainc effect in TaAs Weyl semimetal. Our work could enable a new class of compact and broadband polarization sensitive optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: On-Chip Injection Locked Nonlinear Wavelength Conversion
abstract: We demonstrate narrow linewidth, second-harmonic generation using a semiconductor DFB laser self-injection locked with a high-Q lithium niobate microresonator. A second-harmonic linewidth of 31kHz is achieved from 36dB pump frequency noise suppression.

articleTitle: Topological Mode-Locked Laser with Intracavity Couplings
abstract: We experimentally realize a topological actively mode-locked laser by coupling the pulses with intracavity delay lines. Our work reveals a new regime of nonlinear topological photonics and has potential applications to short-pulse lasers.

articleTitle: Plasmonically Enhanced Electronically Addressable Photonic Switches Incorporating Phase-Change Materials
abstract: Ever-increasing processing and storage requirements steer us towards co-integration of electronics and photonics. Here, we demonstrate waveguide-integrated plasmonic memory and computing elements by employing phase-change materials with reconfigurable properties and dual electro-optic functionality.

articleTitle: Thickness Dependent Optical Properties of Plasmonic Transdimensional Titanium Nitride
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate quantum confinement induced thickness dependent optical properties in atomically-thin, passivated, epitaxial, metallic TiN films using spectroscopic ellipsometry as predicted by a nonlocal Drude dielectric response model for plasmonic transdimensional materials (TDMs).

articleTitle: Generation of High-Power First-Order Laguerre-Gaussian Beam from a Solid-State Tm Laser at ~2 μm
abstract: We report on a high-power first-order Laguerre-Gaussian beam generation from a diode-pumped Tm:YAlO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> laser with a maximum power of 16.7 W at 1987 nm. Wavelength tunable operation is achieved across ~149 nm.

articleTitle: Evanescently Coupled Multimode Silicon Nitride Waveguides for on Chip Spectroscopy
abstract: Integrated and evanescently coupled multimode silicon nitride waveguides hold promise for on chip sensing of optical spectra. Bidirectional evanescent coupling yields low correlation between measurements which is needed for robust reconstruction of spectra.

articleTitle: Coupled Micro Ring Lasers based on Hybrid Integration of Colloidal Quantum Dots
abstract: Coupled and Random laser require flexible fabrication methods for photonic integration. Series of (random) coupled micro ring resonators were made with colloidal quantum dots and their unique properties investigated in both linear and lasing regimes.

articleTitle: Temporal self-compression and self-frequency shift of sub-μJ pulses at 8 MHz repetition rate
abstract: We report a turn-key system producing few-fs pulses at 8 MHz repetition rate for pump energies as low as 220 nJ, and shifting their central wavelength continuously between 1100 nm and 1400 nm.

articleTitle: Covariance Matrix Reconstruction of Nonclassical Light Generated On-Chip
abstract: We reconstruct covariance matrices of two-mode states generated in an above-threshold on-chip optical parametric oscillator. Up to 2.3 dB squeezing is directly observed and all quadratures are measured, as a function of pump intensity.

articleTitle: Real-time reaction monitoring of liquids based on monolithic mid-IR sensors
abstract: We present a fingertip-sized mid-IR lab-on-a-chip for selective and sensitive time-resolved spectroscopy of liquids. Breakthrough beyond state-of-the-art operation of our monolithic sensor is demonstrated by real-time in-situ reaction-monitoring of conformational changes in a protein solution.

articleTitle: Polarization Sensitive Terahertz Bolometer
abstract: We present a novel uncooled terahertz bolometric sensor based on plasmonic absorbers and phase-changing transducer beams. The device facilitates simultaneous sensing of incident radiation intensity and polarization by utilizing polarization-dependent plasmonic field enhancement.

articleTitle: Self-referenced multiplex CARS imaging using beam self-cleaning in GRIN multimode fiber
abstract: Spatial beam self-cleaning process in graded-index multimode optical fiber was successfully applied for self-referenced multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman Scattering (M-CARS) based imaging. M-CARS spectroscopy of methanol and imaging of polystyrene bead are reported through a simplified scheme.

articleTitle: Extreme-Timing-Resolution with Waveguide-Based Balanced Optical Cross-Correlators
abstract: We report a balanced optical cross-correlator based on PPKTP waveguides with sub-attosecond noise floor and more than 100 times higher timing sensitivity when compared to similar bulk optic detectors.

articleTitle: Light Propagation in Spatio-Temporal Crystals
abstract: We study light propagation in spatio-temporal photonic crystals: media whose electromagnetic properties vary periodically in both time and space. We find unique eigenmodes inside mixed energy-momentum gaps, extracting energy and momentum from the modulation.

articleTitle: Cr2+:ZnS laser crystal antireflection treatment by ultrashort laser pulses
abstract: We report on antireflection microstructure fabrication on the working surface of the Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnS laser crystal by 200-fs laser treatment. This allows to increase transmittance in a broad range from 2 to 8 µm, approaching a maximum of 90.5% near 2.5 µm.

articleTitle: Free-electron-driven X-ray caustics from strained van der Waals materials
abstract: We show that X-ray caustics and specifically X-ray Airy beams can be created from free-electron interactions with strained van der Waals materials.

articleTitle: Accurate modelling of mode-locked dynamics in fibre lasers
abstract: We present a comprehensive numerical mode-locked laser model that incorporates amplified spontaneous emission and demonstrates significantly improved agreement with experimental results. Pump powers, which are the only input parameters, are also accurately predicted.

articleTitle: Coherent optical neural network with injection-locked VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate analog coherent homodyne photoelectric multiplication with phase-modulated VCSEL arrays (operating at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>=2 mV). Precise phase control over individual laser emitters enables MNIST image classification with accuracy near the ground truth.

articleTitle: Cloud-Scale Archival Storage Using Ultrafast Laser Nanostructuring
abstract: Recent progress in ultrafast laser nanostructuring enables high-density multidimensional volumetric data writing. With exceptional media longevity, this could transform archival cloud storage. We demonstrate peak volumetric densities above 250 MB/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> of data write and read.

articleTitle: Continuous-variable quantum repeaters based on bosonic error-correction and teleportation: architecture and applications
abstract: We report a teleportation-enabled continuous-variable quantum-repeater architecture assisted by the Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill code to significantly suppress the physical noise. This architecture significantly improves the performance of three representative use cases for quantum communication and sensing.

articleTitle: Second Harmonic Generation in 3R-MoS2 waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate broadband waveguiding second harmonic generation in bulk, non-centrosymmetric 3R-MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. SHG conversion is demonstrated using polarization and wavelength-resolved imaging. We report the first measurement of SHG coherence length in 3R-stacked van der Waals waveguides.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of CFO Estimation in Optical Eigenvalue-domain
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a CFO estimation method in the optical eigenvalue domain. A fine CFO estimation of 5.3 MHz with only one soliton pilot pulse of 6.4 ns duration is achieved.

articleTitle: Repetition-rate Dependence of High-power THz Generation in the Tilted-pulse Front Geometry in Lithium Niobate
abstract: We present experimental evidence of repetition-rate dependent thermal effects that limit THz generation efficiency in the tilted-pulse front geometry in lithium niobate at high average powers.

articleTitle: 2.5D-MoS2-Based Non-Volatile Optical Memory for Integrated Photonics
abstract: We proposed an integrated non-volatile optical memory cell using novel analog linear photo-response resistance switch based on 2.5D MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. It enables a thermally stable and scalable solution for integrated optical memory components.

articleTitle: Performance of Downsized High-power Optical Isolator Using Novel Glass With High Verdet Constant
abstract: Magneto-optical glass with a large Verdet constant has been developed. The glass was utilized as a Faraday rotator in the optical isolator, and the downsizing of the isolator was achieved.

articleTitle: Storage of 147 Temporal Modes of Telecom-band Single Photon with Fiber-pigtailed Er3+: LiNbO3 Waveguide
abstract: Quantum storage of 147 temporal modes at telecom-band is experimentally demonstrated by using a fiber-pigtailed laser-written Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>: LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> waveguide. Memory efficiency of 2.00±0.09 % is achieved with storage time up to 100 ns.

articleTitle: Sub-milliwatt coherent microcomb generation
abstract: We demonstrate coherent microcomb generation based on an AlGaAs-on-insulator microresonator operating at sub-milliwatt pump power regime, that can be directly driven by on-chip laser.

articleTitle: Augmenting the Sensing Performance of Entangled Photon Pairs through Asymmetry
abstract: We explore experimentally the squeezing enhanced phase-sensing performance of an SU(1,1) interferometer and optimize its detection scheme under realistic conditions of loss and coherent seeding. We demonstrate improvement in the interference contrast and phase sensitivity.

articleTitle: Ground-based, Laser Heterodyne Radiometer Measurements of Methane Vertical Profiles
abstract: A laser heterodyne radiometry (LHR) technique for the determination of the vertical distribution of methane and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere using a single, near infrared laser is reported.

articleTitle: Routing single photons from a trapped ion with photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Trapped ions excel as quantum networking nodes. Here, we use integrated photonic circuits to route and directionally switch single photons emitted by an ion. This is a key step towards scalable trapped ion quantum networks.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Optical Biasing of a Superconducting Nanowire Single Photon Detector with a Photodiode
abstract: We present a method to provide the bias current for an SNSPD via the photocurrent of a photodiode at 0.8K. This offers the prospect for noise reduction, heat load reduction, and bias current pulsing.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive fiber optic ultrasound detector array for rapid photoacoustic imaging
abstract: A 32-channel high sensitivity optic ultrasound detector array is demonstrated for rapid photoacoustic imaging. The probe exhibits a NEP of 0.61kPa and the scanning time could be four times faster than a mechanical scan theoretically.

articleTitle: Thermal control of Kerr microresonator soliton comb via an optical sideband
abstract: We demonstrate the thermal control of a microresonator soliton comb via an optical sideband, in which the detuning is passively fixed, enabling the robust and frequency-tunable soliton comb as well as the phase noise reduction.

articleTitle: Metasurface Smart Glass for Object Recognition
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach to realize optical neural networks by condensing the layered computations into a singlet of metasurface device which provides task-specific transformations of signals for recognizing the identity of an optical object.

articleTitle: 3D Color Printing by Additive Manufacturing of Metallic Thin Films
abstract: We demonstrate a new structural color printing technology for micro-scaled images based on polymer-assisted photochemical metal deposition (PPD), a room-temperature, ambient, and additive manufacturing process without requiring any heating, vacuum deposition or etching steps.

articleTitle: Low loss and back-reflection interconnection between SMF and hollow core fiber by angled fusion splicing
abstract: A 2.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup> angle cleave reduces the back-reflection by 25 dB (to below -40 dB) while increasing the insertion loss by only 0.6 dB (to 1.3 dB) when compared to a flat-cleaved splice.

articleTitle: Compact, spatial-mode-interaction-free, ultralow-loss, nonlinear photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We implement Euler bends to build compact high-Q Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> racetrack microresonators, featuring a small footprint of only 0.21 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for 19.8 GHz free spectral range. We demonstrate that these multi-mode microresonators can be operated in the single-mode regime and generate a single soliton microcomb.

articleTitle: Intermodal Four-wave Mixing in MgF2 Microresonators Enable Ultra-wide Frequency Generation
abstract: We study the intermodal four-wave mixing interactions in a high-Q MgF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> microresonator, and show that such interactions can enable the generation of visible and infrared sidebands spaced by more than 150 THz from the pump.

articleTitle: Ion-Based High-Harmonic Generation from Water Window to keV X-Ray
abstract: Ion-based high-harmonic generation with quasi-phase-matching is proposed. The calculation shows that the relative conversion efficiency for water window/x-ray operation reaches about 15% of the perfect phase-matching condition.

articleTitle: TiO2-based Flexible Integrated Photonics for High-sensitivity Temperature Sensing
abstract: We report a flexible temperature sensor based on TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> photonics that shows double the sensitivity compared to silicon photonics. This high sensitivity and biocompatibility pave the way towards point-of-care temperature detection for many biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Multiresponsive dielectric metasurfaces with light- and temperature-responsive copolymers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate multiresponsive tuning of high-quality-factor dielectric metasurfaces integrated with light- and temperature-responsive copolymers at near-infrared wavelengths. Our work explores multidimensional active control of metasurface-based nanophotonic systems for novel light field manipulations.

articleTitle: Persistent Beating Phenomenon in Coupled Non-Degenerate Parametric Oscillators
abstract: We explore experimentally synchronization and persistent beating dynamics in coupled non-degenerate parametric oscillators. We demonstrate that synchronization is completely prevented due to mode competition, which is unique to non-degenerate oscillators.

articleTitle: Voltage-controlled moiré potentials, propagation and luminescence of indirect excitons in MoSe2/WSe2 heterostructure
abstract: We present a new mechanism for exciton transport control based on tuning moiré potentials by voltage to enable delocalization, present long-range exciton propagation due to this mechanism, explore correlations between exciton luminescence and propagation properties.

articleTitle: 3D multiphoton characterization of χ(2) nonlinearity induced in a multimode fiber through optical poling
abstract: We characterize the 3D spatial distribution of the quadratic susceptibility in an optically poled graded-index multimode fiber in presence of spatial beam self-cleaning. We also show how the poling process can improve the beam self-cleaning.

articleTitle: PT-Symmetric Coupled-Cavity AlGaAs Laser for Tunable THz Generation
abstract: We report the design and fabrication of a PT-symmetric coupled-cavity AlGaAs MQW laser for THz beat frequency generation. The THz frequency can be tuned by varying the gain contrast between the two individual resonators.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of 3D Inverse Designed Metaoptics in Mid-Infrared
abstract: Practical realizations of 3-dimensional inverse designed photonics at optical wavelengths have been limited by fabrication and measurement challenges. We present experimental results for mid-infrared multilayer nanophotonics fabricated using two photon lithography for advanced imaging applications.

articleTitle: A Phase-Coherent On-Chip Single-Photon SWAP Gate
abstract: We demonstrate a single-photon SWAP gate between polarization and spatial-momentum qubits on a silicon-on-oxide chip. Phase coherence of the SWAP gate operation is confirmed via single-photon self-interference, with visibility up to 98.89%.

articleTitle: Purcell enhancement of X-ray scintillation
abstract: We demonstrate nanophotonic enhancement of the intrinsic spontaneous emission of X-ray-driven scintillation. By designing a 16-layers nanophotonic scintillator structure, we present the first observation of Purcell-enhanced scintillation, expressed by enhanced angular emission of visible photons.

articleTitle: Casimir-Like Interaction of Bound Solitons
abstract: We the steady states of two-soliton waveforms that form stationary bound states in a fiber laser, passively mode-locked by a nonlinear-multimode-interference based saturable absorber. We model the steady states using noise-mediated Casimir-like pulse interaction mechanism.

articleTitle: Control of single-photon emitters in two-dimensional materials using dielectric nanoantennas
abstract: We show that dielectric nanoantennas are capable of inducing very high Purcell enhancement up to factors > 45 for defect-based single-quantum emitters in atomically thin layered materials, enabling bright single-photon emission with polarization control.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Multi-Layer Foundry-Fabricated Optical Vortex Beam Emitters
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate inverse-designed foundry-fabricated vortex beam emitters that take advantage of multi-layer heterogeneous integration to achieve wide bandwidths and high efficiencies.

articleTitle: Farey-Fraction Frequency Locking of a Breather Ultrafast Fibre Laser
abstract: We report frequency locking at Farey fractions of a breather mode-locked fibre laser. The ratios of the breathing frequency to the cavity-repetition frequency show the Fareytree’s hierarchy and devil-staircase’s structure with a 0.906 fractal dimension.

articleTitle: Strong Anapole-Plasmon Coupling in Dielectric and Plasmon Nanocavities
abstract: We theoretically demonstrated a strong anapole-plasmon coupling in silicon nanodisk and two gold nanorods. The results showed a large Rabi splitting of 134 meV and large field enhancements at room temperature.

articleTitle: Generation of Schrödinger Cat States with Wigner Negativity Using a Low-Loss Continuous-Wave Optical Parametric Amplifier
abstract: We observed Wigner negativity of Schrödinger cat states generated with a low-loss continuous-wave optical parametric amplifier, paving the way toward fault-tolerant and universal quantum computation with terahertz clock frequency.

articleTitle: Gold Metasurface for Passive Mode-locking at 1 µm Region
abstract: We demonstrate passively mode-locked ytterbium-doped fiber laser by using gold metasurface saturable absorber. Experimental results verify that gold metasurface can be implemented for constructing mode-locked lasers at 1 µm region for the first time.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact polarization-independent 3 dB power splitter in silicon
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a polarization-independent 3 dB power splitter (PIPS) assisted with subwavelength structure. The device possesses ultra-compact (1.2 µm × 2.62 µm) and polarization-independent features with an operating bandwidth over 50 nm (from 1540-1590 nm)

articleTitle: Temporal Soliton in a Fiber Laser Cavity with a Detuned Injected Signal for Ultra-dense Optical Frequency Comb Generation
abstract: We generate broadband ultra-dense optical frequency comb in a coherently driven laser pumped below its oscillation threshold. We investigate, both theoretically and experimentally, the crucial role played by the cavity detuning.

articleTitle: Fish-Lateral-Line-Inspired Flexible Optical Sensor for Versatile Underwater Sensing
abstract: We present a flexible silica-polymer composite optical fiber (SPCOF) inspired by fish lateral lines for underwater perception. The unique movement status of robotic fish and hydroacoustic signal with frequency of 100 Hz are detected.

articleTitle: Magnetic Quadrupole Excitation in Meta-atoms Using Structured Light
abstract: We investigate how structured light can enhance and alter the excitation of high-order multipole moments in silicon nanocubes due to its complex field gradient.

articleTitle: Waveguide-based Photodetector integrated with Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
abstract: A new scheme of photodetector monolithically integrated with semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) has been demonstrated. Optical-to-electrical frequency response of 30GHz was obtained with an optical gain of >8dB from SOA, leading to >0.6 A/W responsivities.

articleTitle: Ultrafast free-electron probing of photon statistics inside a laser cavity
abstract: We propose using the quantum interaction of free electrons with light to measure the photon statistics inside laser cavities. This approach has unprecedented spatiotemporal resolution, which could resolve fundamental questions associated with many laser systems.

articleTitle: Quantification of Nonlinear Photonic and Phononic Excitation in CdWO4 Using 2D Spectroscopy
abstract: Using 2D THz spectroscopy, we quantify vibrational nonlinear energy transfer in CdWO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> by determining parameters for electronic Raman scattering and anharmonic coupling.

articleTitle: Light-Induced Structuration of Azopolymer Films for Reconfigurable Diffractive Optical Elements
abstract: Reconfigurable diffractive optical elements, having on-demand practical uses, are realized in single-step all-optical structuration processes of a photosensitive re-shapable polymer film.

articleTitle: microcavity modulation mediated by strongly coupled to LSPR mode
abstract: We demonstrate an effective approach to modulate THz microcavity, experimentally achieved by coupling to LSPR mode. The result provides a new degree of freedom to the design and construction of on-chip THz devices.

articleTitle: Parallel intermodal four-wave mixing for high-dimensional photon-pair entanglement
abstract: We present a proposal for photon-pair generation through intermodal fourwave mixing with high-dimensional entanglement in transverse mode. Based on this, we suggest a simple fiber design capable of generating four-dimensional Bell states.

articleTitle: Programming multi-mode quantum circuits in complex scattering media
abstract: We demonstrate the manipulation of a five-dimensional spatially entangled two-photon state using reprogrammable multi-mode optical circuits implemented within a multi-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Birefringence Compensation from Polarization Maintaining Fiber Pairs
abstract: Theoretical modeling and experimental verification demonstrate that pair of identical polarization maintaining fibers (PMF), with a relative rotation angle of 90°, will preserve any linear polarization state entering the fiber pair.

articleTitle: Observance of lasing and amplification in the first titanium doped sapphire whispering-gallery laser
abstract: We report on the first ever titanium doped sapphire whispering-gallery laser with a record low threshold of 14.2 mW. Moreover, amplification is shown in the mode narrowing of a probe laser at 795 nm.

articleTitle: Photonic Higher-order Topological Orbital States and Nonlinearity-mediated Dynamical Rotation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate photonic higher-order topological orbital corner states in laser-written breathing Kagome lattices, unveiling their charaterisitic dipole-like mode distribution and dynamical rotation in presence of optical nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Nonlinear nano-imaging of few-fs coherent dynamics in 2D graphene-semiconductor heterostructures
abstract: Using correlative adiabatic plasmonic nanofocused four-wave mixing and two-photon photoluminescence we image nanoscale heterogeneity, resolve few- to 10’s fs coherent dynamics, and model underlying interlayer coupling in 2D graphene/WSe2 heterostructures.

articleTitle: Expanding the Quantum Photonic Toolbox with Low-Loss AlGaAs-on-Insulator
abstract: We present the building blocks for a programmable quantum processor with AlGaAs-on-insulator integrated photonics, including low-loss waveguide crossers and > 30 dB extinction tunable interferometers, which we benchmark via photonic qubit demultiplexing with high extinction.

articleTitle: Silicon Microring Modulator for High SFDR Analog Links in Monolithic 45nm CMOS
abstract: We characterize the linearity of a lateral junction microring modulator in a monolithic 45 nm CMOS platform versus modulator bias, optical wavelength, and input power, and achieve peak third-order SFDR of 96.4dB · ${\text{H}}{{\text{z}}^{\frac{2}{3}}}$ at 0dBm laser power.

articleTitle: Fast Dynamics of 10 μm Breakdown in Air by Time and Space Resolved Visible Interferometry
abstract: We report detailed study of temporal and spatial dynamics of air plasma produced by a focused to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser. A record ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> cm/s velocity of electron avalanche expansion is measured with picosecond resolution.

articleTitle: Isolation of Phase Object in Edge-Enhanced Microscopy with q-plate under Tilted Laser Illumination
abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate a method to isolate the phase edge from the amplitude-phase object by employing 4f system with a q-plate filter that uses multiple tilted lights to eliminate the amplitude edge.

articleTitle: A Dual-Stage Photonic Integrated Circuit Spectrometer
abstract: We present a photonic integrated circuit spectrometer that cascades an arrayed-waveguide grating with a series of coupled-resonator optical waveguide filters to achieve a spectral resolution of 0.5 nm over a bandwidth from 805–930 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of Nonvanishing Optical Helicity in Thermal Radiation from Symmetry-Broken Metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate magnetic-field-free circular-polarized thermal radiation based on a symmetry-broken metasurface. A nonvanishing optical helicity in the radiation excited by thermal fluctuations is observed in a dispersionless energy band.

articleTitle: Kerr-lens mode-locked Tm,Ho:CALGO laser
abstract: We report on a Kerr-lens mode-locked Tm,Ho:CALGO laser delivering 46-fs pulses at ~2.06 μm with an average power of 110 mW. The maximum average power reached 423 mW for a pulse duration of 53 fs.

articleTitle: Wavelength Multiplexing in an off-plane Computer - Generated Waveguide Hologram using binary grating
abstract: A novel wavelength multiplexing scheme for off-plane Computer-Generated Waveguide Holography using dislocated binary grating is proposed. Phase modulation is optimized to form a smiley face at λ= 590nm and a danger sign at λ= 650nm.

articleTitle: Distinction of EIT and ATS using photonic crystal nanobeam cavities-waveguide coupled system
abstract: Here we demonstrate the electromagnetically induced transparency and Autler–Townes splitting in a photonic-crystal-nanobeam-cavity-waveguide coupled system for the first time. This work enables to evaluate the interference of fields in integrated optical system.

articleTitle: Producing multiple qubits via spontaneous parametric down-conversion
abstract: We have designed Gaussian masks to subdivide the pump beam before passing it through a BBO. In this way, present an approach to possibly produce multiple entangled photon pairs through spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC).

articleTitle: Fiber Based Generic Photonic Computing Unit
abstract: We present a fiber-based photonic computing concept and system which rely on incoherent data encoding and scalable architecture. Our results suggest projected performance of >1,000,000 Tera operations per second (TOPs) and efficiency of >1000 TOPs/Watt.

articleTitle: Measurement-Verified Spatiotemporal Ultrafast Pulse Propagation
abstract: We develop numerical modeling techniques to predict spatiotemporal ultrafast pulse propagation through optical systems. Predicted pulses are verified with downstream measurement. Measurement feedback enhances modeling for hard-to-access locations in ultrafast laser systems.

articleTitle: Characterization of Weak Modal Dynamics in Multimode Fibers using Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detectors
abstract: We measure the mode transfer matrix of a commercial multimode fiber using ultrasensitive superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs). We quantify distributed mode coupling and differential mode group delay, and observe cladding modes of the MMF.

articleTitle: Fine Structure Splitting and Exciton Interactions in MoWSe2 Single-Crystal
abstract: We demonstrate fine structure splitting in MoWSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> single-crystal experimentally using ultrafast transient reflectance spectroscopy and theoretically by the Bethe-Salpeter equation. Furthermore, alloying creates intermediate states, which play a critical role in the ultrafast carrier dynamics.

articleTitle: 4-bit Ultra Low-loss Cascaded Nonvolatile Photonic Memories Using Broadband Transparent Phase change materials
abstract: Here we demonstrate an ultra-low-loss multi-state photonic memory with phase change materials (GeSbSe), which can be efficiently reprogrammed on-chip. 4-bit memory and over 100,000 cycle tests are shown for this material.

articleTitle: Plasmon Satellites in Photoemission: Application to Metal Nanoparticles
abstract: We theoretically describe the electron–boson interaction governing photoemission from plasmonic nanoparticles and predict that the spectrum exhibits plasmon satellite peaks, whose intensity depends on the experimental parameters and on the plasmon’s initial state.

articleTitle: High-dimensional Frequency Entanglement Certification
abstract: With few measurement settings and no assumptions on the state, we show methods to certify the highest dimensionality of entanglement in the frequency domain harvested from a common χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinear crystal.

articleTitle: High Transmittance Form-Birefringent Nanostructures Fabricated in Lithium Aluminosilicate Glass by Femtosecond Laser
abstract: Anisotropic nanovoids that are oriented perpendicular to the light polarization were observed in lithium aluminosilicate (LAS) glass after femtosecond laser irradiation. The birefringent structures exhibited high transmission of around 99% in the visible range.

articleTitle: Practical Limits to Conversion Efficiency in Kerr Microresonator Optical Parametric Oscillators
abstract: We numerically and theoretically explore the pump-to-signal conversion efficiency of Kerr microresonator optical parametric oscillators. We identify mode competition and cross-phase modulation-induced modulation instability as parasitic nonlinear processes that curb efficiency.

articleTitle: All-optical, ultrafast energy-efficient ReLU function for nanophotonic neural networks
abstract: We introduce and experimentally demonstrate an all-optical ReLU nonlinear activation function based on the strong quadratic nonlinearity of lithium niobate nanophotonic waveguides and achieve a record-breaking energy-time product per activation of 1.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−27</sup> J • s to overcome the nonlinearity bottleneck in photonic neural networks.

articleTitle: The Carrier Dynamics in the GaN-nanowire Based Photoelectrochemical Photodetector
abstract: Two competing charge transfer processes co-determine the photo-responsive behaviour in the GaN nanowires. Furthermore, Platinum decoration tuned the charge-transfer dynamics and contributed to a 20-fold increase of photocurrent. Theoretical calculations finally revealed the underlying mechanism.

articleTitle: Hot-Band Absorption Can Mimic Entangled Two-Photon Absorption
abstract: While searching for entangled two-photon absorption in LDS798, we instead observe fluorescence signals originating from hot-band absorption. This process could lead to overestimating entangled two-photon absorption cross sections by several orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Edge and Grating Coupler Hybrid for Full-scale Wafer-level and Chip-level Testing
abstract: A hybrid edge and grating coupler allowing full-scale wafer and chip-level testing is demonstrated, which achieves insertion loss below 1.2 dB and extinction ratio above 17 dB while operating with either of the couplers.

articleTitle: Attosecond core-level spectroscopy reveals the flow of excitation in a material between light, carriers and phonons
abstract: We use attosecond core-level X-ray spectroscopy to disentangle the spectral and dynamical signatures of energy conversion pathways between photons, charge carriers and the lattice in graphite with attosecond precision and across a picosecond range.

articleTitle: Mode-locked Phase Coherent Singly-Resonant Biphoton Frequency Comb
abstract: We observed evidence of spectral-phase-coherence in a singly-resonant biphoton frequency comb’s second-order cross-correlation function, and we verified the state’s time-energy entanglement by measuring Franson interference in 2 time-bins that violate the Bell inequality.

articleTitle: Waveguide-coupled narrow-linewidth photoluminescence from a single carbon nanotube
abstract: We demonstrate narrow-linewidth and low-background light emission from an individual single-walled carbon nanotube integrated onto a photonic crystal nanobeam cavity and a waveguide operating in the telecom wavelength regime.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic-Electronic Memristors
abstract: We integrate memristors in a silicon photonic/plasmonic platform and demonstrate modulators, photodetectors and electronic devices complemented with memory effect. The demonstrated memristors could be the key photonic building blocks in hybrid photonic-electronic neuromorphic chips.

articleTitle: Phase Noise Reduction of a Kerr Comb via All-Optical Synchronization to an Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate on a silicon-nitride chip all-optical synchronization between an optical parametric oscillator and a soliton Kerr comb, resulting in a near-complete suppression of excess phase noise associated with thermo-refractive noise in soliton comb lines.

articleTitle: Electrically-driven Nonreciprocal Polarization Rotation at 780 nm in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
abstract: We demonstrate an electro-optic nonreciprocal polarization rotator for 780nm light in a lithium niobate on insulator photonics platform. Our device achieves ~12 dB contrast between the polarization-rotated sidebands for opposite directions over a bandwidth ~2nm.

articleTitle: Influence of the lattice orientation onto ultra-short pulsed laser machining of semiconductors
abstract: (100) oriented silicon and germanium wafers, machined with 10 ps pulses in the NIR (1064 nm), clearly show two ablation regimes when the peak fluence is raised from the threshold to several J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In the first regime the roughness increases with the fluence due to strong cavity formation whereas the second regime is dominated by the formation of a melt film leading to smooth and flat surfaces. For (110) and (111) oriented wafers this second regime cannot be observed and the surface roughness continuously increases when the fluence is raised. A similar behaviour is observed for all orientations and fs-pulses or burst mode.

articleTitle: Meta-Holograms for Optical Trapping of Cold Atoms
abstract: We propose metasurface holograms as a platform to efficiently and faithfully generate designer optical traps for cold atoms.

articleTitle: Suppressing Stimulated Brillouin Scattering by Selective Mode Excitation in Multimode Fibers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate efficient suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering in multimode fibers. By distributing the power in a number of high-order modes, the SBS threshold is three times as much as that for fundamental-mode-only excitation.

articleTitle: A compact setup for broadband polarization tomography
abstract: We describe an automated setup for broadband polarization tomography that can be used for measuring birefringence and chirality of metasurfaces, photonic crystal slabs, and other complex optical elements.

articleTitle: Experimental Realization of the Kicked Aubry-André-Harper Hamiltonian
abstract: We report an experimental study investigating transport phenomena of ultracold atoms loaded in a primary optical lattice and periodically-kicked with an incommensurate optical lattice. We observe signatures of an extended multifractal phase.

articleTitle: Utilization of a frequency-swept Fabry-Perot cavity quantum cascade laser for an innovative mid-IR spectrometer
abstract: We present an innovative approach for a mid-IR spectrometer comprising a commercial Fabry-Perot cavity quantum cascade laser. Utilization of the transient blue-chirped emission of such a laser the spectral fingerprint of methane at 8.15µm was clearly observed in absorption.

articleTitle: Approaching the Solar Planck Limit with Dual-Comb Passive Thermal Light Spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrate dual-comb passive thermal light spectroscopy at 1550 nm that pushes below the estimation noise regime and approaches the power spectral density of the Sun, as described by Planck’s black body law.

articleTitle: Filament-Induced Fluorescence of Algae for Remote Contamination Monitoring
abstract: We demonstrate that ultrafast laser filaments can excite chlorophyll fluorescence in green algae and show that it is a promising technique for remote detection of uranium exposure from the shape of the fluorescence time profile.

articleTitle: Non-Gaussian state design with the quantum frequency processor
abstract: We develop an approach for engineering non-Gaussian photonic states in discrete frequency bins. Combining the quantum frequency processor and photon-number-resolving detection, simulated examples demonstrate the potential for producing high-fidelity cat states with reasonable resource requirements.

articleTitle: Ultrafast-Laser-Inscribed Type-I Waveguides and Beamsplitters inside IG2 for Mid-IR Astrophotonics
abstract: We present a 1 × 4 beamsplitter that is for the first time inscribed inside IG2 material by an ultrafast laser, and a comprehensive study of inscription parameters’ effect on the performance of Type-I IG2 waveguides.

articleTitle: Electron-photon correlations induced at a photonic integrated microresonator
abstract: We couple free electrons to optical cavity modes of a chip-based high-Q sili-con nitride microresonator and observe single-particle correlations. Mode-specific cathodo-luminescence is spatially mapped, and coincidence-gated electron imaging enables a two-orders of magnitude contrast enhancement.

articleTitle: Dual-polarity Photocurrent of MBE-grown p-AlGaN/n-GaN p–n nanowires
abstract: We observed bidirectional photocurrent behavior in p-AlGaN/n-GaN nanowire p-n heterojunction, enabling a fast way to distinguish different spectral bands by simply verifying the polarity of photocurrent and its magnitude.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonics for a Compact Strontium Optical Clock
abstract: We explore photonic-integrated circuits and metasurface optics to generate multiple, large diameter, circularly polarized laser beams for a compact strontium optical clock. We demonstrate an <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">88</sup>Sr magneto-optical trap with integrated photonics in a liter-scale apparatus.

articleTitle: Zero-dispersion soliton in fiber based Fabry-Pérot microresonators with anomalous dispersion
abstract: We have theoretically and experimentally demonstrated the existence of zerodispersion solitons in a high Q fiber F-P microresonator with weak anomalous dispersion. This work reveals the nonlinear dynamics of such zero-dispersion solitons in Kerr microresonators.

articleTitle: Generation of Megawatt Optical Vortex Pulses Directly from a Few-mode Fiber Based Mamyshev Oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a few-mode fiber based Mamyshev oscillator capable of generating optical vortex pulses with an energy of ~235 nJ that can be externally compressed to ~76 fs with a peak power of 2.2 MW.

articleTitle: Dispersion in Reflection and Emission of Dye Molecules Strongly Coupled to Surface Plasmon Polaritons
abstract: We have studied coupling of dye molecules with surface plasmon polaritons in the Kretschmann geometry and found that the coupling strength and the multi-segment dispersion curves in reflection are strongly different from those in emission.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced emission from an ensemble of color centers in silicon
abstract: Optical quantum technologies require strong light-matter interaction. We couple silicon color center ensembles to high-Q/V cavities and show enhanced emission in the telecommunications O-band.

articleTitle: Low-loss broadband nonvolatile 2×2 switch based on Sb2Se3 for programmable silicon photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband low-loss nonvolatile 2×2 silicon directional coupler switch based on phase-change material Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The switch has a low insertion loss of ~0.5 dB, a compact footprint of ~41 µm, and less than -10 dB crosstalk across ~33 nm bandwidth around 1550nm.

articleTitle: Highly efficient hybrid integrated microcomb source
abstract: For the first time we demonstrate up to 40% pump-to-comb sidebands conversion efficiency for bright dissipative Kerr solitons in photonic chip-based microresonators and report detailed consideration of its dependence on microresonator parameters.

articleTitle: Determining Transfer Function of Reconstructive Spectrometer using Two Laser Sources
abstract: We demonstrate a technique to experimentally determine the transfer function of a photonic crystal cavity based reconstructive spectrometer using only two lasers. The reconstructed spectrum matches well with the measurements of a commercial spectrometer.

articleTitle: In situ DNA hybridization detection using dual-channel optical fiber sensor with temperature compensation
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, the dual parameter measurement of temperature and DNA sequence by simultaneously using SPR and MZI in a simple single mode fiber-no-core fiber-SMF structure.

articleTitle: Validation of Si3N4 Integrated Photonics Platform for Low-Loss Operation at Wavelengths up to 2.7 µm
abstract: The performance of waveguide components realized using 800-nm thick Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic integrated platform is assessed for operation at 2.6–2.7 µm. Propagation losses as low as 0.67 dB/cm and bend losses of 0.017 dB for 50 µm radius of curvature were measured at 2.68 µm. Moreover, a shape-optimized 1x2 Y-branch with a low loss of 0.1 dB is demonstrated. Finally, a tunable ring resonator with a free-spectral range of 5.16 nm and a tuning factor of 13.25 nm/W is reported. These low-loss building blocks open an attractive perspective for the fabrication of high-performance hybrid-integrated laser required in sensing applications.

articleTitle: Approaching Helstrom Bound Using Single-shot Quantum Measurement Confidences
abstract: We demonstrate the first quantum measurement providing single-shot self-confidence for each received symbol. Further, we use measured confidence data to implement error correction codes reducing error rates by more than five orders of magnitude for reliable communication.

articleTitle: Deterministic double DKS generation in an 88 GHz single-mode Si3N4 microring with controlled spacing
abstract: Here we report double soliton spectrum generation in an 88 GHz tapered Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microring deterministically with dual-pump. The mode-locking nature is verified by both amplitude noise and FROG measurement. The deterministic azimuthal angle of the double solitons is directly related to the spacing between pump mode and avoided mode crossing.

articleTitle: Optically Induced Static Magnetic Field for Nitrogen-vacancy Centers in Diamond
abstract: We demonstrate a room-temperature optically induced magnetic field for nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond. The effective magnetic field is determined by the photonic spin density of a red-detuned optical excitation. This opens a new frontier for studying exotic phases of photons as well as future on-chip applications.

articleTitle: Wavelength-stabilized mode-locked thulium-doped fiber laser operating between 1958 and 2008 nm
abstract: We report a stable, robust, and compact passively mode-locked thulium-doped fiber laser that can be wavelength-stabilized between 1958 and 2008 nm using the appropriate chirped fiber Bragg grating as a wavelength-selective element.

articleTitle: Temporal Multiplexing Enhancement with a Silicon Waveguide Single Photon Source
abstract: Today, photonic quantum technology is held back by photon source efficiency. Here, we multiplex 11 temporally distinct silicon waveguide photon sources, enhancing the single-photon probability by a factor of 4.5 ± 0.5.

articleTitle: 3D Virtual Refocusing of Point Spread Function (PSF) Engineered Images Using Cascaded Neural Networks
abstract: We present a virtual refocusing method over an extended depth-of-field (DOF) using point-spread function (PSF) engineering and cascaded deep neural networks.

articleTitle: Terahertz Shockwave Spectroscopy: Probing Free Electrons in a Narrow-Band Semiconductor
abstract: Separating the contribution of free and bound charge carriers is a fundamental challenge in pump-probe spectroscopy. We present a novel optical-pump broadband-terahertz-probe technique that addresses free electrons specifically by capturing the full electron plasma feature.

articleTitle: Multichannel phase sensitive amplification in periodically poled thin-film lithium niobate waveguides
abstract: In this work, we experimentally demonstrate multichannel phase sensitive amplification in periodically poled thin-film lithium niobate waveguides, achieving 4.6 to 9.6 net gain and 7.8 to 11.8 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Enhancing stimulated Raman excitation and two-photon absorption by entangled light
abstract: We find that stimulated Raman excitation of an atom by a two-photon pulse can be enhanced by orders of magnitude if the photons are simultaneously frequency correlated and spatially anti-correlated. That is correlated photon pair must have an inherent time delay between its constituent photons.

articleTitle: Opportunities and challenges for deep physical neural networks based on nonlinear optical pulse propagation
abstract: We have shown that nonlinear pulse propagation can be designed to directly, all-optically implement machine learning calculations. Building from proof-of-concept experiments, we analyze opportunities for ultrafast, ultra-efficient nonlinear optical neuromorphic systems and smart sensors.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Absorption Spectroscopy of CeO in a Laser-Produced Plasma
abstract: We demonstrate the use of dual-comb spectroscopy to perform time-resolved absorption measurements on cerium monoxide molecules formed in a laser-produced plasma.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength Dual-Comb Spectroscopy of Laser-Produced Plasmas in the Near-IR
abstract: Using the supercontinuum and second harmonic from a dual-comb spectrometer, simultaneous time-resolved absorption measurements of rubidium atomic transitions originating from ground and highly-excited states in the NIR (1529 nm) are obtained following a laser-produced plasma.

articleTitle: Seeing the Light Wave: On-Chip Sampling of Electric Fields with Attosecond Resolution
abstract: Light-matter interactions important to both sensing and energy conversion can unfold on attosecond to femtosecond timescales. We demonstrate that nanoantennabased optoelectronic detectors provide the sensitivity and resolution needed to reveal these dynamics.

articleTitle: A free-space mm-wave photonic limiter
abstract: Sensitive electronics must be protected from high-power microwave radiation. Here we demonstrate the first working prototype of a free-space reflective mm-wave limiter involving a nanolayer of phase-change material (vanadium dioxide) incorporated in a resonant cavity.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Amplification in Relativistic Laser-Driven Implosion of a Gas-Density Structured Target
abstract: We demonstrate significant magnetic field amplification by injecting a relativistic beam along the axis of a preformed gas channel. The induced plasma implosion is found to be the main amplification mechanism.

articleTitle: Strong phase-locking in quantum seeded of Raman comb
abstract: We demonstrate strong and stable phase-locking between the pump and the quantum generated Stokes/anti-Stokes spectral-pair in a comb generated in the regime of a single spatio-temporal coherent mode transient stimulated Raman scattering in H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-filled HCPCF.

articleTitle: A self-salt-cleaning architecture in cold vapor generation system for hypersaline brines
abstract: We reveal a three-dimensional "umbrella" architecture to evaporate hypersaline brines using solar-thermal effects. A stable evaporation rate of >2.6 kg m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> was achieved over a 4-day operation with minimized salt accumulation on evaporation surfaces.

articleTitle: Octave-Spanning Supercontinuum Generation in a Nonlinear Ultra-Silicon-Rich Nitride Waveguide
abstract: A 1.2-octave-spanning supercontinuum generation is demonstrated in a 3-mm-long ultra-silicon-rich-nitride waveguide using 17pJ, 500fs pulses. The generated supercontinuum possesses a spectral coherence (|g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>|) exceeding 0.94 on average across the measured wavelength range.

articleTitle: Integrated Kerr Comb Link with Multi-Channel DWDM Silicon Photonic Receiver
abstract: We demonstrate an error free silicon photonic receiver of a frequency-comb at 16Gb/s/λ that is the first to de-multiplex channels on-chip. These results pave the way to massively parallel links with chip-scale combs and transceivers.

articleTitle: Frequency interleaving dual comb photonic ADC with 7 bits ENOB up to 40 GHz
abstract: We demonstrate a record high performance of frequency-interleaved analogto-digital conversion using a phase-noise-engineered dual frequency comb photonic technique, enabling 7 effective number of bits (ENOB) for signals up to 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Analyzing Thermal Tolerance of Mirror-based Optical Redistribution for Co-packaged Optics
abstract: The thermal tolerance of mirror-based optical redistribution is analyzed for copackaged optics. In physical optics propagation analysis, considering thermal deformation, a coupling efficiency of over 0.9 is obtained in the range 0–100 °C.

articleTitle: Four-Channel Parallel Broadband Quantum Entropy Source for True Random Number Generation at 100 Gbps
abstract: We demonstrate a spatially-multiplexed quantum entropy source with a low-loss 1×8 Silica PLC splitter. Four-channel quantum randomness with 4-GHz/ch bandwidth, based on vacuum fluctuations, is generated, and random bits at 100 Gbps are extracted offline.

articleTitle: Hollow-core to standard fiber interconnection with customized air-gap distance
abstract: By modifying the design of the interconnection between standard and hollow-core fibers, we achieved low insertion loss while creating a gap in between. This will allow for insertion of thin optical elements such as filters.

articleTitle: Geometric Parameter Extraction-based Receiver IQ imbalance correction for MQAM systems
abstract: We present a modulation transparent geometric parameter extraction method to compensate for the receiver IQ imbalance. We evaluate the algorithm’s performance for various imbalance values for 32-GBd 16/64QAM signals in both simulations and through experiments.

articleTitle: Towards Compact Hollow-Core Fiber Gas Cells
abstract: We demonstrate a 3-way interconnection device (hollow-core fiber, standard single-mode fiber and gas inlet) that is compact, low-loss, and easy-to-use. We demonstrate its performance on fibre purging, observing water vapor via infrared spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Synchronizing a quantum local area network with White Rabbit
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable quantum local area network architecture using White Rabbit timing components. Synchronizing three distant nodes with ultralow timing jitter, we obtain significantly improved entanglement distribution fidelity over previous results with GPS clocks.

articleTitle: Power-Over-Fiber Assisted Low-Cost and Remote RRH Based on Delta-Sigma Modulation
abstract: We proposed a remote power-over-fiber system by introducing delta-sigma modulation to simultaneously simplify deployment of remote radio heads and reduce cost. It extends the remote distance to 4-km and realizes 37.2% optical power transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Electro-Optically Derived Arbitrary Millimeter-Wave Sources with 100 GHz of Bandwidth
abstract: We demonstrate fine phase and amplitude control of millimeter-waves, measured on-wafer using an electro-optic frequency comb, programmable spectral filter, and uni-traveling carrier photodiode. We then synthesize arbitrary waveforms with 100 GHz of bandwidth and +12.7 dBm amplitude.

articleTitle: Radar-Assisted MMW-over-Fiber System for B5G Mobile Communications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a radar-assisted MMW-over-fiber system for B5G mobile communications based on polarization interleaving. Centimeter-level ranging accuracy at K-band and 23-Gbit/s wireless rate at 28GHz band were simultaneously achieved without using polarization tracking methods.

articleTitle: Single-mode 1060nm Bottom Emitting Metal Aperture VCSEL Array for Co-packaged Optics
abstract: We present a bottom emitting 1060nm intracavity metal-aperture VCSELs array for co-packed optics. The metal-aperture provides the modulation bandwidth-enhancement and single-mode operation. We demonstrated 60Gbps PAM4 and 46Gbps NRZ for 16-ch bottom emitting array.

articleTitle: O-Band Microring Resonator Based Switch-and-Select Silicon Photonic Switch Fabric
abstract: This paper for the first time reports an O-band micro-ring resonator-based switch-and-select silicon photonic switch fabric with bent couplers. An average crosstalk ratio of below -40dB is achieved with a 3dB passband of 43.6GHz.

articleTitle: First theoretical study of SRS-induced mode distortion in high power fiber laser systems
abstract: Based on generalized nonlinear Schrodinger equation and mode decomposition method, SRS-induced mode distortion in large-mode area passive fibers has been theoretically studied for the first time, which agree well with the experimental observations. © 2022 The Authors)

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Neuromorphic Computing with 16 GHz Input Data and Weight Update Line Rates
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a silicon photonic neuron that supports on-chip input-data and weight update rates at 16GHz. Its computational performance is evaluated via the classification of the MNIST dataset achieving a mean accuracy of 99.18%.

articleTitle: Towards an all-Fiberized GHz Self-Referenced Electro-Optic-Modulated Comb
abstract: We present a new cost-effective, fiberized architecture for generating low noise, sub-100 fs, 12 kW peak power pulses using GHz spaced, filtered electro-optic modulated combs (>70dB OSNR), and nonlinear-pulse-shaping.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Hollow Core Fibre in High-Capacity National Backbone Networks
abstract: We analytically compare HCF with SSMF in point-to-point core networks of BT-UK and TIM-Italy using GN model. HCF reduces line-amplifiers and high power consuming 400ZR+ links, allowing 400ZR, C+L WDM transmission at 23dBm input power.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Quantum Deliberate Signal Randomization for Y-00 Quantum Noise Stream Cipher
abstract: Deliberate signal randomization (DSR) driven by quantum random numbers is proposed for enhancing security. PSK Y-00 cipher with the quantum DSR is demonstrated at 5 Gbit/s, indicating secure transmission is achievable at high optical powers.

articleTitle: Miniaturized and Thin 3D Microscope with Fast Reconstruction
abstract: We demonstrate a miniaturized and thin 3D microscope using a single layer of microlens array and a fast reconstruction algorithm. The microscope can resolve high resolution features at different depths from a single exposure.

articleTitle: Optical Computing STFT Based on Image Depth Learning
abstract: The duration and bandwidth of the broadband signal can be detected by optical computing STFT based on deep learning image recognition algorithm. The experiment results show that mAP reaches 84.52% in 895 samples.

articleTitle: Nanobeam photonic crystal cavities engineered for minimized quantum dot spectral broadening
abstract: Nanobeam photonic crystal cavities are engineered to provide large Purcell radiative rate enhancements for single quantum dot single-photon emitters while minimizing spectral broadening induced by etched sidewalls.

articleTitle: CLONETS-DS – Clock Network Services-Design Study Strategy and Innovation for Clock Services over Optical Fibre
abstract: Long-distance time and frequency transfer methods based on optical fibre links attractive both for very high-performance applications and also for many industrial and societal applications, and they complement and offer an alternative to radio- and satellite-based methods.

articleTitle: Frequency Doubler Based Optical Generation and Transport of 5G mmWave Signals for Fronthauling
abstract: An analog optical doubler system is realized for the transport of 5G mmWave (26.4 GHz) over 2 km fiber. Optimization of operating conditions for error-free performance of 100 MHz signals upto 256QAM is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Underwater Communication System Using Light Carrying Orbital Angular Momentum
abstract: An underwater communication system using light carrying orbital angular momentum is evaluated using a convolutional neural network through simulated and experimental thermally-generated underwater optical turbulence. 100% classification is demonstrated in no or weak turbulence.

articleTitle: EVM Estimation for Performance Monitoring in Coherent Optical Systems: An Approach of Linear Regression
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of a simple linear regression scheme for optical performance monitoring when applied after modulation format identification. It outperforms the FFNN-based benchmark scheme providing 0.2% mean absolute error for EVM estimation.

articleTitle: Microfabricated Low-Profile Tunable LC-Refractive Fresnel (LCRF) Lens for Smart Contacts
abstract: Using high-performance LC (E7) filled microfabricated refractive Fresnel chambers, we experimentally demonstrate a thin low-profile adaptive optical system with high analog tunability (2.1 D) that can be integrated with an adaptive contact-lens system.

articleTitle: High-modulation-efficiency graphene-silicon slot-waveguide micro-ring modulator
abstract: We demonstrate a high-performance graphene-silicon slot-waveguide electro-optic micro-ring modulator featuring a record modulation efficiency of 10.99 V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> with a 33-dB extinction ratio, 8-µm-long graphene and a modulation bandwidth of >40 GHz.

articleTitle: Power intensity noise in cavity optomechanical accelerometers through RF sensing
abstract: We develop a theoretical representation of sensitivity noise generated by laser and power intensity instabilities on optomechanical accelerometers that use RF mechanical resonance shift. The theoretical model is further matched to on-chip measured data.

articleTitle: Denoising Temporal Sampling of Broadband Signals through an All-optical XPM-based Passive Talbot Amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate an XPM-based passive Talbot amplifier for noise mitigation of broadband signals that improves by more than one order of magnitude the operation bandwidth × amplification factor product (>360 GHz) of previous electro-optic implementations.

articleTitle: High-power coherent line emitter at 5.7 THz for high-resolution imaging
abstract: We report generation of 82-kW and 117-kW peak powers at 5.7 THz external and internal to a Si prism coupler atop a KTP parametric line generator, and the use of it for high-resolution THz imaging.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Visible and Near-infrared Beam Steering of Silicon Nitride Optical Phased Arrays
abstract: Two-dimensional beam steering on silicon nitride nanophotonic phased arrays from visible to near-infrared wavelengths is reported for the first time. Steering range of 66° in θ direction and 13.1° in ψ direction is achieved.

articleTitle: Architecture for Compact Photonic Downconversion of Broadband RF Signals
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a dual comb photonic system for downconversion and disambiguation of RF signals ranging from 4.3 GHz to 17.3 GHz. Our system has future potential for miniaturization, a key for deployment in real-world applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Learned Volterra-based Scheme for Time-domain Nonlinear Equalization
abstract: We introduce a learned time-domain Volterra-based equalizer to address nonlinear transmission impairments in fibre systems. When compared to conventional unoptimized equalization schemes it can offer more than 2.2 dB performance gain at reduced computational complexity.

articleTitle: Temperature Characteristics of Intermixed Ridge Type Quantum Dot Lasers
abstract: In this study, ridge type quantum dot (QD) laser diodes were fabricated with ion implantation induced disordering QD Intermixing technique using B and Ar ions. QD-LDs demonstrated low threshold current and very good temperature characteristics.

articleTitle: Autoencoder-Optimized Geometric Constellation Shaping for Unamplified Coherent Optical Links
abstract: Using end-to-end deep learning, we experimentally demonstrate the optimized design of geometric constellation shaping for coherent unamplified links. A power budget gain of more than 2 dB is demonstrated for 8-ary constellations.

articleTitle: Theory of parametric amplification in coupled lossy waveguides
abstract: We study theoretically an optical parametric amplifier made of two coupled waveguides, accounting for losses and spatially dependent coupling, and show that it can have improved performances compared to the standard single waveguide version.

articleTitle: Observation of Light Self-Organization and Mode Attraction in a Multimode Optical Fiber
abstract: We present the first-ever quantitative analysis of mode attraction in a multimode fiber with a counter-propagative setup, as well as an overview of novel self-organization processes.

articleTitle: Demonstration of High-Power DFB Lasers with High Single Mode Yield and Low RIN
abstract: We demonstrate a novel three-section DFB lasers with high output power and good single-mode yield. The fabricated laser exhibited a stable single-mode operation with the output power ~90mW, SMSR over 55dB, and RIN ~-155 dB/Hz.

articleTitle: Near Unit Efficiency in Microresonator Combs
abstract: We optimize the pump-laser conversion efficiency in soliton frequency combs by controlling the nonlinear shift, external coupling, and bidirectional pump field with photonic-crystal resonators. We achieve and explain >86% pump-to-comb conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Optical Adaptive LMS Equalizer with an Opto-electronic Feedback Loop
abstract: We propose an optical adaptive Least-Mean-Squares equalizer with an optoelectronic feedback loop to determine the updating of an optical Finite-Impulse-Response filter’s weights, enabling dispersion compensation introduced by 30-km fiber based on a photonic integrated circuit.

articleTitle: High-Speed Photodiodes on Silicon Nitride with a Bandwidth beyond 100 GHz
abstract: Next-generation telecommunication systems will rely on photonic integrated circuits. However, Silicon Nitride (SiN) photonic platforms do not natively provide high-speed photodiodes. We integrated a waveguide-coupled UTC photodiode on a SiN platform using the scalable micro-transfer-printing technology. These diodes show a responsivity up to 0.45 A/W, a dark current below 10 nA and a 3 dB-bandwidth beyond 100 GHz, even at zero-bias. As such, high-performance photodetectors are available on silicon-nitride pho-tonic platforms.

articleTitle: Model-Based Deep Learning of Joint Probabilistic and Geometric Shaping for Optical Communication
abstract: Autoencoder-based deep learning is applied to jointly optimize geometric and probabilistic constellation shaping for optical coherent communication. The optimized constellation shaping outperforms the 256 QAM Maxwell-Boltzmann probabilistic distribution with extra 0.05 bits/4D-symbol mutual information for 64 GBd transmission over 170 km SMF link.

articleTitle: Group Theory Approach for Designing Symmetry Protected Degenerate Bound States in the Continuum in Metasurfaces
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate methods for designing symmetry protected degenerate bound states in the continuum in dielectric metasurfaces. Deforming the metasurface can break symmetry protection, lifting the degeneracy and allowing the high-Q modes to be accessed.

articleTitle: Filter-free Color Image Sensors with a Full-color-sorting Metalens Array
abstract: We present a filter-free color image sensor utilizing a full-color-sorting metalens array. Our demonstration shows the sensor’s ability to create high-quality color images while enhancing pixel-signal levels compared with those of conventional image sensors.

articleTitle: Wafer-Scale-Compatible Substrate Undercut for Ultra-Efficient SOI Thermal Phase Shifters
abstract: We present a thermally isolated phase shifter through undercutting the silicon waveguide and resistive heaters, yielding a low-power (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>= 1.2 mW) and low-crosstalk tunable Mach-Zehnder interferometer.

articleTitle: Free-Form Micro-Optical Reflectors for Broadband and Low-Loss Fiber-to-Chip Coupling
abstract: We demonstrate a novel fiber-to-chip coupling scheme based on surface-normal freeform micro-reflectors 3D-printed onto SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> waveguide facets. Insertion losses of 0.5 dB and 1 dB bandwidth exceeding 300 nm were measured at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Error probability of Mode Vector Modulation optically-preamplified direct-detection receivers
abstract: Mode Vector Modulation (MVM) is a spatial, multidimensional modulation format for short-haul, optical interconnects. We evaluate the back-to-back performance of optically-preamplified MVM direct-detection receivers and prove that MVM is superior to conventional binary modulations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optical Fiber Couplers Made of Chalcogenide Glass
abstract: We demonstrate chalcogenide optical fiber couplers designed with a transmis-sion spectrum response that depends on the input power. The measured switching power is as low as 126 W at a wavelength of 1938 nm.

articleTitle: On-Chip Quantum Autoencoder for Teleportation of High-Dimensional Quantum States
abstract: Currently most quantum teleportation experiments are based on qubits. Here, we demonstrate a quantum autoencoder assisted teleportation for high-dimensional quantum states.
