Our method of training the autoencoder allows us to take a finite sample of those states, learn how to compress them to qubits with nearly unit fidelity. High fidelity is achieved between the input qutrit and the qutrit recovered from the teleported qubit.

articleTitle: Multi-mode guidance in enhanced inhibited coupling hollow-core anti-resonant fibers
abstract: We present a new type of hollow-core anti-resonant fiber design based on an enhanced inhibited coupling that supports highly multi-mode low loss propagation. The designed fiber supports >25 spatial modes with propagation loss <10 dB/km.

articleTitle: All-Photonic Artificial Neural Network Processor Via Nonlinear Optics
abstract: We propose an all-photonic architecture to accelerate linear matrix processing by encoding information in the amplitudes of frequency states. Our design is unique in providing a unitary, reversible mode of computation at high speeds.

articleTitle: GaP-OI Resonator Design for Octave-spanning Kerr Soliton Frequency Comb Generation
abstract: We propose a thin SiO2-passivated GaP-OI resonator design for octave-spanning Kerr soliton frequency comb generation with a tooth spacing of 100 GHz and 24 mW threshold power. These results underpin the potentials of experimental soliton demonstration.

articleTitle: Ultra-Narrow-Linewidth Lasers for Quantum Applications
abstract: We present an ultra-narrow-linewidth laser designed based on optical self-injection locking to a miniaturized whispering gallery mode resonator. The measured instantaneous linewidth of the laser is at sub-Hertz-level, making it suitable for precise energy-level excitation in quantum technology applications.

articleTitle: Error-Tolerant Integrated Optical Neural Network Processor based on Multi-Plane Light Conversion
abstract: We demonstrate integrated optical neural network processor with excellent error tolerance using multiport directional couplers. Thanks to the robust multi-plane light-conversion mechanism, high data-classifying accuracy over 95% is confirmed, insensitive to the exact coupling ratio.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of S+C+L-Band Optical Transmission over G.652.D and G.654.E Fibers
abstract: We evaluate the performance of 150-nm SCL-band optical transmission over 1280-km G.652.D and G.654.E fibers. By optimizing power allocation and system configuration, SCL-band long-haul transmission enables the same performance as commercial C-band system.

articleTitle: High-Yield Heterogeneous Integration of Silicon and Lithium Niobate Thin Films
abstract: Microtransfer printing of silicon and lithium niobate thin films on generic integrated photonic platforms is demonstrated. An unprecedented integration yield is achieved using crack barriers as a way to mitigate stress-induced shears in the material.

articleTitle: Low Distortion Brillouin Amplification Enhanced with a Power Limiting SOA for Coherent Communications
abstract: Enhanced Brillouin amplification with intensity noise suppressed by a gain saturated semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) is demonstrated. Application to noisy input spectral-lines for 64-QAM coherent communications improves tolerance to detuned polarization and frequency from maximum gain.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Robot Indoor Navigation Using Visible Light Positioning and LiDAR Fusion
abstract: We demonstrated a high accuracy robot indoor localization system using Visible Light Positioning (VLP) and Light Detection And Ranging (LiDAR) fusion, which can provide an average positioning accuracy of 2.5cm.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation into Optimum Laser Coupling Efficiency into Hollow-Core NANFs
abstract: Over 94 % coupling efficiency is presented experimentally for a Gaussian-beam into an antiresonant hollow-core fiber optimized for 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order antiresonance guidance at 1064 nm, which demonstrates approximately 1.5 % (0.06 dB) improvement over the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> window counterpart.

articleTitle: Engineering of Modal Coupling of Counter-Propagating Waves for Multi-Color Dissipative Kerr Soliton Operation
abstract: We present spectral engineering of microring resonators guided by Fourier design of the coupling between counter-propagating modes. We experimentally realize dispersion profiles matching prescribed designs, and we theoretically analyze their application to multi-color soliton microcombs.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Loss and Damage Threshold in Silicon Photonic Waveguides: Modelling and Experimental Verification
abstract: Nonlinear losses of integrated waveguides are crucial for many applications. We develop and experimentally verify a quantitative model for two-photon absorption (TPA), subsequent free-carrier absorption (FCA), and damage thresholds of silicon photonic waveguides under pulsed and continuous-wave (CW) operation.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Noise Semiconductor Lasers
abstract: This invited paper reviews work towards creating ultra-low noise semiconductor laser sources with performance exceeding solid-state and fiber lasers, together with progress in the development of CMOS foundry Silicon Photonics versions of these devices.

articleTitle: An All-Optical Reservoir Computer based on Time Stretch and Spectral Mixing
abstract: A novel all-optical Reservoir Computing (RC) based on time-stretch and spectral mixing is demonstrated. Virtual nodes in the reservoir layer are achieved in time and wavelength domains. Simulation results verify its utility in waveform classification.

articleTitle: Funneling of Lattice Vibrations Through Topological Phathways in Mid-Infrared Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate novel hybrid states of strongly-coupled photon and lattice vibrations in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) integrated with mid-infrared metasurface and show their unconventional helical nature and resilient transport around sharp corners.

articleTitle: Observation of optical gyromagnetic properties in magneto-optical metamaterials
abstract: We report the observation of gyromagnetic and bi-gyrotropic properties in magneto-optical nanostructures. Anomalous s-polarized transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect is observed in magneto-optical Mie resonators and split ring resonators, featuring giant gyrotropic permeability tensors at the near infrared.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable and High Power Multi-THz Transients from a sub-ps Yb:YAG Thin-Disk System and Parametric Amplification
abstract: Phase-locked mid-infrared pulses tunable between 18 and 50 THz are generated with peak electric fields of 150 MV/cm. The compact and low-noise system aims at subcycle studies of matter under nonlinear driving or adiabatic bias.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Mid-IR Lasers for Soft X-ray High-Harmonic Generation and Applications
abstract: Coherent soft x-rays can be generated on a tabletop by using mid-IR lasers to drive high harmonic generation. The high coherence of this source enables diffraction-limited x-ray functional microscopy of nano and bio systems.

articleTitle: Picophotonics: Sub-Brownian Detection of Nanowire Position with Atomic-scale Resolution using Topologically Structured Light
abstract: The first realization of sub-Brownian motion metrology is reported. The position of a nanowire is measured with resolution better than 100 picometers via deep learning analysis of topologically structured light scattering on the nanowire.

articleTitle: All-Optical 25-Gbps Silicon Carbide Kerr Switching Intensity Modulator On Silicon Platform
abstract: All-optical intensity modulator at 25 Gbps in silicon carbide-based Kerr switching with a nonlinear refractive index of 2.88×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/W is demonstrated with an SNR of 5.6 dB and an ER of 11.8 dB.

articleTitle: Metasurface based Orbital Angular Momentum Multiplexing and Demultiplexing at E-band frequency
abstract: We demonstrate orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) multiplexing and demultiplexing at E-band frequency using a metasurface. With off-axis integration, two Gaussian beams are converted to two orthogonal OAM beams, which are in turn demultiplexed into two off-axis directions.

articleTitle: All-optical switching of infrared light on a lithium niobate/semiconductor interface
abstract: We use photo-excited charges on a lithium niobate/semiconductor interface to perform reversible all-optical control of infrared light. Upon, below bandgap illumination it is recorded transmission contrast of 80% due to the build-up of a space-charge.

articleTitle: Physical modeling of the permittivity of in vivo burn injuries using Debye dielectric parameters measured by the THz PHASR scanner
abstract: We report on measuring the permittivity of in vivo burn injuries in a swine model using our new PHASR scanner and show that the extracted Debye parameters can differentiate between grades of burn injuries accurately (p < 0.05).

articleTitle: Dynamical structures and collective dynamics of soliton crystals in Kerr microresonator
abstract: We experimentally observed spatiotemporal dynamics of soliton crystals in a Kerr microresonator. We numerically reproduce our observations and further confirm them using an ultrafast temporal imaging system.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Switching in Integrated Photonics using Antimony
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate the use of Antimony as a reversible memory element in integrated photonics. We show antimony can be used as a multilevel memory with an ultrafast speed of operations.

articleTitle: Temporal mode shaping of single photons from a solid-state quantum emitter
abstract: Through multi-exciton cascade recombination in a quantum dot and engineered Purcell effect in a photonic crystal cavity, we demonstrate the single-photon emission with Gaussianlike spatial and temporal modes and temporally purify single photons from background emission.

articleTitle: 445 nm Laser-Induced Fluorescence monitoring of 5-Hydroxymethylfurfural in Honey
abstract: Rapid monitoring of 5-Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) in honey remains a challenge. This work has demonstrated using 445 nm Laser-Induced Fluorescence spectroscopy technique to monitor honey’s HMF, detecting up to ~40 mg/kg HMF with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Development Update of an Ultra broadband, all OPCPA Petawatt beamline to the Vulcan laser facility
abstract: Installation of a new short pulse petawatt laser, pumped by noncollinear optical parametric chirped pulse amplification is underway at the Central Laser Facility. The new beamline will allow betatron probing for the exiting petawatt facility.

articleTitle: A Self-Supervised Deep Model for Focal Stacking
abstract: We propose to train a self-supervised autoencoder to extract image features and fuse focal stack images. Numerical experiments show the proposed method achieves better fusion performance, compared to traditional fusion method using Laplacian operator.

articleTitle: Dispersion management in integrated lithium niobate photonics enabling on-chip femtosecond pulse generation
abstract: We demonstrate efficient dispersion management in integrated lithium niobate on insulator. Using a chirped Bragg grating in an integrated electro-optic time lens, we generate femtosecond 545 fs pulses entirely on-chip.

articleTitle: 1840-nm femtosecond thulium fiber laser system for label-free third-harmonic generation microscopy
abstract: We report an all-fiberized 1840-nm mode-locked thulium fiber laser seeded chirped-pulse amplification system delivering 416 fs pulses with maximum energy of 105 nJ. Label-free biological imaging is demonstrated by using the laser through third-harmonic generation microscopy.

articleTitle: Single-shot Characterization of Ultrafast Pulses with Spatiotemporal Orbital Angular Momentum
abstract: We developed a simple single-shot method to characterize ultrafast light pulses carrying spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum (ST-OAM) near its Fourier-transform limit. The method is used to measure ST-OAM pulses with different topological charges, chirps, and divergence.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous III-V/Si Non-Volatile Optical Memory: A Mach-Zehnder Memristor
abstract: We demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated optical III-V/Si MZI memristor for the purposes of non-volatile optical memory. The results indicate the possibility of implementing large scale photonics and optical neural networks with inherent memory functions.

articleTitle: Electron-beam Spectroscopies as Probes of Quantum Effects in Nanoplasmonics
abstract: We demonstrate how the unique ability of free-electron beams to produce deeply subwavelength near-fields can be harnessed for inferring the quantum nonlocal response of metals from electron energy-loss and cathodoluminescence spectra.

articleTitle: Novel Data-Processing Method for High-Resolution Spectrally Steered LiDAR using Dispersion-Tuned Swept Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a novel signal-processing method for spectrally-steered LiDAR using DTSL for 3D imaging at >10 kHz. The proposed method gives ranging-resolution of <100 μm, which is 3-4 times better than conventional AMCW methods.

articleTitle: Interband Cascade Lasers with Optimized Waveguide Design for High Power Operation
abstract: Fabry-Pérot interband cascade laser with varied thickness of the separate confinement layers and reduced cladding layer thickness are presented. An epi-side-down mounted device showed a cw-output power of 505mW emitting at λ≈3.3 µm at 10°C.

articleTitle: MoSe2/WS2 heterojunction photodiode integrated with a silicon nitride chip scale photonic devices for visible light photodetection with high responsivity
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the realization of a chip scale 2D MoSe2/WS2 heterostructure photodetector operating at visible frequencies and its application for characterizing silicon nitride resonators that are integrated on the same chip.

articleTitle: Unbiased Quantum Random-Number Generation by Use of Photon-Number-Resolving Detection up to 30 Photons
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an unbiased all-optical random number generator using coherent light and photon-number-resolved detection of up to 30 photons. Our method requires no de-biasing algorithms and is robust to environmental noise and laser fluctuations.

articleTitle: FMCW Source based on a Hybrid Integrated III-V/ Si-Si3N4 Dual-Layer External Cavity Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid integrated frequency-modulated continuous-wave laser on a Si-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> dual-layer platform with 21.9 mW output power, >56.5 dB side mode suppression ratio, >100 nm tuning range, and 895 Hz intrinsic linewidth.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion control in a Ge-Ga-Si-Te microstructured optical fiber
abstract: Based on the thermal and optical properties of Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">77.5</inf> glass, we demonstrate the chromatic dispersion control using a microstructured optical fiber with 6 air holes to shift the zero-dispersion wavelength to the near infrared regions.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared photothermal quantitative phase imaging (MIP-QPI)
abstract: Mid-infrared photothermal microscopy is an emerging technology in the field of label-free vibrational imaging. Instead of using a point-scanning imaging modality, we develop wide-field mid-infrared photothermal imaging techniques with various phase microscopes.

articleTitle: Theory of topological lasers and of their coherence
abstract: We present our recent advances in the building of a theory of topological laser operation. The coherence properties of the emission are characterized using statistical mechanics concepts, the fundamental limitations identified, and robustness against fabrication disorder highlighted.

articleTitle: The Effects of Radiation on Superconducting Nanowire Electronics
abstract: The sensitivity of superconducting nanowire electronics in high radiation environments is not well known. We present numerical simulations of the radiation effects and errors caused by exposure to these conditions.

articleTitle: Fabrication of an Inch-scale High-Q Fiber Ring Resonator
abstract: We demonstrate an inch-scale fiber ring resonator with its core partially exposed by droplet-based wet etching for efficient coupling. A quality factor of (3.14±0.3)×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> with a free spectral range of ~2.2 GHz was measured.

articleTitle: Polarization-Insensitive One-Dimensional Grating Coupler Demonstrated in a CMOS-Photonics Foundry Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a one-dimensional dual polarization fiber-to-chip grating coupler implemented in a CMOS-photonics foundry platform, with a measured 1 dB polarization-dependent loss bandwidth of 70 nm in the O-band.

articleTitle: Quasi-Light Storage Enabled Cognitive RF Sensing
abstract: We report a cognitive RF sensing system enabled by quasi-light storage. A multi-channel signal identification has been experimentally demonstrated based on time-frequency coherence. The method is reconfigurable, wideband and supports real-time signal processing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Generalised Multi-path Wave-particle Duality on a Quantum Photonic Chip
abstract: We report the multi-path delayed-choice experiment on a large-scale integrated silicon photonic chip. Wave- and particle-nature in generalised form are characterised experimentally and the generalisation of Bohr’s multi-path duality relation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Topologically Protected Entangled Photon Pairs in Honeycomb Photonic Crystals
abstract: We propose a topological insulator supporting topologically protected entangled photon pairs. The continuous frequency entanglement between photon pairs generated from the four-wave mixing process is theoretically clarified.

articleTitle: A Novel 16-Channel WDM Silicon Photonics Transceiver with Interleavers for Simplified Ring Modulator/Filter Implementation
abstract: We present a compact ring resonator based silicon photonics transceiver with 16-channel wavelength-division-multiplexing. 56 Gbps data transmission was achieved for a single ring modulator in depletion mode operation, which can support tera-bits-per-second capability for the transceiver.

articleTitle: Global Net-gain Characterization of Monolithically Integrated Waveguide Amplifiers
abstract: Global net-gain characterization is presented for the monolithically integrated Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>:Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> amplifiers by comparing the amplified signal to the output of the passive reference waveguides, showing good agreement with the conventional signal enhancement method.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect in Laser Arrays
abstract: We report on the first realization of the Hatano-Nelson model in photonics by using an array of active unidirectional resonators that exhibit asymmetric nearest neighbor couplings. Non-Hermitian skin effect and laser phase locking is observed.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Nanophotonics Structures with Minimal Computation Using a Pruning Approach
abstract: We present a new approach based on pruning neural networks for solving inverse design in nanophotonics and show how this approach can be used to solve inverse problem with minimal complexity without imposing significant error.

articleTitle: Implementation of Bessel-like LP02 Mode from Higher Order Mode (HOM) Fiber to extend the Depth of Focus in Fourier Domain Optical Coherence Microscopy (FD-OCM)
abstract: A fiber-based robust, design-flexible FD-OCM technique using a Bessel-like LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf> mode is demonstrated. Extended DOF compared to Gaussian illumination of equal spot-size at focus is reported. We characterize the resolution performance of this system.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation in etchless lithium niobate nanophotonic waveguides with bound states in the continuum
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated second-harmonic generation from telecom to near-visible wavelengths on an etchless lithium niobate platform by using a photonic bound state in the continuum for the second-harmonic mode.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated High-Order Vernier Filters and Tuning Circuits for Electronic-Photonic Quantum System-on-Chip
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order filter, w ith h eater driver circuits implemented alongside photonics in a zero-change 45 nm CMOS platform, achieving <1 dB drop loss and >80 dB on-chip pump power suppression.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Face-to-Face Dual-VCSELs Under Passive Mode-Locking
abstract: Two Vertical-Cavity Surface-Emitting Lasers (VCSELs) mutually facing, investigated using time-delay-differential equation model, reveals various dynamics including fundamental mode-locking (FML), multi-pulsing, harmonic mode-locking and non-pulsed fast chaotic dynamics as well as the optimal conditions for FML.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Effect of Ag-Nanoparticles on Self-powered Photodetection Performance of NiO/Si Heterostructure Device
abstract: Self-powered photodetectors have received great attention due to its advantages such as saving energy and compact size. Therefore, an attempt has been made to fabricate a self-biased NiO/Si heterojunction for the photodetection. In addition, the efficacy of Ag-nanoparticles on the photodetection under self-bias condition has been explored.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Semiconductor/Solid-State Vertically Integrated Laser Over kW Peak Power
abstract: We demonstrate an over 50 kW peak-power chip-scale vertical integrated laser consisting of an electrically driven VECSEL cavity with InGaAs quantum well for intra-cavity pumping of Yb:YAG, and a passively Q-switched laser cavity with Yb:YAG/Cr:YAG.

articleTitle: Ultra-Fast Scattering Matrix Solver for Disordered Media
abstract: Using the Schur complement scattering analysis (SCSA) method, we accelerate the scattering matrix computation for large-scale disordered media by many orders of magnitude and realize full-wave simulations of classical and quantum coherent backscattering.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 372 nm Micropillar Light Emitting Diodes Using Novel Ni/Au/Ni Dry Etch Mask and Ohmic Contact
abstract: Micropillar InGaN/AlGaN LEDs were fabricated using a novel Ni/Au/Ni etching mask. This Ni/Au/Ni structure effectively combines a good ohmic contact and etching mask into a single structure, allowing for demonstration of 372 nm micropillar LEDs.

articleTitle: InAs/InP Quantum-dash Laser-based 8 Gb/s QPSK/16QAM Bidirectional 25–28 GHz MMWoF-Wireless Transport System in Mid L-band
abstract: First report of 8-Gb/s QPSK downstream and 16QAM upstream data-transmission over 28 and 25 GHz MMW, respectively, at 1610nm with single InAs/InP quantum-dash laser. The heterogeneous system integrates hybrid 10-km-SMF–4m-WL channel with wavelength-reuse strategy.

articleTitle: Focused X-ray Beams from Van der Waals Heterostructures
abstract: We present the concept of customized van der Waals heterostructures with periodicity tailored to generate pre-designed X-ray patterns from free electrons. As an example, we demonstrate focused X-ray beams.

articleTitle: Scalable, Autonomous On-Chip Picosecond Pulse-Shaping Enabled by Smart Optimization
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable, autonomous on-chip pulse shaping system based on temporal coherence synthesis. The inclusion of smart optimization algorithms enables robust, and reconfigurable pulse-shaping over a wide range of input and target durations.

articleTitle: A Chip-Based, 1 Hz Integrated Linewidth Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a chip-scale laser stabilized to an 8 mL micro-fabricated vacuum-gap cavity, exhibiting 1.1 Hz integrated linewidth, frequency noise down to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz at 4 kHz, and Allan deviation below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> to 1 s.

articleTitle: 1.5mJ, 30W OPA at 2um via spectrally selective amplification
abstract: To reach high average power operation combined with good conversion efficiency we utilize spectrally selective amplification with multiple nonlinear crystals to yield 12% conversion efficiency with 30W output at 2um wavelength.

articleTitle: Statistics of multiphoton photoemission under coherent and non-classical illumination
abstract: We investigate experimentally how the photon statistics of light gets imprinted on multiphoton electron emission from needle tips. Coherent and bright squeezed vacuum light lead to entirely different electron statistics, matching with a quantum-optical analysis.

articleTitle: Compact Few-Cycle Source in the Mid-Infrared by Adiabatic Difference Frequency Generation
abstract: We present a compact ultrafast source tunable from 2 µm to 3.5 µm with 60 nJ pulses at 50 kHz repetition rate producing wideband spectra by adiabatic difference frequency generation supporting close to single-cycle pulses.

articleTitle: Fundamental Thickness Bounds for Wide-Field-of-View Metalenses
abstract: We show that any aberration-free wide-field-of-view lens system must have a minimal thickness—depending on the field of view, lens diameter, and numerical aperture—that originates from the Fourier transform relation between space and angle.

articleTitle: Wavelength Tunable Group delay in InGaAs Subwavelength Grating Waveguide for Mid-Infrared Absorption Spectroscopy
abstract: An engineered structure based on InGaAs-InP subwavelength grating waveguide is proposed on QCL/QCD platform for sensing application. The proposed structure attribute slow light effect with fine group index tuning capability of 0.48nm/K using thermo-optic effect.

articleTitle: In-cavity beam cleaning by anti-resonant hollow-core fiber spliced to multimode Yb-doped fiber
abstract: We demonstrated that an anti-resonant hollow-core fiber, exhibiting large higher-order mode extinction ratio, works as an efficient spatial mode filter inside a cavity, improving the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> from 2.09 to 1.39 at 57.7 W laser output.

articleTitle: Setting Experimental Bounds on Entangled Two-Photon Absorption Cross Sections
abstract: We show strong evidence—from both fluorescence and transmittance measurements—that entangled two-photon absorption cross sections are several orders of magnitude lower than many prior reports have claimed.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive and selective gas sensing using polymer-coated microtoroid optical resonators
abstract: We use a system known as FLOWER (frequency locked optical whispering evanescent resonator) in combination with different sorbent polymer coatings to rapidly detect trace amounts of the toxic gases DIMP, ammonia, and formaldehyde.

articleTitle: Swept-Source Optical Coherence Tomography (SS-OCT) Using a Hybrid Silicon Photonic External-Cavity Laser (ECL)
abstract: We demonstrate the first swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT) measurement that relies on an integrated hybrid InP/silicon-photonic external-cavity laser (ECL). We prove the viability of the scheme by recording volumetric images constructed from 90 000 A-scans.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr solitons in a warm atomic vapor system
abstract: Dissipative Kerr solitons generated by four-wave mixing in hot rubidium atoms within a phase conjugate resonator are presented. The solitons are tunable with pump detuning and laser power and exhibit Turing rolls and dark-soliton formation.

articleTitle: Experimental measurement of the orbital-angular-momentum spectrum in high-gain parametric down-conversion
abstract: We measure the orbital angular momentum (OAM) spectrum of the field generated from spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in the high-gain regime. The experimentally measured spectra and the angular Schmidt number are consistent with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Two-Photon Dual-Comb LiDAR
abstract: We demonstrate dual-comb LiDAR with two-photon detection at 1555 nm, achieving sub-100 nm precision in 3 seconds. The non-interferometric pulse-like signals enable a timer-based approach that reduces the data burden of dual-comb ranging by >10,000.

articleTitle: Sculpted Non-paraxial Light Fields: From Customization to Application and Identification
abstract: We present the customization of non-paraxial structured light fields of 3D polarization and their application for optical manipulation of zeolite-L nanocontainers. Unlocking its full potential, we identify invisible non-paraxial properties by a self-assembled monolayer.

articleTitle: Photon-assisted interlayer transport in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures
abstract: Heterostructures of two-dimensional materials are highly interesting for opto-electronic applications as they provide a fast charge transfer between the layers. Here we present photocurrent measurements at photon-energies far below the involved band gaps.

articleTitle: 3D Position Nanometrology of a Coronavirus-like Nanoparticle with Topologically Structured Light
abstract: Scattering of topologically structured light is highly sensitive to the position of a scattering object. We show that the position of a coronavirus-like 100 nm polystyrene sphere can be measured optically with deeply subwavelength accuracy.

articleTitle: Experimental Hamiltonian Reconstruction via Polarimetry of High-order Sidebands in a Semiconductor
abstract: Accurate knowledge of the parameters of effective Hamiltonians of quasipar-ticles is critical for designing the next generation of quantum devices. We present a method to reconstruct quasiparticle Hamiltonians of semiconductors by polarimetry of high-order sidebands.

articleTitle: Simulating Phase Transition in Two-Dimensional Ising Model on Coherent Ising Machine
abstract: We show that two-dimensionally coupled optical parametric oscillator pulses capture the signature of the exact phase transition of the two-dimensional Ising model rather than that of a mean-field one.

articleTitle: Control of Femtosecond Laser Filamentation and Supercontinuum Generation in Liquids Using Neural Networks
abstract: We demonstrate controllable spectral shaping of supercontinuum radiation through intense femtosecond laser filamentation in ethanol. Neural networks are shown to predict robust results even under the presence of high-order nonlinearities and noise.

articleTitle: Slow light engineering in the hollow-core vertical photonic crystal waveguide for gas sensing
abstract: In this paper, we present a hollow-core vertical photonic crystal waveguide geometry in silicon for gas detection in the mid-infrared region. The dispersion is engineered to enhance light-matter interactions inside the hollow-core defect.

articleTitle: Increasing the power threshold in fiber amplifiers considering both the transverse mode and Brillouin instabilities
abstract: We study the Brillouin instability and the transverse mode instability in a combined computational model for fiber amplifiers. We find the optimal core diameter, which leads to the highest power threshold and output power.

articleTitle: Characterization of Optical Aberrations with Scanning Pentaprism for Large Collimators
abstract: We present a systematic study and practical implementation of characterizing optical aberrations of large collimators using scanning pentaprism technique and reconstructing the transmitted wavefront. Quantitative agreement between measurement results and theoretical predictions validates our methodology.

articleTitle: Ultra Large Mode Area All-Solid Ytterbium-Doped Antiresonant Fiber for 976 nm Lasing
abstract: We propose and investigate an all-solid ytterbium-doped antiresonant fiber design that suppresses four-level lasing wavelengths using high confinement loss (> 20 dB/m) in resonant band, to achieve three-level lasing with remarkably high efficiency (> 85%).

articleTitle: Localization by Disordered Gauge Fields
abstract: We show that it is possible to induced Anderson localization in an optical lattice with no disorder in their couplings or index of refraction but by a disordered artificial gauge field generated by periodic driving.

articleTitle: Ship Detection Based on LiDAR and Visual Information Fusion
abstract: A multi-modal information fusion algorithm with LiDAR point cloud and camera images for ship target detection is proposed. It can effectively solve the limitations of single sensor environment perception and has higher precision and robustness.

articleTitle: Deep UV Raman and Fluorescence Spectroscopy and Spatial/Spectral Imaging on Mars and on Earth
abstract: Deep UV Raman & fluorescence spectroscopy has emerged as an increasingly valuable active sensing tool for standoff detection and chem/bio multi/hyperspectral imaging of trace concentrations of materials on surfaces on Mars and on Earth.

articleTitle: Topographical, Structural and Chemical Nanopatterning of Ultrafast Laser Irradiated Surfaces
abstract: Design of periodic structures with arranged topographical, chemical and structural state offers new ways to manipulate material properties at the nanoscale and can be realized by spontaneous ordering of matter induced by laser irradiation. We report here the achievement of laser-induced nanopatterns that combine physicochemical features at the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Generation of Spatiotemporal optical vortices with arbitrary orbital angular momentum orientation
abstract: We demonstrate a convenient method to generate spatiotemporal optical vortices (STOVs) with arbitrary orbital angular momentum orientation (OAM). The OAM direction is tuned by using a cylindrical lens system.

articleTitle: Photon-pair generation in a heterogeneous silicon photonic chip
abstract: We perform photon-pair generation in a heterogeneous multi-layer silicon photonic chip consisting of SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> and a-Si:H waveguides. Record high CAR value of 1632.6 (± 260.4) is achieved in a-Si:H waveguides from the heterogeneous design.

articleTitle: Chip- and Wafer-Scale Manufacturing of High-Power Membrane-External-Cavity Surface-Emitting Laser Gain Elements
abstract: We describe the manufacturing of high-power membrane-external-cavity surface-emitting laser (MECSEL) gain elements. This process leverages low-temperature direct bonding to combine multi-quantum-well active regions with single-crystal SiC heatspreaders, yielding output powers >20 W at 1178 nm.

articleTitle: Digital electronics platform-based supercontinuum light detection for mid-infrared trace gas sensing
abstract: We present a digital platform-based lock-in detection scheme to improve the gas sensing performance of a spectrometer. A numerically-controlled oscillator serves as reference clock to trigger the supercontinuum source and to demodulate the detector signal.

articleTitle: Single Mode High Energy Amplification in Mid-IR Using Large Core Er:ZBLAN Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We demonstrate high energy pulses in a single transverse mode from 50µm and 30µm core Er:ZBLAN fibers in mid-IR at ~2.8µm. 100ns pulses with up 450µJ have been achieved at kHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: Generation of Light Transverse Spin with a Vectorial Field Controlling Metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate the direct generation of focused transverse spin of light with a metasurface fully controlling the vectorial properties of the transmitted light field through sub-wavelength pixelized manipulation of phase, polarization, and amplitude independently.

articleTitle: Generation of broadband highly-linear frequency-modulated signals for optical sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a generation method based on a recirculating frequency shifting fiber loop for frequency-modulated optical signals with up to 48 GHz tuning range and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> linearity for fast and high resolution optical sensing.

articleTitle: Low noise 560 GHz generation from a fiber-referenced Kerr microresonator soliton comb
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of a low noise 560 GHz wave from a dissipative Kerr microresonator soliton comb, which is locked to a fiber delay in a two-wavelength delayed self-heterodyne interferometer.

articleTitle: Controlling Light Propagation in Frequency Space through non-Hermitian Time Modulations
abstract: A new mechanism to control the spectral flow of light through non-Hermitian time-modulations is presented. This general approach for light control in frequency space may open new opportunities, including for ultrabroadband absorbers and nonreciprocal devices.

articleTitle: Broadband Terahertz Signal Processing and Multiplexing with Four-wire Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate a new waveguide geometry, namely a four-wire waveguide, which acts as a terahertz polarization-division multiplexer and a novel platform to realize versatile signal-processing functionalities into independent channels over a broadband terahertz frequency range.

articleTitle: Observation of Optomechanical Solitons and Cnoidal Waves in Optical Microresonators
abstract: We report the observation of mechanical solitons and cnoidal waves in optical microresonators. We study the driving forces for the soliton generation and explore possible soliton interaction in the optomechanical system.

articleTitle: III-V Lasers on Silicon by Selective Area Heteroepitaxy
abstract: GaAs/InGaAs quantum-well micro-disk lasers on silicon realized by selective area heteroepitaxy is reported. The laser is grown in a 15-µm -wide silicon dioxide recess and demonstrates a threshold of 400 µW and emission at 940 nm.

articleTitle: Tunable Frequency Filter Based on Twisted Bilayer Photonic Crystal Slabs
abstract: We introduce a tunable narrow-band-stop frequency filter based on twisted bilayer photonic crystal slabs in sub-wavelength regime. A desired lineshape is achieved by introducing additional uniform slabs. The filter can operate without diffraction loss and is polarization-independent.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Carrier Transportation in Stepwise-Doped GaAs Photocathodes – Theory and Experiment
abstract: We report a theoretical model specifically developed to explain photoelectron dynamics in stepwise-doped GaAs photocathodes. Comparisons with pump-probe reflectometry measurement show good agreement and offer insights into carrier transportation and decay processes.

articleTitle: Flexible Time-Domain De-Multiplexing of Nyquist OTDM Channels by Orthogonal Sampling in Silicon Photonics
abstract: We report for the first time, inter-symbol-interference (ISi) free demultiplexing of Nyquist optical time division multiplexed (OTDM) signals using a reconfigurable orthogonal sinc-pulse sampling enabled by silicon photonic Mach-Zehnder Modulators.

articleTitle: Terahertz Generation from GaAs Metasurfaces: Role of Surface Nonlinearity
abstract: We show that a GaAs metasurface can generate THz radiation with comparable efficiency to a bulk GaAs crystal. We attribute the enhanced generation to second order nonlinearity with the surface making a strong contribution.

articleTitle: Polarization Speckle Generation & Control of Angular Memory Effect in Optically Anisotropic Media
abstract: We present an experimental investigation into correlations of polarized speckle patterns generated from optically anisotropic liquid crystal elastomer films. The anisotropic scattering provides a prolific template to control the angular memory effect in these films.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth picosecond source at 760 nm generating 50 nJ pulses using four-wave mixing
abstract: We have demonstrated an electronically controlled laser, generating 50 nJ picosecond pulses at 760 nm. The gain-switched pulses at 1032 nm are amplified in Yb-fiber and frequency converted in photonic crystal fiber using four-wave mixing.

articleTitle: An Entanglement-Based QKD System for Scalable Robust Multi-User Networks
abstract: We present entanglement-based quantum key distribution in a star-shaped network with time-bin coding. We demonstrate key exchange under typical operation conditions for metropolitan-scale networks. Without much efforts, it is scalable to more than 100 users.

articleTitle: Microscale Additive Assembly with Optical Tweezers
abstract: The ability to fabricate three-dimensional structures with microscale resolution is critical to many emerging applications. We use an optical tweezers platform with biochemical linking mechanism to assemble 3D structures consisting of hundreds of individual building blocks.

articleTitle: A Sub-mW Silicon Waveguide Microheater
abstract: We demonstrate a thermo-optic phase shifter in silicon photonics. Our design generates heat by passing current through a 60 µm suspended waveguide and achieves a π phase shift with 0.87 ± 0.04 mW of dissipated power.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated Fourier Injected REsonator (FIRE) for coherent beam combining
abstract: An on-chip FIRE resonator, consisting of an angled laser array monolithically integrated with a slab waveguide propagation region, is experimentally demonstrated for coherent beam combining with the increased supermode discrimination and reduced edge losses.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-Induced Nonreciprocity in Passive Silicon Gratings Supporting Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: Optical nonlinearities, combined with structural asymmetry, can break reciprocity and realize devices that transmit light asymmetrically. We show the first experimental implementation of this concept for free-space radiation, using silicon metasurfaces supporting asymmetric quasi-bound states.

articleTitle: Approximate Model of Light Transport in Scattering Media for Computational Sensing in Fog and Tissue
abstract: We present a computationally efficient a pproximate solution to the time-resolved radiative transfer equation that is applicable in weakly and diffuse scattering heterogeneous media. Applications will be considered, including computational sensing in fog and tissue.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive thin-film lithium niobate electro-optic modulator
abstract: Based on the thin-film lithium niobate platform, we experimentally demonstrate a polarization-insensitive electro-optic modulator which features a polarization-dependent loss of 0.35 dB and an on-chip loss of less than 2 dB.

articleTitle: Optimal Optical Beamsteering with Phase-Amplitude Coupled Elements
abstract: A new generation of spatial light modulators enables high speed operation. However, amplitude-phase coupling of elements makes optimal beamforming a computationally expensive task. In this work we present an analytical solution to this problem.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency entangled two-photon states in Sagnac interferometer
abstract: By pumping a periodically poled lithium niobite waveguide in a Sagnac interferometer, we obtain three types of frequency entangled two-photon states with further spectral manipulation.

articleTitle: Conversion of unpolarized to fixed-polarization light with topology-optimized metasurfaces
abstract: We design and fabricate topologically optimized metasurfaces that can achieve almost complete conversion of unpolarized light to the same pure polarization in several outputs, exceeding the fundamental 50% transmission limit of conventional polarizers.

articleTitle: Demonstration of range-resolved detection of stable water isotopologues by differential absorption lidar
abstract: We present range-resolved measurements of the stable water isotopologues ${{\text{H}}_2}^{16}{\text{O}}$ and HD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>O in the lower troposphere enabled by a ground-based differential absorption lidar based on a high-energy parametric laser source.

articleTitle: Controlling spatial coherence with a complex medium
abstract: The mutual correlations between spatially separated optical fields can be controlled employing an optical linear port. By shaping the wavefront of the light transmitted through a complex medium, we realize this port for three beams.

articleTitle: Dynamic Mapping of Temperature Using Phase-Change Materials
abstract: GST pixels are fabricated on metallic heaters where the optical reflection is observed and used to extract dynamic temperature changes. Our results provide a new way to measure the thermal response of microsystems in real-time.

articleTitle: Divergence-degenerate spatial multiplexing towards higher-dimensional optical communications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel modal basis set with highly consistent propagation dynamics, having a divergence variation by merely 18% among 100 lowest order modes, which provides two orders of magnitude larger channels than orbital angular momentum basis.

articleTitle: Multispectral Trans-Palpebral Illumination for Widefield Fundus Photography of the Retina and Choroid
abstract: This study is to characterize spectral efficiency of trans-palpebral illumination, and to validate label-free multispectral imaging for nonmydriatic widefield examination of the chorioretinal vasculature in the living human eye.

articleTitle: Cross-Gain Modulation-Based Reservoir Computing Using Membrane SOAs on Si-MZI
abstract: We solve the Santa-Fe prediction task with reservoir computing utilizing cross-gain modulation in membrane semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs). SOAs are heterogeneously integrated on each arm of Si-based Mach-Zehnder interferometer to spatially separate the input/output ports.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable and Narrow Linewidth Laser Source based on Normal-Dispersion Frequency Combs and Optical Injection Locking
abstract: By injection-locking tones of a normal-dispersion, photonic molecule enabled microcomb, a tunable laser source is demonstrated with > 55 nm of tunable range, < 8 kHz integrated linewidth, > 5 dBm of power, and > 60 dB SMSR.

articleTitle: Optically computed phase microscopy to assess cellular uptake of lipid nanoparticles
abstract: We developed a novel optically computed phase microscopy (OCPM) system, for depth-resolved phase imaging. We used OCPM to assess cellular uptake of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), for the optimization of drug delivery systems based on LNPs.

articleTitle: Outcoupling Hyperbolic Modes from Aligned Carbon Nanotube Films
abstract: Aligned carbon nanotube films make an excellent hyperbolic material plat-form in the infrared. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the presence of high-k modes in aligned carbon nanotube films and outcouple them to free-space via gratings.

articleTitle: On-chip lithium niobate isolators at 780 nm with nm-scale tuning bandwidth
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate frequency tuning of on-chip electrically-driven isolators at 780 nm via thermo-optic control. Coarse tuning of up to 1 nm (6 mode pairs) is demonstrated, and can increase the operational bandwidth of the device.

articleTitle: Smart Biolaser Array for Amyloidogenesis and Drug Screening Analysis
abstract: A smart biological microlaser array was developed through inkjet-printing process, where lasing spectra and images were employed for in vitro amyloidogenesis and drug screening. This work could pave the way for high-throughput laser analysis of neurological diseases.

articleTitle: LED-on-CMOS digital light projector with 128x128 pixels, 0.5 Mfps frame rate and nanosecond pulse capability
abstract: We present a micro-LED-on-CMOS digital light projector array operating up to 0.5 Mfps. The 128x128 pixel array has individual control of each pixel and can operate with 32 grayscale levels and emit nanosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Interference-Free Methane Laser Sensor Using Cepstral Analysis
abstract: A laser sensor is developed for methane measurements in environmental conditions. It is based on tuning an ICL near 3.3 µm and cepstral analysis to isolate methane absorbance from baseline intensity fluctuations and interfering absorbance.

articleTitle: Bloch oscillations of temporal cavity solitons in a synthetic frequency dimension
abstract: We report on the theoretical and experimental demonstration of nonlinear dissipative Bloch oscillations occurring in a long-range synthetic frequency dimension sustained by temporal cavity solitons persisting endlessly in a nonlinear fibre Kerr resonator.

articleTitle: Wafer-Scale Functional Metasurfaces on Free-Standing Membranes
abstract: We demonstrate free-standing metasurfaces made by a new wafer-scale and CMOS compatible nanofabrication method and produce nanostructures over large-area transparent oxide membranes. Applications include narrow-band spectral filtering, efficient light focusing, polarization control and optofluidic biosensors.

articleTitle: Fabrication Tolerant Inverse Design Grating Couplers for Scalable Trapped Ion Quantum Computing
abstract: A fabrication tolerant Si grating coupler for 1.762 µm operation is optimized with inverse design, allowing for −30 dB crosstalk between a pair of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">133</sup>Ba<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> trapped ion qubits within expected fabrication variation.

articleTitle: Flatten optical frequency combs generated via parametric oscillations of a bottle microresonator
abstract: We investigate the formation of flatten optical frequency combs (OFCs) generated by oscillations of a bottle microresonator parameters and show that an adjusted spatial distribution of oscillations can dramatically enhance the generated OFCs.

articleTitle: Thin Disk Laser Development for Space Debris Monitoring and Mitigation
abstract: Space debris laser tracking is a versatile tool for mitigation of collision risks in low earth orbit. Thin Disk lasers are highly suitable to provide the required laser parameters. A transportable kW-class pulsed laser system was developed and tested. New Thin Disk concepts promise a more compact future system. Beyond monitoring, the Thin Disk can also be part of a ground-based laser debris removal system.

articleTitle: Unipolar quantum technology enabling high-speed free-space communication in the long-wave infrared regime
abstract: A combination of unipolar quantum laser, modulator and detector allows us to demonstrate a free-space communication at 40 Gbits/s and 9 µm far-infrared wavelength. The distance between the emitter and the receiver is 31 meters.

articleTitle: Single-photon nonlinearity at room temperature
abstract: We realize an all-optical transistor using exciton-polariton condensation, enabling nonlinearities down to single-photon level at room temperature. Sub-picosecond switching and amplification near the fundamental quantum limit are pivotal steps for energy efficient, ultrafast all-optical logic.

articleTitle: Ultrasensitive ultrasound sensing using optical microcavities in the dissipative mechanism
abstract: We study an ultrasound sensor using the dissipative interaction in an optical microcavity-microfiber coupling system. The sensitivity of this dissipative microcavity is demonstrated to be insensitive to Q factors.

articleTitle: Electrically-Driven Light Emitter in Tailor-Made Photonic Crystal Cavity
abstract: We for the first-time developed telecom hybrid graphene photonic crystal cavity device with an integrated carbon nanotube ensuring high enhancement of its electroluminescent signal and demonstrating the supervision of its intensity.

articleTitle: Topological corner states mediated by quadrupole polarization and Dirac-like band touching
abstract: We demonstrate corner states in trivial and nontrivial 2D SSH lattices diagonally stretched to exhibit both HOTI and higher-order semimetal-like features and examine the underlying topological mechanisms from the calculated spectral phase density.

articleTitle: Thermo-Optic Characterization of SU-8 at Cryogenic Temperature
abstract: We report for the first time the thermo-optic behavior of SU-8 around 1550nm in a ring resonator from 300K to 3K. Cryogenic measurement is enabled by on-chip 3D polymer structures that secure the fiber-to-chip coupling.

articleTitle: Non-invasive and Online Pipeline Corrosion Detection based on Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: A non-invasive online method for pipeline corrosion detection based on active acoustic flaw detection is proposed and demonstrated. The test results show that the proposed method can identify corrosion with a size less than 0.5%.

articleTitle: Suspended Waveguide for Mechanical Driving of Color Centers in Diamond
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of a ~4-GHz surface acoustic wave across a suspended diamond waveguide. This enables simultaneous coherent mechanical driving of, and optical access to, diamond-based color centers.

articleTitle: Physics-Informed Machine Learning of Optical Modes in Composites
abstract: We present machine learning techniques that incorporate physics into the training process. We demonstrate, on example of predicting light propagation in multilayered composites, that physics-informed models are significantly more robust than their black box counterparts.

articleTitle: High resolution soft X-ray spectrometer for FEL characterisation and optimisation
abstract: A high resolution (ΔE < 100 meV) single shot spectrometer for the soft X-ray at SwissFEL is reported. Use of this high fidelity single shot data to develop new modes of operations of operation is described.

articleTitle: All-Optical Spatial Beam Switching in Multimode Fibers
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel approach to spatial all-optical switching, based on beam self-cleaning in nonlinear graded-index multimode opti-cal fibers.

articleTitle: Boundary-induced trapped state in electro-optic frequency combs
abstract: We show that, when optical energy propagates in the frequency dimension during the generation of electro-optic microcombs, the introduction of a frequency boundary can reflect the energy propagation. Further, we show that two boundaries yield a trapped state in frequency dimension.

articleTitle: Exploiting Atomic Nature of the Interface for Controlling Mode Coupling in Microresonators
abstract: We show the ability to control the degree of mode coupling in high quality factor silicon nitride (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) microresonators by controlling the atomic nature of the resonators interface.

articleTitle: High Peak and Average Power Pulse Post-Compression via Multi-Pass Cells
abstract: Spectral broadening via the multi-pass cell technique provides a power-efficient route to direct post-compression of high-power diode-pumped Yb lasers. The talk provides an overview of the method, its performances and discuss prospective advances and applications.

articleTitle: Mapping of momentum-space topological singularities in photonic lattices with hybrid pseudospin-1 Dirac-like cones
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate higher-order topological charge conversion, exhibiting a vortex pair of identical helicities that can be reversed altogether by selectively mapping different momentum-space topological singularities in photonic T-graphene lattices with integer pseudospin-1 Dirac-like cones.

articleTitle: Data Mining for Terahertz Generation Crystals
abstract: We discover, develop, and test new organic nonlinear optical crystals that produce intense pulses of terahertz radiation through a combination of data mining from Cambridge Structural Database and density functional theory calculations.

articleTitle: Anomalous Dips in Reflection Spectra of Polymers Deposited on Plasmonic Metals
abstract: Anomalous dips in reflection spectra of optical polymers deposited on plasmonic metals have been observed and discussed in terms of singularity of surface plasmon polaritons (SPP’s) in the ultraviolet (UV) part of the spectrum.

articleTitle: High-quality factor tantalum pentoxide microring resonator mirror at 780 nm
abstract: Microring resonators in Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> platform are demonstrated at 780 nm with quality factors > 1.4 million. Devices are engineered with tunable on-chip reflections to create effective cavity lengths of ~ 300 mm, suitable for compact, narrow-linewidth lasers.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Sensing at Sub-10 Hz Frequencies using a Mach-Zehnder Fabry-Perot Hybrid Fiber Interferometer
abstract: We report record-setting strain resolutions achieved at sub-10 Hz frequencies using a Mach-Zehnder Fabry-Perot hybrid fiber interferometer, which is supported by an off-the-shelf diode laser and a simple soil-based insulation system.

articleTitle: Robust Multimode Waveguide Design for Avoided Mode Crossing-Free Microresonators
abstract: We present a robust multimode waveguide design against intermodal coupling and experimentally demonstrate an anomalous-dispersion, avoided mode crossing-free microresonator, which is highly desired for bright soliton comb generation.

Author Keywords: (190.4390) Nonlinear optics, integrated optics, Optical resonators

articleTitle: Cavity-Enhanced Few-Cycle Mid-IR Pulses for Field-Resolved Spectroscopy
abstract: Up to tenfold power enhancement of waveform-stable few-cycle pulses is demonstrated in a minimally-dispersive resonator (22-37 THz). This enables spectroscopy of molecular samples based on impulsive excitation and electro-optic sampling at 66 m interaction length.

articleTitle: A 16×17-SPAD Sensor with Peak Detection for Single-Shot Pulsed-LiDAR
abstract: Outdoor LiDAR gets more and more challenging in high background light environments. We propose a novel SPAD chip architecture and an effective background rejection technique enabling single-shot Time-of-Flight LiDAR acquisitions.

articleTitle: Pulse Guiding by Effective Gauge Potential in Synthetic Time-frequency Space
abstract: We theoretically provide an approach for actively manipulating single pulse including the temporal diffraction and spectral frequency conversion in a synthetic time-frequency space by introducing and controlling the non-uniform effective gauge potential for photons.

articleTitle: Low-loss dispersion-engineered silicon nitride waveguides coated with a thin blanket layer
abstract: We demonstrate that coating with a thin blanket layer reduces the propagation loss of silicon nitride dispersion-engineered waveguides featuring strong optical field confinement.

articleTitle: Tunable Metasurface using thin film lithium-niobate in the telecom regime
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable metasurface made of aluminum nanodisk array coated with ITO on a thin film of lithium niobate. A spectral resonant shift of few nanometers and modulation contrast of ~40% are observed.

articleTitle: Non-magnetic Optical Isolator for Telecom based on Atomic Cladding Waveguide
abstract: In this work we present chip scale nonmagnetic optical isolator in the telecom regime. The nonreciprocity is realized by Doppler shift resulting from the velocity selective optical pumping of warm Rubidium atoms in ladder scheme.

articleTitle: Retrieving Masked Signal Through Tracking and Wavefront Shaping
abstract: We present a novel approach that tracks and localizes hidden signal inside or behind scattering media. The method combines traditional feedback based wavefront shaping with a switch function that utilizes two different feedback signals.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser frequency combs covering up to 80 cm-1 for dual-comb spectroscopy at 8μm
abstract: Quantum cascade laser frequency combs with up to 80cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> spectral coverage at ~8µm are demonstrated. We perform dual comb spectroscopy of gaseous species with up to 210 modes covering 63 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of spectral range.

articleTitle: Fiber Laser Front-Ends for Next Generation X-Ray Free Electron Laser and Ultrafast Electron Diffraction Facilities
abstract: We present recent developments of Yb-fiber laser front-ends tailored for a variety of special needs for high repetition rate accelerator driven FEL and UED facilities.

articleTitle: Room-temperature exciton-polariton condensation in a tunable two-dimensional Lieb lattice
abstract: Microcavities filled with conjugated polymer active in strong light–matter interaction regime enable exciton-polariton condensates at room temperature. By imprinting lattices through nanostructuring and using a tunable platform, we can explore solid-state physics toy models.

articleTitle: Single-pixel high-speed imaging through a multimode fiber
abstract: While traditional high-speed cameras are generally bulky and based on pixel-array detectors, we propose a high-speed imaging scheme based on a multimode fiber using only one pixel. The frame rate of imaging reaches 60.3 Mfps.

articleTitle: 1 GHz mid-infrared dual-comb spectrometer spanning more than 30 THz
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband 1 GHz mid-infrared dual comb spectrometer based on intra-pulse difference frequency generation, addressing the 3 – 5 µm wavelength region for the characterization of dynamic molecular systems.

articleTitle: Bragg Reflector Co-integrated with SiN and a-Si on 300 mm Wafers for Low Loss Optical Beamformers
abstract: We demonstrate a build-up consisting of SiN and a-Si photonics with a Bragg reflector, targeted at optical beamforming applications. We developed CMOS-compatible low-loss PVD SiN waveguides and grating couplers with enhanced efficiency.

articleTitle: 324-fs Pulses from a SESAM Modelocked 2-µm GaSb-VECSEL without an Intracavity Heat Spreader
abstract: We present the first modelocked backside-cooled GaSb-VECSEL operating at 2061 nm, producing shortest pulses of 324 fs with record high average output power up to 65 mW at 3 GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Sub-ps High-Energy Seeding for Power Broadening and Rabi-Flopping of Terawatt CO2 Amplifiers
abstract: We present a new approach to high-energy seeding of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser amplifiers based on mixing of 1338-nm and 1540-nm pulses that suppresses pulse splitting and shortens the main pulse by power broadening and Rabi-flopping.

articleTitle: Generating Quantum Light: New Prospects from Superradiance
abstract: We discover a property universal to all superradiant processes: the radiation undergoes a transition from classical to quantum, distinguished by a negative Wigner function, opening new avenues toward the generation of engineered quantum light states.

articleTitle: Noise Figure and Saturation Characteristics of Multi-section Semiconductor Optical Amplifier for Data Center Networks
abstract: The noise figure and saturation power of a multi-section SOA, with non-uniform bias conditions, are characterized. Optimum biasing achieves 2 dB improvement at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> for 10 Gb/s OOK transmission over 25 km.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Upconversion Time-Stretch Spectroscopy
abstract: We develop upconversion time-stretch infrared spectroscopy and demonstrate a highresolution and broadband measurement of mid-infrared absorption spectra of gas-phase molecules at a scan rate higher than 10 MSpectra/s.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Enhanced Emission and Blinking Suppression for Single Quantum Dot Digital Resolution Biosensing of Cancer-associated miRNA Biomarkers
abstract: We report 3,000-fold signal enhancement with blinking suppression capability and single QD sensitivity using low-NA lens. Applied toward miRNA detection assays, we achieve single-base mutation selectivity, and 10-attomolar detection limit.

articleTitle: Mach-Zehnder FOPA for Dual Polarization Wavelength-Division-Multiplexed 100G Signal Amplification
abstract: We demonstrate amplification of 17x100 GHz-spaced channel in C-band by a PI-FOPA based on Mach-Zehnder architecture with net gain >10 dB and confirmed its robustness over time. A commercial 100G-PDM-QPSK transponder was used to measure/compare the bit-error-rate versus received power with a commercial EDFA.

articleTitle: Nanoelectromechanical tuning of slot dielectric metasurfaces
abstract: We present a design for nanoelectromechanical tuning of high-Q slot resonant dielectric metasurfaces. The design provides over 60% intensity modulation under 1.5V and independent modulation for multiwavelengths.

articleTitle: Near-infrared Dual-comb Spectroscopy for Direct Characterization of Optical Responses in Metamaterials
abstract: Near-infrared dual-comb spectroscopy is applied to observe optical responses of metamaterials. Complex transmittance spectrum of sprit-ring resonators is successfully evaluated. The developed method has a great potential as a versatile characterization tool for metamaterials.

articleTitle: Observation of Giant Five-Photon Upconversion Luminescence in Subwavelength AlGaAs Resonators
abstract: We design and fabricate individual subwavelength AlGaAs nanoantennas supporting Mie resonances in the mid-infrared spectral range. Near the resonant modes, we observe five-photon upconversion photoluminescence in the visible spectral range.

articleTitle: Terahertz Topological Meta-devices for On-chip Photonics
abstract: We design and demonstrate experimentally the on-chip integration and miniaturization of topological devices for the terahertz technologies. Our devices are based on valley-Hall photonic structures employed for integrated components of on-chip THz systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic regimes and damping of relaxation oscillations in III-V/Si external cavity lasers
abstract: We report how external cavity III-V/Si hybrid lasers operate in regimes of ultra-damped relaxation oscillations or in turbulent and self-pulsing regimes. The different regimes are reached by detuning the lasing wavelength respect to the mirror effective reflectivity peak and are the consequence of the dispersive narrow band reflectivity of the silicon photonics mirror, the linewidth enhancement factor and four-wave mixing in the gain medium.

articleTitle: Ultralow-loss etchless lithium niobate integrated photonics at near-visible wavelengths
abstract: We developed an ultralow-loss etchless lithium niobate integrated photonic platform at near-visible wavelengths (765–781 nm) and experimentally achieved a maximal intrinsic Q factor of 1.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> in disk microcavities at ~765 nm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear topological protection of spontaneous symmetry breaking in a driven Kerr resonator
abstract: A two-mode Kerr cavity with a π-phase defect exhibits a virtual Möbius topology and enables spontaneous symmetry breaking with unprecedented robustness. Experiments performed with homogeneous and localized states confirm our predictions.

articleTitle: Suppressing Transverse Mode Instability in Multimode Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We demonstrate numerically and theoretically that the transverse-mode stability for a high-power fiber amplifier is greatly increased via simultaneous excitation of many high-order modes, while the amplified light maintains spatially coherent and high beam quality.

articleTitle: Multiscale Numerical Modeling for Near-Field Microwave Impedance Microscopy
abstract: In this work, we analyzed numerically a multiscale nanosystem based on sMIM on TBG. Spontaneous formation of a water-meniscus by the approximation between the tip-sample concentrates the microwave fields, reaching resolutions of up to 1nm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Circular Dichroism with Resonant Metasurfaces
abstract: We predict and demonstrate experimentally large third-harmonic circular dichroism in transmission for chiral dielectric metasurfaces with broken in-plane symmetry. We explain the observed large nonlinear circular dichroism by excitation of resonant multipolar Mie modes.

articleTitle: Spiral phase modulation based deep learning for autofocusing
abstract: We demonstrate the use of spiral phase modulation in preprocessing defocused image before feeding into deep learning model for autofocusing. Average predict error is shown to outperform previously published works on an open dataset.

articleTitle: Large >0.2dB/µm Modulation Depth Double-Layer Graphene Electro-Absorption Modulator on Slot waveguide
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated >10 dB extinction ratio (ER) at 4 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf> with a 50µm-long double-layer graphene electro-absorption modulator (DLG EAM) integrated on a silicon slot waveguide. Both the modulation depth (0.2dB/µm) and efficiency (0.070 dBV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) exceed state-of-art.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Characterization of Time-varying Optical Vortices with a Bulk Interferometer
abstract: We implement an in-line and ultrastable spatiotemporal technique based on uniaxial crystals, which solves high-complexity and stability problems associated with other techniques. Moreover, we generate and characterize the temporally resolved wavefronts of time-varying optical vortices.

articleTitle: Highly-confined, low-loss visible photonics using foundry-fabricated Silicon Nitride circuits
abstract: In this paper, we present CMOS-foundry-fabricated silicon nitride photonic structures at barium emission wavelengths - 493nm and 650nm. High mode-confinement, low propagation losses, and inverse-designed 3dB splitters are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Quasi-Phase Matched Second Harmonic Generation in Orientation-Patterned Gallium Phosphide Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate continuous-wave second-harmonic generation from 1.5 µm lasers in orientation-patterned gallium phosphide waveguides with 200 %/W.cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> efficiency, to our knowledge the highest reported conversion efficiency in this platform.

articleTitle: Quantum Interface for Telecom Ultrafast and Nanosecond Light Pulses
abstract: We experimentally show spectral bandwidth compression of broadband heralded single photons by two orders of magnitude, from 1.5 nm to 5 pm, increasing a photon flux through a 2 pm filter by a factor of 12.

articleTitle: Spatio-Spectro-Temporal Characterization of Ultrashort Vortex Pulses
abstract: Generation of OAM ultrashort vortices requires compensation of dispersive broadening and distortion. Here, we present analysis of spatio-spectro-temporal properties of an ultrashort vortex through (3+1)D numerical simulations. Case studies are presented.

articleTitle: Tailoring Free Electron Spontaneous Emission from Graphene using Shaped Electron Wavepackets
abstract: Photons emitted via bremsstrahlung are inherently incoherent and non-directional. We show that the intrinsic cross-section of bremsstrahlung from crystalline solids can be enhanced and made directional by shaping the quantum wave nature of free electrons.

articleTitle: Novel dual-comb multiplexing technique for low-noise solid-state lasers
abstract: We present a new cavity multiplexing method to support a pair of noise-correlated, yet cavity length independent modes. 2.1-W of average power per 140-fs, 80-MHz pulse train are achieved with a low uncorrelated timing jitter.

articleTitle: Height-Driven Symmetry Breaking for High-Q Resonances in All-Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach to control photonic bound states in the continuum induced by a symmetry-breaking with tailored resonator heights leading to more precisely engineered system asymmetries and new metasurface functionalities.

articleTitle: Telecom Quantum Network Node via Atom-Nanophotonic Coupling
abstract: We propose neutral atoms coupled to telecom nanophotonic cavities as quantum network nodes. Our novel protocol for generating atom-telecom photon entanglement enables a scalable network architecture featuring identical qubits and direct telecom operation.

articleTitle: Fano Laser Based on a Photonic Crystal Nanobeam Cavity
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Fano laser based on an InP-on-silicon photonic crystal nanobeam cavity, which can overcome limitations faced by two-dimensional photonic crystal structures.

articleTitle: Polarization-Entangled Photons From Ultrathin Nonlinear Layers
abstract: We report on the first-time g eneration o f p olarization-entangled photons via spontaneous parametric down-conversion in ultrathin nonlinear layers. Relaxed phase matching leads to an unprecedented tunability of the two-photon polarization state, not achievable in bulk sources.

articleTitle: Interband cascade external laser system for the rapid detection of trace gases in the MIR region
abstract: An IC-ECL with different waveguide concepts and a MEMS device as tuning element for high acquisition rates is presented. Characterization results and use for detection of trace gases in the MIR region will be shown.

articleTitle: Origin of High Transmission in 120-degree Sharp Bends of Photonic-crystal Waveguides with and without Inversion Symmetry
abstract: Various reports demonstrated that valley photonic-crystal waveguides without inversion symmetry support high transmission in 120-degree sharp bends, whose origin, however, has not been clarified yet. Here, we find that the type of waveguide interfaces dominates this phenomenon instead of the existence of the broken inversion symmetry.

articleTitle: Photonics PNT Based on Multi-Tone Continuous Wave Ranging
abstract: When GPS signals are not available alternative positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) systems become indispensable. We propose and experimentally demonstrate a photonic PNT system that localizes targets with ~10cm separation and <5cm resolution at a 1km distance.

articleTitle: Patch-Type Wireless Power Transfer System Based on Electromagnetic Wave Focusing Metasurface for Bioimplantable Devices
abstract: We propose a patch-type wireless power transfer system for bioimplantable devices using electromagnetic wave focusing metasurface. Simulation and experimental results have been demonstrated that transmitted power was enhanced at specific locations into the tissue.

articleTitle: SPDC Conversion from Bound State in the Continuum in Semiconductor Metasurfaces: Polarization Properties
abstract: We study the polarization properties of photon pairs emitted via spontaneous parametric down-conversion from a nonlinear metasurface driven by symmetry-protected, bound state in the continuum.

articleTitle: Inverse-Designed Silicon Carbide Nanoresonators
abstract: We implement inverse-designed nano-resonators in 4H-Silicon-Carbide-on-Insulator and demonstrate high quality factors and quantum frequency comb generation.

articleTitle: Millimeter-range Optical Trapping and Manipulation in Suspensions via Asymmetric Potentials
abstract: The well-known counter-propagating optical traps require the beams to be symmetrical for 3D trapping, resulting in a highly-sensitive system. Here, we study an easy-to-align counterpropagating trap with a broken symmetry, demonstrating stable trapping over millimeter-range.

articleTitle: Optically Tunable Third Harmonic Generation in a Conducting Oxide Film
abstract: We demonstrate actively tunable third harmonic generation (THG) in zinc oxide, increasing THG by 600%. This is done using an interband pump, generating free carriers to increase Kerr nonlinearities, and enhancing fields through permittivity reduction.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Quantum Noise Dynamics in Ultrafast Nonlinear Nanophotonics
abstract: We present a split-step framework for simulating nonlinear propagation of multimode quantum noise and entanglement in ultrafast pulses, beyond conventional linearized-noise approximations. We apply our method to model state-of-the-art dispersion-engineered devices on thin-film lithium niobate.

articleTitle: Photon-Limited Image Recovery with Fourier Convolution Network
abstract: We propose and validate a deep learning based algorithm for recovering images from their photon-limited samples. The method can be applied to complicated images and is able to retain most of the details.

articleTitle: Inverse Designed Integrated Optical Filters for Optical Transmission Shaping
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate inverse-designed low-pass, long-pass, and band-stop filters. They show flexible optical transmission shaping with high extinction ratio and low insertion loss, and are commercial foundry-compatible.

articleTitle: Thermal Metasurfaces: Selective Emission of Custom Wavefronts from a Structured Ultrathin Optical Element
abstract: We demonstrate a metasurface platform based on quasibound states in the continuum capable of generating partially coherent designer wavefronts via thermal emission.

articleTitle: Optical Emission of Iron-doped ZnSe Particles in a Chalcogenide Glass
abstract: Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-doped ZnSe particles were dispersed in a chalcogenide glass matrix amenable to fiber drawing. Adding an alumina shell prevented ZnSe dissolution and preserved normal Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> optical absorption and emission properties.
