articleTitle: Computational and Theoretical Modeling of Acoustoelectrically Enhanced Brillouin Optomechanical Interactions in Piezoelectric Semiconductors
abstract: We computationally explore the optical and elastic modes necessary for acoustoelectrically enhanced Brillouin interactions. The large simulated piezoelectric (k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ≈ 6%) and optome-chanical $\left( {\left| {{{\text{g}}_0}} \right| \approx 8000({\text{rad}}/{\text{s}})\sqrt {\text{m}} } \right)$ coupling theoretically predicts a performance enhancement of several orders of magnitude in Brillouin-based photonic technologies.

articleTitle: Mode-locking induced by continuous wave driving in a fiber laser
abstract: We analyze the formation of solitons in a coherently driven fiber laser. By means of bifurcation analysis, we demonstrate that coherent continuous wave driving can induce mode-locking without saturable absorption.

articleTitle: Consequences of Introducing Non-Differentiable Angular Dispersion into a Pulsed Optical Field
abstract: We verify experimentally that newly identified non-differentiable angular dispersion enables independent control over the group velocity and the sign and magnitude of all dispersion orders along the propagation direction of a pulsed field.

articleTitle: High Average Power Four-pass Amplifer Based on Yb:CALYO crystal
abstract: We report on a four-pass femtosecond amplifier based on a Yb:CALYO crystal. The seed of 2.7 W is amplified to 20.15 W, corresponding to 19% optical-to-optical efficiency. The spectrum and the beam quality maintain well.

articleTitle: Measuring Topological Invariants within Dissipatively-Coupled Lattices
abstract: We demonstrate Bloch oscillations in a dissipatively-coupled network of time-multiplexed resonators, and experimentally measure the topological invariants in open systems. This reveals the complex interplay between topology and dissipation with potential applications in quantum/classical photonics.

articleTitle: Observation of a Bimorphic Floquet Topological Insulator
abstract: We introduce a novel class of Floquet topological insulators simultaneously hosting Chern-type and anomalous edge states. The driving mechanism is implemented in a chained honeycomb lattice, allowing us to observe its different chiral edge states.

articleTitle: All Polarization-Maintaining Wavelength-Tunable Femtosecond Pulse Mode-Locked Fiber Laser Based on Strain Controlled Lyot-Filter
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a strain controlled all-PM fiber Lyot-filter which serve as a new wavelength tuning mechanism for all-PM femtosecond pulse mode-locked fiber laser. This tuning mechanism is approximately 100 times more efficient than previous approaches and suitable for generating kHz-order wavelength-swept femtosecond pulse laser.

articleTitle: Topological Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: Despite recent progress in topological photonics, a challenge remains to realise topological states in a scalable platform. Here we fabricate optical fiber characterized by a topological invariant and demonstrate protected supermode propagation over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> wavelengths.

articleTitle: Destructive Controlled Phase Gate using Linear Optics
abstract: Two nonlinear sign gates can be combined to implement a controlled-phase gate using only linear optics. We propose a destructive controlled-phase gate for single-rail target qubits requiring the use of a single nonlinear sign gate.

articleTitle: Implantable Neural Probe System for Patterned Photostimulation and Electrophysiology Recording
abstract: We demonstrate a system for implantable nanophotonic neural probes with custom packaging and peripherals. The probes, which were manufactured on 200mm Si wafers, monolithically integrate SiN waveguides with TiN electrophysiology electrodes and were tested in vivo.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic Approach Using a Broadband Laser Source for Sensing Carbon Monoxide and Carbon Dioxide
abstract: Supercontinuum laser-based broadband photoacoustic technique is de-mostrated for sensing CO, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O around 2µm. The detection limit of 6 ppm, 736 ppm and 20 ppb respectively, is attained with SNR of 3 dB.

articleTitle: Photonic supercontinuum as transfer oscillator for optical frequency synthesis
abstract: we demonstrate frequency transfer effect simultaneously in the supercontinuum process of a mode-locked laser. Together with spectral broadening, the CEO information, is freely transferred to the entire supercontinuum, which opens flexible schemes for frequency synthesis.

articleTitle: Neural network-based phase calibration for integrated optical phased arrays with resolved ambiguity
abstract: Using neural networks, we experimentally extract phase errors of an optical phased array from its far-field pattern non-iteratively for calibration. Periodic and conjugate phase ambiguities are resolved, helping achieve high sidelobe suppression ratio.

articleTitle: Portable Centimeter-Scale Rigidly Held Optical Cavity with <3×10-14 Fractional Frequency Stability
abstract: We present a rigidly held 10 mL-volume optical reference cavity with a simple cylindrical geometry. A laser stabilized to the cavity has < 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> fractional frequency stability, and minimal holding force sensitivity is measured.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Quantum Cascade Laser Dual-Comb Spectroscopy with Accurate, Absolute Frequency Scale
abstract: We acquire interleaved spectra with a frequency scale that is accurate to within ±2 MHz in 54 ms using a dual-comb spectrometer with two quantum cascade laser frequency combs around 1300 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: 2-D Optical Phased Arrays with Multilayer Antenna Elements and Off-Aperture Phase Control
abstract: A single-wavelength multilayer 2-D optical phased array (OPA) architecture with vertically-stacked nanoantennas, 3-D light distribution, and off-aperture phase control is reported. An 8x8 OPA with 3μm element-spacing and 23° beam steering range is demonstrated as a proof of concept.

articleTitle: Photon Pair Generation from Bound States in the Continuum in Nonlinear Metasurfaces
abstract: We report, for the first time, the generation of non-degenerate photon pairs via spontaneous parametric down-conversion driven by Bound States in the Continuum resonances in semiconductor metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Vibration Sensing with a Hybrid Electronically Addressable Random Laser
abstract: The operation of a Hybrid Electronic Addressable Random laser is analyzed. The laser operates as a ϕ-OTDR distributed vibration sensor in a transform-limited mode-locked regime with 41 MHz FWHM bandwidth and <7-kHz mode linewidth.

articleTitle: All-Silicon Metalens for Long Wavelength Infrared Imaging
abstract: We made meta-optics in the long-wave infrared (LWIR) regime and demonstrate imaging with a 2 cm aperture f/1 all-silicon metalens under ambient thermal emission. We showed that even with the strongly chromatic nature of the metalenses, we can perform ambient light imaging, thanks to the lack of wavelength discrimination in the sensor.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Devices for Multiplexing and Switching
abstract: Our recent progresses in silicon photonic devices for multiplexing and switching are reviewed. The first part is for on-chip wavelength-division-(de)multiplexers, including optical filters based on microring resonators (MRRs) and waveguide gratings. The second part including photonic switches based on MZIs.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic polarization splitter-rotator with subwavelength grating metamaterials
abstract: We present a silicon photonic polarization splitter-rotator (PSR) with subwavelength gratings (SWGs). SWGs enhance the local coupling coefficient during the modal transition and make the PSR more compact than a strip waveguide-based PSR.

articleTitle: Controllable Material Removal and Polishing of Glass Using Femtosecond Lasers
abstract: Femtosecond laser polishing of glass is demonstrated for the first time, achieving controllable material removal and sub-nanometer surface roughness. This result opens a path for complex optical processing tasks on various materials.

articleTitle: An atomic frequency comb memory in rare-earth doped thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We demonstrate compact chip-integrated atomic frequency comb storage in rare-earth doped thin-film lithium niobate. Our optical memory exhibits a broad storage bandwidth exceeding 100 MHz, and optical storage time of over 250 ns.

articleTitle: A Polarization-independent directional coupler on a thin-film lithium niobate platform
abstract: We design a polarization-insensitive directional coupler on a thin-film lithium niobate platform by overcoming the polarization anisotropy. We use it as a Bell-state analyzer for entangling two remote trapped ions and achieve < 99.99% fidelity.

articleTitle: Advantages of YLF host over YAG in power scaling of ytterbium based lasers at cryogenic temperatures
abstract: Our spectroscopic, lasing and thermal-lens measurements performed with Yb:YLF and Yb:YAG under almost identical conditions show that YLF host has several advantages over YAG for the development of high-power ultrafast laser/amplifier systems at cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Long-Range Distributed Acoustic Sensor Based on 3×3 Coupler Assisted Passive Demodulation Scheme
abstract: A distributed acoustic sensor based on phase-sensitive optical time domain reflectometry (φ-OTDR) and passive 3x3 coupler demodulation is demonstrated which is capable of quantifying strain perturbations at 40 km of a sensing fiber.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Nonlinear Optics and Mid-IR Frequency Comb Generation With Mode-Locked Cr:ZnS lasers
abstract: Ultrafast lasers based on Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-doped II-VI semiconductors provide a convenient way to generate optical frequency combs in a broad spectral range. We will give an overview of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+-</sup>based femtosecond sources and their applications in dual-comb spectroscopy.

articleTitle: F-SYNC: a 1 kHz high energy OPCPA auxiliary beam synchronizable with fs precision and arbitrary delay to the L1-Allegra laser
abstract: We report on the progress in developing a high energy, 1 kHz OPCPA auxiliary laser (F-SYNC) which is intended to supplement the L1-Allegra beamline. The auxiliary pulses are synchronized to the main laser with femtosecond precision and arbitrary delay.

articleTitle: Fundamental thermodynamic noise in crystalline optical materials
abstract: We have discovered a new thermodynamic noise unique to crystalline materials that will limit their performance in optical metrology. It causes frequency-dependent depolarization of the optical field, which appears as apparent amplitude and phase noise when the field is detected. Our work generalizes all prior descriptions of thermo-optic noises in amorphous materials.

articleTitle: Low Half-wave Voltage Thin-film Lithium Niobate Modulator with Ultra-flat Electro-optic Response
abstract: A thin-film lithium niobate modulator employing low-loss capacitively-loaded traveling-wave electrodes terminated by an on-chip resistor is demonstrated, with 6-dB electrical bandwidth over 150 GHz, ultra-flat electro-optic response and low half-wave voltage of 2 V.

articleTitle: Physical layer security monitoring of optical communication using a quantum pilot tone signal
abstract: We demonstrate a low-complexity, quantum-level-sensitivity security monitoring system using a quantum pilot tone which is detected by an independent local oscillator, with compact data conversion acquisition units over a 10dB loss channel.

articleTitle: Generation of High-power Picosecond Optical Vortex beams from a Yb-doped Multicore Fiber Amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of optical vortex beams with controllable topological charge of l=±1 from a coherently-combined Yb-doped multicore (6-core) fiber amplifier. An average/peak power of 7-W/21.3-kW is achieved for 110-ps pulses.

articleTitle: High-flux table-top hard X-ray source driven by few-cycle 5 μm OPCPA at a 1 kHz repetition rate
abstract: A table-top femtosecond hard X-ray source at 8 keV provides a flux of up to 1.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> photons/s. Few-cycle 5 μm laser pulses serve as driver that are generated by a multiple-stage optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier (OPCPA).

articleTitle: Fast-Tuning Adiabatic Microrings for CROW Filters and Athermal WDM Receivers in a 45 nm SOI CMOS Process
abstract: Adiabatic microrings with opposing p/n contacts achieve full carrier sweepout in reverse bias and energy-efficient carrier injection in forward bias, exhibiting 200GHz/V peak shift in C-band for athermal tuning over a 220 GHz range.

articleTitle: Photonic Frequency Analysis of Microwave Signals using an Integrated Ring Resonator and Heterodyne Detection
abstract: A photonic frequency analysis of microwave signals based on filtering by a ring resonator and heterodyne detection with a resolution and accuracy of 1 MHz and ±0.5 MHz for a wide measurement range is presented.

articleTitle: Laser Cavity-Solitons and Turing Patterns Microcombs: the Interaction of Slow and Fast Nonlinearities
abstract: Slow nonlinearities are critical in microresonator-based frequency combs, regulating essential phenomena, from stability to soliton starting and formation. We discuss their effect in a microresonator-filtered fiber laser.

articleTitle: Thermally Tunable Silicon Topological Photonic Add-Drop Filter
abstract: By exploiting the robust transport of light along the edges formed by two types of valley photonic crystals, we experimentally demonstrated a thermally tunable silicon topological photonic add-drop filter in the telecom band.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Network of the Optical Hitless Wavelength-Selective Switches Using the MZI-Embedded MRR
abstract: We demonstrate the multi-channel optical hitless wavelength-selective switches using the MZI-embedded MRR. The rising response time is about 4.8 µs and it can realize hitless rerouting of multi-wavelength signals without interruption.

articleTitle: Parabolic Core W-type Thulium-doped Fiber for 1.7 μm High-energy Ultrafast All-fiber Lasers
abstract: A parabolic core W-type fiber offers normal dispersion and a short-pass filtering effect while being bent, enabling high gain in a 1.7-μm region. An achievable core size of the design is studied within fabrication capability.

articleTitle: Dark-Bright Soliton Frequency Combs in a Microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate mutually trapped dark-bright-soliton pairs in microresonators. The solitons are generated by seeding modes in different dispersion regimes with similar group velocity. Dark-bright-soliton pairs enable frequency combs with nearly constant power in time domain.

articleTitle: Few-mode self-similar pulse compression in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We numerically investigate few-mode self-similar pulse compression in photonic crystal fibers. Simulation shows three copropagating modes can be compressed self-similarly with deviation < 5% when input pulses are longer than 3.58 ps.

articleTitle: High Order (N=4–6) Multiphoton Mid-IR Absorption in GaP, ZnSe, GaSe, and ZGP and the Role of Free Carriers
abstract: We report multiphoton absorption (MPA) and pulse-length-dependent nonlinear absorption in four mid-infrared crystals. While MPA order varied following crystals’ bandgaps, generated free carriers by MPA contributed considerably to the total absorption even at 30-fs durations.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Waveguides and Gradient Index Flat Optics by Nanoimprinting Refractive Index
abstract: We report the fabrication of gradient index flat optics and waveguides using the ‘nanoimprinting refractive index’ (NIRI) technique applied to mesoporous silicon substrates. Optical wavefront shaping and waveguiding are demonstrated in the visible and near-infrared respectively.

articleTitle: Cosmic radiation effect on silicon photonic Mach-Zehnder Modulator
abstract: We evaluated the radiation effects of cosmic rays on silicon Mach-Zehnder Modulator loaded on International Space Station. Permanent changes of refractive index (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>) and carrier lifetime reduction have been observed after 6 months’ radiation.

articleTitle: Measurement-dependent erasure of distinguishability for the observation of interference in an unbalanced SU(1,1) interferometer
abstract: We report a method of homodyne detection that can recover otherwise lost interference effect in an unbalanced SU(1,1) interferometer. The indistinguishability due to amplitude measurement and slow detection is responsible for the recovery of interference.

articleTitle: Wavelength Conversion of a 36 Gb/s Net Rate PAM-4 Signal Using an a-Si Waveguide
abstract: Wavelength conversion of a net rate 36 Gb/s PAM-4 signal is achieved using an amorphous silicon waveguide with less than 23 dBm of pump power, enabled by over 13 dB improvement in the output-to-input conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency On-Chip Frequency Conversion in the Telecom Band
abstract: Using silicon-nitride microresonators with integrated Moiré-Bragg gratings to suppress parasitic nonlinear processes, we demonstrate on-chip frequency conversion to a single idler tone with a record-high 71% efficiency using Bragg scattering four-wave-mixing.

articleTitle: Generation of Tunable, Picosecond Pulses from a MEMS-VCSEL
abstract: We demonstrate sub-170ps pulse generation from electrically gain-switched MEMS-VCSELs that are continuously tunable from 833-848nm. This compact, tunable picosecond pulse source is well-suited to optical coherence tomography, high resolution laser spectroscopy and light ranging applications.

articleTitle: Comparison of the full model and phase-matched model for transverse mode instability
abstract: We compare the full model and phase-matched model for the transverse mode instability. The phase-matched model, which requires less longitudinal discretization with less computational time, predicts the same refractive index gratings as the full model.

articleTitle: Arc-Induced Core Expansion in Visible-Light Multicore Fibers
abstract: Using a fusion splicer, we demonstrate tapered core expansion at the facet of a custom visible-light 16-core fiber. Across all cores, the average mode-field diameter was expanded from 3.1µm to 8.9µm at λ=488nm.

articleTitle: Varifocal Meta-lens for Fluorescence Microscopy
abstract: We demonstrated a Moiré meta-lens to perform fluorescence bioimaging. The focal length can be varied by tuning mutual angles. The compact design plays an important role in fluorescence microscopy and endoscopy for clinical purposes.

articleTitle: Dynamic Ellipsometry Measurement Based on a Simplified Independent Locking Dual-Comb System
abstract: High-speed and dynamic ellipsometry spectroscopic measurement has been developed with an independent locking dual-comb system. The measurement precision and dynamic performance of the proposed system are demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: 1.6-GHz, 3.3-W Kerr-lens Mode-locked Yb:KGW Oscillator Pumped by a Multimode Laser Diode
abstract: We demonstrate a high-power high-repetition-rate Kerr-lens mode-locked oscillator pumped by a laser diode for the first time. 269-fs pulses at the repetition rate of 1.6 GHz with up to 3.3-W average power are obtained.

articleTitle: PAPR Reduction in DCO-OFDM and PAM-DMT Based VLC Systems
abstract: In this paper, a pilot-assisted scheme is used to reduce the peak-to-average power ratio of multicarrier signalling based visible light communication systems and the system throughput is maximised with bit and power loading.

articleTitle: High quality factor slow light modes and localized defect modes in a microgear photonic crystal ring
abstract: We demonstrate silicon nitride photonic crystal microrings supporting both high quality factor (Q ≈1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) slow-light modes (slowing ratio ≈10) and high-Q (≈6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) localized defect modes (volume < 5(λ /n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>). These microcavities are created through a gear-like modulation of the microring inner sidewall.

articleTitle: Multimode soliton interactions and molecules in GRIN optical fibers
abstract: We experimentally study the interactions of multimode Raman solitons in graded-index optical fibers. Fission of a femtosecond multisoliton pulse leads to anomalous soliton self-frequency shift, inelastic collisions and multimode soliton molecules.

articleTitle: High-performance Dual-Polarization IQ Modulator Based on Hybrid Silicon and Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a large bandwidth and low half-wave voltage dual-polarization IQ modulator based on hybrid silicon and lithium niobate platform, with a roll-off of only 2 dB at 67 GHz and a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 3 V.

articleTitle: Observation of walk-off Solitons in Step-index and Graded-index Multimode Fibers
abstract: We observe a new type of walk-off soliton propagating in multimode step-index and in graded-index fibers. Pulse initial duration and energy only depend on the input wavelength, and it evolves into a fundamental mode soliton.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-order optical orbital angular momentum measuring assisted by annular phase grating
abstract: Combining Gaussian beam and annular phase grating (APG) can highlight the spiral stripes with uniform distribution. Here, it shines new light on ultrahigh-order orbital angular momentum (OAM) states detecting, achieving higher than ± 220.

articleTitle: Brillouin amplification of helical Bloch modes carrying optical vortices
abstract: We observe Brillouin amplification of circularly polarized vortex modes in chiral photonic crystal fiber. Angular momentum conservation means that the pump and backward Stokes signals have opposite topological charge and spin.

articleTitle: Generation of spatio-temporal beams using orbital angular degrees of freedom
abstract: We demonstrate an OAM microring laser array to generate spatio-temporal beams based on the superposition of different orbital angular momenta in the far-field.

articleTitle: Quantum Enhanced LIDAR using Nonlocal Dispersion
abstract: By utilizing quantum temporal correlations in spontaneous parametric down conversion photon pairs, in conjunction with non-local dispersion, we can achieve 35.94 ± 0.91dB improvement in SNR over classical LIDAR.

articleTitle: Jamming Attacks at Terahertz Frequencies
abstract: We demonstrate the vulnerability of a 200 GHz wireless link to a jamming attack and show how a jammer can exploit the broadband nature of typical receivers to reduce the target signal’s BER.

articleTitle: Phase Locking of Pulsed Squeezed Light Generated by a Single-Pass Optical Parametric Amplifier
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a phase-locking scheme for squeezed vacuum generated by a single-pass optical parametric amplifier. Stable phase locking of picosecond squeezed vacuum with a squeezing level of −1.7 dB was achieved.

articleTitle: Quadratic Cavity Solitons for Enhanced Optical Gas Sensing
abstract: We utilize the unique formation dynamics of quadratic cavity solitons for enhanced sensing, experimentally show CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensing with high sensitivity and large dynamic range, and present the promising potentials of soliton-enhanced gas sensors.

articleTitle: Information Extraction in Photon Counting Experiments
abstract: We use quantum detector tomography to quantify the extracted information of detection outcomes from five different multiplexed SNSPDs. This allows to directly compare the quality of different multiplexing architectures for photon-counting applications.

articleTitle: All-optical Nonlinear Noise Suppression in State-of-the-art Fiber Oscillators and Amplifiers
abstract: New developments regarding all-optical noise suppression in state-of-the-art Kerr-type fiber oscillators and amplifiers are presented. Optimized noise-transfer dynamics from nonlinear amplifying loop-mirror mode-locked fiber oscillators enable quantum-limited noise performance.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr solitons in chains of microresonators
abstract: We theoretically study Dissipative Kerr solitons (DKS) in chains of optical microresonators. We show regimes of formation of conventional solitons and 2D spatio-temporal pulses considering both topologically non-trivial and trivial systems.

articleTitle: Microresonator Frequency Comb-Based Transmission of Intensity Modulated Direct Detection Data
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed transmission of 30Gbaud NRZ and PAM4 data using a silicon nitride microresonator frequency comb. We achieve bit-error-rates below the FEC limit and a low power penalty of 0.1dB compared to B2B characterization.

articleTitle: Broadband and boosted saturable absorption in free-standing carbon nanotube film
abstract: The saturable absorption in free-standing single-walled carbon nanotube film was studied both theoretically and in experiments. The absorption modulation depth at resonance wavelength 1375 nm was found to be as high as 30%. (e-mail: viatcheslav.vanyukov@uef.fi).

articleTitle: Spectral and Temporal Shaping of Spectrally Incoherent UV Pulses by Sum-Frequency Generation
abstract: We study via modeling and experiments the broadband sum-frequency generation of spectrally incoherent pulses from 1053 to 351 nm and demonstrate the generation of temporally and spectrally shaped ultraviolet pulses.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the validity of entangled two-photon absorption measurements in organic compounds
abstract: We present a study of entangled two-photon absorption (ETPA) in Rhodamine B and Zinc Tetraphenylporphirin, using different experimental schemes. Our results suggest that while photon-absorption takes place, it is not due to ETPA.

articleTitle: Noncontractible loop states in fractal-like photonic lattices with co-existing flatband point and plane degeneracy
abstract: We realize fractal-like photonic lattices, thereby demonstrating noncontractible loop states in a Corbino-shaped geometry as well as distinct compact localized states in a triangle-shaped geometry that possess both point (singular) and plane (nonsingular) flatband degeneracies.

articleTitle: Face-down Pumped Quantum Dot LEDs Novel Package
abstract: The PLQY of the novel face-down pumped package is increased 11.1% than that of the traditional face-up pumped package. However, the operation temperature of the face-down pumped structure has increased.

articleTitle: Phase noise reduction of a soliton microcomb with an auxiliary mode
abstract: We demonstrate a neat method to reduce the phase noise of a soliton microcomb caused by thermal fluctuation. It is realized by rendering the pump to simultaneously excite a slightly red-detuned auxiliary mode.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Ring Resonators Based on Subwavelength Grating Metamaterials
abstract: We demonstrate subwavelength grating metamaterial ring resonators on a silicon nitride platform. We report an internal Q factor of 2.11˖10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> and 1.48 dB/cm propagation loss at 1540 nm wavelength. We discuss the potential of these novel devices for applications in evanescent field sensing and light amplification.

articleTitle: Circulating Optical Delay Line Based on a Multi-Mode Converter
abstract: We propose a novel optical delay line utilizing multi-mode conversion to achieve three time longer delay. The three-mode recursive converter is realized via inverse design.

articleTitle: Second-order transient photo-induced reflectivity changes for retrieval of plasmonic nanostructures’ dynamics
abstract: By utilizing a novel experimental pump-probe method, we measure simultaneously the first- and second-order transient reflectivity in plasmonic nanostructures. We find that the additional information imposes strong constraints on the interpretation of the ultrafast dynamics.

articleTitle: Stretched pulse generation from a simple and novel PM-NPE linear fiber laser
abstract: Stretched pulses with 36.8-nm bandwidth are directly generated from a simple and novel linear fiber laser mode-locked by nonlinear polarization evolution in polarization-maintaining fibers, which is suitable for optical frequency comb applications.

articleTitle: Breathing Solitons in a Passively Harmonic Mode-Locked Fibre Laser
abstract: We report on the first experimental observation of breathing solitons in a passively harmonic mode-locked fibre laser. Various features of a 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-harmonic operation state showing breather oscillations with a period of 5 roundtrips are discussed.

articleTitle: Mie-resonant metaphotonics
abstract: We introduce the recently emerged field of Mie-resonant metaphotonics and discuss spatial and temporal control of light by employing multipolar electric and magnetic Mie resonances and the physics of bound states in the continuum.

articleTitle: Quantitative Measurement of Absolute Displacement of Surface Acoustic Wave with ~26 pm Axial Resolution Using Time-Division Dual-Comb Interferometry
abstract: We demonstrate a quantitative evaluation of absolute displacement of surface acoustic wave by the time-division dual-comb interferometry with the Sagnac geometry. Due to an ultrahigh stability of the Sagnac geometry, achieved resolution is ~26 pm.

articleTitle: Location resolved internal structure identification and defect detection in PIC chips with optical coherence domain reflectometer
abstract: We explore using a coherence domain reflectometry (OCDR) we developed to probe the inside of PIC chips. With clean and sharp reflection peaks having a spatial resolution down to 3 μm in Si, OCDR has the potential to detect and locate defects or anomalies inside PIC chips.

articleTitle: Bounds on the Coupling Strengths of Communication Channels and Their Information Capacities
abstract: We present a shape-independent bound on the coupling strengths of communication channels between two domains, which establishes the maximal number of effective channels and maximal information capacity between domains of any shape.

articleTitle: Photonic microwave synthesizer in microresonator-filtered fiber lasers
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic microwave synthesizer based on microresonator-filtered fiber lasers with two co-lasing laser frequencies. Low phase noise is achieved at 10.088 GHz due to common-mode noise suppression, comparable to the state-of-art.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Cluster States Using a Single Spin-photon Interface Coupled Strongly to an Intrinsic Nuclear Register
abstract: We propose the generation of multi-dimensional cluster states using a single, efficient spin-photon interface coupled strongly to a nuclear register. We show numerically that for SiV- in diamond a 2×5- sized cluster state is achievable.

articleTitle: Unifying cavity solitons and frequency combs in active and passive driven resonators
abstract: We introduce a generalized equation capturing the physics of frequency combs generated from active and passive cavities. This unification opens the possibility to control the morphogenesis of patterns such as Turing rolls and temporal solitons.

articleTitle: Entanglement-enhanced Optomechanical Sensing
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate entanglement-enhanced optomechanical sensing in which entangled optical probes jointly read out the displacements of two mechanical membranes, enabling enhanced force sensitivities and enlarged measurement bandwidths.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-Q packaged silica microrod cavity for microcomb generation
abstract: A packaged silica microrod cavity with greater than one billion Q factor is demonstrated. Based on this packaged device, a single soliton microcomb with repetition rate of 24 GHz is generated.

articleTitle: Exciton-Driven Ultrafast Enhancement of Quasiparticle Bandgap and Effective Mass in Monolayer MoS2
abstract: We report an ultrafast increase of the quasi-particle bandgap and effective mass in photoexcited monolayer MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> on HOPG, utilizing extreme-ultraviolet time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (XUV-trARPES). Combined with theoretical models, we attribute these compelling band renormalizations to the excitonic effects from bound electron-hole pairs.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Crosstalk Multiplexer for Neuromorphic Photonic Data Processing
abstract: Neuromorphic architectures aim for powering artificial intelligence algorithms energy efficiently. We fabricate a neuromorphic photonic circuit for matrix vector multiplications using phase change materials and integrate wavelength multiplexers with a crosstalk below -41 dB on-chip.

articleTitle: Influence of the In-Stretcher Beam Size on the Temporal Contrast of CPA Laser Systems
abstract: We demonstrate here, that for clever stretcher designs the dependency between beam size and the slow rising edge in the ps-scale, that is present in most CPA laser systems, can be used for contrast improvements.

articleTitle: Optical properties of silicon-rich silicon nitride for photonic integrated circuits
abstract: The optical properties of silicon-rich silicon nitride are analyzed for different compositions, obtained by varying the deposition parameters. Here we demonstrate how the bandgap, refractive index, and thermo-optic coefficient depends on the relative silicon composition.

articleTitle: Spontaneous parametric down-conversion in bottom-up grown lithium niobate microcubes
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of biphotons from a free-standing, bottom-up grown lithium niobate microcube at telecommunication wavelength through the spontaneous parametric down-conversion. The maximum biphoton rate obtained from a ~4 μm microcube is ~80 Hz.

articleTitle: Space-Time Supermodes: Propagation-Invariant Optical Fields in a Highly Multi-Moded Slab Waveguide
abstract: In contrast to conventional pulsed fields propagating in multimode waveguides that undergo erratic axial changes in their intensity distribution, we introduce propagation-invariant space-time supermodes, which are observed in a 168-micron-thick slab waveg-uide.

articleTitle: A Duplexed CTFBG with Broad Bandwidth for SRS Suppression in High Power Lasers
abstract: CTFBGs with different center wavelengths are cascaded to broad the bandwidth to 20 nm (FWHM). The homemade duplexed CTFBG assists a 20.88 kW output of single fiber laser system with 18.6 dB of SRS suppression.

articleTitle: Long-distance Pulse Propagation of 50 Uncoupled Fiber Modes due to Topological Confinement
abstract: We demonstrate unmixed pulse propagation of 50 modes over ~0.5km of a fiber with average mode purity ~18dB and loss ~4dB/km exploiting a phenomenon where light guides due to topological confinement rather than total internal reflection.

articleTitle: 32-fs Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:GdYCOB laser
abstract: We demonstrate a diode-pumped Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:GdYCOB laser delivering 32-fs pulses at 1052.4 nm with an average power of 51 mW. The maximum average output power is scaled to 189 mW for 35-fs pulses.

articleTitle: Large-scale synthetic frequency dimension optical computing using integrated acousto-optic modulator
abstract: We show the large-scale, complex-valued matrix-vector multiplications on synthetic frequency lattices with an ultra-efficient, silicon-based cavity acousto-optic modulator. With the strong electro-optomechanical coupling, we achieve, full-range phase-coherent frequency conversions in a single modulator.Comments and questions should be directed to the Optica Conference Papers staff (tel: +1 202.416.6191, e-mail: cstech@optica.org).

articleTitle: Motion recording via the Fourier-phase camera
abstract: An original motion recording framework is proposed, which records dynamic scene through the Fourier-phase and a sharp image. Pixel-wise motion-offsets are inferred through the trained Phase-net, and guide the video reconstruction from a static image.

articleTitle: Colorimetric Metasurfaces for Quantitative, On-Chip Tissue Diagnostics
abstract: We leverage the unique properties of anisotropic, colorimetric metasurfaces to selectively visualize disease-relevant fiber density and orientation in biological tissue, paving the way toward rapid, precise and low-cost diagnostics ranging from cancer to neurodegenerative disease.

articleTitle: Quantum Holograms with Quantum Metasurfaces
abstract: We develop quantum holograms by analyzing the light scattered from quantum metasurfaces made out of strongly interacting atoms for applications such as the non-destructive probing of many-body atomic state dynamics.

articleTitle: Scalable Ultralow Latency Photonic Tensor Processor
abstract: We propose a photonic processor with the potential to compute deep neural network layer outputs in ∼10 ns. Our proof-of-concept experiments show low loss of classification accuracy on the MNIST dataset; we investigate fundamental throughput limits.

articleTitle: Terahertz conductivity of nanograined bulk Bi2Te3
abstract: Nanograined Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> offers a large surface-to-volume ratio, making it an interesting material to employ the high mobility surface states for devices. We present THz spectroscopic measurements to reveal the role of the surface carriers.

articleTitle: 4-GW Few-Cycle Visible Pulse Generation via Fiber Mode Mixing
abstract: Starting from 175-fs-long pulses at 1035 nm, we directly generate 20 µJ, 4.6 fs visible pulses through the nonlinear mixing between the spatial modes of a 3-m-long Ar-filled hollow-core fiber, without any pulse post-compression.

articleTitle: Self-seeded XFEL for Science Applications
abstract: PAL-XFEL achieved the highest spectral intensity of XFEL using the self-seeding scheme. We demonstrated that the self-seeded FEL with higher reproducibility and cleaner spectrum enables a superior multiplicity of data to the SASE FEL for the serial femtosecond crystallography. Time-resolved X-ray absorption spectroscopy using the self-seeded FEL is under study. Comments and questions should be directed to the Optica Conference Papers staff (tel: +1 202.416.6191, e-mail: cstech@optica.org).

articleTitle: Free-Electron Triggered Superfluorescence for Resolving Collective Optical Properties of Quantum Materials
abstract: We present the first observation of superfluorescence triggered by free electrons, shown for superlattices of lead-halide perovskite quantum dots. By controlling the excitation area, the emission is switched between spontaneous to superfluorescence emission.

articleTitle: Physics-informed Neural Network for Forecasting Time-domain Signals in Terahertz Resonances
abstract: We present a physics-informed recurrent neural network to precisely forecast long time-domain signals from a wide range of terahertz resonance features using short input signals. This can accelerate the discovery of new physical phenomena.

articleTitle: Low-Loss, Narrowband Integrated Si3N4 Pulse Shaper for Quantum Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an optical pulse shaper in silicon nitride with spectral resolution on the order of a few GHz and line-by-line phase control for potential applications in quantum communications and networking.

articleTitle: Polarization splitting dual-band grating coupler for wavelength multiplexing at 1310 nm and 1550 nm
abstract: We propose a polarization splitting dual-band grating coupler with minimum losses of 2.80 dB and 4.62 dB at O and C-band. The fabricated device has maximum coupling efficiencies of -4.70 dB and -8.45 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Imaging at the Camera Noise Floor
abstract: We present a homodyne imaging system capable of imaging an object under a level of illumination comparable to the noise floor of the detector.

articleTitle: Topological Protection of Supercontinuum Generation
abstract: We demonstrate a topologically protected supercontinuum generation process based on lithium niobate valley photonic crystals. Simulation results show that this structure can achieve full coverage topological protection of the supercontinuum spectrum.

articleTitle: Superscattering empowered by the physics of bound states in the continuum
abstract: We propose and verify experimentally a novel mechanism for achieving superscattering from subwavelength dielectric resonators empowered by the physics of bound states in the continuum.

articleTitle: Generation of Different Polarization States Simultaneously with a Metasurface for On-Chip Quantum Information Technology
abstract: Manipulating the polarization state of light is essential for on-chip photonics and quantum information processing. We demonstrate the generation of different polarization states via a single metasurface based on geometrical-scaling-induced phase modulations.

articleTitle: Low-Threshold Lasing in GeSnOI Microdisk Lasers with Reduced Defect Density
abstract: We report optically pumped low-threshold lasing in GeSnOI microdisk lasers with reduced defect density. The measured lasing threshold of 17 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was 10 times lower than that of the control sample containing highly defective interfaces.

articleTitle: Bayesian Optical Heterodyne Tomography
abstract: We introduce a complete workflow for Bayesian quantum state tomography of generic continuous-variable states. We also summarize experimental results applying this workflow to the tomographic reconstruction of thermal and coherent states of light.

articleTitle: Nonlinear behavior of InP-on-insulator waveguide at 2-μm wavelength range
abstract: We develop a low-loss (0.7 dB/cm) InP-on-insulator waveguide at 2-μm-wavelength range. A large nonlinear parameter of 270 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is obtained with suppressing two-photon absorption. We also demonstrate over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> quality factors of ring resonators.

articleTitle: Attosecond Science at ELI Scale
abstract: ELI-ALPS facility supports laser based fundamental and applied research at extreme short timescales, operating specialized lasers which drive nonlinear frequency conversion and acceleration processes. The attosecond beamlines based on advanced HHG techniques will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Hot Carrier Photodection In Graphene Coupled To a Plasmonc Grating Via 1D Electrodes
abstract: We show here how encapsulated graphene devices can be laterally coupled to plasmonic gratings, preserving the ultra-high mobility of encapsulated graphene, while still enhancing its optical coupling. Our device also works as a bolometric photodetector.

articleTitle: Sync-Pumped Femtosecond OPO Based on Dispersion-Engineered Nanophotonic PPLN with 3-Octave Spectrum
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-high-gain sync-pumped OPO using a dispersion-engineered lithium niobate nanowaveguide in a free-space cavity with minimal spectral dependence. It generates a three-octave-wide spectrum from visible to mid-IR with only 4.5 pJ of pump.

articleTitle: Probabilistically Constellation Shaped Kramers-Kronig Detection Enabling Reduced CSPR Condition
abstract: We propose to relax the requirement of carrier-to-signal power ratio in Kramers-Kronig receiver by probabilistically shaping the constellation to avoid destroying minimum phase condition. About 1.5-dB reduction in optimal carrier-to-signal power ratio are observed.

articleTitle: Polarization multiplexed dissipative Kerr solitons in an on-chip micro-resonator
abstract: We demonstrate polarization multiplexed dissipative cavity solitons in an on-chip silicon nitride micro-resonator, and analyze the evidences and reasons of the weak mutual interaction between orthogonally polarized soliton microcombs.

articleTitle: On-chip Multi variant COVID 19 detector From silicon nitride double-ring resonators
abstract: We report a label free, rapid and reliable bio-sensor for SARS-CoV-2(COVID-19), consisting of Silicon-Nitride Double-micro-ring-resonator (DMRR) with surface functionalization. Minimum detected concentration of ~ 10 cp/µL and sensitivity of 743 nm/RIU were achieved.

articleTitle: Fully integrated multipurpose microwave frequency identification system on a single chip
abstract: We demonstrate a multipurpose microwave frequency identification system on siliconon-insulator platform. The chip is able to identify different types of microwave signals, as well as discriminates instantaneous frequency variation thanks to its multipurpose features.

articleTitle: Managing Mode-Partition Noise of SMF/MMF Coupled 850-nm Few-Mode VCSEL
abstract: Relative-intensity and mode-partition noises of 850-nm few-mode VCSEL manipulated by using different lensed SMF/MMF coupling schemes are performed to optimize the transmission performance.

articleTitle: Ultrashort Pulse Laser-Induced Defects Underneath Undamaged Surface Region in ß-Gallium Oxide
abstract: We present results of 100-fs, 1030nm laser damage in single crystal n-type ß-gallium oxide, a wide-bandgap semiconductor. KPFM (Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy) and cathodoluminescence analysis reveals laser-induced defects that are undetectable by atomic force/optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Monolithic KTP Raman Oscillator as a Supercontinuum Source
abstract: We report generation of octave-spanning supercontinuum from a high-gain, ultra-broadband, and mirrorless Raman oscillator in a monolithic KTP crystal. The supercontinuum output contains two spectral groups between 540~750 and 1095~1800 nm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulses tunable in 800-1650 nm via SPM-enabled spectral selection pumped by dual-color fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate a four-color ultrafast source based on SPM-enabled spectral selection driven by a dual-color fiber laser. The resulting source delivers femtosecond pulses tunable in 800-1650 nm, which exceeds one octave.

articleTitle: Sensitive Optoelectronic Detection of Small Molecules Using Metal Nanoparticle Readers
abstract: We demonstrate a highly sensitive plasmonic nanoparticle-based assay for optoelectronic detection of small molecules using a portable optoelectronic readout system, achieving ~100 pM detection limit of cannabidiol with high specificity.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of topological parametric phonon lasers
abstract: We experimentally realized the first topological parametric phonon lasers based on nonlinear nanoelectromechanical Dirac-vortex cavities with strong squeezed interaction, which represent an important advance in nonlinear topological physics.

articleTitle: Start-to-End Software Model: Engineering and Reverse-Engineering Laser Systems
abstract: A full start-to-end (S2E) software model of a laser system – including oscillator, amplifier, stretcher/compressor, pulse shaper, and non-linear conversion – can be essential in choosing the hardware design and establishing limitations on what can be accomplished given a specific hardware setup. Furthermore, such S2E models can even allow one to reverse engineer a laser system should it be necessary for characterization. Here, we present a generalized S2E model of a photoinjector laser system, currently targeted for X-ray Free-Electron Lasers but which can readily be adapted to any broadly defined laser system.

articleTitle: Ultra-High-Resolution Beam Steering using Non-Redundant Optical Phased Array
abstract: We demonstrate beam steering with ~19,000 resolvable points using a silicon photonic phased-array chip with only 127 phase shifters. The spatial resolution is enhanced drastically by using the non-redundant-array concept to define antenna positions.

articleTitle: Photon Trapping for Increased Efficiency of Cascaded Downconversion
abstract: Cascaded spontaneous parametric downconversion is used to produce entangled photon triplets, although poor efficiency limits rates. As a solution, we propose trapping photons in an active cavity, giving them many chances at downconversion.

articleTitle: Multiphysics Modeling of Grating Chips for Magneto-Optical Trapping of Atoms
abstract: We present a modeling method that incorporates full-wave electromagnetic simulations and radiation force calculations to evaluate the performance of grating chips for compact megneto-optical traps (MOTs).

articleTitle: Simulating Graphene Dynamics in a Synthetic Honeycomb Lattice with the Frequency Dimension
abstract: We propose simulating multiple graphene dynamics in a synthetic honeycomb lattice including the frequency dimension of light, with parameters flexibly controlled by external modulations, which shows the capability for complex functionalities and future quantum simulations.

articleTitle: Quantum information processing of spatially entangled photons with a programmable light converter
abstract: We demonstrate a reconfigurable and scalable processor of entangled photons based on multi-plane light conversion and perform key tasks of quantum information processing including high-dimensional entanglement certification, arbitrary state transformations, and mode conversion.

articleTitle: Chiral Sensing with Semiconductor Nanophotonics
abstract: Detecting molecular chirality is crucial in biochemistry. It is, however, limited by low sensitivity at low concentrations. I will discuss our progress to push the limits of chiral sensing by exploiting semiconductor nanophotonics.

articleTitle: Chip-Scale Optical Frequency Comb Sources: Light sources for Massively Parallel Communications, Fast Optical Ranging, and Ultra-Broadband Signal Processing
abstract: Chip-scale optical frequency combs have emerged as novel light sources for miniaturized optical systems, offering the potential to disrupt a wide range of applications. In this talk, we will give an overview on our recent progress in exploiting such devices for massively parallel wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM), ultra-fast distance metrology, and ultra-broadband signal processing.

articleTitle: Optical Beam Control Based on Variable Focus Lenses for WDM FSO Communications
abstract: We review the recent research activities on optical beam control for pointing, acquisition, and tracking in free-space optical communications (FSOCs). Also, we explore the possibility of using variable focus lens-based beam control for wavelength-division-multiplexed FSOCs.

articleTitle: Broadband, Programmable Phototransistor using Black Phosphorus
abstract: Black phosphorus is promising for its electrostatic tunability of optical and electronic properties. We engineered a charge storage layer for non-volatile tuning of the BP-channel and demonstrated programmable electric-conductivities and photo-responsivities for optoelectronic in-memory computing.

articleTitle: Realization of Resonant Optical Metasurfaces with Maximal and Tunable Chiral Response
abstract: We employ the physics of chiral bound state in the continuum and suggest planar chiral metasurfaces with near-perfect circular dichroism (CD). We demonstrate experimentally metasurfaces with CD=0.9 with Q factor exceeding Q=390 at optical frequencies.

articleTitle: Mitigating Anomalous Sub-Megahertz Frequency Response of Electro-Optic Phase Modulators in X-cut Lithium Niobate on Insulator
abstract: We report anomalous sub-MHz frequency response of electro-optic (EO) phase modulators in X-cut lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) and demonstrate improved response via careful preparation of the LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/metal interface and high temperature annealing in forming gas.

articleTitle: Nontrivial corner states in breathing Kagome lattices with bearded edge truncation
abstract: We report two types of distinct corner states in breathing Kagome lattices with bearded edge truncation. One type exists only in the topologically nontrivial regime, while the other preserves in both trivial and nontrivial regimes.

articleTitle: Low-loss lithium niobate integrated photonics with tight optical confinement
abstract: We demonstrate a strip waveguide-based LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> photonic integrated circuit fabricated with a hard mask approach. The steep sidewall configuration exhibits tight optical confinement and dispersion control while preserving ultra-low loss of <0.1 dB/cm

articleTitle: Indirect Measurement of LP01 Effective Area Reduction in Bent Large-Core Step-Index Fibres Using Raman Scattering
abstract: We present an indirect measurement, using stimulated Raman scattering (SRS), of the fundamental mode effective area in several bent large-core step-index passive fibres used for industrial high-power high-brightness beam delivery. The increase of the SRS gain in bent fibres can lessen the benefit of such large-core fibres.

articleTitle: Spatial and temporally controlled Log-Spiral optical beams
abstract: Experimental results are presented for a high-speed ultrashort pulsed system utilizing a geometrical optical transform with an acousto-optical device for the generation of single and coherent combinations of logarithmic spiral beams containing OAM.

articleTitle: Steady-state dissipative Kerr soliton with a 30 GHz existence window in a microresonator pumped by a step-tuned laser
abstract: We demonstrate the steady-state dissipative Kerr soliton with a 33-GHz single-soliton step and a 30-GHz existence window, by tuning the pump laser at an adiabatic scanning speed (1nm/s) and with step mode, respectively.

articleTitle: 10 PW peak power femtosecond laser pulses at ELI-NP
abstract: We report on the generation and delivery of 10 PW peak power laser pulses, using the High Power Laser System (HPLS) at the Extreme Light Infrastructure – Nuclear Physics (ELI-NP).

articleTitle: 1T-TaS2 based dynamically tunable plasmonic metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate a dynamically tunable plasmonic metasurface enabled by light-tunable optical constants of a quantum material - 1T-TaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. We observe a relative reflectance change of 10% under low-intensity incoherent illumination.

articleTitle: Active Spintronic-metasurface Terahertz Emitters with Tunable Chirality
abstract: In this work, we propose a novel spintronic-metasurface terahertz emitter for the generation and manipulation of coherent broadband terahertz waves. The ellipticity of the chiral terahertz waves can reach >0.75 over the entire 1-5 THz broadband and the polarization state can be easily controlled by an external magnetic field.

articleTitle: 3D-Printed Facet-Attached Optical Elements for Beam Shaping in Solid-State Phased Arrays
abstract: We demonstrate solid-state optical phased arrays exploiting 3D-printed facet-attached freeform elements for shaping and deflection of an edge-emitted beam to a surface-normal direction. The concept opens an attractive alternative to widely used grating structures.

articleTitle: Enhanced Brillouin-based Fast Light via Rayleigh-scattered Random Lasing Oscillation in Half-open Linear Cavity
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated Brillouin-induced fast light based on Rayleigh scattering-assisted half-open random lasing oscillation along kilometers optical fibers, providing enhanced all-optical manipulation of light group velocity.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Orbital Corner States in Higher-order Photonic Topological Insulators
abstract: We report higher-order orbital corner states in two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) photonic lattices, representing an orbital HOTI model. With appropriately shaped input beams, we explore orbital corner excitations in topologically nontrivial and trivial regimes.

articleTitle: Simulation of an EOT Based 1D-Plasmonic Metasurface Sensor for Absorptive Analytes
abstract: Simulation and optimization of extra-ordinary transmission from 1D-plasmonic metasurfaces was performed for near-infrared spectral range and utilized to sense absorptive analytes. Optimal metasurfaces could achieve spectral-sensitivity of 1539 nm/RIU and transmittance-sensitivity of 426 %/ RIU.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband mid-infrared generation in dispersion-engineered thin-film lithium niobate
abstract: We demonstrate efficient m id-infrared d ifference-frequency g eneration in dispersion-engineered thin-film lithium niobate ridge waveguides on sapphire. These uniformly poled devices achieve phase-matching bandwidths in excess of a micron, and rapid phase-matching peak tuning with temperature.

articleTitle: THz PHASR scanner with 2.6 kHz ECOPS trace acquisition rate and longer than 75 picosecond time-domain sampling
abstract: We report on our fast THz PHASR scanner capable of achieving time-domain measurements at a 2600 trace/second rate over a 75-picosecond sampling window by operating ECOPS technique using ASOPS hardware. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The electrical and optical properties of micro-scale deep-ultraviolet light-emitting diodes
abstract: The electrical and optical properties of micro-scale deep-ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (LEDs) were investigated. We found that the smaller micro-LEDs deliver higher output power density and exhibit higher external quantum efficiency. Moreover, it has been found that the inclined sidewall can enhance light extraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Reduction of Noise in a Passively Harmonic Mode-locked Fiber Laser by Optimizing Cavity Length
abstract: We present the reduction of noise in a passively harmonic mode-locked fiber laser by optimizing cavity length. Experimental observation and measurement suggested that the noise could be induced by guided acoustic-wave Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: Dependence of a direct THz driven Stark effect on the energy band alignment in heterostructure Quantum Dots
abstract: We report on direct ultrafast electro-absorption switching in colloidal CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots driven by intense THz pulses without a field enhancing structure, and suggest a route to optimize electro-absorption modulators with respect to the energy band alignment of the heterostructure material.

articleTitle: Fully Integrated On-Chip Ring Resonator Spectrometer Based on Compressed Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a compact on chip spectrometer with built-in detectors, 512 spectral channels and bandwidth of 51.2nm. Compressed sensing is used for spectrum reconstruction to minimize the chip size.

articleTitle: High Power Ultrafast laser for High Brightness X-ray source
abstract: We report on a stable 74mJ 1kHz ultrafast Yb laser dedicated for a high-brightness X-ray source based on plasma generation. Preliminary results on the X-ray source are presented using 25mJ and 100Hz.

articleTitle: Non-Perturbative Harmonic Generation in ZnO Driven by a Few-Cycle, 100 MHz Er:fiber Frequency Comb
abstract: Using a few-cycle 100 MHz Er:fiber comb, we demonstrate solid state harmonic generation in ZnO yielding broadband spectra from 200-650 nm. Sensitivity to the driving pulse carrier envelope phase is demonstrated across the spectrum.

articleTitle: All optical switching in a silicon nonlinear Fano resonator
abstract: We present a low-power optically-controlled transmission switch realized with inverse-designed silicon photonic circuits, based on time-reversal-symmetric nonlinear response and geometrical asymmetry in a Fano resonator.

articleTitle: Ultrafast infrared nano-thermometry: imaging thermal transport at semiconducting heterointerfaces
abstract: We perform ultrafast pump-probe nano-spectroscopic imaging of WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> interfaces. From transient phonon softening as a local probe of substrate temperature, we resolve heterogeneity in ps thermalization and quantify interfacial boundary conductance.

articleTitle: Quantum Emission into Synthetic Dimensions
abstract: We study the emission of a quantum source in a cavity that supports a synthetic lattice of modes. The modal lattice dynamics causes unidirectional frequency shift that has no counterpart in spatial structures.

articleTitle: Space-Time Superoscillations in Structured Light Pulses
abstract: We show that band-limited light fields exhibit superoscillations simultaneously in space and time, which oscillate faster that the highest harmonics of their spatial and temporal frequency spectra, and verify such behavior in supertoroidal structured pulses.

articleTitle: Autonomous and Self-correcting Laser Subtractive Patterning Using Reinforcement Learning
abstract: A novel subtractive laser patterning approach, actuated by reinforcement learning-controlled motorized XYZ stages, enables path-planning for quasi-arbitrary target patterns and an ability to supervise the machining process and perform self-correction following inadvertent pulse misfires.

articleTitle: Deterministic Creation of Tunable Single Photon Emitters in Bilayer WSe2
abstract: Single photon emitters are deterministically created in homobilayer WSe2 by strain engineering. These emitters are highly tunable in energy by the electric field.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical properties of thin-film EuS at room temperature
abstract: We report on the magneto-optical properties of thin-film EuS characterized at room temperature. The Verdet constant of EuS is one order of magnitude higher than the commonly used Terbium Gallium Garnet (TGG) crystal.

articleTitle: 80-channel WDM-MDM communication link utilizing a Photonic Crystal Resonator and Inverse-Designed Mode-Division Multiplexers
abstract: We demonstrate a 80-channel communication link with >150 Gbps error-free data transmission utilizing Photonic Crystal Resonator (PhCR) with normal dispersion as a comb source. We utilize a 4-channel inverse-designed mode-division multiplexer to increase data rates.

articleTitle: Quantum Interference between Integrated and Independently Controlled Quantum Dots
abstract: We realize a quantum photonic circuit enabling the resonant excitation of multiple quantum emitters. Using independent electrical control, we demonstrate quantum interference between two embedded quantum dots in a single device. Our result represents a crucial step towards on-chip multi-photon generation for quantum information applications.

articleTitle: Light-Induced Density Shockwave Interaction in Opaque Nanosuspension
abstract: We study experimentally and theoretically the interactions between two optically- induced density shockwaves in colloidal nanosuspensions, and find interaction features of annihilation, merging, and domain walls formation, determined by the shock fronts and the proximities between shockwaves.

articleTitle: Black Silicon Photodetector with Broadband Spectral Photoresponsivity and High Gain by Ti-hyperdoping
abstract: Ti-hyperdoped black silicon photodetector is prepared by femtosecond laser irradiation, which exhibits high comprehensive properties with broadband spectral photoresponsivity and high gain, showing great potential in high-performance imaging and large-scale optoelectronic integration.

articleTitle: Low insertion loss, graphene-based platform for loss modulation
abstract: We show low insertion loss platform based on loss modulation of hybrid SiN/graphene structure. We measure an intrinsic quality factor of 80,000 in a ring resonator based device when the graphene is in its high loss state.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical gain modulation: a novel method to generate highly-coherent femtosecond pulses
abstract: We report a new method to transform continuous-wave single frequency laser into femtosecond pulses by nonlinear optical gain modulation, opening a new possibility to obtain highly-coherent pulses with flexible wavelength.

articleTitle: Laser Fabrication of Holograms on Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymers
abstract: We report for the first time to our knowledge laser fabrication and reconstruction of holograms on Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymers using an industrial UV laser source.

articleTitle: Dye-doped polymer based optical fiber transducer for PA-US dual-modality imaging
abstract: A dye-doped polymer based optical fiber transducer is demonstrated for PA-US dual-modality imaging, which exhibits an ultrasound generation efficiency of 0.064MPa mJ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with a bandwidth of 33.5MHz as well as an optical transmittance of 83.1%.

articleTitle: Diffraction-Free Propagating Electromagnetic Skyrmions
abstract: We report on a family of diffraction-free toroidal light pulses, exhibiting propagation-robust skyrmionic topologies that persist over arbitrary distances.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric control of spin quantum memories in a cryogenic programmable photonic circuit platform
abstract: We demonstrate piezoelectric strain control of diamond tin vacancy defects in cryogenic photonic integrated circuits fabricated in a 200 mm CMOS platform, enabling frequency tuning and control bandwidth above 20 GHz and 2 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Submegahertz spectral width photon-pair source based on fused silica microspheres
abstract: We demonstrate, and characterize, a photon-pair source based on the process of spontaneous four wave mixing in fused-silica microspheres, with single heralded photon bandwidths down to 366kHz [1].

articleTitle: Topologically Protected Entanglement Emitters
abstract: We report topologically-protected entanglement emitters, that emit topological Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen state and multiphoton entangled state from a plug-and-play silicon-photonic chip in ambient conditions. The device emulating a photonic anomalous Floquet insulator allows the generation of four-photon topological entangled states at nontrivial edge modes.

articleTitle: Super Agile High Resolution Spectrum Analyzer by Sampled Heterodyne System
abstract: We demonstrated a sampled heterodyne system that enables wide-bandwidth and high- resolution spectrum measurement with agile scanning despite of using a low-speed DSP. 5-GHz high-bandwidth spectral measurement with 0.006-pm resolution, 0.01-ms scanning speed was achieved.

articleTitle: Sub parts-per-billion detection of ethane in a 30-meters long mid-IR Antiresonant Hollow-Core Fiber
abstract: In this work we report on Wavelength Modulation Spectroscopy of ethane with sub parts-per-billion detection limit in the mid-IR spectral band aided with a 30-meters long self-fabricated all-silica Antiresonant Hollow-Core Fiber-based absorption cell.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low-Power Unitary Matrix Multiplier Based on Silicon Photonic MEMS
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an ultra-low-power 3×3 unitary matrix multiplier with MEMS-based tunable couplers and phase shifters. The static power consumption and tuning energy per tuning element are less than 0.13 µW and 115 pJ, respectively.

articleTitle: Tailoring the Spectral Response of Multilayered Chiral Mid-Infrared Metamaterials
abstract: A simulation and experimental study of multilayered chiral metamaterial stacks, optically active in the important mid-IR region of the spectrum. We demonstrate the ability to tune the spectral response based on layer configuration.

articleTitle: High resolution fiber grating dynamic strain sensor with broadband light
abstract: A fiber grating strain sensing system based on self-reference mechanism was developed. The resolution is $34.6{\text{p}}\varepsilon /\sqrt {{\text{Hz}}}$ at 1kHz, which is several orders of magnitud better than traditional FBG systems.

articleTitle: Self-pulsing and chaos in nonlinear photonic dimers
abstract: We study the dynamics emerging in the photonic driven dissipative Bose-Hubbard model describing two coupled Kerr cavities. By bifurcation analysis we identify rich dynamics, including oscillatory states, chaotic dynamics as well as spikes.

articleTitle: Characterization of exhaled e-cigarette aerosols in a vape shop using a field-portable holographic on-chip microscope
abstract: Field experiments measuring the volatility of e-cig generated aerosols using a deep learning-enabled portable holographic microscope were conducted in a vape shop, showing a link between e-cig usage and the volatility of aerosols.

articleTitle: Terahertz Metasurfaces Prototyping Using Low-Cost Hot Stamping
abstract: A rapid and low-cost prototyping technique to fabricate terahertz metallic metasurfaces is presented. Arrays of split-ring resonators, wire-grid polarizers and polarizing beam splitters are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Imaging Biophotonic Lasing Network in Optical Microresonators
abstract: The concept of biophotonic lasing network is demonstrated by confining self-assembled amyloid fibril network in a Fabry-Perot cavity. Complex lasing dynamics were interpreted into a graph, revealing the optical connection in biological network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methane and Carbon Dioxide Plasmas with Supercontinuum-based Fourier Transform Spectroscopy
abstract: We present the results of a home-built Fourier transform spectrometer based on mid-infrared supercontinuum sources for analysis of the species inside methane and carbon dioxide plasmas and the products formed in the outflow.

articleTitle: Single-Mode Laser Diode Pumped Single-Cavity Yb:KYW Dual-Comb Laser in a MOPA Architecture
abstract: We present a single-mode-diode pumped polarization-multiplexed Yb:KYW dual-comb laser combined with an Ytterbium-doped fiber-amplifier resulting in 1.1 W output power per comb. We characterize the influence of the amplifier on amplitude and timing noise properties.

articleTitle: A femtosecond laser two-photon polymerization for generation of Mathieu-Gauss beams
abstract: Ultra-compact Mathieu phase plates were fabricated using femtosecond laser-induced two-photon polymerization. The generated Mathieu-Gauss beam shows good quality and is propagation-invariant up to 800 mm.

articleTitle: Spin/Orbit Conversion in Dichroic Spherulite for Optical Vector Vortices Generation
abstract: Using a naturally existed circular anisotropy from spherulites, we obtain cylindrical vector optical vortex beams through the spin/orbit conversion. This strategy provides promising opportunities for the spherulite applications in structured light fields.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Lidar for Industrial Process Analysis
abstract: We report real-time simultaneous measurement of average water vapor temperature and concentration in a full-scale industrial boiler, and further map the concentration profile in the boiler, by a broadband lidar employing a custom supercontinuum source.

articleTitle: Generating tripartite entanglement via spatial overlap of identical particles
abstract: We report experimental generation of all the genuine three-party entangled states, i.e., GHZ and W states, of identical particles via spatial overlap. It shows that the indistinguishability is crucial for generating entanglement of identical particles.

articleTitle: Quantum-Inspired Superresolution for Multiple Incoherent Optical Point Sources
abstract: We report a superresolution experiment based on SPLICE. We observe a worst-case error 41 times below the diffraction limit with two sources and > 24 dB signal-to-noise ratios for semiparametric estimation with multiple sources.

articleTitle: A Floquet Topological Phase Induced by PT-symmetry in 2D Photonic Lattices
abstract: We show that a judicious modulation of gain and loss can generate a non-trivial topological phase in a honeycomb photonic lattice, demonstrating unidirectional edge states with real eigenvalues.

articleTitle: All-optical Kerr Polarization Controller
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical polarization controller in a high-finesse Fabry-Pérot microresonator. Kerr-nonlinearity-induced symmetry breaking splits linear polarized input light into left- and right-circular polarized components, enabling all-optical polarization control with mW-level threshold.

articleTitle: Propagation-Invariant Two-Photon Coincidence Patterns Induced by Polarization-Mediated Artificial Gauge Fields
abstract: We construct artificial gauge fields in waveguide lattices with customized birefringence and experimentally demonstrate that, for a net phase of π, two-photon interference patterns remain static during photon propagation in square lattices.

articleTitle: Method for Building kW-class Lasers with kHz-class Linewidths
abstract: Binary phase shift key phase-modulated waveforms with GHz bandwidths, suitable for use in kW-class fiber amplifiers, can be narrowed back to the source laser’s linewidth via second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Real-time imaging of mid-range LiDAR using single-chip beam scanner
abstract: We demonstrate light-detection and ranging (LiDAR) operation detection ranges up to 30 m, 20 fps using fully integrated silicon photonic optical phased array with sparsely arranged semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs), for the first time.

articleTitle: High-Speed Compressive Spectroscopy at 3.3 µm by Spectral Shaping with a Digital Micromirror Device
abstract: We demonstrate compressive spectroscopy at 3.3 µm by projecting a sparse set of spectra shaped by a digital micromirror device. Acquisition at 280 Hz is achieved. Reconstructed spectroscopy shows good agreement with ground truth measurements.

articleTitle: Two-Mode Photon-Number Correlations Created by Measurement-Induced Nonlinearity
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally complex correlations in the photon numbers of two-mode quantum states using measurement-induced nonlinearity. For this, we combine the interference of coherent states and single photons with photon subtraction.

articleTitle: Quantitative particle agglutination assay using mobile holographic imaging and neural networks
abstract: A quantitative particle agglutination assay using mobile holography and neural networks is demonstrated to rapidly and accurately measure C-reactive protein (CRP) concentration in human serum samples.

articleTitle: Nonvolatile electrically controllable broadband switches based on phase-change material GST
abstract: In this work, we report a nonvolatile electrically programmable broadband silicon photonic switch based on phase-change materials Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> with compact coupling length (50 µm), small crosstalk (<-8 dB) across the entire telecommunication C-band, and record-high endurance (>2,800 cycles).

articleTitle: Reinforcement Corrosion Detection by Using Fiber Bragg Grating based Sensors
abstract: The corrosion effect on the steel bar in reinforced concrete is one of the major issues for the durability of concrete throughout the world. The service life of each type of building structure is severely damaged by reinforcement corrosion, which results in billions of dollars annually in repair and maintenance. Therefore, evaluating and monitoring the corrosion of steel bars embedded in reinforced concrete in terms of safety and maintenance is the main theme of this paper. The rust layer initiated on steel bars causes expansion and concrete cracking of cover due to swelling pressure (tensile stress) inside the concrete. The loss of bond and cross-section results in the loss or destruction of load sustaining and defraying capacity of the corroding structural members.

articleTitle: Cryogenic O-band photoluminescence spectroscopy of T-centers in monolithic Si for mesoscopic cavity quantum electrodynamics
abstract: We examine the 1325-nm T-center excitonic transitions in FZ-Si and SOI substrates towards a chip-scale strongly-coupled spin-photon interface. We further observe an unidentified doublet transition around 1312-nm in FZ-Si as a possible single-photon emitter.

articleTitle: Topological Polarized Laser Solitons
abstract: We present results of analytical and numerical analysis of spatial solitons with polarization singularities in wide-aperture surface-emitting semiconductor lasers with saturable absorption. Singularities includes C-points with circular polarization and L-lines with linear polarization.

articleTitle: Field-resolved high-order nonlinearities in a free-running terahertz quantum cascade laser
abstract: Two-dimensional terahertz strong-field spectroscopy reveals wave-mixing processes up to eighth order in a free-running quantum cascade laser, unravelling its sub-cycle gain dynamics and nonlinearities in a regime of negative absorption.

articleTitle: Active Thermal Tuning of a Soliton Frequency Comb in a Crystalline Optical Microresonator
abstract: We report the thermal tuning of a Kerr soliton frequency comb in an ultrahigh-Q magnesium fluoride crystalline microresonator yielding broad pump frequency tuning of up to ~ 50 GHz and a repetition rate of ~ 6 MHz.

articleTitle: Nested Spontaneous Symmetry Breakings of Light in Kerr Ring Resonators
abstract: We show multiple nested spontaneous symmetry breakings in a ring resonator with two counter-propagating light waves. The results could be of interest for telecom sys-tems, nonlinear polarization control, soliton frequency combs, and all-optical oscillators.

articleTitle: Semicircular Dielectric Gratings for Strongly Polarized and Enhanced Emission from InAs Quantum Dots
