abstract: We demonstrate ~100-fold collection enhancements and strongly polarized emission from single InAs quantum dots in anisotropic semicircular dielectric grating optical cavities. In contrast to previous works, our cavities are on bulk substrates (i.e., not suspended).

articleTitle: SOA-based all-optical neuron with reconfigurable nonlinear activation functions
abstract: We propose an all-optical neuron based on the self-induced polarization rotation in a semiconductor optical amplifier, which achieves reconfigurable nonlinear activation functions by tuning the initial state of polarization of input signal.

articleTitle: Electro-optical Dual-Comb Cavity Ring-Down, Mode Width and Mode Dispersion Spectroscopy
abstract: A versatile new spectroscopy approach is demonstrated combining the advantages of dual-comb spectroscopy with the sensitivity of cavity-enhanced techniques. A comprehensive theoretical framework and experimental demonstrations are presented, underlining the large potential of the techniques.

articleTitle: Third Order Parametric Oscillations in a Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Comb
abstract: A frequency comb in a quantum cascade laser can appear with two distinct spectral lobes. These two spectral features are switching in time and show strong anticorrelations similarly to parametric phenomena.

articleTitle: Generation of spatial photon entanglement from lithium niobate nonlocal metasurfaces
abstract: We propose and demonstrate experimentally, for the first time to our knowledge, that strongly enhanced generation of spatially entangled photon pairs can be achieved from metasurfaces supporting nonlocal double resonances at the signal and idler wavelengths.

articleTitle: Beyond 100Gb/s from a single silicon MZI modulator
abstract: We discuss co-design of electronics and photonics, in order to achieve optimal performance of a silicon photonics transmitter. This will include our recent work to enable performance beyond 100Gb/s OOK from a single Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: Optimization and manipulation of quantum-dot-based single-photon sources by 3D polymeric photonic structures
abstract: We report on optimization and manipulation of optical properties of CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum-dot single-photon emitters by placing them in polymer photonic structures using a low-cost technique called low one-photon absorption direct laser writing.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Optical Crystals Nanoprinted in a Hydrogel
abstract: We demonstrate how Implosion Fabrication, a new three-dimensional nanofabrication technique, enables the realization of three-dimensional photonic devices at optical wavelengths. We realize two- and three-dimensional optical crystals of hydrogel-embedded silver meta-atoms.

articleTitle: Ultralow Energy van der Waals InSe PN junction heterostructure photodetector for NIR applications
abstract: We show a self-driven indium selenide (InSe) p-n heterojunction photodetector with a threefold increase in responsivity at 980 nm over a photoconductor detector based on p- or n-doped regions.

articleTitle: Finding the Right Deep Neural Network Model for Efficient Design of Tunable Nanophotonic Devices
abstract: We develop generative deep neural networks that explore relevant statistical structures to expedite a complex inverse design of nanophotonic on-chip wavelength de-multiplexer. Our design, targeting at telecomm-wavelengths, is electrically switchable via liquid crystal tuning.

articleTitle: Tailored Tuning of Temperature-Controlled Supercontinuum Generation in Liquid-Core Fibers
abstract: We demonstrate real-time tailoring of supercontinuum generation in liquid-core fibers through altering the fiber’s dispersion profile via longitudinal temperature distributions. Experiments using a Peltier element array show extraordinary modification of the spectrum of higher-order modes.

articleTitle: Single-shot passive 3D and polarization vision using a monocular metasurface camera
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a monocular camera that can simultaneously perform high-precision depth sensing with error below 1% and high-fidelity polarization imaging, using a metasurface lens with an optimized depth- and polarization-dependent point spread function.

articleTitle: Temperature Sensor Based on Femtosecond Laser Inscribed Novel Grating Structure in No-Core Fiber
abstract: A novel long-period annular grating inscribed in a no-core fiber by femtosecond laser is proposed. The grating structure can be used for high temperature sensing with high sensitivity, and it is insensitive to humidity.

articleTitle: Quantifying Randomness in a Gain-Switched Laser Diode
abstract: Using numerical modeling and experimental measurements, we quantify the amount of phase noise randomness produced by a gain-switched laser diode. This has applications in QKD and QRNG where phase randomization is essential to security.

articleTitle: Doped CQD-based Two-photon Fabrication of Fluorescent Micro/nanostructures for Arsenic Species Detection
abstract: We report fabrication of fluorescent micro/nanostructure by two-photon polymerization of sartomer (SR) with doped-carbon quantum dots for attomolar dimethylarsinate(DMA) detection. Fluorescent selective detection in picomolar range (50-300pM) was achieved followed by sensor fabrication (area~100µm 100µm).

articleTitle: Degradation Free Spectral Broadening in a Multimode Fiber with ∼0.5 µJ Pulses
abstract: We present a nonlinear pulse compression approach using the fundamental mode of a multimode fiber. We achieve > 5× compression factor, producing sub-40 fs pulses at 470 nJ (9.5 MHz), and >1000 hours of run time.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Scanning Probes for Nanoscale Imaging of Thermal Conductivity and Interfacial Thermal Conductance
abstract: Nanophotonic resonator integration and miniaturization decrease detection noise of nanomechanical scanning probe microscopy and increase its throughput. Using pulsed laser excitation, we demonstrate fast imaging (≈500,000× faster than a commercial probe) of thermal properties with 35nm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Probing Ultrafast Dynamics of Anharmonically Coupled Phonons in Few-Layer Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: Nonequilibrium dynamics of transverse optical (TO) phonons in few-layer hexagonal boron nitride is studied in mid-infrared pump-probe experiments. TO phonons display a 1.2 ps lifetime and a transient redshift due to anharmonic coupling with low-frequency interlayer modes.

articleTitle: 8-Channel Quantum Photonic Network Switch
abstract: We report a reconfigurable quantum photonic network switch with sub-μs rise times operating at visible wavelengths. Using hardware error correction, this system enables high-fidelity access to eight channels connected to spin memories.

articleTitle: Compact fiber optic ultrasound transducer with integrated ultrasound emission and detection
abstract: A compact fiber optic ultrasound transducer with integrated ultrasound emission and detection is developed. The transducer exhibits an emission pressure of 0.45MPa and a noise equivalent pressure of 72.8Pa.

articleTitle: Nuclear Spin-wave Quantum Register for a Rare-earth Ion Qubit
abstract: We implement a nuclear spin-wave quantum register for optically-addressable <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> qubits in YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> using a local ensemble of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">51</sup>V<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5+</sup> lattice ions. This quantum memory is a critical demonstration for future rare-earth ion-based quantum repeater networks.

articleTitle: Tunable Table-Top X-Rays from Tilted Van Der Waals Crystals
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate unprecedented versatility in free electron-driven X-ray sources based on van der Waals (vdW) materials. By controlling the crystal tilt, we broaden the accessible X-ray photon range by over 100%.

articleTitle: Multimodal imaging using combined Optical Fourier Ptychographic Microscopy and Atomic Force Microscopy for biological measures
abstract: We present a platform that perform live imaging using Fourier Ptychographic Microscopy co-localised with Atomic Force Microscopy. This specially fit emerging research on cellular biological processes regulated by tissue mechanics, including neuronal growth and stem-cell differentiation.

articleTitle: Picometer-precise post-processing of optical microresonators via slow-cooking
abstract: The recently discovered slow optical cooking method is developed to demonstrate the fabrication of optical microresonators having smooth and dramatically shallow nanoscale profile introduced along a water filled silica microcapillary with picometer wavelength precision.

articleTitle: Metaphotonic Color-Routing Nanostructures for Sub-micron Scale CMOS Image Sensors
abstract: We design color-routing nanostructures that can spectrally guide light into a Bayer array. To demonstrate, we fabricated 1.0-0.5 um pixel Bayer arrays composed of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanoposts and imaged the color-routing focal plane under white light illumination.

articleTitle: Hybrid photonic integration for multifunctional laser systems on a chip-scale platform
abstract: We discuss our recent work in hybrid integration of III/V and Si3N4 PICs and demonstrate diode laser wavelength tuning and linewidth reduction, beam steering with multiple sources, coherent beam combining, and wavelength beam combining.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinear optics in CMOS silicon
abstract: We demonstrate electric-field-induced second-harmonic generation from 2.4 μm to 1.2 μm in 3μm-thick silicon ridge waveguides integrated with alternating p-n diodes. Second-harmonic generation as a function of fundamental wavelength tuning is characterized.

articleTitle: Electrically induced adiabatic wavelength conversion in an integrated lithium niobate ring resonator
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically induced frequency shift through adiabatic wavelength conversion in an integrated lithium niobate ring resonator. Frequency shifts of up to 14.3 GHz are achieved by changing the voltage of an RF signal.

articleTitle: Weak and strong field control of valley polarization in WSe2 monolayer
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate the control of valley pseudospin in WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayer by single-cycle linearly polarized laser pulse. The asymmetric electric field controlled by the carrier-envelope phase is used to induce the valley polarization.

articleTitle: Experimental Optimization of a High Power Fiber Laser With Raman Filter
abstract: We study the impact of inserting a chirped and tilted fiber B ragg grating in between variable lengths of oscillator and amplifier stage of a high-power fiber laser, reaching up to 2 kW in output power.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Terahertz Spectroscopy of Coupling Between Fundamental Excitations in Solids
abstract: Using two-dimensional (2D) terahertz spectroscopy we investigate fundamental electronic, lattice, and spin excitations in solids, and the couplings between them.

articleTitle: Angular and Spectral Sparse Sensing With End-to-End Optimized Nanophotonics
abstract: We present a method for angle and wavelength sensing for underdetermined imaging systems by performing end-to-end nanophotonic inverse design with a compressed sensing backend.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Mode- and polarization-division multiplexing optical transmission based on ultrafast laser inscribed on-chip mode (de)multiplexer
abstract: We demonstrate mode and polarization multiplexing of 3×2 channels for high-speed optical communication based on ultrafast laser inscribed on-chip mode (de)multiplexer. The mode (de)multiplexers are fabricated in glass chips through femtosecond laser direct writing technology.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Bragg-Reflection Waveguides for On-Chip Time-Bin Entanglement
abstract: We fabricate low-loss AlGaAs Bragg-reflection waveguides for the creation of telecom wavelength photon pairs via parametric down-conversion. These photon pairs are used in a hybrid on-chip time-bin entanglement scheme.

articleTitle: On-chip Microwave-to-Optical Transducer Based on Rare-Earth Ions
abstract: Microwave-to-optical transduction is essential for connecting superconducting platforms with optical quantum networks. We demonstrate coherent transduction in both continuous-wave and pulsed mode using rare-earth ions with an integrated superconducting microwave resonator and nanophotonic optical resonator.

articleTitle: Rapid Patterning of Nonlinear Optical 2D-photonic Crystals on Indium Tin Oxide
abstract: Rapid pattering of honeycomb nonlinear optical, 2D-photonic crystals on ITO is demonstrated via parallel capillary stamping of lithium niobate. Mediated interaction between the photonic crystal and gold nanoparticles by infrared light is validated using SHG.

articleTitle: Ultra-low frequency noise spiral-cavity hybrid-integrated laser
abstract: A semiconductor laser is self-injection-locked to a spiral, ultra-high-Q silicon-nitride resonator. The laser attains record-low frequency noise noise floor (0.006 Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz or 40 mHz white-noise-linewidth) with stability at low-offset frequencies comparable to high-performance fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Gas flowing effect in anti-resonant hollow core fibers for thermal sensitivity reduction
abstract: The gas flow in hollow core fibers is studied in dynamic conditions of temperature variation theoretically and experimentally. The results of an over 40-fold reduction of thermal sensitivity relative to standard single-mode fibers are identified.

articleTitle: 2D quantum emitters for Integrated Quantum Photonics
abstract: Integrated quantum photonic circuits is an emerging area that requires efficient coupling of quantum light sources to waveguides and optical resonators. So far, much effort is devoted to developing on-chip systems from 3D crystals such as diamond or gallium arsenide. In this work, room-temperature operation of quantum emitters in on-chip photonic waveguides and cavities is demonstrated using single photon emitters embedded in layered hexagonal boron nitride. The results serve as foundation for integrating layered materials to on-chip components and realizing integrated quantum photonic circuitry.

articleTitle: One-sided cavity on an optical nanofiber using a composite technique
abstract: A nanophotonic-based one-sided cavity is demonstrated using a composite technique. The cavity is designed to maximize channeling efficiency into one side of an optical nanofiber. Cavity coupling characteristics exhibited good correspondence with simulation results.

articleTitle: 250C Process for < 2dB/m Ultra-Low Loss Silicon Nitride Integrated Photonic Waveguides
abstract: We report fabrication of CMOS-compatible Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguides, including resonators, with 2.0dB/m loss as well as 11.18million loaded Q at 1550nm, using a maximum temperature of 250C during and after Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> deposition, enabling system-on-chip integration.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Broadening of an Electro-Optic Pulse Source on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip broadening of an integrated electro-optic-modulator-based femtosecond pulse source on thin-film lithium niobate. A frequency comb spanning 3/5 octave is generated using 14 mW average on-chip power and 0.5 pJ pulse energy.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Parfocal Zoom Metalens
abstract: We designed and experimentally realized a non-mechanically tuned metalens capable of performing ×10 zoom while maintaining focus. The metalens consists of two dielectric metasurfaces made of low-loss optical phase-change material, Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Chip-Integrated Full-Stokes Polarimeter Array Based on Plasmonic Metasurfaces
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrated a chip-integrated polarimeter array design based on bi-layer plasmonic metasurfaces structure for ultracompact, accurate, and efficient polarization mapping in the mid-infrared range.

articleTitle: Multispectral Spatial Light Modulators based on Fabry-Perot nanocavity resonances
abstract: We demonstrate a Fabry-Perot nanocavity based SLM; capable of achieving high reflectance and large phase shift~2π simultaneously at multiple wavelengths in visible region. This device can be used for multispectral beam steering and tunable lensing.

articleTitle: Simultaneous strain-temperature analysis by machine learning assisted FBG sensor
abstract: We present a new and efficacious Artificial Neural network (ANN) approach utilizing the fiber Bragg grating (FBG) for temperature and strain measurement simultaneously. ANN successfully manifests the highly improved performance compared to transfer matrix method.

articleTitle: Controlling thermal radiation with a phase-change metasurface
abstract: We demonstrate a VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> based phase-change metasurface that self regulates its emissivity in response to the ambient temperature. The mid-infrared emissivity increases to near unity when operating above the insulator-to-metal phase transition temperature of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: Fermi edge singularity in ultracold neutral electron-hole plasma
abstract: We studied electron-hole plasma in separated electron and hole layers. We observed a strong enhancement of photoluminescence intensity at the Fermi energy of the ultracold plasma that evidences the emergence of excitonic Fermi edge singularity.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 28 Gb/s Physical Secure Optical Communication over 120 km Based on Self-Feedback Phase Encryption Loop
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a high speed 28Gb/s physical layer secure optical communication system with 120km SMF transmission link based on a novel hardware self-feedback optical phase encryption scheme.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Narrowband Terahertz Generation in PPLN Driven by a Two-Line Laser Source
abstract: We demonstrate record efficiencies of nonlinear optical-to-terahertz conversion near 1% for narrowband terahertz generation. This is achieved by strongly-cascaded difference frequency generation in periodically-poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystals using a novel multi-mJ laser source with two narrow spectral lines of tunable separation and pulse duration.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Dispersion Cancellation and Inversion in the Anomalous and Normal GVD Regimes
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time group velocity dispersion (GVD) cancellation and inversion in both the anomalous and normal GVD regimes utilizing space-time wave packets endowed with non-differentiable angular dispersion.

articleTitle: Speckle Reduction by Frequency Compounding in 1.7 μm Optical Coherence Tomography using Tunable Quasi-Supercontinuum Laser Source
abstract: Speckles in OCT hinder visibility of fine-scale structures. We demonstrated speckle reduced OCT imaging using 1.7 μm tunable Quasi-supercontinuum fiber laser source, and the improvement of image contrast in deep tissue imaging was successfully confirmed.

articleTitle: High Energy Diode-Pumped Tm:YLF Amplifier
abstract: We report on the first multi-joule-level Tm:YLF amplifier. In this experimental setup, a Tm:YLF oscillator seeds a 4-pass diode-pumped Tm:YLF amplifier, producing output energies of 3.88J in 20ns and up to 38.1J in long-pulse operation.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Generating a 10-Gbit/s QPSK Laguerre-Gaussian Beam using Integrated Circular Antenna Arrays to Tune Both Spatial Indices
abstract: We experimentally generate a Laguerre-Gaussian (LG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ℓ,p</inf>) beam with tunable spatial indices (LG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,0</inf>, LG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,1</inf>, LG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1,0</inf>, and LG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+1,1</inf>) using integrated circular antenna arrays. A 10-Gbit/s free-space QPSK link carried by the generated LG beam is demonstrated.

articleTitle: An intrusion events recognition method by incremental learning assisted with fiber optic DAS system
abstract: An intrusion events recognition method by incremental learning is proposed and demonstrated. Assisted with fiber optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system, the average recognition accuracy of 91% is achieved with only 28.7% training set in the field test.

articleTitle: A Low-cost Fresnel Lens Fluorometer to Detect Fecal Contamination in Drinking Water in Realtime
abstract: We report the detection of tryptophan at sub-ppb levels for a fluorometer based on Fresnel lenses and low-cost electronics. These fluorometers can be used to detect fecal contamination in drinking water, indicated by tryptophan-like fluorescence.

articleTitle: Third-harmonic generation on chip through cascaded χ(2) processes
abstract: By integrating two periodic poling structures into a single high-Q lithium niobate microresonator, cascaded SHG and SFG achieved third-harmonic generation on-chip at a wavelength of 520 nm with an efficiency of 0.6%.

articleTitle: Antiresonant hollow core fiber-based photothermal interferometry of Nitric Oxide at 5.26 µm with parts-per-billion sensitivity
abstract: We demonstrate an antiresonant hollow-core fiber-based photothermal sensor capable of targeting gases having absorption lines beyond 5 µm. The sensor reached a nitric oxide detection limit of 11 ppbv for 144 s integration time.

articleTitle: Stretched Noise-like Pulse for High-Resolution Laser Ranging
abstract: We reported a high-resolution laser ranging method utilizing the noise-like pulse stretched by the dispersive Fourier transform technique. The experimental results demonstrated a 1-cm spatial resolution within 2.861m range.

articleTitle: Programmable On-chip Photonic Machine Learning System Based on Joint Transform Correlator
abstract: We present a programmable on-chip photonic machine learning system based on the joint transform correlator. Testing the system on MNIST dataset shows 96.9% accuracy with even 10% signal delay.

articleTitle: Exploiting Water Vapor for Security in Terahertz Wireless Links
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the terahertz wireless channel fading due to atmospheric water vapor attenuation and distortion, and propose a protocol of utilizing this effect for physical-layer security.

articleTitle: Photo-refractive Switching of Micro-ring Resonators via few-layer Tellurium
abstract: We observe exceptionally high photo-refractive nonlinearities in a silicon microring resonator covered with only 2-micrometer coverage of few-layer.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian skin effect and point-gap topology in photonic crystals
abstract: We show that two-dimensional non-Hermitian photonic crystals made of lossy material can exhibit nontrivial point gap topology and non-Hermitian skin effect. Our work shows that these effects can be exhibited in systems beyond tight-binding models.

articleTitle: Massively Parallel Generation of Random Numbers Using a Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We employ spatio-temporal interference of many lasing modes for ultrafast, scalable random number generation. The laser diode with a specially-designed cavity produces hundreds of bitstreams at a total rate of two orders-of-magnitude faster than state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Spatially Variable Wave Plate for Depolarization Compensation Induced in High-Power Yb:YAG Amplifier
abstract: In this work we present a novel method for depolarization compensation based on spatially variable wave plate. Thermally induced depolarization losses were reduced from 14.3% to 1.3% and bifocusing eliminated in a double-pass Yb:YAG amplifier.

articleTitle: Deterministic Generation of Perfect Soliton Crystal Assisted by Saturable Absorption
abstract: We found that we can deterministically generate a perfect soliton crystal by incorporating a saturable absorber in a microresonator. The crystal is generated directly from the initial Turing rolls without passing through chaos.

articleTitle: Backscatter-TDLAS Detectors for Monitoring, Locating, Imaging, and Quantifying Methane Emissions
abstract: The urgency to reduce methane emissions to the atmosphere is driving industry adoption of advanced technologies for methane measurement and monitoring. We present a suite of laser-based products for detecting, locating, and measuring methane sources.

articleTitle: Integrated Passive Nonlinear Optical Isolators
abstract: We demonstrate non-reciprocal continuous-wave transmission through integrated Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> micro-resonators using the Kerr nonlinearity. We achieve a 5 dB nonreciprocal transmission ratio with 30 mW input power on Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, a significant step towards integrated passive isolators.

articleTitle: Electrically Driven Bound-state-in-the-Continuum Laser
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of electrically driven bound state in the continuum (BIC) laser. The laser is based on two types of BIC modes in a photonic crystal metacavity lasing at room temperature.

articleTitle: Polarization-dependent Enhanced Vibrational Raman Conversion Efficiency in SF6-filled Hollow-core Photonic Bandgap Fiber
abstract: We experimentally report a substantial Raman conversion efficiency enhancement, achieving more than 100% improvement over previous reports. The enhancement results from a non-trivial vibrational Raman conversion efficiency sensitivity to the input pump polarization angle.

articleTitle: Mode-selective imaging and control of nano-plasmonic near-fields
abstract: We demonstrate how ultrafast electron microscopy can be used to quantitavely analyse the modal structure of plasmonic nano-resonators and to coherently manipulate the optical near-field by multicolor laser pumping scheme - enabling the generation of complex beating patterns between different plasmonic modes.

articleTitle: A New Method to Measure Thermal Impedance for All-Active Semiconductor Lasers using the Athermalisation Condition
abstract: A method for measuring thermal impedance of several laser sections at once is presented. We measured thermal impedance length product as 29.3±2.1 and 39.33±2.8°C µm/mW for gain and grating sections respectively for our DBR lasers.

articleTitle: Hypergrating for Focusing Vortex Beam Below Diffraction Limit
abstract: Light with an orbital angular momentum can strongly modify optical transition selection rules when beam size is reduced to subwavelength scale. We demonstrated a method for focusing orbital angular momentum beams below the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Can electron–hole plasma induce an excitonic ARPES signature?
abstract: The presented systematic many-body computations demonstrate that angle-resolved photoemission spectra can exhibit an excitonic signature even without the formation of excitons.

articleTitle: In-fiber Nonlinear Silicon Photonics
abstract: This paper reviews recent advances in the application of silicon core fibers for nonlinear photonics. Particular focus will be placed on novel device designs that benefit from the fiber geometry.

articleTitle: Parity symmetry of reflection, optical symmetric pushing, and pulling-pushing flipped force in parity-time symmetric photonic systems
abstract: By Lorentz reciprocity theorem and parity-time (PT) symmetry, we propose a generalized parametric space for any PT symmetry photonic systems to indicate symmetry phase, broken symmetry phase, exceptional point, transmittance and reflectances. Through this generalized parametric space, We discover the emergence of symmetry reflection and optical pulling force.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of a photoexcited and periodically-driven Dirac semimetal Cd3As2 studied by multiterahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: We investigated ultrafast broadband (12-45 THz) response functions of a photoexcited Dirac semimetal Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Under periodic driving at 30 THz, we observed coherent nonlinear response dominated by stimulated Rayleigh scattering between the photon-dressed states.

articleTitle: Absolute Frequency Referencing in the Long-Wave Infrared using a Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrate that mid-infrared quantum cascade laser frequency combs are highly suitable as high-accuracy frequency references. We fully stabilize the comb and exploit it for comb-calibrated spectroscopy, achieving 100-kHz frequency accuracy at 7.7 μm.

articleTitle: Delay-Augmented Spectrometry for Target Classification Using a Frequency-Comb LiDAR
abstract: We demonstrate LiDAR-based remote spectrometry of natural targets augmented with delay spectra using an ultra-broadband frequency comb. Material-dependent spectrally-resolved delays with an equivalent sensitivity better than 100 µm complement reflectance signatures for enhanced target classification.

articleTitle: Transmission of 100 GBaud 64QAM Using an All-Silicon IQ modulator
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of 100 GBaud 64QAM achieving a BER below the 25% OH SD-FEC threshold using a single segment all-silicon IQ modulator; featuring a throughput of 600 (net 480) Gb/s.

articleTitle: Topology-Optimized Plasmonic Metasurfaces for Angle-Insensitive On-Chip Spectral Imaging
abstract: We demonstrate angle-insensitive spectral imaging in the wavelength range of 400 to 800 nm for average polarization based on topology-optimized plasmonic metasurfaces by optimizing the period and shape of the meta-atom.

articleTitle: Range resolved CO2 measurements over 3 km using a 10-point fiber-based differential-absorption LIDAR (DIAL) system
abstract: We present a multi-frequency DIAL system based on a fast-switching wavelength source and fiber optic amplification to acquire range-resolved dry-air CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentrations over the city of Boulder, Colorado USA.

Author Keywords: not subject to copyright in the United States

articleTitle: High-Resolution Millimeter-Depth Optical Coherence Tomography with 1-um 100-GHz Chip-Scale Laser Frequency Microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate an optical coherence tomography system utilizing a 1-um Kerr frequency comb. We take images with comparable image quality to that of an SLD with a resolution of 10um.

articleTitle: Design and Operation of Silicon Monolithic 1 × 4 Wavefront-control-type Wavelength Selective Switch
abstract: We designed and fabricated a 200-GHz-spacing, 16-channel, 1 × 4 silicon monolithic wavelength selective switch (WSS), adopting a wavefront control configuration with no waveguide crossings. Its basic switching operations were demonstrated with four wavelength channels.

articleTitle: Optical Teleportation using Electro-Optic Plasmonic Graphene Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate that optical teleportation can be realized by using two interacting optical fields in an electrically driven graphene waveguide. The simulations show that the proposed system can achieve high-fidelity teleportation over significant transmission distances.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Free-Form Metasurfaces with Deep Neural Networks
abstract: We show that the free-form inverse design of nanophotonic matasurfaces can be solved with a modified CGAN machine learning method that balances the accuracy of desired optical properties with experimental feasibility.

articleTitle: Vernier Frequency Combs for Stabilization of RF/Optical Links
abstract: We utilize the Vernier effect to partially stabilize a pair of high repetition rate, octave-spanning Kerr solitons in silicon nitride microrings fabricated on the same wafer.

articleTitle: Broadband amplitude, phase and polarization modulation by geometric phase metasurface
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a geometric metasurface enabled by the parallel-tasking method, which can simultaneously and independently modulate the amplitude, phase and polarization profile of spatial light in broadband.

articleTitle: Free-form and Large Lens Characterization Using At-focus Scanning Ptychographic Metrology
abstract: Here we implement and test a new ptychographic metrology for characterization of large optical components, including transmissive and reflective systems. As proof of concept, we present the phase and transmission profile of a short focus, aberrated lens.

articleTitle: Graded-Index medium profiles associated with curvature and conformal maps
abstract: We consider a comparison of the curved space geodesics with the eikonal equation in a GRIN medium. We relate aspects of the analog curvature to the conformal maps useful for a transformed virtual medium.

articleTitle: More than 5-fold energy up-scaling for multiple-plate compression with a donut-shaped vortex beam
abstract: A vortex beam is employed in multiple-plate compression to overcome the crystal damage threshold. 190-fs, 1030-nm pulses are compressed to 42 fs with a pulse energy 5.5 times higher than the Gaussian beam counterpart.

articleTitle: Properties of Heterogeneously Integrated Photonic Crystal Nanolasers with Ultra-low Threshold Current
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically-driven heterogeneously integrated InP-on-Si photonic crystal nanolaser that exhibits an ultra-low threshold current of 10.2 μA and we investigate the injection efficiency and leakage current that currently limit the performance.

articleTitle: Demonstration of On-Chip Optical Skyrmionic Beam Generators
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate on-chip optical skyrmionic beam generators. Skyrmionic beams with tailored skyrmion numbers were generated from single silicon microrings diffracting two beams whose spin and orbital angular momenta were controlled via optical spin-orbit coupling.

articleTitle: Vortex laser arrays with topological charge control and self-healing of defects
abstract: We present a non-Hermitian metasurface laser generating 100 strongly coupled vortices. The internal coupling mechanism allows to tune their charges as well as to heal defects in the system, opening new perspectives in topological optics.

articleTitle: A scalable infrastructure for strontium optical clocks
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable, integrated photonics infrastructure for optical atomic clocks. We laser cool and trap 4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5 87</sup>Sr atoms in a magneto-optical trap, using metasurface optics and a compact, single-chamber vacuum system.

articleTitle: Ultrashort Pulse-beam Characterization Using Femtosecond Interferometric Shack-Hartmann Frequency Resolved Optical Gating
abstract: We introduce a self-referenced system that retrieves the full spatio-temporal profile of an ultrashort pulse using a Shack-Hartmann and second harmonic generation FROG. The key feature is the precise co-location of a spectral phase measurement at one spatial position with the spectrally resolved spatial measurements.

articleTitle: Broadband Photodetectors through Tunable Tunneling Heterointerfaces
abstract: We report tunable tunneling van der Waals heterointerfaces with two strategies (oxidation layer and bandgap engineering) for broadband photodetection covering from the ultra-violet to the mid-infrared ranges.

articleTitle: Optical Energy-difference Conservation in a Synthetic Anti-PT Symmetric System
abstract: We create an optical APT-symmetric system in the synthetic frequency domain using a conventional fiber without intrinsic gain/loss and observed the optical energy-difference conservation. Our results provide a robust framework connecting non-Hermitian physics with nonlinear interactions.

articleTitle: Axial Characterization of Ultrafast Optical Vortices in Nonlinear Regime
abstract: Circular arrangements of laser filaments produced by vortical beams show promise for applications such as long-distance waveguiding. We examine the differences in linear and nonlinear propagation characteristics of beams with varying topological charge.

articleTitle: Low-loss Germanium-on-Silicon Waveguides and Ring Resonators for the Mid-Wave Infrared
abstract: Low-loss germanium-on-silicon waveguides for 4.6 µm light are demonstrated in both rectangular (loss= 1.7 dB/cm) and rib (0.6 dB/cm) waveguide geometries. High-Q microring resonator filters (Q= 93,400) are also demonstrated. © 2022 Massachusetts Institute of Technology

articleTitle: High-Power Fully-Integrated Frequency Comb Generation
abstract: We generate an integrated high-power Kerr frequency comb in a silicon-nitride resonator via self-injection locking of a high-power multimode gain chip. We generate 27 comb lines with total power exceeding 0.1 W.

articleTitle: Direct CEP Stabilization of a high-repetition rate, few-cycle OPCPA chain with a single feedback loop, employing a Stereo-ATI
abstract: We present the direct stabilization of the CEP of a high-repetition rate OPCPA by employing a Stereo-ATI pulsemeter for single-shot detection and feedback to the oscillator at the full OPCPA repetition rate.

articleTitle: Optical Scattering Tomography for Volumetric Additive Manufacturing
abstract: We introduce a new optical method for real-time monitoring of volumetric additive manufacturing. Using tomographic geometry for printing and imaging, we simultaneously print and record the 3D shape of the object during photopolymerization.

articleTitle: Remarkable Improvement of Atomic-Frequency-Comb Memory Efficiency by Comb Transfer Method in 167Er3+:Y2SiO5 under Zero Magnetic Field
abstract: We demonstrated atomic frequency comb (AFC) quantum memory in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">167</sup>Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> under zero magnetic field by using optical frequency comb (OFC), which enables to quickly and easily produce AFCs with high efficiency over a wide bandwidth.

articleTitle: Frequency comb generation in a silicon nitride microring resonator fabricated by using hot-wire CVD method
abstract: We report frequency comb generation in a silicon nitride (SiN) based microring resonator fabricated by the hot-wire chemical vapor deposition (HW-CVD) method with an intrinsic quality factor in excess of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy for Accurate Carbon Dioxide Transition Intensities near 1.96 μm
abstract: We present transition intensity measurements for the 20011 ← 00001 band of carbon dioxide to test quantum theory and support sensing and isotopic analysis. Preliminarily, a relative combined standard uncertainty of ≤ 0.2 % was achieved.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared silicon-integrated high-bandwidth GeSn PIN photodetectors and LEDs
abstract: Monolithic all-group IV GeSn PIN detector and emitting devices were fabricated and their bandwidth was measured. The obtained high bandwidth PDs were utilized in time resolved spectroscopy in the picosecond range.

articleTitle: 3-Core Microstructure Optical Fiber-Based Fiber Optic Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We report on a multi-core microstructure optical fiber-based fiber optic parametric oscillator (FOPO), the first of its kind. The FOPO has wavelength tunability over 125 nm and a pump-to-signal conversion efficiency reaching 24%.

articleTitle: Electrically reconfigurable photonic PUF based on a moiré quasicrystal interferometer
abstract: Motivated by cryptographic applications seeking enhanced reliability and security, we demonstrate physically unclonable photonic circuits based on active quasicrystal interferometers with integrated micro-heaters. Small changes in electrical stimuli are shown to produce distinct optical fingerprints.

articleTitle: Continous-wave travelling wave optical parametric amplification on a photonic chip
abstract: We demonstrate a traveling wave parametric amplifier in a photonic Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>integrated spiral waveguide of 2.0 m length with footprint 3×5 mm. We achieve net gain of 7 dB on-chip and 2 dB fiber-to-fiber in the optical C-band.

articleTitle: Electro-Optic-Modulator-Based Integrated Optical Isolator
abstract: We realized an optical isolation of 48 dBm using a travelling-wave electro-optic phase modulator on thin-film lithium niobate platform. We showed our device successfully protects the linewidth of an integrated III-V laser.

articleTitle: Metalens Doublets for Self-sorting of Fluorescent Particles
abstract: We establish design principles for, and numerically explore characteristics of, metalens doublets for sorting fluorescent particles in microchannels. The doublets focus fluorescent light back onto the source particles, which may lead to automatic cell sorting.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Reservoir Computer for Early Stage Alzheimer’s Disease detection
abstract: An optoelectronic Reservoir Computer is proposed and implemented numerically and on physical hardware for early-stage Alzheimer’s disease detection for the first time. The approach yields classification accuracy of 85% surpassing state-of-the-art performances.

articleTitle: Towards high-sensitivity mid-IR dual-comb spectroscopy via solid-state laser driven optical parametric oscillators
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-comb 80-MHz optical parametric oscillator from a single-cavity and a diode-pumped 250-MHz Yb:YAG dual-comb oscillator. Their combination can lead to a low-noise source in the mid-IR with high-power per comb line.

articleTitle: Enhanced-Precision Displacement Measurements Using Position-Entangled Photon Pairs
abstract: Optical split detection is a common technique for measuring displacement. We experimentally demonstrate split-detection measurements using entangled photons. This scheme may be applicable to precision measurements requiring low light intensity, to avoid disturbing a sample.

articleTitle: PAM4 wireless communication in 300 GHz-band using integrated-optic PAM signal emulator
abstract: We report on 25 Gbaud PAM4 communication in the 300 GHz-band, which employs an integrated-optic PAM signal emulator with a tunable asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometer configuration. We did not adopt special signal processing or coherent detection.

articleTitle: Achieving flat spectral envelopes of soliton crystal frequency microcombs
abstract: Flat optical spectra are desired in many frequency microcomb applications such as ultrabroadband optical communication, interconnects, spectroscopy, and metrology. Here we achieve flat-top spectral envelopes via deterministic control in soliton crystal microcombs.

articleTitle: Mode-selective band-tuned topological waveguide
abstract: A mode-selective topological waveguide has been proposed. By performing appropriate band tuning in two photonic structures that comprise topological waveguides, we can realize topological waveguides which allow optical vortex modes with a specific charge numbers.

articleTitle: Phase and Amplitude Imaging with Undetected Photons via Four-wave Mixing in Silicon Core Fibers
abstract: Undetected photon imaging based on four-wave mixing is demonstrated in silicon core fibers. Both amplitude and phase images are presented for a low-power telecom pump, with the potential for imaging at longer wavelengths discussed.

articleTitle: Photonic resonators with hybrid standing-traveling waves
abstract: We introduce a new class of photonic resonators with resonant modes that feature hybrid standing-travelling waves.

articleTitle: Sub-symmetry protected topological states in photonic lattices
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate the concept of sub-symmetry in symmetry-protected topological systems, wherein the original symmetry is partially broken so bulk topological invariant no longer exists, but some edge states are still topologically protected.

articleTitle: Flat Band Quantum Dot High Order Mode Locked Laser for Tbit/s Transmission
abstract: We report 4th order colliding pulse mode-locked laser based on InAs/GaAs QD structure, which can generate ultra-stable optical frequency combs in O-band with 100 GHz spacing and a record-high 3 dB optical bandwidth of 11.5 nm (20 comb lines) at 25 °C. Single channel NRZ modulation rates of 70 Gb/s and PAM-4 of 40 GBaud/s are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced multiphoton photoluminescence in metaphotonics
abstract: We study multiphoton photoluminescence from several types of nonlinear resonant metaphotonic structures. We develop a general theoretical approach to describe such nonlinear effects and confirm our predictions in experiments with perovskite metasurfaces and AlGaAs nanoantennas.

articleTitle: Near-Visible End-Fire Array with Large FoV Scalable for 3D Sensing and FSO Communication
abstract: At 850 nm, an array of SiN waveguide-emitters (end-fire) to enable wide beam steering and splitting in a field of view of 60° and is presented. A free-space data rate of 6.25 Mb/s is achieved.

articleTitle: Minimum ranging time for a LiDAR module using CMOS single-photon avalanche diodes
abstract: Single-point minimum integration time (T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf>) is a core parameter for LiDAR. We demonstrate a method to theoretically evaluate Tmin with given signal/noise levels. It exhibits excellent consistence with the experiment from our CMOS SPAD LiDAR.

articleTitle: Phase Identification and Bespoke Beam Shaping for Coherent Beam Combination via Deep Learning
abstract: Practical application of coherent beam combination of multiple fibres necessitates phase identification and optimisation in real-time. Here, we solve this mathematical challenge via deep learning, and hence demonstrate the potential for real-time bespoke beam shaping.

articleTitle: High-throughput optofluidic nanoplasmonic biosensor array for monitoring single-cell secretion in real-time
abstract: We report a high-throughput biosensing microarray platform integrating ultrasensitive nanoplasmonic substrate and microwell compartments for label-free and real-time secretome monitoring. Interleukin-2 from hundreds of single EL4 cells were measured and a statistical analysis was done.

articleTitle: Fourier transform cavity ring-down spectroscopy using an optical frequency comb source
abstract: We demonstrate a new broadband multiplexed cavity ring-down approach based on a near-infrared frequency comb source and a time-resolved Fourier transform spectrometer. We apply the technique to spectroscopy of atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength reconstruction in a compact (< mm) high-resolution (< 0.1 nm) random photonic crystal spectrometer
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the reconstruction of multiple wavelength light with an ultra-compact spectrometer. The spectrometer is based on a random photonic crystal and operates with a spectral resolution beyond the fabrication error.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Heterogeneous III-V/Si DWDM Transmitter based on (De-) Interleaved Frequency Comb
abstract: For the first time, a simultaneous wavelength and space division multiplexed transmitter is demonstrated on a heterogeneous III-V-on-silicon platform. The proof-of-concept experiment shows (de-)interleaved 2×8 comb lines each modulated at 25 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Exceptional-point encirclement in an integrated non-Hermitian optomechanical system
abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate an integrated non-Hermitian optomechanical system capable of exceptional-point encirclement in a deterministic manner. The proposed scheme opens a way for investigating non-Hermitian optomechanics on chip.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Spatial-Mode Sorter for Super-Resolution Imaging
abstract: We build a reconfigurable spatial mode sorter for super resolution imaging using a spatial light modulator (SLM). Our system can easily adapt to sort different, mutually non-orthogonal, spatial mode bases.

articleTitle: Nanometer Vibration Sensing by a Laser Pointer Used as a Self-mixing Interferometer
abstract: Adding a plain photodiode to a commercial green laser pointer, we obtain a high resolution self-mixing interferometer, capable of detecting minute vibrations down to ≈4.4-nm (rms) resolution, or measuring displacements with half-wavelength (λ/2=266 nm) increments.

articleTitle: End-to-end Nanophotonics Inverse Design for Computational Imaging
abstract: We introduce end-to-end inverse design in which a nanophotonics frontend is optimized in conjunction with a computational-imaging backend to minimize reconstruction errors. We present several nanophotonics designs for depth, spectral and polarization imaging.

articleTitle: Mode-Locking through Doubly Resonant Intra-Cavity Sum Frequency Generation
abstract: A new technique for mode-locking through sum-frequency generation is presented. The technique produced 200 ps long 1064 nm pulses in a coupled-cavity system with two Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> crystals and a PPRKTP phase-matched for sum-frequency generation.

articleTitle: 67.5 Gbit/s PAM-8 Signal Transmissions Over 25-km SMF With a 1550-nm 10G-Class DML Using Machine Learning
abstract: We report 67.5 Gbit/s PAM-8 signal transmissions over a 25-km SMF using a 1550-nm 12-GHz bandwidth DML. Performance below the HD-FEC level is achieved using a machine learning equalizer operating with baud-rate sampling.

articleTitle: Low thermal noise TiO2-doped GeO2 for gravitational wave detectors
abstract: TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doped GeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin films with excellent optical properties and exceptionally low mechanical loss for a ternary amorphous oxide are used to demonstrate interference coatings with low thermal noise for the test masses of gravitational wave interferometers.

articleTitle: Direct nanosecond laser welding of semiconductor materials
abstract: We provide a first solution to the challenging problem of direct laser micro-welding of semiconductors. Infrared nanosecond pulses applied on an optical contact between similar and dissimilar materials systematically create shear joining strengths >10 MPa.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr solitons in a photonic dimer on both sides of an exceptional point
abstract: We study experimentally and theoretically dissipative Kerr soliton formation in a driven photonic dimer on both sides of exceptional points. We describe a diversity of nonlinear coherent states emerging from the additional dimensionality.

articleTitle: Frequency-to-time Mapping-Assisted Spectral Characterization of Parametric Biphoton States
abstract: A frequency-to-time mapping technique is employed to directly characterize the biphoton state from a pulsed spontaneous parametric process. For the first time a Hanbury Brown and Twiss measurement is performed directly in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: Neural Network Assisted Ditherless Bias Control for Optical IQ Modulator Using Relative Detection
abstract: We propose a ditherless bias control algorithm, which uses relative detection and neural network to predict bias state. Experimental results show the precision is 1.5% and 0.3% of 2V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> for bias IQ and P.

articleTitle: Non-singular near-touching plasmon modes in nanocube dimers
abstract: Through investigating plasmons in dimers near the transition from touching to non-touching configurations, we reveal that the two-dimensional touching area makes the transition non-singular, while a one-dimensional or zero-dimensional touching region produces a singular transition.

articleTitle: Generating a Space-Time Pulse in Free Space after Multimode Fiber Propagation in which Fiber Modal Coupling is Mitigated, Divergence is Reduced, and Group Velocity is Tuned
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the generation of a space-time pulse in free-space after 1-m multi-mode fiber propagation. The generated space-time pulse has reduced diffraction and a tunable group velocity from 1.0042c to 0.9967c.

articleTitle: Demonstrations of 160×28 GBaud C-band Same-Wavelength Bidirectional Fiber Transmission Experiments
abstract: We demonstrate C-band same-wavelength bidirectional transmission experiments of 66.7 Tb/s DP-16QAM and 33.3 Tb/s DP-QPSK over 90 km and 130 km, with Rayleigh back-scattering suppressed by Raman amplification and reflection interferences eliminated through LFMTS-assisted DSP.

articleTitle: All-optical nonreciprocal response in a ring resonator integrating transition metal dichalcogenides
abstract: The photoinduced nonreciprocity was experimentally observed in WS2 monolayer pumped by circularly polarized light. Based on this, we propose a theoretical model of nonreciprocal optical ring resonator integrating valley polarized WS2 monolayer.

articleTitle: Controlling Orbital Angular Momentum in Wavelength-Tunable Optofluidic Microlaser
abstract: Optical vortices were generated based on a nanogroove-structured optofluidic microlaser, for which the topological charges, chirality, and laser wavelengths can be fully manipulated. Real-time dynamic switching of vortex beam was demonstrated through optofluidics for the first time.

articleTitle: Vapor-condensed nano-lenses for air-quality monitoring with a lensfree imaging system
abstract: Many air-quality monitoring devices can detect different sizes of particles but cannot quantify individual particle sizes across the range 0.1-10 μm. Here we show such a device that is furthermore cost-effective and portable.

articleTitle: Laser fabricated optical fibers with 3D printed cores
abstract: We utilized a powder-based, 3D printing technique for prototyping optical fibers. Co-doped silica rods were printed using sub-micron powders with various compositions. The rods were sleeved and drawn into fibers. Ti/Al/Er-co-doped fibers are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Broadband and Flat Mid-Infrared Supercontinuum Generation in a Varying Dispersion Waveguide for Parallel Gas Spectroscopy
SPM-enabled spectral selection in hollow-core fiber
abstract: We propose and demonstrate that SPM-enabled spectral selection in a Xenon filled hollow-core fiber can produce broadly tunable femtosecond pulses with μJ-level pulse energy—representing one order of magnitude improvement compared with current implementations.

articleTitle: Long Range Single Pulse Raman Distributed Temperature Sensor Using Standard Single Mode Fiber
abstract: We present a single pulse Raman distributed temperature sensor using standard single mode fiber and having ~5.2 m spatial resolution at 18.5 km sensing distance with an averaging time of ~3.3 minutes.

articleTitle: High Purcell Factor Single-Photon Emitter based on Extreme Dielectric-Confinement GaAs-on-Insulator Waveguides
abstract: We theoretically investigate the potential of the extreme mode-confinement waveguides for single-photon sources. Confining light far below the diffraction limit in a V-groove GaAs-on-insulator waveguide, we enhance the Purcell factor by a factor of eight.

articleTitle: Magnetic Control and Entanglement of Electron Spins with Bunched Electron Beams
abstract: We investigate longitudinally structured electron beam interaction with two-level spin quantum systems. Deriving a semi-classical and fully quantum model, we demonstrate entanglement generation of two spins and independent control of system spin and energy states.

articleTitle: Improved rf Tolerance of Trap-Integrated Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detectors for Trapped-Ion Qubit State Readout
abstract: The performance of ion-trap-integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors for trapped-ion qubit readout is significantly impacted by rf trapping fields. We demonstrate an electrically-shielded trap-integrated detector with substantially improved rf tolerance.

articleTitle: 5G-Based Bidirectional WDM VLLC-UWLT and White-Lighting Converged Systems
abstract: A 5G-based bidirectional WDM VLLC-UWLT and white-lighting converged system through 10-m free-space link with an 8.8-m ocean water-air-ocean water interface is successfully built. It outperforms existing OWC systems through free-space link with an air-water-air interface.

articleTitle: In vivo Detection of NO using Photonic Microring Resonators
abstract: Here we show how photonic microring resonators enable real-time detection of Nitric Oxide (NO) in vivo, which is critical for physiological monitoring particularly during the wound healing process.

articleTitle: Line-scanning Brillouin microscopy for fast 3D biomechanical imaging
abstract: Confocal Brillouin microscopy is an emerging tool for biomechanics and biophysics but encounters challenges of slow speed and redundant illumination. We developed a multiplexing configuration that is ten times faster and has much less phototoxicity.

articleTitle: Orthogonally-Polarized Bi-directional Dual-Comb Fiber Laser
abstract: We propose a novel nonreciprocal polarization isolator for the realization an all-PM dual-comb fiber laser. An orthogonally-polarized bi-directional output has been demonstrated, for the first time, with 5.474 kHz repetition frequency difference at 20 MHz.

articleTitle: Wafer-scale single-aperture near-infrared metalens fabricated by deep UV photolithography
abstract: We reported a wafer-scale near-infrared metalens with an aperture size of eight centimeters operating around 1.5 µm fabricated using deep UV photolithography. Our measurements show that it has diffraction-limited performance with about 80% focusing efficiency.

articleTitle: Kerr soliton formation in nondegenerate phase-conjugate resonators
abstract: Phase conjugation is a unique phenomenon that readily mimics Stokes’s principle of time reversal. We report, for the first time, experimental observations of the formation of Kerr solitons in a phase-conjugate resonator.

articleTitle: Spectral emissivity modelling in multi-resonator systems
abstract: We propose a semi-analytical spectral prediction tool for coupled, multi-resonator systems. We demonstrate the accuracy of our method by predicting and optimizing the spectral response of a thermal emitter composed of coupled hBN ribbons.

articleTitle: Quantum noise of dark pulse microcombs
abstract: We investigate the fundamental timing jitter of dark pulse microcombs generated in an AlGaAs microresonator, where the quantum-limited frequency noise of the 91-GHz repetition rate is measured to be 0.5 Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz.

articleTitle: Impact of frequency-dependent nonlinearity on soliton trajectory in microstructured optical fiber
abstract: We show that the frequency dependence of the nonlinear parameter has a significant impact on the evolution of femtosecond solitons inside microstructured optical fibers. For realistic modeling of nonlinear processes, several higher-order nonlinear terms are added.

articleTitle: High Power and High Efficiency on-chip Integrated Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a highly efficient integrated laser, with more than 200 mW single mode output, overcoming the tradeoff between high power, efficiency and coherence in traditional lasers. The laser is based on the collapsing of a multimode gain into a single mode via self-injection locking.

articleTitle: 5-Level Model for D2-Line Absorption Spectrum in Thermal Rb Vapor
abstract: We present a 5-level rate equation model for the Doppler-broadened Rb D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-line absorption spectrum and experimentally verify that it correctly predicts upto 10× lower saturation intensity as compared to the simple 2-level system, induced by hyperfine pumping.

articleTitle: On-chip Integration of High-Power Lasers and Thin-film Lithium Niobate Modulators
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically-pumped integrated high-power laser on thin-film lithium niobate with 60 and 25 mW of optical power in the passive and active devices, respectively.

articleTitle: Logical WGM laser assisted by mesogens scattering
abstract: We proposed an all-in-one scattering-assisted mesogens micropillar laser with self-seeding and self-guiding. Based on the hysteresis characteristics of the electrically anchored mesogens under the interaction of thermal force, an erasable active memory device is realized.

articleTitle: An optical parametric Bragg amplifier on a CMOS-chip
abstract: We demonstrates the first optical prametric amplification using nonlinear Bragg grating where enhanced phase matching is enabled by utilizing the rapid increase and decrease in effective index near the stopband. An on/off parametric gain of 20dB is achieved in a 3-mm ultra-silicon rich nitride Bragg grating at a low peak power of 1.6W.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser inscribed photonic lantern for the fan-in/fan-out of a 19-core fiber
abstract: We design and fabricate a 19-channel fan-in/fan-out photonic lantern based on the femtosecond laser direct writing technique. Such a device enables space-division multiplexing transmission in a 19-core fiber over the C+L band.

articleTitle: Active Switching of Electromagnetic Induced Transparency in Ge2Sb2Te5 Tunable Terahertz Metamaterial
abstract: We demonstrate active switching of EIT in a THz metasurface comprising of phase change material/gold patterns. Dynamic interchange between EIT and dipolar resonance due to ultrafast phase-transition of Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> promises applications in slow light devices.

articleTitle: High energy, all-polarization maintaining fiber optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification at 1053 nm
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the amplification of ultrashort pulses up to µJ level at 1053nm in an all-polarization maintaining FOPCPA system. This high energy level originates from a parametric process in a specially designed hybrid fiber.

articleTitle: Enhancing polariton nonlinearity via interlayer excitons in bilayer MoS2
abstract: We report the first demonstration of strong coupling of an interlayer exciton (IE). This results in an order of magnitude enhancement in nonlinear optical response compared to the more common intralayer exciton -polaritons.

articleTitle: Experimental resource-efficient photonic variational quantum eigensolver
abstract: We report implementation of experimental-resource efficient photonic variational quantum eigensolver using multiple degrees of freedom of a single photon. It is equipped with the quantum error mitigation protocol that efficiently remedies the Pauli channel noise.

articleTitle: Fractal photonic topological insulators
abstract: We present the first experimental observation of a fractal topological insulator and demonstrate how the self-similar properties of the Sierpinski gasket systematically enhance the transport of light in its topologically protected edge states.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser inscription of integrated orbital angular momentum emitter
abstract: We present integrated orbital angular momentum (OAM) emitters by using femtosecond laser inscription. The emitter we designed consists of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer and specially designed trench waveguide, transforming Gaussian beams into first-order OAM beams.

articleTitle: Adjustable Q-Factor Infrared Absorption with Germanium Nanohole Metasurfaces
abstract: The absorption ~90% at the communication wavelength was demonstrated by germanium nanohole metasurface with subwavelength thickness. By tuning the different hole depth in Ge metasurface, we can get the tunable Q-factors from 116 to 236.

articleTitle: Integration of GaAs waveguides with quantum dots on Silicon substrates for quantum photonic circuits
abstract: We present the heterogeneous integration of GaAs membranes with embedded quantum dots on a Silicon substrate, based on die-to-die bonding method. We demonstrate light transmission in GaAs nanobeam waveguides and emission from individual quantum emitters.

articleTitle: Visible-wavelength optomechanical crystal for coupling phonons to a silicon vacancy center in diamond
abstract: We demonstrate the first realization of a visible-wavelength optomechanical crystal cavity in diamond. This device is fabricated using quasi-isotropic etching and exhibits optical (mechanical) quality factors of 3.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> (1.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) at room temperature.

articleTitle: Direct Optical Vortex Laser Printing of a Microdot with Close-Packed and Sintered Gold Nanoparticles
abstract: We demonstrate the direct printing of an ultrafine microdot formed of gold nanoparticles by employing optical vortex laser induced forward transfer. Spin and orbital angular momentum induces the close-packing and sintering of gold nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated erbium-doped silicon nitride amplifiers with intense net gain
abstract: We demonstrate photonic integrated erbium-implanted Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> amplifiers that enable record-high 26 dB on-chip net gain and saturation output power exceeding 25 mW, providing an active Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> nanophotonic platform for integrated lasers, LiDARs and microwave photonics.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Post-Processing for Classical Secure Key Distribution in Fiber Networks
abstract: Real-time post-processing for physical-layer secure key distribution in fiber networks is implemented on FPGA, with quantization, information reconciliation and privacy amplification modules, where a key generation rate of 11.7 Mbps is achieved.

articleTitle: Metasurface-Enabled Hyperspectral Polarimetric Camera
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a metasurface capable of processing multidimensional optical information, including light intensity distribution, spectrum, and polarization, which can be used for hyperspectral polarimetric camera.

articleTitle: 5.6 mW average power THz source with 8 THz bandwidth at 540 kHz repetition rate based on organic crystal BNA
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-broadband, high dynamic range THz source using organic crystal BNA, excited with a high-power, ultrafast Yb laser operating at 540 kHz repetition rate, reaching a record-high THz average power of 5.6 mW.

articleTitle: Microcomb based silicon photonics data link with 100Gbps/Lane PAM4 transmission
abstract: We achieve 100 Gbps/Lane PAM4 transmission by employing an AlGaAsOI microcomb source and silicon modulators. With 20 parallel wavelength channels utilized at C-band, an aggregate data rate of 2 Tbit/s is achieved.

articleTitle: Noise Robust High Precision and Real-Time Focus Detection for Laser Micromanaging
abstract: We present a high-precision machine learning method to precisely control laser focus position. We experimentally verified it on different materials and achieved more than 95% accuracy. We simulated the effect of noise on the accuracy.

articleTitle: Electro-Optical Biosensor Based on Embedded Graphene Capacitor
abstract: In this work, an interferometric polymer-based electro-optical biosensor with an embedded double monolayer graphene capacitor is presented. Because of the Fermi level modulation, absorption changes of 129dB/mm and bulk sensitivity of 2828nm/RIU respectively, were observed.

articleTitle: Wide-band Tunable Laser via Integration of High Precision Wavelength Spacing DFB Lasers
abstract: We report a tunable laser by integrating sixteen DFB lasers with high wavelength-spacing uniformity. Wavelength deviations of 89.3% DFB lasers are within ±0.2 nm, enabling high overall yield and low tuning range of each laser.

articleTitle: Long-range dipole-dipole interactions in a plasmonic lattice
abstract: We observe long-range dipole-dipole interactions in a plasmonic lattice mediated by collective plasmonic lattice modes. Fluorescence lifetime measurements show density-dependent non-exponential decay dynamics that commensurate to over 800 nm mean nearest-neighbor separation between interacting emitters.

articleTitle: Revisiting Single-Particle Lineshapes in a Perovskite Nanoplatelet Ensemble
abstract: We study CsPbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> perovskite nanoplatelets using 2D coherent spectroscopy at cryogenic temperatures. Their homogeneous lineshapes are revealed despite the presence of ensemble inhomogeneous broadening, which inform the determining factors in their transition linewidths.

articleTitle: The photorefractive effect in integrated chalcogenide nonlinear photonic device and its application
abstract: We demonstrate the photorefractive effect of chalcogenide (ChG) microresonators in the optical parametric oscillation (OPO) process by our homemade in-situ dispersion measurement. By fine thermal annealing post-treatment, a robust OPO was achieved in on-chip ChG microresonators.

articleTitle: Transient Dynamics in a Femtosecond Fiber-feedback Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We report on transient dynamics in a femtosecond fiber-feedback optical parametric oscillator. Dispersive Fourier transform spectroscopy provides spectral and shot-to-shot temporal resolution, revealing the buildup into various attractors, such as steady states and period-N cycles.

articleTitle: Induced dark solitons by means of singular beams
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear propagation of singular light beams with complex structures of phase and intensity in a colloidal suspension of gold nanoparticles. All the structured beams can act as waveguides of a probe beam.

articleTitle: Beamforming via wrapped transverse propagation for visible integrated photonics
abstract: Controlling visible-laser emission with integrated photonics affects quantum technologies and challenges nanophotonic design and fabrication. Here, we demonstrate a pathway to millimeter-scale beams with versatile polarization, using wrapped lateral propagation via total internal reflection and metasurface optics.

articleTitle: High Responsivity Amorphous Indium Zinc Oxide Photo Sensor For In-cell Fingerprint Identification
abstract: Amorphous InZnO material is chosen for a phototransistor sensing layer, respectively, with a completely compatible process integrated into in-cell embedded photo sensor architecture. The photo sensor exhibits a high optical responsivity (1720 A/W) and good signal to noise ratio (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) under the low blue light illumination.

articleTitle: Normal-Incidence Infrared Silicon Photodetectors Based on Surface-State Absorption and Their Applications
abstract: We fabricated and tested a normal-incidence infrared silicon photodetector based on surface-state absorption for free-space optical applications. It featured -46-dBm sensitivity and near transparency at 1560-nm wavelength as well as broad spectral photoresponse.

articleTitle: Lock-in detector for accelerated nonlinear imaging
abstract: We present a lock-in amplification scheme allowing an order of magnitude reduction of data acquisition time for nonlinear imaging applications in materials science, biology, and medicine, including four-wave mixing and stimulated Raman scattering imaging.

articleTitle: Long Wave Infrared Wavefront Reconstruction Through Complex Media
abstract: A novel broadband infrared (IR) speckle imaging system with a thin scatterer and an uncooled microbolometric camera is employed to encode wavefront phase variations as local speckle deformations. The phase reconstruction from speckle shifts using a fast diffeomorphic algorithm ultimately demonstrates IR wavefront reconstruction through complex media.

articleTitle: Photonic Topological States: the role played by symmetry and nonlinearity
abstract: We discuss our recent demonstrations of nonlinear control of topological states in cw-laser-written photonic lattices of different symmetries, including manipulation of edge and corner states in higher-order topological insulators and dynamically emerging nonlinear topological phenomena.

articleTitle: Vertical Growth Models Outperform Effective Medium Models in Analyzing VO2 Phase Transition
abstract: We propose vertical growth models as a numerical method to analyze the phase transition in vanadium dioxide thin films, and show that they can outperform effective medium models in predicting temperature-dependent linear optical properties.

articleTitle: The choice of materials for post-compression of high-peak-power long-wave infrared pulses
abstract: We report the initial results of a systematic measurement of nonlinear refraction and absorption of infrared materials at 9.2 µm and their application to the development of a post-compression scheme for long-wave infrared pulses.

articleTitle: Enhanced Light Extraction Efficiency of Ultraviolet Light-Emitting Diode via Hybrid Patterned Sapphire Substrate
abstract: We propose GaN-based ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (UV LEDs) grown on a hybrid patterned sapphire substrate (HPSS). Compared with the LED grown on the conventional patterned sapphire substrate (CPSS), HPSS-LED exhibits 14.5% enhanced light output power.

articleTitle: Cryogenic calibration of photonic circuits using the reversible deposition of xenon
abstract: We realize reconfigurable photonic devices that, once configured, consume no power. Here, we use the controlled deposition and sublimation of xenon to achieve π-phase shifts over a minimum length of just L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> = 12.3±0.3 µm.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of outdoor O2, CO2, and CH4 with a dual-comb spectrometer
abstract: We configure a fiber-laser based dual-comb spectrometer to measure the O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> delta band (1260 nm) in addition to CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> absorption features (1600 nm).

articleTitle: Enhancement of Color Conversion Efficiency of A High-Concentration Quantum-Dot-Converted LED with Collagen Encapsulating Materials
abstract: The CQD with collagen device can increase CCE by 7.15% higher than the PDMS device. The thermal results show that the areal surface temperature can be reduced in the CQD mixed with collagen package.

articleTitle: Thermal Bistability Induced by Optomechanical Oscillations
abstract: We report the observation of thermal bistability induced by optomechanical oscillation in an optical microcavity. It is shown experimentally and theoretically that such bistability appears due to optomechanically modulated photon number.

articleTitle: Waveguide Integrated MoTe2 Photodetector with High speed and energy efficient
abstract: Here we presented a waveguide integrated plasmonic MoTe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> based photodetector with the new design to accomplish high speed (300 GHz) energy efficient (0.8 AW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) detection of light at 1310 nm.

articleTitle: An optimized diamond nanopillar for enhanced NV-center collection efficiency
