abstract: Ultrafast two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy with phase-locked pump pulses provides a unique method to disentangle exciton and free carrier dynamics in the prototypical semiconductor gallium selenide with sub-10 fs temporal and 4 meV spectral resolution.

articleTitle: Longitudinally Structured Light Sheets for 3D Holography
abstract: We demonstrate a new holographic technique which projects target 3D scenes constructed from parallel multi-sheets oriented perpendicular to the hologram plane. Our holograms provide high axial resolution and realistic depth perception for AR/VR applications.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Mid-IR Optical Parametric Oscillator in Nanophotonic PPLN
abstract: We present on-chip optical parametric oscillators in nanophotonic periodically-poled lithium niobate, which are pumped near 1 µm and generate outputs tunable over an octave from 1.53 µm to 3.25 µm in the mid-IR.

articleTitle: Enhanced Smith–Purcell radiation from photonic flatband resonances
abstract: We show in both theory and experiment that flatband p hotonic resonances can control and boost free-electron radiation, as validated by enhancement, band, and polarization-shaping measurements.

articleTitle: Plasmonically Enhanced Second Harmonic Generation of Weyl Semimetal TaAs through field confinement
abstract: We demonstrate 300 percent increase of second-harmonic generation from Weyl semimetal TaAs surface by distributing plasmonic silver nanoantennas on TaAs. Normalizing laser spot size area over silver nanoantenna areas yields actual SHG enhancement is 90-fold.

articleTitle: Macroscopic condensation of photon noise in nonlinear dissipative systems
abstract: We present a new type of dissipation unique to nonlinear optical systems. We show how this phenomenon enables a new type of laser that deterministically creates macroscopic Fock states of light at optical frequencies.

articleTitle: Mach-Zehnder Interferometer for Topological Edge States Based on a Designer Domain Wall
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable single-waveguide interferometer based on interfaces between photonic topological insulators. Tunability is achieved by engineering the domain wall without altering the bulk. Topological protection enables compactness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Cosmic radiation reduced photo-thermal dispersion in silicon micro-ring resonators
abstract: The accumulative radiation increases the defects density in silicon and reduces the free-carrier lifetime, which results in reduced photo-thermal dispersion in silicon micro-ring resonators.

articleTitle: Tunable narrowband MIR ns-pulses at 5 kHz repetition from a 70% efficient backward wave OPO pumped at 1030 nm
abstract: Precision-tuned nanosecond pulses at 1981.1 nm and 2145.6 nm are generated from a PPKTP BWOPO with 70% efficiency, pumped by an amplified single-frequency fiber laser at 1030 nm. It is free from mechanically-adjustable optical cavities.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Transmission of Four-Dimensional LDPC-Coded Modulation with Slepian Sequences for DSP-Free 40 km Metro Network Transmission
abstract: We implement a 4-dimentional modulation format using Slepian sequences. We applied LDPC coding and experimentally investigated the BER performance in a 40km fiber link transmission and get the error free region without complicated DSP.

articleTitle: Imaging dynamics of optical vortices in 2D materials
abstract: We present the first observation of optical vortices in 2D materials. Specifically, we use ultrafast transmission electron microscopy to measure phonon-polariton-vortices in hBN. This provides the first experiment of vortex-pair creation&annihilationn in any optical system.

articleTitle: Large Scale Frequency-Encoded RF-Photonic Neural Networks
abstract: Photoelectric multiplication between RF-encoded optical frequency combs allows single-shot matrix-vector multiplication and nonlinear activation, leading to high throughput and ultra-low latency. This architecture allows for an arbitrary number of layers to be cascaded in analog.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Non-Symmetric Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Modulator with a 3-dB Bandwidth Beyond 100 GHz
abstract: Thin-film lithium niobate electro-optic modulators with bandwidths >100 GHz are demonstrated. The trade-off between bandwidth and voltage is alleviated by non-symmetric positioning of waveguides with respect to electrodes and by incorporating a dielectric buffer layer.

articleTitle: Ultrafast All-Fiber Mid-Infrared Laser Sources
abstract: We report on all-fiber construction of ultrafast mid-infrared sources with up to 500 kW peak power at MHz repetition rate. We illustrate the potential of the sources by generating supercontinuum in chalcogenide fibers.

articleTitle: Distributed Bragg Reflector Lasers at 689.45 nm for Sr Spectroscopy
abstract: We present distributed Bragg reflector lasers optimized for strontium-based quantum technology applications at 689.449 nm. The devices achieved optical output powers up to 88 mW, four times more than previously reported, and a spectral linewidth of 0.4MHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz frequency synthesizer referenced to an ultra-stable optical cavity
abstract: A terahertz frequency synthesizer is devised with reference to an ultra-stable cavity via an optical comb with an unprecedented stability of 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> at 1-s averaging.

articleTitle: White Rabbit-assisted quantum network node synchronization with quantum channel coexistence
abstract: We show that the Ethernet-based time transfer protocol ‘White Rabbit’ can synchronize two distant quantum-networked nodes to within 4 ps, enabling HOM interference at >90 % visibility using 17.6 ps FWHM single-photons coexisting with White Rabbit.

articleTitle: High efficiency mid-infrared soliton self-frequency shift in a fluoride fiber
abstract: We present a simple and efficient design of wavelength converter tunable in the wavelength range of 2.10-2.65 µm. Raman solitons at 1.94 µm are frequency shifted in a fluoride fiber with conversion efficiency of 53%-91%.

articleTitle: Realization and Investigation of Non-Reciprocal Raman Gain in a Nanophotonic System
abstract: We demonstrate non-reciprocal amplification of light using R aman gain. The non-reciprocal response originates from spin-polarized atoms chirally coupled to a nanophotonic waveguide. We show that the gain scales superlinearly with the number of emitters.

articleTitle: Spectral Shaping In a Multimode Fiber By All-Fiber Modulation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate spectral shaping in a multimode fiber by macro-bend based transmission matrix engineering. We implemented an all-fiber reconfigurable narrowband single-and dual-window bandpass filters.

articleTitle: High-power 894nm semiconductor lasers for Cs atom pumping based on surface high-order gratings
abstract: A high-power semiconductor laser based on surface high-order gratings at 894nm is present. The output-power of 203 mW, a SMSR of higher than 35 dB, and a efficient slope of 0.52 W/A are obtained.

articleTitle: Excitation of Surface Plasmon Polaritons by Space Time Wave Packets
abstract: Current nanoplasmonic applications are limited due to surface plasmon polariton (SPP) attenuation. Here, we experimentally demonstrate additional means to excite a larger area of SPPs by expanding the extent of 1D Space-Time wave packets.

articleTitle: Using a Camera Based Imaging Lidar to Detect Temporal Distributions of Boundary Layer Aerosols in The Bahamas
abstract: A wide-angle camera based imaging lidar was used to measure altitude dependent aerosol single angle side scattering. Aerosol extinction was derived for several continuous hours to monitor spatial and temporal distributions of boundary layer aerosols.

articleTitle: Integrated electronic-photonic barrel shifter for high-performance optical computing
abstract: We propose a 2-bit electronic-photonic shifter based on microdisk add-drop switches with experimental demonstrations. The proposed shifter can be deployed in future high speed and energy efficient electronic-photonic arithmetic logic units.

articleTitle: High-Speed Chip-based Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution with Double-Scanning Method
abstract: Photonic integration offers a practical solution for wider deployment of quantum secure communication. Based on carrier-depletion modulators (CDMs) in silicon photonics, we design and fabricate high-speed transmitter chips and demonstrate its capability to implement measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD). In the proof-of-concept experiment, the quantum bit error rate (QBER) is as low as 0.85% in Z basis and 25.5% in X basis, respectively. With a double-scanning method, the optimized system shows a key rate per pulse of 1.65 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> over an emulated attenuation of 10 dB (corresponding to 50-km standard fiber) with 80% single photon detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Self-starting and low-noise counter-propagating all-normal-dispersion (CANDi) fiber laser
abstract: Self-starting dynamics and noise characteristics of CANDi laser has been investigated. Near deterministic self-starting has been realize through enhanced self-seeding and the key to lowering the relative phase noise has been identified.

articleTitle: Top-Side Illuminated InAs/AlAsSb Quantum Cascade Detector at 2.7 μm
abstract: We present the design, growth, and optical and electrical characterization of an InAs/AlAs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.16</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.84</inf> quantum cascade detector at 2.7 μm designed for top-side illumination assisted by a diffraction grating with a room-temperature responsivity of 5.63 mA/W.

articleTitle: Beyond 100 Gbit/s per Wavelength PAM-8 Transmission over 25 km Using Low Complexity Equalization
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed PAM-8 transmission over 25 km SMF for access networks using an MZM. BERs below 3.8e-3 were obtained at 108 Gbit/s and 120 Gbit/s using a linear and a simplified Volterra equalizer respectively.

articleTitle: High Extinction Ratio Microring Modulator
abstract: We design and demonstrate a high extinction ratio (ER) microring modulator. The modulator has a high ER of 27 dB across the wafer, and a measured ER of > 13.9 dB for modulation speeds up to 20 Gbps.

articleTitle: Surface Chemistry Measurements of Atmosphere-Driven Transition in Wettability of Ultra-Short Pulsed Laser Processed Copper
abstract: Changes in surface chemistry and wettability of femtosecond laser surface processed (FLSP) copper due to atmospheric exposure are quantified using X-ray photo-electron spectroscopy and contact angle measurements.

articleTitle: An Integrated Platform for Collinear Beam Combination
abstract: We develop a photonic integrated chip and metasurface platform for collinearly combining laser beams at 813 nm and 698 nm wavelengths for the lattice and clock beams of a miniature atomic clock.

articleTitle: Heteroepitaxial Growth of Mixed OP-GaAsP Periodic Structures and Second-Harmonic Generation
abstract: Orientation-patterned GaAs<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.85</inf>P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.15</inf> is grown by hydride vapor phase epitaxy on a GaAs template and second-harmonic generation is demonstrated for this ternary periodic structure using ultrashort pulses with an intrinsic conversion efficiency exceeding 19%.

articleTitle: Photonic-Eletronic Arbitrary Waveform Generation up to 100 GHz Using Active Phase Stabilization
abstract: We demonstrate photonic-electronic ultra-broadband arbitrary waveform generation based on coherent reception of IQ signals and active phase stabilization. We show the viability of our concept by generating OOK and PAM4 data signals at symbol rates up to 200 GBd.

articleTitle: Drone-Based Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Current quantum cryptography implementations primarily use fixed free-space or fiber-based communication channels. We seek to broaden this to include mobile plat-forms. Here we report progress towards optical tracking system stabilization leading to efficient quantum state transmission.

articleTitle: Automatic Design of a Broadband Directional Coupler via Bayesian Optimization
abstract: In integrated silicon photonics, a directional coupler (DC) capable of working in a broad band is of high interest. To facilitate its design, an automatic gradient-free synthesis approach based on Bayesian optimization is proposed.

articleTitle: Creation of Photonic Cat and GKP States Using Modulated Electrons
abstract: We show how the coherent shaping of free-electron wavefunctions enables the construction of coherent grid states. We present a scheme to create Schrödinger cat and GKP states, which are sought-after for fault-tolerant photonic quantum computation.

articleTitle: Photoinduced Surface Reshaping from Azopolymer Micropillars with Programmable Anisotropy
abstract: Tailoring surface-driven functionalities requires versatile techniques for surface micropatterning. Here surfaces of a photosensitive azobenzene-containing polymer, prepatterned with an array of discrete cylindrical micropillars, are reconfigured through a light-driven polarization-sensitive surface deformation.

articleTitle: Large Scale Deterministic Creation of Single Photon Emitters in Silicon Nitride Nanopillars
abstract: We demonstrated large scale deterministic creation of single photon emitters in annealed silicon nitride on silicon oxide pillars. The estimated single photon emitter yield is approximately 50% with a lateral accuracy of ±85nm.

articleTitle: Complete measurement of the phase-space topology of fiber four-wave mixing using iterated initial conditions
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical fiber testbed enabling the quantitative study of ideal four-wave mixing. We directly measure the complex phase-space topology including features such as the separatrix, Fermi Pasta Ulam recurrence, and stationary waves.

articleTitle: 3 μm Wavelength OPCPA for Soft X-ray Generation
abstract: We report a robust, 3µm wavelength OPCPA system with sub-mJ pulse energies at 1kHz repetition rate. The use of high-pressure hollow-core waveguides, both regular and anti-resonant, provide a pathway for phase-matched soft X-ray generation.

articleTitle: 1030 nm Photoconductive Receiver excited at >20 mW of THz Average Power
abstract: We present an investigation of an ErAs:InAlGaAs photoconductive antenna receiver optimized for 1030 nm probe pulses at 24 mW THz power and show a dynamic range of 92 dB in 10 s measurement time. The saturation behavior under high THz average power is studied as well.

articleTitle: Correction of Apodisation-Induced Phase Error in Small-Spot Direct UV Bragg Grating Writing
abstract: A modification to the small-spot direct UV writing scheme is presented to resolve apodization-induced phase shift. Numerical and analytic simulations of the scheme are demonstrated alongside experimental results of gratings fabricated with the modified technique.

articleTitle: A Nanophotonic Broadband Quantum Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrate generation of a broadband quantum optical frequency comb using spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a dispersion-engineered thin-film lithium niobate resonator spanning 30-THz bandwidth and 600 comb lines at 50-GHz mode spacing.

articleTitle: GaN Coupled Microring Lasers: Towards a Topological Laser Array
abstract: We demonstrate a MOPA GaN system, a microring DFB laser coupled to another microring laser. Both rings lase in a single mode, establishing a building block towards a topological laser array in GaN.

articleTitle: Full-silica metamaterial to tailor polarization state of UV high power lasers
abstract: We report on a full silica transmission grating able to act as a wave plate at the wavelength of 351nm, offering performances that open the road to high-power lasers applications

articleTitle: Diffractive Networks All-Optically Reconstruct Holograms
abstract: We present a new framework for computer-free, all-optical reconstruction of inline holograms through a passive diffractive network that is trained with holographic image data using deep learning.

articleTitle: Speckle resistance from space-time light sheets
abstract: We investigate the propagation of the space-time (ST) light sheet through a thin diffuser. We find that the ST light sheet shows considerable resistance to speckle formation and pulse broadening.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed multi-wavelength, multi-mode optical interconnects using soliton microcombs
abstract: We demonstrate 130 Gbps transmission in each of 4 spatial modes using Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> soliton microcombs and inverse-designed silicon mode multiplexers. Out of 52 carriers, 42 data channels show natively error-free data transmission.

articleTitle: Nd:Phosphate Split-slab Liquid Cooled kJ Amplifier for High Power Laser at 1 Shot/Minute
abstract: A liquid cooled Nd:Phosphate split-disk amplifier, operating at 1053nm and one shot/min, was designed and built. Good wavefront quality is obtained, in agreement with multi-physics modeling and with performance needs on high power laser systems.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation of blue light on integrated thin-film lithium niobate waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient second harmonic generation of blue light using periodically poled thin-film lithium niobate waveguides. Our device shows a conversion efficiency of η<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> = 33000%/W-cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Continuous Wave Operation of Terahertz Metasurface Quantum-cascade VECSEL with a Long Intra-cryostat Cavity
abstract: An off-axis paraboloid mirror is introduced into the intra-cryostat quantum-cascade VECSEL cavity as a focusing element to reduce the diffraction loss. Continuous-wave lasing at 3.4 THz is obtained with a cavity length ~27 mm.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Lithium Niobate nanophotonic circuits for quantum information processing with InAs/GaAs Quantum Dot single-photon sources
abstract: We present the experimental realization of electro-optically reconfigurable Lithium-Niobate-On-Insulator waveguide circuits featuring propagation loss down to ~0.8 dB/cm at a ~900 nm wavelength, designed for operation with single photons emitted by InAs/GaAs Quantum Dots.

articleTitle: Controlling the PT Symmetry of Dirac Plasmons in Dual-Grating-Gate Graphene THz Laser Transistors for Ultrafast Gain Switching
abstract: We introduce a new scheme of actively controlling the $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry of the graphene Dirac plasmon metasurface in a graphene-channel laser transistor structure. Numerical simulation demonstrates the capability of 100-Gbit/s-class ultrafast gain-switching in its plasmonic THz laser operation by electrically modulating the $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry by the applied bias voltages.

articleTitle: An Eigenchannel Theory for Super-Resolution Sensing with a Randomly Scattering Analyzer
abstract: It has been established that a randomly scattering analyzer can give increased sensitivity to a changing incident field. We propose an explanation using random matrix theory and an eigenvalue decomposition of the transmission matrix.

articleTitle: Generation and manipulation in parallel of a terahertz pulse train with sub-picosecond resolution
abstract: We demonstrate a new technique for the generation and the active modulation of a THz pulse train using the combination of a terahertz (THz) spintronic emitter with an echelon mirror and a digital micromirror device (DMD).

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Equalizer to Extend Input Power Dynamic Range of SOA in 100Gb/s/λ PON
abstract: We propose a novel equalization scheme for 100Gb/s/λ PAM4 PON based on Gated Recurrent Neural Network to increase SOA preamplifier input power dynamic range tolerance to 30 dB below hard-decision FEC BER limit of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Digital Holography at Fast Sampling Rate
abstract: Near-infrared and visible frequency combs, combined with fast CMOS cameras and multi-heterodyne read-out, open up new opportunities for lens-less imaging, three-dimensional metrology and scan-free wavefront reconstruction.

articleTitle: Third order backward second-harmonic generation in periodically poled Rb-doped KTP with a period of 317 nm
abstract: We demonstrate 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> order QPM backward SHG in a bulk PPRKTP with a poling period of 317nm. This is the shortest QPM period ever fabricated. These results pave the way towards 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> order BSHG.

articleTitle: Polarization Independent Waveguide Bragg Gratings using Tilted Subwavelength Grating Waveguides
abstract: We propose and demonstrate polarization independent Bragg gratings using tilted subwavelength grating waveguides. In particular, by controlling the tile angle, we can make the Bragg wavelengths of the fundamental transverse electric and transverse magnetic modes the same.

articleTitle: Phase conjugation of orbital angular momentum in cylindrical vector beams by stimulated Brillouin scattering
abstract: We show experimentally and theoretically that the phase conjugation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) in cylindrical vector beams does not happen in most regions of the higher-order Poincaré sphere, except near the poles where the beam reduces to a scalar beam and conjugation of OAM may take place.

articleTitle: Arbitrary Space-time Wave Packet Synthesis
abstract: We demonstrate arbitrary spatiotemporal synthesis of ultrafast optical transients by leveraging the multifunctional control of light at the nanoscale offered by metasurfaces, enabling ready-synthesis of complex space-time wave packets over an ultrawide bandwidth.

articleTitle: 3D Imaging Using Extreme Dispersion in Optical Metasurfaces
abstract: We exploit strong chromatic dispersion of metasurfaces by combining it with computational imaging to enable compact, single-shot, large field-of-view, and passive 3D imaging. We employ a dielectric metasurface with interleaved RGB meta-elements in this demonstration.

articleTitle: High-speed PAM4 Transmission Using a 12.5G Class DML Enabled by Low Complexity DSP
abstract: We demonstrate 90 Gbit/s PAM4 transmission for intra-data center links using a 1540-nm DML. BER values below 3.8e-3 were achieved after 1 km of SMF at 0 dBm using low complexity eye-skew compensation and equalization.

articleTitle: Complex-valued Reconfigurable Diffractive Optical Neural Networks using Cost-effective Spatial Light Modulators
abstract: We demonstrate a reconfigurable diffractive optical neural network based on cost-effective spatial light modulators. We explored various diffraction calculation methods to match trainable models with experimental results. This lays the foundation for fast system deployment.

articleTitle: Approaching the motional ground state of a 10 kg object
abstract: Thermal decoherence impedes preparing massive objects in quantum states. Using feedback cooling, we place the center-of-mass motion of a 10kg oscillator in a state with phonon occupation 10.8, bringing it from room temperature to 77 nK.

articleTitle: Shaping Free-space Emission with Monolithically Integrated Metalenses on Silicon Photonic Waveguides
abstract: We report a monolithic and CMOS-compatible platform to integrate metalenses on silicon waveguides for shaping free-space emission. We demonstrate experimentally a 2.5 μm tightly focused spot, and the focus position is switchable with excitation direction.

articleTitle: Control of the coherent excitonic nonlinear response in WSe2
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate pulse-shape-based coherent control of the A-exciton resonance in monolayer WSe2, steering the third-order nonlinear response from fully destructive to constructive interference. Our results outperform the transform-limited case by a 2.3 enhancement factor.

articleTitle: Hybrid-mode-family Kerr optical parametric oscillation for robust and efficient coherent light generation
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the use of different transverse spatial mode families for χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> microresonator optical parametric oscillation. This new scheme shows unprecedented robustness to geometric variations, and an on-chip pump-to-signal power conversion efficiency of ≈ 8 %.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction and Classification using Silicon Photonic Neuron with a Self-Connection
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated real-time operation of a photonic neuron with a self-connection, a pre-requisite for integrated recurrent neural networks (RNNs). After studying two applications we propose a photonics-assisted platform for time series prediction and classification.

articleTitle: Photonic molecule microcombs at 50 GHz repetition rate
abstract: We present a microcomb in a photonic molecule with 50 GHz repetition rate. The comb attains > 50% power conversion efficiency and displays a quiet point of operation in repetition rate with decreased phase noise.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Detection of Terahertz Radiation With Regenerative Terahertz Quantum Detector
abstract: Quantum cascade lasers can be operated as resonantly amplified terahertz detectors with wide RF bandwidth. Responsivities up to 50 V/W and noise equivalent powers down to 100 pW/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> are demonstrated at 4.7 THz. Constant peak responsivities with respect to the detector temperature are observed up to 80K. The sub-ps intersubband lifetime allows electrical bandwidths as large as 67 GHz as suggested by detection of optical beatnotes from a femtosecond laser.

articleTitle: Single-frequency Single-resonator Lasers on Erbium Doped Lithium Niobate on Insulator
abstract: Single-frequency single-resonator lasers on erbium-doped lithium niobate on insulator are demonstrated. The 35 GHz microring laser exhibits wavelength switching while the 192 GHz microring laser achieves a maximal output power of 2.1 μW.

articleTitle: Multimodal Photoacoustic Microscopy, Optical Coherence Tomography, and Fluorescence in vivo Tracking of Stem Cells
abstract: We present a novel method for longitudinal tracking of transplanted stem cells in the subretinal space in a living rabbit using multimodal photoacoustic microscopy (PAM), optical coherence tomography (OCT), and fluorescence imaging.

articleTitle: Towards Ultrahigh Quantum Cooperativity with Side-coupled 2D Optomechanical Crystals
abstract: We present the design and fabrication of side-coupled 2D optomechanical crystals. By mechanically disconnecting the optical waveguide from the cavity, we expect to remove a significant contribution to the thermal bath limiting the optomechanical cooperativity.

articleTitle: Minimal memory differentiable FDTD for inverse design
abstract: We construct a reverse mode automatic differentiation FDTD that reduces the memory requirement, a typical bottleneck, by two orders of magnitude, and employ it to produce meta-atoms with specified phase responses and group delays.

articleTitle: Globally Optimized EUV Monochromator for Ultrafast Spectroscopy and Coherent Diffractive Imaging
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-optic imaging-spectrometer for high harmonic generation sources, ideal for coherent diffractive imaging in a tunable monochromatic mode. Our optimization combines record-high efficiency, high spectral resolution, low aberrations, broad spectral coverage, and polarization-maintaining.

articleTitle: Rack-Mounted Ultrastable Laser System for Sr Lattice Clock Operation
abstract: We present a rack-mounted ultra-low-noise laser system for Sr lattice clocks, with spectral purity transfer stability of 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup>@1s and 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-19</sup>@100s. We realize a system stability of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-16</sup>@1s, representing state-of-the-art performance for rack-mounted commercial systems.

articleTitle: Phase-Sensitive Femtosecond Detection in the Infrared with a Third-Order Nonlinear Interaction
abstract: We demonstrate a time-domain technique for phase-sensitive detection of mid-to-near-infrared electric transients. Exploiting third-order nonlinearities, limitations for electro-optic sampling like few-femtosecond probe pulses and carrier-envelope phase stability are circumvented.

articleTitle: Tunable optical switches based on spin valley quantum coherence in hybrid WS2-metallic nanoantenna systems
abstract: A tunable optical switching process based on spin valley quantum coherence in a hybrid system consisting of a WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayer and a metallic nanoantenna is investigated. This process is induced by plasmonically-mediated intervalley exciton-plasmon coupling which is shown to be quite resilient against ultrafast valley decoherence.

articleTitle: Quantum Interface Based on a Non-Hermitian Magnon-Photon Beamsplitter
abstract: We report an atom-light beamsplitter-type interface, in which flying photons and stored atomic coherence can be transformed reversibly. The degree of Hermiticity of this interface can alter the atom-photon quantum interference from bosonic to fermion-like.

articleTitle: Programmable Microlaser Array Enabled by Living Biomaterials
abstract: A biologically programmable microlsaer was developed, where lasing wavelength can be controlled by enzyme reaction in hydrogel microdroplets confined in microcavities. This study represents the first development of a biological controlled laser for optical information applications.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Dynamics of Photochromic Molecules Coupled to Anisotropic Plasmon Nanoantennas
abstract: We study coupling of merocyanine to aluminum nanoantennas in weak and strong interaction regimes. Experiments reveal modification of the molecular dynamics induced by the plasmons as verified by quantum modelling of the hybrid system.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Single-Photon Synapses
abstract: We present a single-photon-sensitive synapse realized by the monolithic integration of superconducting-nanowire single-photon detectors with Josephson electronics. Data show the utility of the synapse for achieving synaptic weighting and integration of pulse trains.

articleTitle: Observation of Pulse Formation Dynamics in Yb Fiber Lasers with Time Stretch Spectroscopy
abstract: We report on the real-time spectral dynamics on an initial stage of build-up femtosecond pulse in a homemade passively mode-locked Yb fiber laser with a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror using time stretch spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Noise Rejection Through An Improved Quantum Illumination Protocol
abstract: We demonstrate an improved full-field quantum illumination protocol that achieves the rejection of 99.9% of background light. This imaging protocol has applications in covert imaging and quantum LIDAR schemes.

articleTitle: On-demand Structured Wavepacket Generation
abstract: We demonstrate a versatile approach to judiciously synthesize on-demand convoluted ultrafast light structures in which the spatial and temporal dimensions are precisely correlated. Our results establish a new paradigm with a broad range of applications.

articleTitle: All-Optical, Tunable Third Harmonic Generation in the Ultraviolet Range using Reconfigurable Chalcogenide Metasurfaces
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate ultra-high-speed, tunable third harmonic generation (THG) in the opaque spectral range of Arsenic trisulfide (As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) glass metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband Simulation of Nonlinear Optical Processes with Finite Element Time Domain Methods
abstract: We investigate simulation of complex nonlinear optical processes. A mathematical model and numerical simulation techniques are developed. They are used to elucidate THz generation in periodically poled Lithium Niobate (PPLN) including optical harmonic generation.

articleTitle: All-Glass, Mass-Producible, Large-Diameter Metalens at Visible Wavelength for 100 mm Aperture Optics and Beyond
abstract: We present a mass-producible, all-glass, 100 mm diameter metalens working at visible wavelengths manufactured using deep-ultraviolet projection lithography, overcoming the intrinsic exposure size limit of the lithography tool.

articleTitle: Compact, broadband CWDM demultiplexer using energy constrained inverse design
abstract: A three-channel (de)multiplexer with 50 nm channel spacing and 6.2 μm × 5.4 μm footprint is designed with an energy constrained inverse design method, providing low loss, acceptable crosstalk, and 47 nm 3-dB bandwidth experimentally.

articleTitle: Long-Distance Ranging with Fiber-Frontend-Based LiDAR using a Free-Running Dual-Comb Laser
abstract: We demonstrate long-distance ranging with a fiber-frontend-based LiDAR using a free-running solid-state dual-comb laser to reduce complexity and increase robustness. A distance of >10 meters to a moving target can be measured with micrometer precision.

articleTitle: Sculpting multipoles for the optical pulling force in an unstructured light beam
abstract: We study optical forces acting on a triangular dielectric prism illuminated by a circularly polarized light and suggest a novel approach for engineering optical pulling forces by employing multipolar modes of Mie-resonant subwavelength particles.

articleTitle: Dispersion Adjusting Knife Edge Scan for Optimization of Simultaneously Spatially and Temporally Focused Ultrafast Pulses
abstract: We present a pulse characterization technique based on dispersion scan which is capable of measuring the spatial focal quality and through-focus temporal evolution of simultaneously spatially and temporally focused ultrafast pulses.

articleTitle: Exciton complexes and quantum electrodynamics of highly-symmetric single-site-controlled InGaAS quantum dot nanocavities
abstract: We demonstrate high-resolution cryogenic photoluminescence measurements on exciton complexes emitting ≈ 1 μm of a single-site-controlled highly-symmetric quantum dot-nanocavity system. Observed fine spectral features uncover the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3v</inf> QD symmetry and cavity quantum electrodynamics.

articleTitle: Integrated FMCW Lidar with 210-meter Ranging Based on Lens-assisted Beam Steering (LABS) Technology
abstract: An integrated frequency-modulated continuous-wave Lidar is demonstrated based on lens-assisted beam steering technology at 1550nm. For the first time, the integrated Lidar has achieved a maximum ranging distance up to 210m.

articleTitle: Revealing Cellular Features by Transverse Laser Modes in Frequency Domain
abstract: This study reveals the key mechanism governing the frequency distributions of transverse modes in cellular lasers. By extracting laser modes in frequency domain, cellular microlasers were applied for studying cell adhesion process and cell classification from rat cortices.

articleTitle: High Harmonic Generation Driven by Quantum Light: Strong-Field Approximation & Attosecond Pulses
abstract: We develop a quantum-optical theory of high harmonic generation under the strong-field approximation, showing that continuum electronic trajectories and the corresponding attosecond pulses (envelope, duration & phase) strongly depend on the driving field’s photon statistics.

articleTitle: Dynamically Tunable Harmonic Generation Using Hybrid Metasurfaces Incorporating Phase-Change Chalcogenides
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a dynamic nonlinear metasurface incorporating the phase-change material GST that facilitates large modulation of second harmonic generation featuring gap-surface plasmon resonance and tunable second-order nonlinearity of GST.

articleTitle: High-speed Semipolar Micro Light-emitting Diodes and Quantum Dot Phosphor Applied to Visible Light Communication
abstract: We report the blue semipolar $\left( {202\,\bar 1} \right)$ μLED array which exhibited excellent optical-electrical characteristics and polarization performance. A high 3-dB bandwidth of 1.056 GHz under a current density of 2.5 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 1.8 Gbit/s data rate were achieved in a certain free-space transmission distance.

articleTitle: Subradiant Directional Memory in Cooperative Scattering
abstract: Using ensembles of coupled point-like scatterers, we demonstrate long-living, backscattering directional memory in spatially bounded random media. This counter-intuitive phenomenon emerges from subradiant quasi-modes located in the vicinity of medium’s interface.

articleTitle: Engineering Carrier Dynamics in Pseudo-Landau-Quantized Graphene towards Developing Graphene Lasers
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that strong pseudo-magnetic fields in strained graphene significantly modify the hot carrier dynamics. We also theoretically propose that pseudo-Landau-quantized graphene may serve as an excellent gain medium for integrated graphene lasers.

articleTitle: X-ray imaging with nanophotonic scintillators
abstract: We develop a general framework to enhance and control X-ray scintillation by embedding nanophotonic structures into scintillators. We demonstrate 10-fold scintillation enhancement in a conventional scintillator, showing the potential of our technique for X-ray imaging.

articleTitle: Spectrally Resolved Linewidth Enhancement Factor of an Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: The linewidth enhancement factor (LEF) is an important parameter of semiconductor lasers as it describes many of their unique properties. Recently, it is gaining broad attention due to its key role in frequency comb operation. However, previously developed techniques to measure the LEF are limited to sub-threshold bias or singlemode operation. Here, we report a novel and universally applicable technique to directly obtain the LEF of a running multimode laser frequency comb over its entire spectrum. The technique utilizes a phase-sensitive single shot measurement scheme. We derive a theoretical model, perform numerical Maxwell-Bloch simulations and experimentally demonstrate our technique on a quantum cascade laser.

articleTitle: Narrow-Linewidth Fano Laser
abstract: By exploiting Fano resonances, a microscopic laser with a linewidth >20 times smaller than previous microscopic lasers is experimentally demonstrated. We also show that the linewidth can be further improved by engineering the Fano lineshape.

articleTitle: High-Density and High-Efficiency Silicon Photonics Optical Interconnects for Space Division Multiplexing with Multi-Core Fiber
abstract: We present an architecture for space-division-multiplexing with multi-core-fiber (MCF) for high-density and high-efficiency short-reach optical interconnects. A silicon photonics transceiver with tera-bits-per-second capability and high-efficiency dual-layer grating couplers for MCF fan-in/fan-out are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Direct Growth of Graphene on V2O5 for Optoelectronic Devices
abstract: We report a large area uniform graphene was graphically grown directly on a mental-oxide-semiconductor substrate at low temperature. The graphene was grown and used for the fabrication of graphene-V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>-Si Schottky junction photodetectors with a responsivity of 388.3 mA/W.

articleTitle: Chip-Integrated Full-Stokes Polarimetric Imaging Sensor
abstract: We report a chip-integrated, dual-wavelength full Stokes polarimetric CMOS imaging sensor based on metasurface polarization filter arrays. Our device provides high accuracy polarization detection and imaging at a single snapshot.

articleTitle: Optimal purification of a spin ensemble by quantum-algorithmic feedback
abstract: We present a coherent quantum feedback algorithm to purify a mesoscopic spin ensemble at the ultimate level of a single spin. Applying it to a quantum dot narrowed nuclear-spin fluctuations by two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Exhaust Gas Diagnostics at Real Driving Conditions using a Compact TDLAS Measurement System
abstract: Stronger regulation requirements for industrial application based thermo-chemical energy conversion processes demand for new measurement approaches to characterize the composition of the exhaust gas emission. We present a robust multi-channel, multi species measurements system for the quantification of exhaust gas species direct at the tail pipe end of a driving car. The application of the TDLAS spectrometer at a car during a syn-fuel test drive will be shown and the robustness as well as uncertainties of the optical system will be discussed.

articleTitle: An Environmentally-robust Visible Optical Clockwork Capable of Supporting Instabilities Below 1×10-17
abstract: An environmentally-robust optical clockwork in the visible spectrum with in-loop instabilities below 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-17</sup> is presented. Individual optical subsystem performance is analyzed, and the potential for integration into next-generation quantum sensors is discussed.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Boundaries along a Synthetic Frequency Dimension
abstract: We theoretically outline and experimentally demonstrate the creation of boundaries along a synthetic frequency dimension, and use it to show the reflection-free nature of backscattering immune topological one-way edge states in a quantum Hall ladder.

articleTitle: Polarization Quantum State Tomography With a Single Liquid Crystal Variable Retarder
abstract: We present a method of performing polarization-based quantum state tomography with a single liquid crystal variable retarder per photon, allowing for full state characterization to be performed in applications where space and power are limited.

articleTitle: Large Aperture and Wide Field of View Meta-Receiver for Free Space Optical Communications
abstract: We present large aperture optical meta-receiver design to capture ±5° incident angles on single photodetector by using two metalenses and one off-the-shelf aspheric lens to eliminate the impact of pointing jitter in free-space optical communications.

articleTitle: Waveguide-Coupled Mid-IR Photodetector Based on Interlayer Excitons Absorption in a WS2/HfS2 Heterostructure
abstract: We demonstrate a waveguide-coupled mid-IR photodetector based on interlayer excitons in a WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/HfS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure. We measure broadband photodetection, with responsivity in the order of tens of µA/W with low losses to the waveguide mode.

articleTitle: Aluminum Nitride Slot-mode Piezo-Optomechanical Crystals
abstract: We demonstrate an AlN piezo-opto-mechanical slot-mode resonator excited using a radio-frequency electrode hovering above the chip, with a 1550-nm optical mode coupling to multiple mechanical modes over broad frequency span (4.5 MHz - 3.8 GHz).

articleTitle: Efficient high-peak-power 50-fs-class Yb:YAG thin-disk laser oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate efficient short-pulse generation from Yb:YAG in the regime of strong intracavity self-phase-modulation. We reach 102-MW, 52-fs pulses at 103-W average-power with 26% optical-to-optical efficiency, presenting the highest peak-power of any ultrafast laser oscillator.

articleTitle: Self-Powered GaN Nanowire-Based Photoelectrochemical Type Photodetector for Wireless UV Photodetection in Seawater
abstract: We fabricated a wireless photo-detecting system consisting of a self-powered PEC PD based on GaN nanowires in an artificial seawater environment. The portable electrochemical workstation with wireless data transmission and cloud storage in this system shows a promising future in photo-detecting and optical communication applications.

articleTitle: Generating Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Qubits Over Continuous-Variable Cluster States with Photon-Number-Resolving Measurements
abstract: We develop a method to embed Schrödinger Cat states in continuous-variable cluster states with high probability using photon-number-resolving detection. Embedded cat states can then be bred into Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits with Gaussian measurements on the cluster.

articleTitle: Compact, Low-Noise Optical Reference Cavity with Lithographically Fabricated Mirrors
abstract: Our 8 mL vacuum-gap Fabry-Pérot cavity uses lithographically fabricated mirrors to achieve >900 000 finesse, thermally limited noise to nearly 1 kHz offset, and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> fractional frequency instability over 7 seconds of averaging.

articleTitle: Directionality Control and Strong-localization of Light in a Disordered Medium of Reduced Area
abstract: By juxtaposing a 2D periodic array, Anderson localization of light is attained in a disordered medium of reduced area. Directionality control of the strongly localized mode of light is also attained with the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Observation of Interorbital Coupling
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally show the coupling between different orthogonal modes by tuning their propagation constant in a photonic chip platform. This element is completely passive and effectively converts single modes to higher modes.

articleTitle: Regenerative DFB lasing from new silicone elastomer waveguide for printable and imprintable optics fabrication
abstract: Regenerative dye lasing was demonstrated using new polydimethylsiloxane-based core, with high solubility and thermoplasticity. Furthermore, dry-diffusion of dye-molecules observed in the material. PDMS substrate as a dye-reservoir post-doped dye into core, and regenerative lasing achieved.

articleTitle: Unveiling the underdamped longitudinal soft mode in paraelectric KDP by ultrafast x-ray diffraction
abstract: We present ultrafast x-ray diffraction experiments of the underdamped soft mode in paraelectric KDP. Charge density maps derived from the x-ray data reveal oscillatory electronic charge relocations over interatomic distances, much larger than the sub-picometer nuclear displacements, a hallmark of soft-mode behavior.

articleTitle: Coherence properties of a thermalized highly multimoded nonlinear parabolic fiber
abstract: We investigate the coherence characteristics of the parabolic fiber by utilizing optical thermodynamic theory. Our analysis indicates that the mutual correlation function can be related to the optical temperature and the corresponding chemical potential.

articleTitle: Visible Topological Lasing Based on a Polymer-cholesteric Liquid Crystal Superlattice
abstract: Low-threshold topological lasing at visible wavelengths and with circular polarizations is demonstrated theoretically, and experimentally in a femtosecond-laser-written micron-sized polymer-cholesteric liquid crystal composite structure by manipulating the topological mini-bands based on the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Oblique Angle Metaoptics for Mid-Infrared Wavelength and Polarization Splitting
abstract: Practical implementations of volumetric nanophotonics require acceptance of oblique angles of incidence. We use an inverse design approach to optimize metaoptic devices for central angles up to 15° with minimal performance loss.

articleTitle: Photonic Metacrystal: Design and Experimental Results
abstract: Going beyond the limited design freedoms of traditional photonic crystals, we experimentally show how photonic metacrystals exploit the inclusion of subwavelength dielectric scatterers in the unit cell to deterministically modify k-space and real space profiles.

articleTitle: Predicting Molecular Properties Using Photonic Chip-Based Machine Learning Approach
abstract: The intensive neural network architecture for molecules resulted in exponential growth in computation cost. Photonic chip technology offers an alternative platform with faster processing. We apply an optical neural chip to predict multiple quantum mechanical properties of molecules.

articleTitle: Silicon Integrated Terahertz Quantum Cascade Ring Laser Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrate terahertz quantum cascade lasers realized in ideal ring resonators that are mounted episide-down on a silicon substrate by a die-bonding technique. Devices show much reduced threshold current densities and free-running comb formation.

articleTitle: Wavefront-tilt Correction of Laser Pulses by Angular Dispersion Management
abstract: A new diagnostic has been tested to visualise pulse-front-tilt in ultrashort laser pulses. Dispersive mediums were rotationally controlled in an automated feedback loop in accordance to the diagnostic to successfully minimise existing angular dispersion.

articleTitle: Quantum-Coherent Light-Electron Interaction in an SEM
abstract: Quantum-coherent light-free-electron interaction was shown more than a decade ago in a transmission electron microscope leading to a variety of applications. We now show the quantum-coherent interaction in a scanning electron microscope, offering substantial advantages over TEMs.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Temporal Talbot Effect of Dark Pulse Trains
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the temporal Talbot effect of optical dark pulse trains in frequency combs. It features a mixed pattern of dark and bright pulses at positions of higher-order fractional self-imaging.

articleTitle: Second-Harmonic Generation from Metasurfaces with Spatially Engineered Nonlinearity
abstract: We demonstrate resonant metasurfaces with spatiallly engineered nonlinearity based on periodically poled lithium niobate. Such spatial control of the nonlinearity unlocks additional degrees of freedom for controlling the properties of second-harmonic radiation from metasurfaces.

articleTitle: Inference and Gradient Measurement for Backpropagation in Photonic Neural Networks
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate in situ backpropagation in a programmable nanophotonic interferometer network, achieving inference accuracies matching digital implementations. Error gradients are computed by simultaneously measuring optical interference at intermediate network components, eliminating expensive digital computations.

articleTitle: Humidity- and Temperature- Stimuli-Responsive Tunable Metal-Hydrogel-Metal Reflective Filter
abstract: Our work demonstrates a tunable reflectance filter based on a metal-hydrogelmetal structure responsive to humidity and temperature. The filter employs a hydrogel as an insulating layer. Swelling/deswelling and the volume phase transition of the hydrogel allow continuous reversible humidity- and/or temperature-induced tuning of the optical resonance.

articleTitle: A Single-Photon-Sensitivity Spectrometer Based on Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a single-photon-sensitivity spectrometer based on metasurfaces and superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors with 1.5% ~ 9.5% total detection efficiency at 1100 nm ~ 1700 nm.

articleTitle: Broadband achromatic metalens design based on artificial neural network
abstract: We used the backpropagation neural network to design a high performance achromatic metalens at visible range. Experimental demonstration showed that the fabricated achromatic metalens can operate from 420 to 640 nm without the polarization dependence.

articleTitle: Passive 1×32 Multiplexer with 200GHz Channel Spacing in Silicon Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate passive 1×32 (de)multiplexers with 200GHz channel spacing that matches the ITU grid in the C and L bands. A flat-top 120GHz-wide 1dB passband, channel-to-channel crosstalk of <−30dB, and ~2.5dB insertion loss is measured.

articleTitle: Super-resolution magnetic imaging of magnetic nanoparticles with charge state depletion of nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond
abstract: We have used a method called Charge State Depletion (CSD) microscopy with Nitrogen-Vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to perform fluorescence microscopy beyond the diffraction limit. Combined with Optically Detected Magnetic Resonance (ODMR) measurements on NV centers in a layer near the diamond surface, this enables super-resolution magnetic microscopy of ~30 nm ferromagnetic nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging via Deep Learning with Adversarial Training
abstract: We present deep learning with adversarial training for video compressive imaging, which can recover 50 frames from a snapshot with boosted visual quality compared to typical iterative algorithm and neural network with simple loss function.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr soliton induced by intermodal cascaded stimulated Brillouin scattering in graded-index multimode fiber Fabry-Pérot microresonators
abstract: We demonstrate the first intermodal cascaded SBS up to three orders and corresponding Brillouin-Kerr soliton microcombs in a multimode fiber FP microresonator, along with the coexisting Raman combs and Turing pattern for the pump mode.

articleTitle: Broadband Tunable Electro-Optic Switch in Integrated Lithium Niobate Waveguide Circuits
abstract: We report a fast optical switch in LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> photonic-circuit chip integrating an electro-optic (EO) polarization-mode converter and a broadband adiabatic polarizing-beam splitter. The device features high EO switching efficiency (~95%) and broadband (>100 nm) tunability.

articleTitle: Data-driven Optical Fiber Channel Modeling Using Fourier Neural Operator
abstract: We utilize Fourier neural operator to accurately model a 1200km optical fiber channel. It can achieve similar performance compared with SSFM, while with lower computational complexity (the running time is reduced from 30s to 0.09s).

articleTitle: Optical-terahertz conversion in graphene meta-cavities
abstract: We report an experimental study of optical parametric conversion from an ultrafast laser to terahertz waves in graphene meta-cavities. This enables terahertz transmission enhancement up to 46.5%, with optical response delay < 10ps.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of quantum cascade lasers, detectors and active waveguides
abstract: Opto-electronic integration in the mid-infrared may unlock new implementations of miniaturized imaging and sensing systems. We demonstrate a small mid-infrared system composed of a laser, bus waveguide and photodetectors fabricated on a single conventional quantum cascade laser wafer.

articleTitle: Native Waveguide Light Emitting Diodes in Silicon Electronic-Photonic Platforms
abstract: We demonstrate electrically driven, native silicon waveguide LEDs in silicon photonic fabrication processes. The emission wavelength is centered at 1130 nm and the optical power is >100 pW, allowing for on-chip detection of the generated light.

articleTitle: Integrated III-V/Lithium Niobate Nonlinear Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a narrow linewidth integrated nonlinear laser with both fine and coarse tunability based on electro-optic and thermo-optic effect respectively, as well as an intracavity frequency doubling capability via second-harmonic generation.

articleTitle: High brightness single photon source at the telecom wavelength based on inhibited-coupling hollow-core fiber
abstract: We report on a Raman-free heralded single-photon source based on xenon-filled hollowcore fiber pumped with GHz-repetition rate femtosecond laser. The measured brightness of 720 kHz is one order of magnitude improvement over our previous demonstration.

articleTitle: Giant Nonlinear Optical Response in VS2/Ti3C2 MXene Nanohybrid
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically demonstrate giant excited-state absorption and positive nonlinear refractive index in VS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/MXene nanohybrid for fs pulses. The hallmark result is attributed to direct charge transfer, and a benchmark optical limiter is fabricated.

articleTitle: Visualizing exciton coupling dynamics in transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures in space and time
abstract: We demonstrate coherent coupling between excitons in a MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure, as well as rapid interlayer electron and hole transfer. We visualize the spatial homogeneity of the coupling in the presence of significant sample inhomogeneities.

articleTitle: Memristor with optically tunable dynamics
abstract: We demonstrate an electro-optical memristor capable of volatile and non-volatile operation. For the first time, we show control over the switching dynamics using a global optical signal, effectively mimicking neuromodulatory processes in the human brain.

articleTitle: Long-range photodetection of organic exciton-polaritons
abstract: In light-matter strong coupling regime, we observe long-range photodetection response at room temperature mediated by organic exciton-polaritons, which results from strong interactions between organic excitons and low-loss Bloch surface wave (BSW) modes.

articleTitle: A temperature compensation method of FBG based on OFDR fiber sensing system
abstract: In order to obtain the strain data excluding the influence of the ambient temperature, a new temperature compensation method of 30-80°C is realized when the external stress is less than 10000pe in this paper.

articleTitle: Coherent stacking of 128 pulses amplified in the large nonlinear regime with pre-amplitude modulation
abstract: We numerically demonstrate a coherent pulse stacking of 128 pulses amplified in the large nonlinear amplification regime.

articleTitle: Tunable mid-infrared frequency combs from nanophotonic parametric oscillators
abstract: We demonstrate mid-infrared frequency combs from synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillators in nanophotonic lithium niobate at 19 GHz. With a picosecond pump at ~1 µm, the output can be tuned between 1.5 and 3.3 µm supporting sub-picosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Focusing free-electron radiation with source-embedded metalenses
abstract: We experimentally study simultaneous generation and focusing of free-electron radiation by a metalens, and explore theoretically metasurface lenses showing polarization control. Our work paves the way towards versatile and tunable free-electron metasurface light sources.

articleTitle: Long-term stable OPCPA-based seed laser for high intensity Ti:Sapphire LPA drivers
abstract: Ultrafast laser pulses featuring both, high spatio-temporal beam quality and excellent long-term stability are crucial for many applications. Here, we present a collinear OPCPA-based seed laser for 100 TW-class laser systems, that has been designed to fulfil the particularly strict demands presented by laser-plasma acceleration.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Cross-Correlation of Counter-Propagating Pulses in a Disordered Nonlinear Crystal
abstract: Single-shot acquisition of the cross-correlation between two counterpropagating short pulses is demonstrated over 150 ps using sum-frequency generation in an SBN61 crystal with random ferroelectric domains, revealing the jitter between two laser systems.

articleTitle: Ultrafast-Laser-Inscribed Type-II Waveguides in IG2: Self-Organized Morphology and Waveguiding Properties
abstract: We report the ultrafast-laser inscription of type-II waveguides in the IG2 chalcogenide glass, focusing on the self-organized morphology within the tracks and the waveguiding properties over a large range of writing parameters.

articleTitle: Efficient Third-harmonic Generation Control with Ultrathin Dielectric Geometric-phase Metasurface
abstract: Efficient third-harmonic generation control is theoretically studied. Dielectric nanostructures placed on the metallic substrate could offer effective geometric-phase modulation on third-harmonic signals by selecting proper structure rotational symmetry.

articleTitle: Diffraction-free propagation of terahertz spoof surface plasmon polaritons on metasurfaces with hyperbolic dispersion
abstract: We report the implementation of metasurfaces with hyperbolic dispersion that route propagating terahertz spoof surface-plasmon polaritons on highly confined, almost diffraction-free signal paths. We also tuned their propagation angle by adjusting the hyperbolic isofrequency contour.

articleTitle: Dual Channel High Power OPCPA System for 3-photon In-Vivo Brain Imaging
abstract: A compact high power OPCPA system with two output channels at 1300 nm and 1700 nm and ultrashort pulses is presented for 3-photon in-vivo brain imaging with repetition rates of up to 4MHz.

articleTitle: Power-efficient soliton microcombs in anomalous-dispersion photonic molecules
abstract: We demonstrate a microcomb with power conversion efficiency exceeding 50%. It originates from a single dissipative Kerr soliton circulating in an anomalous-dispersion microresonator whose pump resonance is shifted through linear coupling with an auxiliary cavity.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral image classification via integrated metasystem
abstract: On silicon photonic platform, we demonstrate a spatial-spectral pattern classifier and a three-channel wavelength demultiplexer in few-layer metasystems.

articleTitle: Scalable two-dimensional photonic phased array with compact and ultralow power resonator phase shifters
abstract: We demonstrate two-dimensional silicon photonic phased arrays with compact ultralow power microresonator phase-shifters within the array. Each phase-shifter consumes an average ~100 µW static power for resonance alignment, and ~25 µW power for far field beamforming.

articleTitle: Synchronization of a Terawatt Yb laser and TiSa laser at a fs-level for ultrafast dynamics experiments
abstract: We report on a 1.2 Terawatt Ytterbium laser delivering 515mJ with 435fs pulse duration at 50Hz repetition rate, electronically synchronized with a 4mJ 100fs 1kHz Ti:Sa laser with as low jitter as 3.2fs rms.

articleTitle: Space Frequency-Comb for In-Orbit-Demonstration in Low-Earth-Orbit
abstract: We present a compact, radiation tolerant, space frequency comb that is scheduled for an in-orbit-demonstration in low-earth-orbit with a launch in 2024.

articleTitle: Environmental sensing by the propagation of structured light through turbulence channel
abstract: OAM beams are distorted by changes in weather as they propagate through air. We demonstrate an experimental measurement system that identifies weather conditions with 99.6% accuracy in 12 seconds, considerably faster than traditional scintillometer approaches.

articleTitle: Time Programmable Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrate a programmable optical frequency comb that emits coherent pulses with user-specified time and phase at sub-10 attosecond accuracy while maintaining the underlying referenced stability characteristic of combs.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinear optics of noncollinearly arranged plasmonic Au nanorod dimer structure
abstract: Second-order nonlinear optics was studied about noncollinearly arranged dimeric Au nanorods. The efficient SHG conversions were attributed to noncentro-symmetrically distributed, intense near-fields at nanogap. The roles of the asymmetry on the nonlinearities will be discussed.

articleTitle: Spatially Homogeneous Few-cycle Compression of Yb Lasers Via All-solid-state Free-space Soliton Management
abstract: A predictive method for all-solid-state high-quality pulse compression is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The 170 fs pulses from a Yb:KGW laser is compressed to ~9.2 fs with a highly spatially homogeneous mode and a high efficiency of >50%.

articleTitle: Valley-polarized Hyperbolic-Exciton-Polaritons in 2D Semiconductors
abstract: In this work, we predict the existence of hyperbolic-exciton-polaritons (HEPs) in 2D semiconductors of transition-metal-dichalcogenides (TMDs) at visible frequencies. We show that hyperbolicity can be induced in the layered material owing to the behavior of the excitons supported by the TMD, therefore leading to the existence of HEPs. We derive the HEPs dispersion relation, analyzing their confinement and loss properties and finding the HEPs’ wavelengths are about two orders of magnitude smaller than the corresponding free-space wavelength. Furthermore, we show that the existing HEPs are coupled to the valley degree-of-freedom, leading to a hyperbolic spin-valley hall effect.

articleTitle: Cd1−xMnxTe as a magneto-optical material for miniaturized optical isolators: A broad-range spectroscopic analysis of relevant optical properties
abstract: We show wavelength-dependent measurements of Verdet constants and reflection/transmission values for various stoichiometric ratios of Cd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Te. From the data we derive absorption coefficients that help to design optical isolators for GaAs-based diode lasers.

articleTitle: Low Noise Coherently Synthesized Two-Color Electro-Optic Frequency Comb
abstract: A coherently synthesized two-color EO comb is generated by modulating two CW lasers with common EO modulators. The comb has the feature of low noise due to suppression of accumulated phase noise from RF synthesizer.

articleTitle: Design and protocol of a spin-optomechanical quantum repeater
abstract: Quantum repeaters require long-lived quantum memories interfaced with telecom-wavelength fiber optics. We design a tapered diamond optomechanical cavity mechanically coupled to a Group IV spin and propose its operation in heralded quantum entanglement.

articleTitle: Measuring Optical Chirality with Unpolarised Light
abstract: We measure optical chirality within an apparatus for demonstrating the Bell inequality. This differs from current polarimetry as it enables the measurement of optical activity with unpolarised light.

articleTitle: RF signal processing by photonic-assisted coherent control of acoustic wave interference
abstract: We report coherent control of the acoustic wave interference effects via stimulated Brillouin scattering on a silicon photonic chip. This acoustic wave interference enables RF signal amplification and cancellation on the hybrid photonic-phononic system.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integration of Si3N4 Ring Resonator and On-Chip Fourier Transform Spectrometer for The Lab-On-A-Chip Biosensor
abstract: We demonstrated the monolithically integrated biosensor with micro-ring-resonator (MRR) and spatial-heterodyne Fourier-transform-spectrometer (SH-FTS) on Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-on-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, substituting the external optical spectrum analyzer. The spectrum is retrieved from SH-FTS with the bulk sensitivity of 42.9 nm/RIU.

articleTitle: A diffuse photon-counting LiDAR for optical characterization of glacier ice
abstract: We present a portable photon-counting LiDAR that uses a bistatic geometry to measure pulse broadening in the multiple-scattering regime. A diffusion model allows us to extract optical scattering and absorption coefficients of glacier ice.

articleTitle: Kilowatt-peak-power Green Pulse Delivery over Hundred-meter Scale Lengths of Hollow-Core Fiber
abstract: We report on the delivery of kilowatt-peak-power and watt-average-power green laser pulses through single-ring hollow-core fibers up to 300-m-long. The delivered beams are near-diffraction limited with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> factor <1.1.

articleTitle: High sensitivity distributed fiber optic sensing using Brillouin lasing
abstract: We present a distributed Brillouin fiber sensor that operates by exciting a series of lasing modes via periodic Brillouin amplification. The high-intensity, narrow-linewidth lasing modes enable precise measurements of the Brillouin frequency along the fiber.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Characterization of Baria-Silicate ErbiumDoped Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We present a baria-silicate erbium-doped fiber, fabricated using solution-doping technique, with 3 mol% BaO concentration. The fiber displays a low background loss (<10 dB/km at 1200 nm) and is used in an extended L-band amplifier.

articleTitle: Image Differentiation with Incoherent Light Using Angle-Sensitive Plasmonic Photodetectors
abstract: We use specially designed plasmonic photodetectors to develop a new method for image differentiation that can produce edge-enhanced images without external optical elements and under incoherent illumination, unlike traditional optical spatial filters.

articleTitle: On-chip Channel Conductance based Modulation of Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton Interconnects
abstract: Signal-modulation of a spoof surface plasmon polarition interconnect is attained by controlling the channel conductance of a transistor incorporated in the metallic grove. Amplitude modulation of SSPP signal has been analytically derived and numerically verified.

articleTitle: Single photon emission from waveguide-integrated color centers in silicon
abstract: We demonstrate silicon color centers coupled to foundry-compatible silicon waveguides. We produced G-centers via carbon implantation in commercial silicon-on-insulator waveguides and measure through-waveguide single-photon emission in the telecommunications O-band.

articleTitle: 120-fs Pulse Generation and Single-Pulse Trapping of Stretched-Pulse Solitons in Fiber Kerr Resonators
abstract: Stretched-pulse solitons are generated with record-short 120-fs duration. Stretched-pulse soliton trapping is demonstrated despite large intra-cavity dynamics, enabling controllable single-pulse performance. Theoretical predictions in excellent agreement with experiments provide insight and suggest opportunities for enhancement.

articleTitle: Predicting the Surface Topography of Stainless Steel Cut by Fibre Laser via Deep Learning
abstract: Predicting target material topography resulting from fibre laser cutting is challenging. We show that deep learning offers a data-driven capability for predicting the topography of 2mm thick laser machined stainless steel for different cutting speeds.

articleTitle: Realization of topological complex-energy braids and knots of non-Hermitian bands
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate topologically nontrivial braids and knots formed by complex band energies of non-Hermitian systems in a synthetic frequency dimension implemented by two coupled optical ring resonators undergoing dynamic modulations.

articleTitle: Strong exciton-photon-spin coupling in a van der Waals antiferromagnet
abstract: A hitherto unobserved three-body coupled composite of excitons, photons and spins is created by strong light-matter coupling in a van der Waals magnetic insulator hosting spin-correlated excitonic excitations [1].

articleTitle: A compact dual-comb fiber laser based on a mechanical sharing cavity configuration
abstract: We demonstrate a compact, mechanical-sharing dual-comb fiber laser based on an all-polarization-maintaining configuration and a micro-optic-component of saturable absorber mirror. This setup realizes a high relative stability with a standard deviation of 0.6 Hz.

articleTitle: Time Domain Modeling of Inhomogeneous Broadening in Nonlinear Optics
abstract: Currently, only material models with homogeneous broadening are implemented in time domain computational photonics, while modeling inhomogeneous broadening remains a challenge. We present an efficient approach to time-domain modeling of Gauss-Lorentz absorption in linear/nonlinear materials.

articleTitle: Light-Controlled Switching in Electro-Optical Memristors
abstract: We demonstrate a new concept in an electro-optical memristor where a global light stimulus induces non-volatile conductance changes. The optical signal acts as a third, independent stimulation channel, similar to neuromodulators in three-factor learning rules.

articleTitle: SNR Enhanced Coherent-Lite Transmission Using an Intensity-Noise-Suppressed ASE Source
abstract: We experimentally transmit 10-Gbaud 64QAM signal over 300-m duplex fiber using an intensity-noise-suppressed ASE source in self-homodyne coherent detection (SHCD). ASE-based SHCD outperforms ECL-based system at medium-to-low OSNR region benefiting from spectral expansion.

articleTitle: Extreme UV Spectral Broadening in Hollow Core Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate extreme spectral broadening of third harmonic pulses from a 35-fs Ti:Sapphire laser using cross-phase modulation with the fundamental in Neon filled hollow core fibers. The potential for high energy sub-2-fs UV-pulses is explored.

articleTitle: Wideband Ultra-Flat Spectral Enhancement by Cascaded Phase Modulation on Frequency Comb Generated from Mach-Zehnder Modulator
abstract: We demonstrated efficient spectral enhancement of comb generator where cascaded phase-modulation was applied to comb generated from Mach-Zehnder Modulator; additionally enhancing spectra keeping spectral flatness without increasing modulators cascade scale. 25×25-GHz spectrum was experimentally generated.

articleTitle: On-Chip Carrier-Envelope Phase Scanner
abstract: We performed an on-air measurement of CEP spatial distribution of focused few-cycle laser oscillator beam. The on-chip probe exploits the CEP sensitivity of electric currents in dielectrics exposed to the strong field.

articleTitle: Towards Continuous Wave, Single Mode, Surface-Emitting Laser at 24μm
abstract: A surface emitting, single mode laser at 24μm is presented, based on InGaAs/AlInAs system. Processed into a metal-metal device and employing planarization technology, heat dissipation can be improved on the way to continuous wave operation.

articleTitle: Magnetic-Field Tuning of Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic tuning of dielectric optical metasurfaces infiltrated with liquid crystals using external magnetic field. We show that our approach does not require pre-alignment and refractive index of liquid crystal can be dynamically changed.

articleTitle: Electronic Control of Soliton Self-Mode Conversion
abstract: We demonstrate control of soliton self-mode conversion - a process capable of producing energetic ultrashort pulses - solely by chirping the pump, yielding nearly constant pulse energy, transform-limited sub-100-fs pulses in the 1000-1300 nm range.

articleTitle: High-resolution hyperspectral imaging including amplitude and phase spectra using chirped optical frequency comb
abstract: We developed high-resolution hyperspectral imaging using a chirped optical frequency comb. Precise all-optical processing with the comb enables simultaneous amplitude and phase of ultrashort pulse. A 100-nm spectral range with a 1.8-nm resolution was demonstrated.

articleTitle: The ELI-ALPS MIR-HE laser system - design and status
abstract: We report the design for a high-power optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier (OPCPA) at 3200 nm central wavelength for the MIR-HE laser at ELI-ALPS, aiming to provide 20 mJ pulse energy and sub-2.5 cycles pulse length.

articleTitle: 3D Camera using a Single Layer of Microlens Array and a Learned Reconstruction Algorithm
abstract: We demonstrate a 3D camera using a single layer of microlens array and a learned reconstruction algorithm through physics-aware neural networks. The camera can resolve objects at different distances from a single exposure.

articleTitle: Chiral-Symmetric Higher-Order Topological Phases Protected by Multipole Winding Number Invariants
abstract: We introduce novel higher-order topological phases in chiral-symmetric sys-tems protected by multipole winding numbers, bulk integer topological invariants that can yield multiple topological states per corner.

articleTitle: 1760 nm Multi-Watt Broadband PM Tm-doped Fiber Amplifier
abstract: We report the performance of a CW single-clad PM Tm-doped fiber amplifier optimized for the wavelength band from 1760 to 1960 nm. Output powers as high as 3 W and an OSNR > 55 dB/0.1 nm are achieved with our OEM packaged amplifier.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystals with Split Ring Unit Cells for Subwavelength Light Confinement
abstract: We report a split ring photonic crystal that demonstrates an order of magnitude larger peak energy density compared to traditional photonic crystals. The split ring offers highly focused optical energy in an accessible subwavelength gap.

articleTitle: Program-controlled generation and stabilization of single soliton in a Si3N4 micro-resonator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate program-controlled single-soliton generation in a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> micro-resonator assisted by an auxiliary laser. A feedback control method is employed to enhance the stability of the single soliton.

articleTitle: Fiber Sensing Using Higher-Order Spatial Modes and the Orbital Angular Momentum of Light
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber sensor, based on optical orbital angular momentum (OAM), for measuring temperature. Two higher-order modes in polarization maintaining fiber are combined to produce OAM that varies with phase between the modes.

articleTitle: 1D Beam Steering by a Waveguide-Integrated MEMS Cantilever in the Visible Spectrum
abstract: We demonstrate one-dimensional beam steering in the visible spectrum using an electro-thermally actuated waveguide-integrated MEMS cantilever. A 24° scan range, 29 mW power consumption, and resonant scan rate of 4.74kHz were achieved at a fixed wavelength.

articleTitle: Computable limits of optical multiple-access communications
abstract: We model the optical networks as interference multiple-access channels, place computable limits on the capacity region, and evaluate the ultimate entanglement-assisted capacity of total rate. Entanglement is shown to provide strict rate-region advantages [1].

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Process for Mode-Orthogonal MEMS-Tunable Photonic Devices
abstract: We report a silicon-photonics process for MEMS-tunable phase shifters that leverages orthogonal optical modes. A phase shifter with -0.63dB insertion loss and π phase shift and a preliminary tunable directional coupler are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pre-Compensating the Shifted Power-to-Bias Response of Si Waveguide Modulator Induced by High-Speed Encoding
abstract: The shifted power-to-voltage response and reduced on/off extinction ratio observed in uncooled Si waveguide intensity modulator can be pre-compensated with offsetting the DC bias to recover the bit-error-ratio from 8.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> to 9.4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> under 60-Gbit/s NRZ-OOK.

articleTitle: Tunable lasers by optical parametric oscillation in photonic-crystal resonators
abstract: We demonstrate laser-wavelength access by design of optical parametric oscillation in photonic crystal resonators. Our experiments and theoretical modeling elucidate coupled bidirectional oscillation that we can jointly optimize for wavelength tuning and efficiency.
